rows.original: [dayNight|Eirina, captain of the Astrida, is present on the temple floor today. The tall, broad-shouldered warrior-woman walks amongst the clergy, and men and women bow their heads reverentially to her wherever she goes, leaving her to just smile awkwardly and try to offer words of encouragement to the scholar-priests that so clearly hold her up on a divine pedestal.|Eirina is kneeling in front of the grand Narevan statue, now that the temple has fallen quiet for the night, hands wrapped around the haft of her spear and head bowed in prayer to the goddess.]
rows.translation: [dayNight|今天，阿斯特丽达的队长艾瑞娜正在神殿大厅里。这个身材高大、肩膀宽阔的女战士在神职人员之间穿行；无论走到哪里，男女信徒都会虔敬地向她低头行礼，把她奉若站上了神圣高台，只留下她尴尬地微笑，努力对这些学者祭司说些鼓励的话。|夜深后，神殿安静下来。艾瑞娜跪在宏伟的纳瑞瓦神像前，双手环握长矛的矛杆，垂首向女神祈祷。]
rows.raw: "\n\n[dayNight|Eirina, captain of the Astrida, is present on the temple floor today. The tall, broad-shouldered warrior-woman walks amongst the clergy, and men and women bow their heads reverentially to her wherever she goes, leaving her to just smile awkwardly and try to offer words of encouragement to the scholar-priests that so clearly hold her up on a divine pedestal.|Eirina is kneeling in front of the grand Narevan statue, now that the temple has fallen quiet for the night, hands wrapped around the haft of her spear and head bowed in prayer to the goddess.]"

rows.original: Go and speak to the First Spear of the Order.
rows.translation: 去和教团的首席长矛手交谈。
rows.raw: "Go and speak to the First Spear of the Order. "

rows.original:
You've barely stepped into the temple before a pair of black-scaled salamanders, clad in imposing suits of field armor and carrying bladed staves, approach you. "Champion. Lady Eirina wishes to speak with you. Follow us."
    
    Their tone brooks no argument. 
    
    You're lead out of the familiar sanctuary and through a brass-reinforced door, through a descending stone passage, and into another chamber guarded by another pair of Astrida at its entrance. The door has a silver ouroboros nailed into it, surrounded by interlocking [pc.isMage
        |warding runes, circles within circles of protective magic that would have taken even an archmage years to craft in such exacting detail
        |magic circles
    ]. 
    
    When you step inside, you're greeting by Ynes stretching over a stone slab table, heart-shaped ass thrust out at you while she shuffles through an enormous black-bound tome. Eirina is sitting on the table's edge beside her, using her tail-flame like a lantern while her thrall works through the pages. "Ah, there [pc.heShe] is!" the black-scale says, giving you a two-fingered wave. "[pc.name], come in. Welcome to the Order's stronghold."
    
    You glance around the stone-walled room, with its one big table, and walls covered with hanging shields and banners all displaying the same silver ouroboros. There are three other doors, all with the same sort of runic pattern on them, along with the one you just stepped through all precisely facing the cardinal directions. The sanctum of the world's greatest mage-hunters is less imposing, and more... [silly
        |OCD
        |cold? Sterile. Every little thing in its place
    ]. 
    
    "Not much to look at, I know. We barely use the place." Eirina gestures to the tome Ynes is busy with. "Just a place to hold things that shouldn't be out in the world. Most of the year you'd barely see more than two Astrida here at a time. But this demon business has me worried enough to recall my sisters. And then there's whatever's wrong with Kythie..."
rows.translation:
你刚踏进神殿，两名黑鳞蝾螈人就朝你走来，他们身着威风凛凛的野战铠甲，手持带刃的长杖。“冠军。艾瑞娜女士想跟你谈谈。跟我们走。”
    
    他们的语气不容置疑。 
    
    你被带出那座熟悉的圣所，穿过一扇黄铜加固的门，走过一段向下的石砌通道，进入另一间厅室——门口由另外两名阿斯特里达把守。门上钉着一枚银色衔尾蛇，周围环绕着彼此交扣的[pc.isMage
        |防护符文，层层相套的护佑法阵，如此精密的细节，就算是大法师也得花上好几年才能绘制出来
        |魔法阵
    ]。 
    
    你走进去时，迎接你的是俯身在石板桌前伸懒腰的伊内斯，她那心形的屁股正对着你翘起，同时翻动着巨大黑皮封面的书卷。艾瑞娜坐在桌沿她身旁，用尾焰当提灯，照着她的奴仆翻阅书页。“啊，[pc.heShe]来了！”黑鳞蝾螈人说，用两根手指朝你挥了挥。“[pc.name]，进来吧。欢迎来到教团的堡垒。”
    
    你环顾这间石墙房间，里面只有一张大桌子，墙上挂满盾牌和旗帜，全都绘着同样的银色衔尾蛇。另外还有三扇门，上面都刻着同一类符文图案，加上你刚走进来的那扇，正好精确地朝向四方。这座世上最伟大的猎法师组织的圣堂，看上去并不怎么威严，反而更……[silly
        |像强迫症
        |冷清？死板。每样小东西都各归其位
    ]。 
    
    “我知道，没什么好看的。这地方我们几乎不用。”艾瑞娜朝伊内斯正忙着的那本书卷比了比。“只是个用来存放不该流落到世上的东西的地方。一年里大半时间，你在这儿最多也就见到两个阿斯特里达。但这次恶魔的事让我担心到把姐妹们全都召了回来。再加上凯西那边出的状况……”

rows.correctionNote: business 在此为事务、勾当之意，译作商业有误。

rows.original: What does Eirina know about your "demon business" exactly?
rows.translation: 艾瑞娜究竟了解你那些“恶魔勾当”的哪些细节呢？
rows.raw: 'What does Eirina know about your "demon business" exactly?'
rows.correctionNote: "demon business" 被译成与恶魔无关的“秘密行动”，丢失原意。

rows.original: Maybe she can explain the Order's lack of involvement in this investigation?
rows.translation: 也许她能够解释一下教团为什么没有参与这次调查呢？
rows.raw: "Maybe she can explain the Order's lack of involvement in this investigation?"
rows.correctionNote: the Order 指阿斯特里达教团（Order Astrida→阿斯特里达教团），“秩序组织”为字面误译。

rows.original: Delve a little deeper into the assassin himself.
rows.translation: 让我们更深入地了解一下这位刺客本人吧。
rows.raw: "Delve a little deeper into the assassin himself."

rows.original: So what's the story with the two of them? They seem a little closer than just mistress and slave.
rows.translation: 那么他们俩之间到底有什么故事呢？他们的关系似乎比单纯的主人与仆从要亲密一些。
rows.raw: "So what's the story with the two of them? They seem a little closer than just mistress and slave."

rows.original: So how did Ynes get dragged into this anyway?
rows.translation: 那么，伊内斯究竟是怎么卷入这件事中的呢？
rows.raw: "So how did Ynes get dragged into this anyway?"

rows.correctionNote: 指雇凶者的幕后主使（对应提示“Does the Astrida have any suspects?”），非“刺客大师”。

rows.original: Does the Astrida have any suspects?
rows.translation: 阿斯特里达有没有任何嫌疑犯呢？

rows.original: Was there anything else the girls wanted?
rows.translation: 女孩们还想要些什么吗？
rows.raw: "Was there anything else the girls wanted?"

rows.original: Eirina flashes you a fang-toothed grin. "We know enough. [var0 |Normally I'm glad we Astrida are few in number, but with what's going on in Khor'minos, I wish the goddess had given me an army! Still, we mean to do what we can. We've killed several demons crossing the Greyvales. I doubt we'll see an end to that with the war on. |I'm very sad we didn't meet before you had a chance to drive a dagger into the demon horde's heart — because me saying how proud I am of your work doesn't mean much. I've had my hands full killing demons crossing the Greyvales, stragglers and spies alike, but I've watched your career from afar with great interest. |There have been reports of strange individuals in the Greyvale Mountains. A local cult, proclaiming that their Dark Queen has finally come. The Order has been aware of their existence since the Massacre of Hawkethorne almost two decades ago, but now they've gone from local rumor to active destabilization. ] Every sister I have to spare is withdrawing to Tychris as we speak to help deal with the problem. But we're spread far and wide, and it's taking time." "Have any of you actually seen Kasyrra?" "Their Dark Queen herself? No. But we've captured some cultists who have." Ynes adds, "They were most forthcoming. It was difficult to stop their rambling about her." "Yeah," Eirina nods. "Rare for an interrogation to feel so much like a sermon. They're certified whack-jobs, to the man."
rows.translation: 艾瑞娜向你露出一个露着獠牙的微笑：“我们已经掌握了足够的信息。 [var0 |通常来说，我挺高兴我们阿斯特里达一族的人数并不多，但考虑到科尔米诺斯发生的那些事情，我真希望那位女神能赐予我一支军队！不过，我们还是会尽自己所能。我们已经消灭了几只在灰谷地区活动的恶魔。不过，既然战争还在继续，我觉得这种战斗恐怕永远也不会结束。 |我是非常真遗憾我们在你有机会直击恶魔军团的要害之前就没有相识——因为我说自己对你的成就感到多么自豪，其实并没有什么实际意义。这些年来，我一直在忙于消灭那些穿越灰谷的恶魔，无论是那些散落的敌军还是间谍，但我一直都非常关注你的发展历程。 |有报道称，在灰谷山脉出现了一些行为古怪的个体。一个当地邪教组织宣称，他们的“黑暗女王”终于降临了。自从近二十年前鹰棘镇大屠杀之后，圣殿骑士团就已经知道这个邪教的存在了，但现在，他们已经从仅仅是一些地方性的谣言，发展成了威胁社会稳定的活跃势力。 ] 目前，我们所有能够抽调出来的姐妹都在前往提克里斯地区，以协助解决这个问题。不过我们分散在各个地方，因此需要一些时间才能集结完毕。” “你们当中有没有人真正看到过卡希拉？” “他们的暗影女王本人？不。但我们抓到了一些崇拜她的狂热分子。” 伊内斯补充道：“那些人非常配合我们的调查。不过，获取这些信息确实挺困难的。停止他们对她说的那些废话……” “是啊，”艾瑞娜点了点头，“这种审问过程竟然更像是一场说教，真是少见。那个男人，显然是个十足的疯子。

rows.original: "Ah, well, yeah. Tethys has been up my ass like a brothel itch. Not that I blame her." Eirina shifts her weight on the table's edge. "Not that I have kids, or ever will, but I help raise my younger sisters here in the Order. I'd lose my damn mind if something happened to them. But she was actively interfering with our investigation. Making it impossible to get anything done. So we had to cut her out. Not my fault she can't cope with it." Ynes gives her a look. "You could have been a bit more diplomatic." "Well, then we wouldn't have a [pc.mf |[pc.isFemboy |cute |handsome ] |beautiful ] Champion here. And that'd be a shame." "I suppose," Ynes says, rolling her eyes. Eirina turns her attention back to you. "So, yeah, the princess. Poor girl. She's not cursed per se. More like poisoned. It's got a magical, or alchemagical, component, but it's not a spell. And it's not a one-shot either." "What do you mean?" "I mean, we broke the effect on her. One of my sisters did to start with. Then it came back. So I went and did it myself. And I'm the best spellbreaker in the Order, bar none. Whatever's wrong with her isn't sticky, it's not recursive, it's being reapplied. And it tastes like shit, too." The Astrida grimaces. "I had to run out of the palace and puke after I pulled the magic out of her. Was like I was eating raw liver on a bed of dirty ass." "As opposed to clean ass," Ynes says. "Well, yeah. That's a good meal." Eirina slaps her scaly palm down on her thrall's expansive rear, hard enough to make her cheeks wobble. "You really would think rarified horny would taste good." "So do you have any idea who's behind it? And who hired that assassin?" "That's the rub," Eirina says, continuing to caress Ynes's butt until the witch swats her hand away. "The wanna-be sharpshooter was a local boy. A poor farmer's third son. He'd been nabbed for poaching a couple years ago and spent a day in the stockades, but that's the closest to a motive I can put on him. Ynes had never met him before, and he wasn't a regular at the temple. A lot of the farmer-folk go to Velunite churches out in the baronies." "In other words," Ynes says, "he was a total stranger. A nobody."
rows.translation: “啊，好吧，确实是这样。泰西斯一直缠得我不得安生，像妓院里的痒疮一样。倒也不能怪她。”艾瑞娜把身体重心移到桌边。“虽然我并没有孩子，也不打算要孩子，但我在教团里帮忙带大我的妹妹们。要是她们出了什么事，我真会疯掉的。但她一直在干扰我们的调查，导致我们根本无法开展工作。所以我们只好把她排除在外。她无法应对这种情况，这可不是我的错。” 伊内斯看了她一眼：“你本可以更圆滑一点的。” “嗯，那样的话，我们就不会 [pc.mf |[pc.isFemboy |可爱 |英俊的 ] |美丽 ]冠军了。那可太可惜了。” “我想也是吧，”伊内斯说着，翻了个白眼。 艾瑞娜又将注意力转向你：“所以，没错，就是那位公主。可怜的姑娘……她严格来说并不是被诅咒，更像是中毒。其中有魔法——或者说炼金术——的成分，但它不是咒语。而且它也不是一次性的。” “你是什么意思？” “我的意思是，我们解除了她身上的效果。最初是我的一个姐妹这么做的，后来那种效果又重新出现了。于是我就亲自去做了。毫无疑问，我是教团里最出色的解咒师。她身上的问题既不是粘性效应，也不是递归现象，而是被反复施加的。而且那味道简直糟透了……”阿斯特里达皱着眉头说道，“当我把那些魔法从她身上驱除后，我不得不跑出宫殿去呕吐。感觉就像是在一堆脏屁股上吃生肝一样。” “跟干净的屁股比起来是吧，”伊内斯说道。 “嗯，确实。那可是顿美餐。”艾瑞娜将她那布满鳞片的手掌狠狠地拍在仆从那宽大的臀部上，力度大到让她的脸颊都跟着晃动起来。“你确实会以为，稀薄的情欲尝起来应该不错。” “那么，你有没有猜到是谁在背后指使这一切？又是谁雇了那个刺客？” “问题就在这里，”艾瑞娜说道，她继续轻抚伊内斯的臀部，直到女巫一巴掌拍开她的手。“那个想当神枪手的家伙是本地的一个男孩，一个贫穷农民的第三个儿子。几年前他因为偷猎被抓过，在枷架上关了一天，但这也算是我能为他找到的唯一动机了。伊内斯以前从没见过他，而且他也不是那座神殿的常客。诸侯领里很多农户都会去维伦信徒的教堂。” “换句话说，”伊内斯说道，“他只是个彻头彻尾的陌生人。一个无名小卒。”

rows.original: No motive, no connection to the victim, a criminal record and a poor family... "So he was just a hired shot after all." Eirina snaps her fingers. "Exactly. And here's the kicker." The Astrida reaches into her weapon belt and draws out a wood disk. She flicks it to you with a smirk. "The guy got his windfall and immediately rented a red room at the House of Mallach. He paid a bunny-girl with pretty feet to do all sorts of things to him with a whole gold coin." You look at the wooden disk in your palm, completely devoid of inscription. Or value. [pc.isMage |"A glamor, or transmutation?" "Transmutation," Eirina says. "Good thought about the glamor, but that wouldn't pass the touch check for long. |You furrow your brow. "Magic counterfeiting?" "Exactly," Eirina says. " ] This is why we use electrum coins; they're almost impossible to spoof with magic or alchemy. But gold is gold to a whore, I guess, and she was happy to take it. Happier to let me swap it for real hawks after I undid the transmutation. Still, that's real advanced magic. Highly illegal, too." "Far beyond the ability of a grain-fed hick," Ynes adds. "This is the kind of magic that would require decades of dedicated training to master." "More evidence there's a powerful mage behind all this," you say. The girls both nod.
rows.translation: 没有作案动机，与受害者也没有任何关联，还有犯罪前科，家庭条件也很贫困……“所以，他终究只是一个受雇的枪手罢了。” 艾瑞娜打了个响指：“没错。而最关键的一点就在这里。”阿斯特里达从武器带里拿出一个木盘。她带着一丝笑意把东西扔给你：“那个家伙一下子赚了一大笔钱，立刻在马拉赫旅馆租了一间红色的房间。他还付给一个足部趾漂亮的小姑娘一枚金币，让她为自己做各种事情。 你看着掌心中的那块木盘，上面没有任何铭文，也没有任何价值。 [pc.isMage |是一种魅力，还是某种转变呢？” “转变，”艾瑞娜说道，“关于魅力的想法很不错，但那样的变化很快就会被人发现。 |你皱起了眉头：“魔法伪造？” “没错，”艾瑞娜说道。 ] 这就是我们使用琥珀金币的原因：用魔法或炼金术来伪造它们几乎是不可能的。不过，对那个女人来说，黄金就是黄金吧，所以她很乐意接受它。而当我取消那次转化后，她更高兴的是能让我把琥珀金币换成真正的鹰币。不过，无论如何真实的高级魔法。而且也是极其违法的。” “这种魔法远远超出了一个乡下土包子的能力范围，”伊内斯补充道，“要掌握这种魔法，需要花费数十年的时间进行专注的训练。” “这进一步证明了背后肯定有一位强大的法师在操纵这一切，”你说。 两个女孩都点了点头。
rows.raw: ' No motive, no connection to the victim, a criminal record and a poor family... "So he was just a hired shot after all." Eirina snaps her fingers. "Exactly. And here's the kicker." The Astrida reaches into her weapon belt and draws out a wood disk. She flicks it to you with a smirk. "The guy got his windfall and immediately rented a red room at the House of Mallach. He paid a bunny-girl with pretty feet to do all sorts of things to him with a whole gold coin." You look at the wooden disk in your palm, completely devoid of inscription. Or value. [pc.isMage |"A glamor, or transmutation?" "Transmutation," Eirina says. "Good thought about the glamor, but that wouldn't pass the touch check for long. |You furrow your brow. "Magic counterfeiting?" "Exactly," Eirina says. " ] This is why we use electrum coins; they're almost impossible to spoof with magic or alchemy. But gold is gold to a whore, I guess, and she was happy to take it. Happier to let me swap it for real hawks after I undid the transmutation. Still, that's real advanced magic. Highly illegal, too." "Far beyond the ability of a grain-fed hick," Ynes adds. "This is the kind of magic that would require decades of dedicated training to master." "More evidence there's a powerful mage behind all this," you say. The girls both nod. '

rows.original: "Ah, that's harsh. I don't really think of Ynes as a slave," Eirina says, running a claw around her ouroboros pendant. "It is true in the strictest legal sense," Ynes says. She gives her owner a thin smile. "And it's not as though I can just walk off if I wanted to." Eirina groans. "Well, I'm not the one who decided to tattoo restricted magic all over your body, am I? Should have thought of that before you carved Hypercranial Incineration on your underboob! If you were actually a spellbook I'd keep you locked in a lead chest in a deep, dark cell!" "Oh, yes, I'm very glad my cell has a bed, and even a window." Both of them laugh. You can tell this is an argument the two of them have had several times, and neither takes very seriously. Ynes gives you an apologetic look. "We've been friends for years now, Champion. Don't mind us." "See? Friends!" Eirina says. "Just... not necessarily voluntary friends." "Though I think we'd have been friends in other circumstances," Ynes laughs. "If I'd been born a salamander of Tychris, rather than fated to be a dangerous, evil witch." Eirina's smile falters. "Evil is never fate, Ynes. You-" "I know!" Ynes groans, rolling her eyes. "Don't moralize me when I am joking, paladin." "Well don't give me opportunities to preach, witch!" Ynes sticks her tongue out. Eirina mirrors the gesture. This is a very different side of Ynes than she lets on at her desk job.
rows.translation: “啊，这话说得太重了。我并不真的把伊内斯当奴隶看，”艾瑞娜说着，用爪子沿着自己的衔尾蛇吊坠转了一圈。 “从最严格的法律意义上说，这是事实，”伊内斯说。她朝自己的主人挤出一个淡淡的笑。“而且也不是我想走就能一走了之的。” 艾瑞娜呻吟了一声。“好吧，决定把受限魔法纹满你全身的人又不是我，对吧？你在自己乳下刻上超颅腔焚化之前就该想到这一点！你要是真的是本魔法书，我就把你锁在铅箱里，扔进又深又暗的牢房里！” “哦，是啊，我很高兴我的牢房里有张床，甚至还有扇窗。”两人都笑了。你能看出这场争论她们已经吵过好几回，谁都没当真。 伊内斯歉意地看了你一眼。“我们已经是好几年的朋友了，冠军。别在意我们。” “看见没？朋友！”艾瑞娜说。“只是……不一定是自愿的朋友。” “不过我觉得，换个情形我们也会是朋友的，”伊内斯笑道。“如果我生来就是提克里斯的蝾螈人，而不是命中注定要当个危险邪恶的女巫。” 艾瑞娜的笑容一滞。“邪恶从来不是命运，伊内斯。你——” “我知道！”伊内斯翻了个白眼，呻吟道。“我开玩笑的时候别跟我讲大道理，圣骑士。” “那就别给我说教的机会，女巫！” 伊内斯吐了吐舌头。艾瑞娜也做了同样的动作。 这跟伊内斯在办公桌前表现出的那一面大不相同。

rows.original: "I've been wondering that myself!" Ynes pouts. "It started quite a while ago, before the Order was even made aware of Kythie's problem..." "I'm not sure she was even cursed yet. This was right during the Tycathalon's opening week." You nod. "What tipped you off?" "We'd left the city for a bit," Ynes says. "There's a river that flows through the western principality, bringing glacial melt down and feeding the baronial farms' irrigation-" "It was the first anniversary of me being appointed captain of the Order. Ynes made us a picnic, and a pie." Ynes sighs. "Yes, I decided to treat Eiri. After we were done, I took the opportunity to bathe in a waterfall near where we'd eaten. That's when I first noticed somebody watching me, hidden in the brush. I... am not ignorant of my appearance." She shifts her stance, resting the substantial heft of her breasts on the table, and swaying her voluptuous hips. "I assumed at first it was a curious farmboy, and paid it little mind." "Told me you put on a little show," Eirina says with a smirk. "Perhaps I did," Ynes admits. "It is nice to be appreciated. That ended when I heard a quilltip snap. I wasn't just being peeped on, [pc.name]. Someone was trying to copy the runes on my body. I felt helpless: I couldn't cast my spells, and my daggers were out of reach. All I could do was try and hide my body under the water and scream for Eiri." You turn towards the black-scaled salamander. "I'm guessing you didn't catch the perv?" "Ha, no. Would have saved us all a lot of hassle if I was a faster sprinter, huh? By the time I got there, the peeping tomcat was long gone. I found salamander footprints in the dirt, but Ynes didn't catch a glimpse of a flame, and having lizard feet doesn't exactly narrow down the list of suspects in Tychris by a lot." [pc.bg hunter |"The soil should have been pretty soft by a riverbank. Where did the trail lead you?" Eirina grins at you. "You've got a keen sense for these things, huh. You're right, there should have been. Whoever it was knew how to step lightly through the wilderness. |"Was there a trail for you to follow?" "Not for long." Eirina scowls. "He covered his tracks pretty well. ] But it wasn't our assassin here, I can tell you that much. No mage would trust an uneducated farmhand to transcribe arcane runes. One wrong syllable and you could turn your intestines into your out-testines. I'd bet a year's wage the perv is our man." Ynes furrows her brow. "You don't make a wage." "Shhhh. Details."
rows.translation: 我也在想这个问题！”伊内斯撅着嘴说，“这一切其实开始得很早，在‘秩序组织’还不知道凯西遇到的麻烦之前……” “我甚至不确定她当时是否真的被诅咒了。这件事发生的时候，正是泰卡塔隆节开幕的第一周。你点了点头，问道：“是什么让你察觉到这个的？” “我们之前离开城市一段时间，”伊内斯说道，“有一条河流流经西部的公国，它带来了冰川融水，为那些男爵们的农场提供了灌溉用水—— 那天正好是我被任命为‘秩序’组织队长的第一周年纪念日。伊内斯为我们准备了一场野餐，还做了一个派。” 伊内斯叹了口气：“是啊，我决定好好犒劳一下艾莉。饭后，我趁机在我们用餐的地方附近的一处瀑布边沐浴了一会儿。就在那时，我第一次注意到有人躲在灌木丛中注视着我。我……当然清楚自己的外貌。她调整了自己的姿势，将丰满的胸部倚在桌子上，同时摇摆着她那性感的臀部。起初，我以为他只是个好奇的农家男孩，所以并没有太在意他。我你刚才表演得还挺不错的呢，”艾瑞娜带着一丝笑意说道。 “也许吧，”伊内斯承认道，“被人认可的感觉确实很好。不过，当我听到羽毛笔折断的声音时，那种感觉就结束了——原来不只是有人在偷看我。 [pc.name]有人试图复制我身上的符文。我感到无能为力：既不能施展法术，手中的匕首也够不着。我只能尽量躲在水下，同时大声呼救埃里。” 你转向那只黑鳞蝾螈问道：“那么，你应该没有抓到那个变态吧？” “哈，没有。要是我跑得更快些，就能为我们省去很多麻烦了，对吧？等我赶到那里的时候，那个偷窥的混蛋早就跑得无影无踪了。我只能蝾螈的足迹虽然伊内斯摔倒在泥地里，但她并没有看到有任何火焰；而且，拥有蜥蜴般的足部并不会让提克里斯的嫌疑人名单缩小多少。 [pc.bg hunter |河岸边的土壤应该会相当松软才对。这条小路最终把你引向了哪里呢？” 艾瑞娜对你笑了笑：“你对这些事情确实很有敏锐的洞察力，哈。你说得对，那里的土壤确实应该会是松软的。不管那个人是谁，他显然懂得如何小心翼翼地穿越那片荒野。. |有没有什么痕迹可以让你追踪呢？” “没有持续太久。”艾瑞娜皱了皱眉头，“他把自己的踪迹掩盖得相当好。 ] 但我可以肯定，那不是我们这里的刺客。没有哪个法师会信任一个没受过教育的农夫来抄写那些神秘的符文——只要一个音节抄错，你的内脏就会立刻变成你的外肠。我敢用一年的工资打赌，那个变态肯定就是我们要找的人。 伊内斯皱起了眉头：“你又没有工资可拿啊。” “嘘……细节嘛，以后再告诉你。

rows.original: "Oh, this?" Ynes taps the titanic tome in front of her. Intentionally or not, her broad hips sway from side to side. "Something from Nareva's own archive. A real privilege to hold. Or, well, behold. I don't think I could lift it if I tried." "The Order's notes say it belonged to a mountain giant," Eirina says. "Which I guess is probably just a jotun living down south? Though it would have been a pocket book to someone that big! It's been down in the dungeon for two hundred years, so the goddess is the only one who knows for sure now." You gesture past the girls. "What's it say?" "That's the question," Ynes says. "This is a book of curses. Apparently its last owner used it to hypnotize young women from a village outside his abode in Callathia, forcing them to become his brides. Any who resisted him, he would afflict with a sort of... lust madness. He meant to erode their will, make them desperate for him-" "After he cursed all the men in the village with impotence." "And let me guess, that got the Astridas' attention?" Eirina nods. "One of our fore-sisters wandered through the region and met a pair of sisters that were, well, in need in more ways than one. She follow the magic to its source, killed an evil giant, got the babes, you know how the story goes. But the spellbook ended up with us — goddess knows how she dragged it all the way to Tychris — and now I've got Ynes trying to see if she can find this lusty curse. This is the only thing in the archive that's even remotely close to what's wrong with Kythie." You nod. "If you learn how that curse works, maybe you can figure out how Kythie's works?" "It's a start," Eirina says. "What's going on with Kythie isn't a spell, but maybe there's some common threads. I want to find whoever's responsible, but maybe we can give the princess some relief in the meantime. It's worth a try."
rows.translation: 哦，这个吗？”伊内斯轻敲着面前那本厚重的典籍。不知是有意还是无意，她那宽大的臀部随之左右摇晃起来。“这是娜瑞瓦自己的档案中的资料。能拿到它，真的是一种荣幸……不过，说真的，我想就算我试着去搬，也搬不动它吧。教团的记录上写着，这东西原本属于一只山巨兽，”艾瑞娜说道，“我想那应该只是生活在南方的某种巨型生物吧？不过对那么大的生物来说，这个东西恐怕只是个小小的口袋而已！它已经在地牢里沉睡了两百年，所以现在只有女神才能确定它的真正来历了。你示意着让那些女孩们离开，然后问道：“上面写了什么？” “这正是问题所在，”伊内斯说道，“这是一本充满诅咒的书。据说它的最后一位主人曾用它来催眠卡拉西亚附近一个村庄里的年轻女子，迫使她们成为他的新娘。任何反抗他的人，他都会用一种……欲望的疯狂来折磨他们。他的目的就是削弱他们的意志，让他们对他产生无法抗拒的渴望—— “在他用这种手段让村里的所有男人都丧失了性功能之后。” “那么，让我猜猜，这件事是不是引起了阿斯特里达斯的注意？艾瑞娜点了点头。“我们的一位前辈曾游历过这个地区，遇到了两位姐妹……嗯，她们需要帮助从很多方面来说都是如此。她追寻魔法的源头，杀死了那个邪恶的巨人，还得到了那些美女，你知道故事的发展过程吧。但那本魔法书最终落在了我们手里——天知道她是怎么把它一路带到了提克里斯的——现在，伊内斯正在试图找出这个令人欲火中烧的诅咒的真相。这是档案中唯一可能与凯西所遭遇的问题有关的线索了。” 你点了点头：“如果你能弄清楚其中的原因那个诅咒确实有效，也许你能弄清楚凯西的那些手段是怎么回事吧？” “这至少是个开始，”艾瑞娜说道，“凯西身上发生的事情并不是什么魔法作用，但或许其中存在某些共同点。我想找出幕后黑手，但与此同时，也许我们可以为公主缓解一些痛苦。值得一试。

rows.original: "I do, but I don't want to taint your half of the investigation. It's better if we both come to the same conclusions on our own." Ynes sighs and tweaks the tip of Eirina's tail. "At least share something, Eiri." The Astrida sucks a sharp breath in. "Ah, alright, fine. Something. Whoever we're dealing with is a mage with substantial experience and training. They have extensive knowledge of transmutation magic, but lack hard resources — paying an assassin with fake coinage is a gamble, and one not worth taking if you just have the cash to pay. The culprit's also a skilled alchemist, and has to have regular access to Kythie, or her immediate environs. Some curses can be cast onto a sympathetic doll or something from yonks away, but this isn't being cast like ritual magic. Kythie's having to be exposed directly, either ingested or breathed in or something like that." Eirina sits back. "The problem is motive. I know it's trite, but really, Tychris doesn't have a lot of enemies. The royal family's fairly popular with the people, and the principality hasn't gone to war in generations — expecting the occasional barbarian raid from the north. The Order's, mm, intelligence assets abroad haven't turned up any evidence of malice in our neighbors. Well, maybe with one exception..." You arch a brow. "Go on." "Maidenbridge," Ynes says. "Another city-state to the south, once a firm ally of Tychris. A few years ago, it fell under control of a warlord. Violently. Relations are tense at best. There was almost a war between the cities." "They've also refused to let the Order Astrida or the Order of the Argent Wing within their borders since," Eirina adds. "I'm sure you're not fans of that," you say. Eirina laughs. "An understatement. But we aren't about to force the issue when there's no suggestion of malfeasance. He won the city through strength of arms, not magic. Let Tira sort him out. The only reason I bring it up is that the new Count of Maidenbridge, Thore, he's actually asked after Kythie's hand in the past. He must figure a marriage would smooth things right out between the cities... and, of course, that would mean his children stand to inherit Tychris. A handy doubling of his domain." You blink. That's new information. "Tethys never mentioned." "I bet!" Ynes prods the salamander's thigh, cutting off her laughter. "Be serious, Eiri. I know it isn't likely, but there's no villainy I would put past a man with such ambitions as Count Thore. An unstable Tychris plays into his hands in any event." Looking for someone with connections to Maidenbridge couldn't hurt.
rows.translation: “我有，但我不想干扰你那一半的调查。我们各自得出相同的结论会更好。” 伊内斯叹了口气，捏了捏艾瑞娜的尾尖。“至少分享一点嘛，艾瑞。” 那位阿斯特里达猛吸一口气。“啊，好吧，好吧。就说一点。我们面对的是一位经验丰富、训练有素的法师。此人精通嬗变魔法，却缺少实实在在的资源——用假钱雇佣刺客是在冒险，如果手头有足够的真金白银，根本没必要这么做。犯人还是个技艺高超的炼金术士，而且必须能经常接近凯西，或至少接近她周围的环境。有些诅咒隔着老远也能施加在感应人偶之类的东西上，但这次并不是以仪式魔法的方式施放。凯西必须直接接触诅咒源，可能是吃下去、吸进去，或类似的方式。” 艾瑞娜靠回椅背。“问题在于动机。我知道这话很老套，但提克里斯确实没多少敌人。王室在民众中颇受爱戴，公国也已经几代人没有打过仗了——偶尔从北方来的蛮族劫掠除外。教团部署在国外的，嗯，情报人员也没发现邻国怀有恶意的证据。好吧，或许有一个例外……” 你挑起眉毛。“继续。” “梅登布里奇，”伊内斯说道。“那是南方的另一个城邦，曾经是提克里斯的坚定盟友。几年前，一名军阀以暴力夺取了那里。如今双方关系往好里说也很紧张，两座城市几乎爆发过战争。” “从那以后，他们还拒绝让阿斯特里达教团或银翼教团进入国境，”艾瑞娜补充道。 “我想你们肯定很不喜欢这样，”你说道。 艾瑞娜笑了。“何止是不喜欢。不过，在没有任何不法迹象的情况下，我们也不会强行插手。他靠武力而非魔法夺下了那座城，就交给蒂拉处置吧。我提起此事，只是因为梅登布里奇的新伯爵托雷过去曾向凯西求过婚。他大概觉得一场婚姻能彻底缓和两座城市的关系……而且那也意味着，他的孩子将有资格继承提克里斯。领地一下就能翻倍，确实划算。” 你眨了眨眼。这可是新情报。“泰西斯从没提过。” “我就知道！” 伊内斯戳了戳那位火蜥蜴的大腿，打断了她的笑声。“认真点，艾瑞。我知道可能性不大，但像托雷伯爵这样野心勃勃的人，我不认为有什么恶行是他做不出来的。无论如何，一个动荡不安的提克里斯都对他有利。” 寻找与梅登布里奇有联系的人，总不会有坏处。
rows.raw: ' "I do, but I don't want to taint your half of the investigation. It's better if we both come to the same conclusions on our own." Ynes sighs and tweaks the tip of Eirina's tail. "At least share something, Eiri." The Astrida sucks a sharp breath in. "Ah, alright, fine. Something. Whoever we're dealing with is a mage with substantial experience and training. They have extensive knowledge of transmutation magic, but lack hard resources — paying an assassin with fake coinage is a gamble, and one not worth taking if you just have the cash to pay. The culprit's also a skilled alchemist, and has to have regular access to Kythie, or her immediate environs. Some curses can be cast onto a sympathetic doll or something from yonks away, but this isn't being cast like ritual magic. Kythie's having to be exposed directly, either ingested or breathed in or something like that." Eirina sits back. "The problem is motive. I know it's trite, but really, Tychris doesn't have a lot of enemies. The royal family's fairly popular with the people, and the principality hasn't gone to war in generations — expecting the occasional barbarian raid from the north. The Order's, mm, intelligence assets abroad haven't turned up any evidence of malice in our neighbors. Well, maybe with one exception..." You arch a brow. "Go on." "Maidenbridge," Ynes says. "Another city-state to the south, once a firm ally of Tychris. A few years ago, it fell under control of a warlord. Violently. Relations are tense at best. There was almost a war between the cities." "They've also refused to let the Order Astrida or the Order of the Argent Wing within their borders since," Eirina adds. "I'm sure you're not fans of that," you say. Eirina laughs. "An understatement. But we aren't about to force the issue when there's no suggestion of malfeasance. He won the city through strength of arms, not magic. Let Tira sort him out. The only reason I bring it up is that the new Count of Maidenbridge, Thore, he's actually asked after Kythie's hand in the past. He must figure a marriage would smooth things right out between the cities... and, of course, that would mean his children stand to inherit Tychris. A handy doubling of his domain." You blink. That's new information. "Tethys never mentioned." "I bet!" Ynes prods the salamander's thigh, cutting off her laughter. "Be serious, Eiri. I know it isn't likely, but there's no villainy I would put past a man with such ambitions as Count Thore. An unstable Tychris plays into his hands in any event." Looking for someone with connections to Maidenbridge couldn't hurt. '

rows.correctionNote: 同上一条，同一菜单项。

rows.original: "Good question," Eirina says. She jerks her thumb towards the gigantic book Ynes's face is buried in. "There was indeed. I wanted to ask for your help with our experiment here. Something to help us better understand what's happening to Kythie." [pc.ra valkyrie |"Are you sure you want a valkyrie's help?" Eirina waves her hand. "If anything, that makes me more confident in asking you. The Argent Wing and the Astrida have been allies since the Godswar; it's been yonks since I've gotten to work with one of you. And if you have Lumia's trust, you have mine too." "Good to know. So what are you two up to?" ] "I've been working to translate and adapt the curses in this tome," Ynes continues, finally straightening her back and turning to face you. That big, heart-shaped ass might not be thrust out in your face anymore, but as the witch folds her arms in front of herself, you're treated to a rare glimpse of just how buxom she is under those baggy robes. "The effect should only be temporary, the span of a few hours, but it will give Eirina a chance to study similar symptoms more closely, without Tethys's interference." [flags.YNES_TLK_DREAMLESS |You glance between the girls. "Isn't there a bit of a problem with that?" you ask. "You can't cast spells, can you?" Eirina nods. "And that's why we asked you to come down here. Ynes is going to be the victim in our little experiment. [pc.isMage |You're going to be the hexer. Between us, we should be able to manage her while we study. |I'll cast the spell, but I'll need you to help me... manage her. I can't study her and hold her down at the same time. ] "Are you okay with that, Ynes?" The thrall sighs. "If it helps Princess Kythie, I am willing. May this serve as some small penance for my many sins." |"And what do you need my help with?" "Well, the problem is... I cannot cast the spell myself, as a Dreamless," Ynes says glumly. "But [pc.isMage |you can. I will walk you through it. My knowledge of magic is, thankfully, undimmed even if my ability has been stripped. |Eirina can. ]" Eirina pats Ynes's hair. "And I'll need some help, well, managing her while she's afflicted. I can't study her if I'm having to hold her back from jumping my bones." ] "Couldn't you just, I don't know, tie her down?" The girls exchange a look. "I... yeah, I guess?" Eirina says. "Problem is, this will be the first time we cast the spell. It shouldn't be as potent as what's afflicting Kythie, but also, you've seen the damage Kythie can do, right? Ynes isn't as strong, physically, but the Order's trained her to... be very good at slipping out of places, and restraints. I'm worried she'll get free. Or worse, hurt herself in the attempt." "Besides," Ynes says, giving her mistress a thin smiles, "I am accustomed to being the one who puts others in bondage." Eirina chokes back a cough and crosses her legs. You see the front of her kilt tent a bit, before she quickly adjusts herself. "Ahem, anyway, that's the issue. I don't want Ynes to hurt herself, and for a girl that wears a collar all day, she sure doesn't like being tied up. So... it would be easier to just have some help."
rows.translation: “问得好，”艾瑞娜说道。她用拇指指向了伊内斯正埋头研究的那本巨著。“确实有这样的资料。”我想请你帮忙进行我们这里的实验，希望能借此更好地了解凯西身上发生的事情。 [pc.ra valkyrie |你确定自己真的需要一位女武神的帮助吗？” 艾瑞娜摆了摆手：“恰恰相反，正因为如此，我才更有信心向你们求助。自神战以来，银翼军团和阿斯特里达一直保持着盟友关系；而我能够与你们中的任何一方合作，也已经是很久以前的事了。既然你得到了卢米娅的信任，那么你也得到了我的信任。” “知道了。那么你们两个到底在策划什么事情呢？ ] “我一直在努力翻译并改编这本典籍中的咒语，”伊内斯继续说道，终于挺直了身子，转过身来面对你。虽然她那颗心形的大屁股不再朝你凑过来了，但当这位女巫双臂交叉在胸前时，你还是难得地看到了她那宽松长袍下究竟有多丰满。”这种效果应该只是暂时的，持续几个小时而已，但这会让艾瑞娜有机会更仔细地研究类似的症状，而不会受到泰西斯的影响。” [flags.YNES_TLK_DREAMLESS |你目光在两个女孩之间来回扫视，问道：“这样不是有点问题吗？你们不能施展法术，对吧？” 艾瑞娜点了点头：“正因为如此，我们才邀请你过来。在我们的这个小实验中，伊内斯将会成为实验对象。 [pc.isMage |你将会扮演那个施法者。我们两个人一起，应该能够在学习的过程中控制她。 |我会施展这个咒语，但需要你的帮助……来控制她。我无法在研究她的同时又把她固定住。 ] 你真的愿意这样做吗，伊内斯？” 那个奴隶叹了口气：“如果这能帮助凯西公主的话，我愿意。希望这能算是对我诸多罪过的小小赎罪吧。 |那么，你需要我帮忙解决什么问题呢？” “嗯，问题在于……作为一个没有梦境的人，我无法自己施展那个咒语，”伊内斯沮丧地说道，“但是 [pc.isMage |你可以的。我会一步步指导你完成的。我的知识幸运的是，即使我的能力被剥夺了，那种魔法的力量依然没有减弱。 |艾瑞娜可以。 ] 艾瑞娜轻抚着伊妮斯的头发，说道：“在她处于这种状态的时候，我确实需要一些帮助，来照看她。如果我总是得阻止她做出一些过激的行为，我就根本无法对她进行研究了。 ] “你就不能想办法把她绑起来吗？” 几个女孩互相对视了一眼。 “我……嗯，应该可以吧？”艾瑞娜说道，“不过问题在于，这是我们第一次使用这个咒语。它的效果应该不会像那个折磨凯西的咒语那么强，不过你们也看到了凯西能造成多大的破坏，对吧？伊内斯在体力上并不强，但教团对她进行了特殊训练……使她非常擅长逃脱各种束缚。我担心她会逃脱控制，或者更糟的是，在尝试逃脱的过程中受伤。” “另外，”伊内斯对着自己的女主人露出一丝淡淡的微笑，“我已经习惯了将别人束缚在手中。” 艾瑞娜强忍住咳嗽，然后交叉双腿坐了下来。你能稍微看到她那顶用短裙材料搭建的帐篷的前面部分吗？她迅速调整了自己的状态，然后说道：“嗯，总之，问题就在这里。我不想让伊内斯受到伤害，而对于一个整天戴着项圈的女孩来说，她确实不喜欢被束缚。所以……如果有别人帮忙的话，会方便很多。”

rows.original: Magic that makes girls uncontrollably horny? You're in.
rows.translation: 能让女孩们无法抑制地产生性欲的魔法？你找对地方了。
rows.raw: "Magic that makes girls uncontrollably horny? You're in."

rows.original: You don't want any part in casting a curse, even if it is at the behest of a divine champion.
rows.translation: 你绝对不愿意参与施加任何诅咒，即使这是受一位神之冠军的委托。
rows.raw: "You don't want any part in casting a curse, even if it is at the behest of a divine champion."
rows.correctionNote: 术语 Champion→冠军，原译“神圣英雄”未用术语。

rows.original: Is Ynes sure about this? It seems risky.
rows.translation: 伊内斯确定要这么做吗？这似乎有点冒险。
rows.raw: "Is Ynes sure about this? It seems risky."

rows.original: What does the goddess of magic think about her sworn blade meddling with curses?
rows.translation: 那位魔法女神，对于她的誓约之剑干涉诅咒之事，又是如何看待的呢？
rows.raw: "What does the goddess of magic think about her sworn blade meddling with curses?"

rows.original: You shake your head. "[pc.dcb |Find somebody else to help with your curse kink, ladies. |I'm going to have to pass. |I... I'm good! I wanna leave. ]" "Damn it." Ynes slumps her shoulders. "I understand. Still, I wish you the best of luck in your investigation. The princess is a lovely girl; she doesn't deserve to suffer like this." Eirina leans back on the table and sighs. "Alright. We'll figure something out. And yeah, like she said, good luck with Kythie. I mean it. If you figure something out, make sure to tell Tethys. I'll do the same. Sisters! [pc.name] is ready to leave." The door slides open, and the pair of Astrida who escorted you down gesture for you to follow them back up.
rows.translation: 你摇了摇头。“[pc.dcb |女士们，去找别人来满足你们的诅咒癖好吧。 |我恐怕只能拒绝了。 |我……我没事！我想走。 ]” “该死。” 伊内斯垮下了肩膀。“我明白。不过，我还是祝你在调查中一切顺利。那位公主是个可爱的姑娘，她不该遭受这样的痛苦。” 艾瑞娜靠在桌上叹了口气。“好吧，我们会想出办法的。而且，就像她说的，祝你在凯西的事情上好运。我是认真的。如果你找到了办法，一定要告诉泰西斯。我也会这么做的。姐妹们！[pc.name] 准备出发了。” 门滑开了，先前陪你下楼的那两名阿斯特里达示意你跟他们上去。

We'll figure something out. And yeah, like she said, good luck with Kythie. I mean it. If you figure something out, make sure to tell Tethys. I'll do the same. Sisters! [pc.name] is ready to leave." The door slides open, and the pair of Astrida who escorted you down gesture for you to follow them back up. '

rows.original: "There's no long-term risk," Ynes insists. "I have Eirina here. She can break the curse with ease." "Yeah! Believe me, breaking spells is my specialty, even among the Order. The problem with Kythie is that somebody keeps reapplying the curse, even after we dispel it. I don't plan to keep blasting Ynes with this spell." There's a moment's pause. "... Well, plan to." Ynes swats her mistress's tail.
rows.translation: “没有长期的风险，”伊内斯坚持说道。“我有艾瑞娜在这里，她可以轻松解除这个诅咒。” “没错！相信我，解除法术可是我的专长，即使在教团里也一样。凯西的问题在于，总有人在我们驱散诅咒之后一直重新施加它。我并不打算继续用这个法术轰伊内斯。” 短暂的沉默。“……好吧，打算倒是打算。” 伊内斯拍了她女主人的尾巴一下。

The problem with Kythie is that somebody keeps reapplying the curse, even after we dispel it. I don't plan to keep blasting Ynes with this spell." There's a moment's pause. "... Well, plan to." Ynes swats her mistress's tail. '

rows.original: Eirina sighs. "Look, I don't want to say there's rules for thee but not for me, but..." "That's exactly how it works." Ynes says. "We keep these sorts of things under lock and key here in the temple for a reason. Destroying knowledge is as heretical as misusing it; even the darkest of magics can be used for good in the right circumstances. In this case, yeah, the spell's illegal. Incredibly so. But I have a willing subject, and we're doing it for the good of an innocent girl." [pc.isMage |You give the Astrida a suspect look. "I'm not going to get in trouble for casting this spell, right?" "Gods! No!" Eirina laughs. "This isn't some kind of entrapment thing. We don't do that. Despite what you may think, the Order Astrida spend so much more time protecting you mages than hunting you. We try to foster good magicians, not punish them just for existing. Only ones that go way off the deep end earn our ire. If you take this spell and start casting it on people all over, yeah, I'll come and hunt you down. But the whole point of being a Champion is that you're a defender of the people, right? I trust you enough to let you have a glimpse at Ynes's forbidden magic. Under strict observation." She winks. ] "So I'm not going to get divinely smited for this?" Eirina flashes you a fangy grin. "I can write you an official sanction, if you want, as the head of the Order Astrida. '[pc.name] is allowed to participate in one parentheses one dark ritual on this date at this time.' Seriously," she sighs, reaching out and putting a hand on your shoulder, "I appreciate your concern — I really do. It speaks well of you that you're hesitant. But I am the head of the Order. Short of Mother coming out of her demesne and putting her seal on this herself, my word's as good as it gets. I promise, this is fine. You won't get in trouble with me, the Order, or the goddess. This is for a good cause, we all understand." If she says so... you suppose there's no one around who can countermand her short of a god, is there?

rows.original: The girls exchange an ecstatic look. "Alright! Let's get down to business." "Very well," Ynes says, smoothing out her black robes. "[pc.isMage |Let me walk you through the spell. It should be well within your grasp. |Eirina, let's go over the spell one more time. I know you're more fighter than caster. ]" With a grunt of effort, the curvy sorceress drags the giant-sized spellbook up to the edge of the table. "Thankfully there's no danger in me enunciating the spell in its entirety, but try not to do so yourself until we're ready to begin. I'd like a moment to prepare myself before I lose myself." "Hey, you'll be fine, Ynes," Eirina says. "[pc.isMage |[pc.name]'s an accomplished mage. [pc.HeShe] won't let you down." You nod, taking a step closer to the book. The runes inside are harsh hash-marks lashed onto tanned-hide pages in ochre-red; if someone told you it was flesh and blood, you'd hardly feel inclined to blame them. Ynes clears her throat and begins to read them, enunciating each arcane syllable clearly and slowly, tracing them with her fingers as if to emphasis each twist of her tongue. You follow along without much trouble, which if anything is a little more concerning than the book's material composition — "Why the hell is a curse like this so... so simple?" Ynes gives you an approving look. "I see Eirina took your measure well." The Astrida puffs her chest. "I am pretty good at judging mages." "Yes, indeed. That's the draw of dark magic, [pc.name]. It's seductively easy. Power at your fingertips, beyond what you might otherwise grasp. It's an easy road, a shortcut, for the low price of your immortal soul." "A good lesson to take into your campaign against the demons," Eirina says, a little more gravely now. "Their power is a slippery slope, temptation with damnation as its reward. Resist it with all your might. Victory through your own strength may be harder, may require sacrifice, but to embrace their false power is to damn yourself as well." "You're preaching again, dear," Ynes says, clicking her tongue. Eirina frowns. "It's my right as a paladin to lecture. There has to be some kind of upside to this job." "Let's go again, [pc.name]. Another recitation." And another, and another, before Ynes seems satisfied. "I've got it now," you assure her. "[pc.HeShe]'s got it!" Eirina says. "I told you [pc.heShe] was good." Ynes scoffs. "Let's see [pc.himHer] cast the spell before we pass judgement... but I am inclined to agree. A moment, then, before we begin." |You know I won't let anything happen to you. And we've got [pc.name] here to make sure you don't do anything to me." You nod. "We've got you." Ynes sighs. "Very well. Let's go over it one last time, Eiri." The runes inside are harsh hash-marks lashed onto tanned-hide pages in ochre-red; if someone told you it was flesh and blood, you'd hardly feel inclined to blame them. Ynes clears her throat and begins to read them, enunciating each arcane syllable clearly and slowly, tracing them with her fingers as if to emphasis each twist of her tongue. Even without being a trained mage yourself, it's unsettlingly easy to follow along. You try to tell yourself that Ynes is just a talented teacher, but the fact is, for what's supposed to be dark and forbidden magic, it just... comes naturally to you? Maybe it's better not to mention that to the Astrida. After a couple more repetitions, Eirina puts her scaly hands up. "Alright, alright, Ynes. I think I've got it!" Ynes gives her an appraising look. "Are you sure?" "I am! And if, hypothetically, something does go wrong, I've got [pc.name] right here to backstop." Ynes frowns. rows.original: Ynes winces. "Yes, well, my apologies. And thank you for your help. I am not sure what I'd have done if only Eirina was here." "Why did you jump me and not her?" "Why, indeed?" Ynes chuckles. "The new experience is always more thrilling, I suppose. I know what Eirina is capable of. I suppose I sought greener pastures." Eirina snort-laughs. "Damn, Ynes. That almost hurt." "Please." Ynes rolls her eyes. "As if you lack for partners that fawn over you. I am a mean, heartless bitch deep down. You hardly need to feel insecure because I berate you. I hope neither of you take it personally. Now, if you'll excuse me, I need to... to tend to my own needs for a few hours more." The slave-girl gathers up her robes and knocks on the door. Eirina watches her go, biting her lip at the witch's seductive gait. "Hell of a woman, huh? I'm glad she got the chance to let loose. Sorry you didn't, uh, like her style." You can feel a firm, twitching tent in her kilt press up against your middle. "I've been dying to see you again," she whines, all but dry humping you then and there. "Let's go downstairs. Please. I need... I can't wait much longer. Thinking about you's driving me nuts." You glance down at Eirina, thinking back to the last time you two made love. Back to how you left her needy and wanting, and unable to find release. "You didn't...?" She shakes her head. "I wanted you. So come on. I waited, like a good girl. Don't I deserve a reward?"

rows.original: "Can I? Sure. I'm privy to the deepest secrets and mysteries of the venerable Order Astrida." Eirina gives you a fangy smirk. "But that's the thing about the goddess of secrets, [pc.name]. You might say we keep things close to the chest." She just leans back and smugly lets that moment pass. Finally, you sigh. "So, nothing?" "Well, I suppose you are the Champion. Besides, most people around here know a little about the Order. And we make sure the world's mages know we exist well in advance. Better you hear the truth rather than just rumors from the townsfolk, right?" Eirina clears her throat. "If you need to know anything about the Order Astrida, it's that we're Mother Nareva's shield against the worst things in the world: monsters left over from the Godswar, evil sorcerers abusing the gift of magic, and occult phenomenon beyond the ability of mortal mages to combat. It's a purpose we're bred for: each one of us is hand-crafted by the goddess in the womb, blessed with a fierce power to resist and dispel even the vilest magic." The salamander swells with pride as she speaks. "As the daughters of a goddess, it's our duty and honor to stand in defense of the common man against horrors beyond comprehension, and to enforce Mother's divine decrees over magic itself." "How literal is 'daughters of a goddess?'" you ask. She shrugs. "As close as it can be. The gods have no children of their loins, even Lumia, but we are the product of her most faithful servants! She alters us into what we are, her black-scaled paladins, in the womb. Claims us as her own before birth. So, yeah, I don't think it's a stretch to call her Mother." "So you're all really sisters, huh? Do all of you actually join the Order?" "As far as you need to know." Eirina winks. "You can be pretty sure if you see a salamander with naturally black scales, she's part of the Order. There's not all that many of us, compared to Valkyries or whatever, but we're all pretty close-knit. Like you said, we're all sisters here." "So what do you and your sisters actually do? I mean, fighting monsters and mages is pretty broad." Eirina laughs. "Yeah! That's sort of the point. We do what's needed. Most of us are wanderers; we meander around the world sniffing out corruption before it can take root. And, yeah, I know what you're thinking — what a damned blind spot we had in Hawkethorne! The truth is, they were never all that dangerous before. We'd occasionally bag one of them, but the average member was just a drunk blueblood who wanted an excuse to get down and bone all day for their 'Dark Queen' from 'another world' who was just commanding them all to, well, make the beast with two backs." "And that's just most of you?" She sighs and shakes her head. "Yeah, there's others. A few older, injured members of the Order stand guard at temples or watch over reliquaries. There's the occasional weird magical... thing... that needs constant supervision. And a few of us are, mm, on bodyguard duty." You raise an eyebrow. "It's like... there's a lot of promising mages in the world, and they need to be... guided. Shepherded towards good choices, and protected from temptation. The Order assigns Astrida to them, to make sure they both walk the righteous path, and don't accidentally explode themselves while they try and push the boundaries of mortal knowledge." The salamander chews her lip, glancing up at the grand statue of her goddess. "Despite common misconception, Nareva does want the world to advance and get better — she just wants it to be slow and careful. We can't afford another Godswar. And preventing that is the highest calling of the Order... which means keeping a very close eye on the mages that show signs of reaching the kind of heights that could let them, well, open another breach." "How close is close?" Eirina shuffles her scaly feet. "Depends on the mage, and the Astrida. There's a good reason you hear so many bard songs about cute mages and broody Astrida pairing up." "And do these mages get a say in whether they get their own Astrida?" "No. Well, I guess they can always pick being made Dreamless. But if the goddess of magic decides a mage needs watching, they're getting watched. How emotionally close they want to get with the chaperone is something we can work with, and if a particular pair up drive each other up the walls, the Order's not so inflexible that it won't try to reassign someone more compatible, but being bodily close isn't up for debate. Not when the world's at stake. That's the crux of the Order. Like us or not, we're the backstop against people with too much power sinking the world into another nightmare. We have to do what we have to do."
rows.translation: “我能说吗？当然。我知晓古老的阿斯特丽达教团最深邃的秘密与奥秘。”艾瑞娜露出尖牙，朝你坏笑。“不过，[pc.name]，这正是秘密女神的特点。你可以说，我们总把事情藏在胸口。” 她只是向后靠去，得意洋洋地任由这一刻过去。 最终，你叹了口气。“所以，什么都不说？” “好吧，我想你毕竟是那位勇者。再说，这附近的大多数人多少都了解一点教团的事情，而我们也会提前确保全世界的法师知道我们的存在。你最好听到真相，而不是只从镇民那里听些流言，对吧？” 艾瑞娜清了清嗓子。“如果你需要了解阿斯特丽达教团，那最重要的一点便是：我们是纳瑞瓦圣母抵御世间最邪恶事物的盾牌——诸神之战遗留下来的怪物、滥用魔法恩赐的邪恶术士，以及凡人法师无力抗衡的神秘现象。我们生来便是为了这一使命：女神会在母腹中亲手塑造我们每一个人，赐予我们强大力量，足以抵抗并驱散最为邪恶的魔法。”火蜥蜴说话时骄傲地挺起胸膛。“身为女神之女，我们有责任也有荣誉保护普通人，使他们免受无法理解的恐怖侵害，并在魔法本身之上执行圣母的神圣法令。” “‘女神之女’这句话有多么字面意义？”你问道。 她耸耸肩。“几乎就是字面意义。诸神并不会从自己的腰腹生下子嗣，就连鲁米娅也不例外；可我们是她最忠诚信徒的产物！她会在母腹中改造我们，让我们成为如今的样子——她麾下的黑鳞圣骑士，并在出生之前便认领我们。所以，是啊，我觉得称她为圣母一点都不夸张。” “所以你们确实全都是姐妹，对吧？你们所有人真的都会加入教团吗？” “你只需要知道这么多。”艾瑞娜眨了眨眼。“如果看见一只天生黑鳞的火蜥蜴，你基本可以确定她属于教团。与女武神之类的群体相比，我们人数不算太多，不过关系都很亲密。就像你说的，我们在这里全都是姐妹。” “那么，你和姐妹们实际上都确实？我是说，对抗怪物和法师的范围未免太广泛了。” 艾瑞娜笑了。“没错！这正是重点。哪里有需要，我们就做什么。大多数成员都是漫游者；我们在世界各地游走，在腐化扎根之前嗅出它的踪迹。还有，是啊，我知道你在想什么——我们居然对鹰棘镇的情况视而不见，真是该死！事实上，那些人以前从未如此危险。我们偶尔会抓到其中一个，可普通成员往往只是喝醉的蓝血贵族，想找个借口整天替他们那位来自‘另一个世界’的‘暗之女王’做爱；而那位女王给他们的命令，说到底，也不过是没日没夜地交媾。” “这还只是你们大多数人的工作？” 她叹了口气，摇摇头。“对，还有其他人。少数年长或受伤的教团成员会驻守神殿，或看守圣物库。有时候还会出现某种古怪的魔法……东西……需要持续监视。另外，我们之中也有少数人，嗯，负责贴身护卫。” 你扬起眉毛。 “事情是这样……世上有许多前途无量的法师，而他们需要得到……引导。有人必须带领他们作出正确选择，保护他们免受诱惑。教团会给这些法师指派阿斯特丽达骑士，确保他们走在正道上，也避免他们在试图突破凡人知识边界时不慎把自己炸上天。”火蜥蜴咬着嘴唇，抬眼望向女神的宏伟雕像。“尽管世人普遍存在误解，纳瑞瓦确实希望世界进步、变得更加美好——她只是希望过程缓慢而谨慎。我们承受不起另一场诸神之战，而阻止它再次发生，便是教团最崇高的使命……这意味着，我们必须极其密切地关注那些显露出非凡潜力的法师，因为他们可能达到足以再次撕开裂隙的高度。” “密切到什么程度？” 艾瑞娜不自在地挪动覆满鳞片的双脚。“这取决于法师，也取决于阿斯特丽达骑士。吟游诗人会写出那么多关于可爱法师和阴郁阿斯特丽达结成伴侣的歌，可不是没有理由。” “那么，这些法师能决定自己是否要有一名专属阿斯特丽达吗？” “不能。好吧，我想他们总能选择被变成无梦者。可如果魔法女神认定某位法师需要监视，那对方就一定会受到监视。至于他们在感情上愿意与监护人多么亲近，我们可以协商；如果某对组合实在把彼此逼得发疯，教团也没有死板到拒绝尝试重新指派一个更合适的人。不过，身体上必须保持近距离，这一点没有商量余地——尤其当整个世界命悬一线时。这就是教团的核心。无论人们是否喜欢我们，我们都是防止力量过于强大之人把世界拖入另一场噩梦的最后防线。我们必须履行自己的职责。”

rows.original: Eirina scrunches her lips up, and the tips of her black-frilled ears wiggle. "Leave? Why'd anyone do something like that?" You shrug. "Any number of reasons? What if you just... wanted to do something different?" "Never heard of any of my sisters asking if they could. I've never really thought about it." Eirina shrugs. "It's hard and dangerous work, but we're all dedicated to protecting the world. Protecting everyone, and everything. I can't imagine wanting to just abandon that." "The idea's really never crossed your mind?" She shakes her head. "Nah." You blink. "Do you not think that's weird?" The salamander rubs at her chin. "I guess? But think about it this way: Mother Nareva built each and every one of us in the womb. We're put together from the best stuff the goddess can get her hands on. I don't think she'd opt into making any of us a pussy. Why would she go out of her way to make us neurotic about our fate? We don't really get depressed or anxious, we're pretty fearless as a rule. If you're trying to imply I'm brainwashed, well, maybe, but it's by my mother goddess and it's into doing something that's good for the world, so... oh well, I guess? Could be worse." Right. Another angle, then: "What if any of you get too hurt to keep working? What then?" "Doesn't happen often. Fighting an archmage or a Wraith-touched is usually pretty terminal if you fuck it up. But it does happen," Eirina admits. "Sisters that come home maimed usually get put on teaching duty, or set to guarding something of only middling importance. I've only have to issue one reassignment like that so far. One of our oldest sisters, Nymere, lost an eye and most of her right hand to fragmentation from an exploding tree. She was already a patchwork of scars, but that pushed it over the edge. I couldn't let her keep pushing herself into the field if she was off-handing her blade on her blind side." "So what'd you do with her?" "She's bodyguarding a young wizard here in Tychris, a baron's son that we have our eye on. Promising power, but he's a hothead. Figured he could use a mature woman in his life to cool him off. Poor kid lost his mom, so... well, y'know. Seems to be working out for both of 'em."
rows.translation: 艾瑞娜把嘴唇皱起来，黑褶边的耳朵尖抖了抖。“离开？怎么会有人想干那种事？” 你耸耸肩。“理由多得是？假如你只是……想做点不一样的事呢？” “从没听说过哪个姐妹问过自己能不能走。我也从来没真想过这事。”艾瑞娜耸耸肩。“这活儿又难又危险，可我们都一心一意守护这个世界。守护所有人，所有东西。我想象不出自己会想去抛下这一切。” “这念头真的从没在你脑子里出现过？” 她摇摇头。“没。” 你眨了眨眼。“你不觉得这很奇怪吗？” 这位蝾螈人搓了搓下巴。“大概吧？但你可以这么想：娜瑞瓦母亲在子宫里把我们每一个都造了出来。我们是用女神能弄到手的最好的材料拼成的。我不觉得她会选择把我们中的谁造成一个孬种。她为什么要特意让我们对自己的命运神经兮兮的？我们基本上不会沮丧或焦虑，按规矩说我们相当无畏。如果你想暗示我被洗脑了，嗯，也许吧，但洗我的是我母亲女神，而且是为了做对世界有益的事，所以……那也没办法，我猜？总不会更糟。” 好。那就换个角度：“如果你们中有人伤得太重，没法继续干活呢？那怎么办？” “这种事不常发生。跟大法师或者亡魂侵染者打，一旦搞砸通常就是直接了结。但确实会发生，”艾瑞娜承认道。“伤残回家来的姐妹一般会被安排去带训，或者派去守些只算中等重要的东西。到目前为止我只下过一次这样的调令。我们最年长的姐妹之一，妮梅尔，在一棵爆炸的树上被碎片夺走了一只眼睛和右手大部分。她本来就满身疤痕像块拼布，那一下算是压过了临界点。我不能让她在盲侧那只手上握着剑还继续往战场上冲。” “那你把她怎么安排了？” “她现在在提克里斯给一位年轻法师当保镖，是个男爵的儿子，我们盯上他很久了。力量很有前途，但性子太冲。我想他生活里需要一个成熟女人给他降降温。可怜的孩子没了妈，所以……嗯，你懂的。看起来对两边都挺合适。”

rows.original: "Ask my sisters! I'm not sure myself most days!" Eirina laughs. "Honestly it's a bunch of faff: I oversee training and deployments mostly, sometimes I get to smooth over diplomatic kerfuffles between the Church and whatever random rich asswipe is giving us a hard time. This demonic outburst in Hawkstone's the first time I've ever had to put the Order on a war footing. The first time any commander has in over a century. Lucky me! I guess I'll figure this out as we go." "How did you get the job, anyway?" The salamander's toe-claws clack against the stone. "It was... the thing with Ynes, and her master Tiburcio. Mother Nareva was impressed by my performance, and the previous Captain was freshly dead. I guess it was good timing for me, really, coming back with a hell of a triumph the day the mourning was over." "What exactly happened in Corlund?" you ask. Eirina shrugs. "It was... bad. Magister Tiburcio en Corlund had been [silly |on our radar |known to us ] for a while already, a rising star in the field of conjuration magic. Summoning elementals, especially fire spirits, and pyromancy in general... nothing terribly out of the ordinary, nor all that dangerous as far as magic goes, but the Order would occasionally send someone by to peep in on him, usually just a thrall or junior priests rather than actual Astrida. Eventually, one of our mendicant clerics noticed something was off in the province. That the townsfolk were acting strangely, like they were in a daze, and there was no sign of the town's lord." You gesture for her to go on. "I was already in the area, collecting bits and bobs from the Godswar left over in the mountains, when the cleric found me. She ran cross-country until she found an Astrida to give her report to directly. I rode into town maybe two days after the cleric made her report, and... yeah, a daze. That's the best way to describe it. Everyone in the town was shambling around, barely aware of their surroundings, repeating the same day over and over. They weren't dying, but they weren't living either." Eirina snaps her fingers. "They were being controlled by magic, and that's nothing to an Astrida. I started snipping the threads around their minds, freeing the townsfolk, and they all painted the same picture: their own lord had gone mad, sequestering himself in his estate and doing all manner of unnatural things, day in and day out. And his apprentice was... ensorcelling the prettiest men and women of the village into her playthings." "Sounds exactly like what Astrida are supposed to stop." "That's right, so I got to work. But that's... a whole story. Let's just say that killing a archmagister who'd lost his mind, rendering his apprentice Dreamless, and saving a whole town gets you pretty high marks with the goddess. I've got a golden laurel of valor around here somewhere... It's enough that it won me the captaincy against Astrida with a decade more experience." You give Eirina a look-over. She's only got a handful of battle scars on her scales, and her smooth, youthful complexion... she really isn't much past her middle twenties, if even that. "I suppose you do look a little young for the job." "Hey!" Eirina snaps. "I'm not that young, for an Astrida, you know. Most of us don't live that long, so by our standards I'm practically middle aged!" That maybe hit a little bit of a nerve — her tail-flame's blazing, and her brows are all scrunched up. Oh, no, she's kind of cute when she pouts.
rows.translation: “去问我姐妹们！我自己大多数时候都搞不清！”艾瑞娜笑道。“老实说这活儿一堆破事：我主要管训练和调派，偶尔去给教会和某个找我们麻烦的有钱混蛋之间的外交龃龉抹抹平。鹰棘镇这次恶魔爆发，是我头一回不得不让教团进入战时状态。也是上百年来任何一位指挥官的头一回。算我走运！我猜只能边干边琢磨了。” “话说回来，你是怎么坐上这个位子的？” 蝾螈人的趾爪在石面上咯咯作响。“那是……伊内斯那档子事，还有她的主人蒂布尔西奥。娜瑞瓦母亲对我的表现很满意，而上一任队长又刚死。说实话，对我来说时机刚好，服丧期结束那天带着一场了不得的胜利回来。” “科伦德到底发生了什么？”你问。 艾瑞娜耸耸肩。“那是……很糟。科伦德的法师蒂布尔西奥已经[silly |在我们的关注名单上 |被我们知晓 ]有一阵子了，他是召唤系魔法领域一颗冉冉升起的新星。召唤元素生物，尤其是火焰精灵，还有广义上的火系法术……就魔法而言不算特别出格，也说不上多危险，但教团偶尔会派人去瞄他一眼，通常只是派个仆役或者低级祭司，而不是真正的阿斯特里达。最后，我们的一位托钵修士发现那个行省有点不对劲。镇民们行为古怪，像是在发懵，而镇上的领主则不见踪影。” 你示意她继续说。 “当时我已经在那一带了，在山上收集诸神之战留下的零碎物件，那位修士找到了我。她一路越野狂奔，直到找到一个阿斯特里达当面汇报。修士报告之后大约两天，我骑马进了镇子，然后……是啊，发懵。这是最好的形容。镇里所有人都拖着步子游荡，几乎不知道自己周围是什么，日复一日重复着同一天。他们不是在死，但也不是在活。” 艾瑞娜打了个响指。“他们被魔法控制了，而这对阿斯特里达来说不算什么。我开始剪断他们心智周围的丝线，解救镇民，他们描述的景象全都一样：他们自己的领主疯了，把自己关在宅邸里，一天到晚做着各种违背自然的事。而他的学徒则……把村里最漂亮的男女迷成她的玩物。” “听起来正是阿斯特里达该制止的事。” “没错，所以我动手了。不过那是……一整个故事了。这么说吧，杀掉一个失了心智的大法师，把他的学徒弄成无梦者，再救下一整座镇子，能让你在女神那里拿到相当高的评价。我那枚金色英勇月桂环应该就在这附近什么地方……这就足够让我赢过一位资历更老十年的阿斯特里达，拿下队长之位了。” 你上下打量艾瑞娜。她的鳞片上只有寥寥几道战伤，而她那光滑年轻的面容……她真的不过二十五岁出头，甚至可能还不到。“我倒是觉得你干这活儿看起来年轻了点。” “喂！”艾瑞娜呛声道。“对阿斯特里达来说，我可没那么年轻，你知道的。我们大多数人活不了那么久，所以按我们的标准，我差不多都算中年了！” 那大概戳到她一点点痛处了——她尾焰烧得正旺，眉毛也全皱了起来。哦，不妙，她撅嘴的样子还挺可爱的。
rows.raw: ' "Ask my sisters! I'm not sure myself most days!" Eirina laughs. "Honestly it's a bunch of faff: I oversee training and deployments mostly, sometimes I get to smooth over diplomatic kerfuffles between the Church and whatever random rich asswipe is giving us a hard time. This demonic outburst in Hawkstone's the first time I've ever had to put the Order on a war footing. The first time any commander has in over a century. Lucky me! I guess I'll figure this out as we go." "How did you get the job, anyway?" The salamander's toe-claws clack against the stone. "It was... the thing with Ynes, and her master Tiburcio. Mother Nareva was impressed by my performance, and the previous Captain was freshly dead. I guess it was good timing for me, really, coming back with a hell of a triumph the day the mourning was over." "What exactly happened in Corlund?" you ask. Eirina shrugs. "It was... bad. Magister Tiburcio en Corlund had been [silly |on our radar |known to us ] for a while already, a rising star in the field of conjuration magic. Summoning elementals, especially fire spirits, and pyromancy in general... nothing terribly out of the ordinary, nor all that dangerous as far as magic goes, but the Order would occasionally send someone by to peep in on him, usually just a thrall or junior priests rather than actual Astrida. Eventually, one of our mendicant clerics noticed something was off in the province. That the townsfolk were acting strangely, like they were in a daze, and there was no sign of the town's lord." You gesture for her to go on. "I was already in the area, collecting bits and bobs from the Godswar left over in the mountains, when the cleric found me. She ran cross-country until she found an Astrida to give her report to directly. I rode into town maybe two days after the cleric made her report, and... yeah, a daze. That's the best way to describe it. Everyone in the town was shambling around, barely aware of their surroundings, repeating the same day over and over. They weren't dying, but they weren't living either." Eirina snaps her fingers. "They were being controlled by magic, and that's nothing to an Astrida. I started snipping the threads around their minds, freeing the townsfolk, and they all painted the same picture: their own lord had gone mad, sequestering himself in his estate and doing all manner of unnatural things, day in and day out. And his apprentice was... ensorcelling the prettiest men and women of the village into her playthings." "Sounds exactly like what Astrida are supposed to stop." "That's right, so I got to work. But that's... a whole story. Let's just say that killing a archmagister who'd lost his mind, rendering his apprentice Dreamless, and saving a whole town gets you pretty high marks with the goddess. I've got a golden laurel of valor around here somewhere... It's enough that it won me the captaincy against Astrida with a decade more experience." You give Eirina a look-over. She's only got a handful of battle scars on her scales, and her smooth, youthful complexion... she really isn't much past her middle twenties, if even that. "I suppose you do look a little young for the job." "Hey!" Eirina snaps. "I'm not that young, for an Astrida, you know. Most of us don't live that long, so by our standards I'm practically middle aged!" That maybe hit a little bit of a nerve — her tail-flame's blazing, and her brows are all scrunched up. Oh, no, she's kind of cute when she pouts. '

rows.original: "Awesome," Eirina says without a hint of irony. "I don't know if you want a sob story about how terrible a burden it is to spend your whole life training for the most dangerous job in the world in a library-temple, but no — I had a good upbringing. I think most of my sisters would agree. Sure, training is hard, and it took two decades, but the older Sisters at the temple loved us, I spent my childhood getting the personal attention of a wonderful goddess, and — you might not believe this — but I got to spend plenty of time outside, traveling all over." She smiles warmly, looking up at the statue. "My birth-mother, she was a warrior-priestess here in Tychris. Well, was — she's still alive and all, she just doesn't do much warrior-ing in her fifties. Just a regular cleric now. Anyway, my point is, between Mom and Mother Nareva, I had good guidance and plenty of love. It wasn't too different from being any other paladin's kid, training to follow dear old mom's footsteps, just... with a lot more book learning with the priests on top of it. Learning how to use my Astrida abilities with older Sisters. Learning how to fight in the field, when I was a little older." "So your mother's still at the temple here?" Eirina nods. "Yeah, 'course. Still raising younger sisters for the Order. If there's one good thing that's come of the whole, uh, Kythie situation, it's that I've been eating Mom's cooking and getting to spend time with the kiddos. It's a rare treat, getting to stay around in one place. To stay at home." [var0 |"Do you know any of your fathers?" you ask. "We're not really, well, that's not really supposed to be a thing. We have our mothers, and the Goddess, and that's enough." Eirina glances away, wrapping her tail around a leg. "Donors at the ritual are just that, you know. Donors, not dads. Though..." "What?" The salamander shifts her considerable weight. "Ah, I actually have met one of my 'fathers' — I wouldn't have even known it, if I wasn't an officer of the order. I'd, mm, checked the records for the ritual that made me. Just saw the list of participants, idle curiosity, you know? Not a week later I got called out to deal with some Wraith-touched pestering western Sartanni. His territory. He was a vintner-mage, owned one of the vineyards along the Maiden River that was being pillaged by these little... gremlin-y creatures, might've been satyrs once. Or goblins whose daddies shagged a lot of satyrs. Anyway, he's a heartland orc, big gentle giant of a man, specializes in plant magic — making them grow or change their tastes and colors, that sort of thing. He makes this incredible sweet cherry wine. Garron Drace, is his name. I never told him who I was, to him I mean, but even still he offered to host me at his estate for the whole time I was there. Made me feel at home. Good man." "Have you ever thought about-" Eirina shakes her head. "Nah. It's not the done thing. And he doesn't need a twenty-something godsblood trying to be his kid out of nowhere. But I do write to him, now and then. Pretend I'm keeping up with the village, making sure the monsters haven't come back. That kinda thing." |"Is there a father around, too?" you ask, a little cautiously. "Ah, haha, no, nothing like that. We Astrida don't really, mm, have those. Not like you probably would've. It's a whole thing." And she doesn't seem interested in elaborating. ]
rows.translation: “好极了。”艾瑞娜毫无讽刺之意地说道。“我不知道你是不是想听一个催人泪下的故事，讲我在图书馆神殿里用一生训练、准备承担全世界最危险的工作是多么沉重的负担，但事实不是这样——我的成长经历很好。我想大多数姐妹都会同意。训练当然艰苦，而且持续了二十年；可神殿里的年长姐妹都很爱我们，我童年时一直得到一位伟大女神的亲自关怀，而且——你可能不信——我有很多时间待在户外，到处旅行。” 她温暖地笑着，抬头望向雕像。“我的生母曾经是提克里斯这里的战斗祭司。嗯，曾经是——她还活得好好的，只是五十多岁以后不怎么战斗了。现在就是个普通牧师。总之，我想说的是，有妈妈和纳瑞瓦圣母在，我得到了很好的引导和许多关爱。这和其他圣骑士的孩子追随亲爱的母亲脚步、接受训练并没有太大区别，只不过……除此之外，还得跟祭司们学习多得多的书本知识。跟年长姐妹学习如何运用阿斯特丽达的能力。再长大一点后，学习如何在野外战斗。” “所以你母亲现在还在这座神殿？” 艾瑞娜点点头。“是啊，当然。她还在为教团养育年幼的姐妹。整个，呃，凯西事件要说有什么好处，就是我又吃上了妈妈做的饭，还能陪陪孩子们。能留在同一个地方、待在家里，对我来说可是难得的享受。” [var0 |“你认识自己的父亲吗？”你问道。 “我们其实不——嗯，本来就不该有这种关系。我们有母亲，也有女神，这就足够了。”艾瑞娜移开目光，用尾巴缠住一条腿。“仪式上的捐献者就只是捐献者，你明白吧。是捐献者，不是父亲。不过……” “不过什么？” 火蜥蜴挪动了一下分量十足的身体。“啊，其实我确实见过其中一个‘父亲’——如果我不是教团军官，甚至根本不会知道。我曾经，嗯，查过创造我的那场仪式的记录。就是出于无聊的好奇，看看参与者名单，你懂吧？不到一周后，我便奉命前去处理一群骚扰西萨尔坦尼的幽魂侵染怪物。那正是他的领地。他是一名酿酒法师，在少女河沿岸拥有一座葡萄园；那地方当时正遭到一群像小妖精一样的生物劫掠，它们或许曾经是萨堤尔，也可能是父亲和许多萨堤尔乱搞过的哥布林。总之，他是个腹地兽人，体格高大、性情温和，专精植物魔法——让植物生长，或改变它们的味道和颜色，诸如此类。他酿的甜樱桃酒好喝得不可思议。他叫加伦·德雷斯。我从没告诉他自己对他而言是谁；即便如此，他还是邀请我在那段时间一直住在他的庄园，让我感觉像回到家一样。是个好人。” “你有没有想过——” 艾瑞娜摇摇头。“没有。大家不会那么做。而且他也不需要一个二十多岁的神血后裔突然冒出来，非要当他的孩子。不过我偶尔会给他写信。装作自己只是在关注那个村庄，确认怪物有没有回来。类似这样的理由。” |“这里也有一位父亲吗？”你略显谨慎地问道。 “啊，哈哈，没有，不是那样。我们阿斯特丽达其实，嗯，没有所谓的父亲。至少不像你大概会有的那一种。这事说来话长。” 而她看起来并不想继续解释。 ]

rows.original: Eirina casts a glance towards the archive desk and swishes her tail. "Yeah? What about her?" "What do you think about her?" you ask. "After all she's put you, and those townsfolk, through." Eirina scrunches her lips and rubs at her chin. "Well, y'know, she's... she's better than she was. Nareva's not exactly the goddess of redemption here, that's more of Lumia and Mallach's thing, but you don't know what it was like, when I met her. She was insane. And I don't mean, like, swelling with arcane power and high off her ass on it. I mean, something broke inside her, getting tied up and cut on by Tibercio. She was basically a slave, and ended up taking it out on others when she got a lick of power." "She's still a slave," you point out. Again, Eirina looks around uncomfortably. Her tail curls around one of her trunk-thick thighs. "I, I mean, yeah. You're not wrong. But I'm not using her as rape-bait for summoning monsters, or carving on her skin with runes of power I learned from a twisted banshee in the dark of the earth. Believe me, if her body — the runes on it, I mean — wasn't an abject danger to other people, I'd free her. Ynes has gotten better[pc.isDK | — don't give me that look, she has! |, you can tell, right? ] It took a long time for her to find herself, after everything she's been through, but she's making real progress.[ynes.fucked | Especially after the two of you... y'know. She's been in a brighter mood than I've ever seen her lately. ]" You have to ask, "Do you think she's still dangerous?" "Nah. Well, not magically. I taught her how to protect herself with blades, since she's, well, basically a living grimoire that any mage with ambitions would love to get his grippers on. The copy of those spells I made, we keep under about as strict a lock and key as we do anything that isn't actively radiating blow-your-butt-out magic. She'd be dangerous if she fell into the wrong hands. But she's Dreamless — she's about as magically potent as belly button lint. She couldn't cast a cantrip if her life depended on it. And even if she could, genuinely I don't think she'd use her magic to hurt anyone again. And I think I'm a pretty good judge of character."
rows.translation: 艾瑞娜朝档案桌瞥了一眼，摆动尾巴。“嗯？她怎么了？” “你怎么看她？”你问道，“在她让你和那些城镇居民经历过这一切之后。” 艾瑞娜抿起嘴唇，揉着下巴。“嗯，你知道，她……她已经比过去好得多。纳瑞瓦并不算救赎之神，那更像是卢米娅和玛拉奇的职责；不过你不知道我遇见她时，她是什么样子。她当时疯了。我说的不是体内充斥奥术力量、兴奋到神志不清的那种疯狂，而是被蒂贝尔西奥绑起来，在身上刻下伤痕之后，她体内的某些东西真的崩溃了。她几乎就是个奴隶；等到终于尝到一点力量，便把承受过的一切发泄在别人身上。” “她现在仍然是奴隶。”你指出。 艾瑞娜再次不安地环顾四周，尾巴缠上自己树干般粗壮的一条大腿。“我、我是说，对，你没有说错。不过我没有把她当作召唤怪物时诱奸用的饵料，也没有用从地下深处某只扭曲报丧女妖那里学来的力量符文切割她的皮肤。相信我，如果她的身体——我是说，上面的符文——不是会对其他人构成绝对威胁，我早就会还她自由。伊内斯已经变好了[pc.isDK |——别用那种眼神看我，她真的变好了！ |，你也看得出来，对吧？ ]经历这一切后，她花了很长时间才重新找回自己，不过现在确实取得了真正的进展。[ynes.fucked |尤其是在你们两个……你知道的，之后。最近她的心情比我见过的任何时候都要开朗。 ]” 你不得不问：“你认为她现在仍然危险吗？” “不。嗯，至少在魔法方面不危险。我教过她如何用刀刃保护自己，毕竟她实际上是一本活生生的魔法书，任何野心勃勃的法师都会想把爪子伸向她。我抄录下来的那份法术，被我们以几乎最高等级的措施严密锁藏——只比那些正在主动散发‘把你屁股炸飞’级别魔力的东西稍逊一点。她如果落入错误的人手中，确实会很危险。不过她是无梦者——她的魔力大概和肚脐里的绒毛差不多。即使性命攸关，她也施放不了一个戏法。而且就算她真的可以，我也真心认为她不会再用魔法伤害任何人。我觉得自己看人的眼光还是很准的。”

rows.original: "You ready now? Hell yes." Eirina pumps her fist and grabs her spear from where it's resting against the wall. "Come on, I've got a couple horses waiting." "Were you expecting company?" Eirina shakes her head as the pair of you head for the doors. "Nah, I'm just used to bringing a spare. Early on in my career, I was tasked with bodyguarding this sorceress from Lafanze who wanted to explore a ruined Belharan city near her village, thought there might be something left over from its old days when it was famous for forging magic shields. She was worried about it being haunted, or full of Wraith-touched. Turned out she should have been more concerned with the state of the bridge leading into town!" The Astrida shakes her head and laughs. "Her horse went straight through the rotting wood, and mine threw me and bolted in fear. The little lady twisted her ankle going down. I ended up having to carry her all the way back to town." You pull yourself into the saddle of a roan-maned steed, following Eirina towards the palace gates. "Did she ever find what she was looking for?" "Sorta!" Eirina waves to a pair of robed men passing you on the city street. "We tried again, after she healed up. Sure enough there were these little fuckin' gribblies with horns and spiked tails infesting the place. Like a goblin, a manticore, and a pexighast all had a bunch of babies in an ugly tree. But we did find the forge! Just... the forgemasters took their methods to the grave with them. Didn't leave one word written down. We found a few shields hidden in a bolthole, at least, and she took them to study. Still working on unlocking their secrets today." Eirina raps her knuckles against the serpent-faced aspis strapped to her horse's flank. "And I got one as a remember-me." That puts a smile on the Astrida's face. "You might get to see it in action, today. It turns aside projectiles, and from what the farmers said, I think we'll be facing some quillocks." [pc.bg hunter barbarian |Quillocks, huh? You've tangled with them a few times. They're a pretty serious problem in the western reaches of Old Belhar, with their poisonous projectile quills and sharp claws, and particularly tough carapace. Their cold-blooded nature makes them hideously susceptible to the cold, though. It's surprising to see them this far north, this late in the year. ] You push your horse to a canter matching Eirina's. "[pc.dcb |Lead the way. |Let's not leave them waiting. |Alriiight!" you cheer, "Let's go! ]"
rows.translation: “现在准备好了吗？太好了。”艾瑞娜挥了挥拳头，从墙边拿起靠在那里的长矛。“走吧，我让人备了两匹马。” “你早就料到会有同伴？” 你们两人朝大门走去，艾瑞娜摇了摇头。“没有，我只是习惯多带一匹。刚开始干这一行时，我接过一个护卫任务，要保护一位来自拉凡泽的女术士。她想探索村庄附近一座荒废的古贝尔哈尔城市，觉得那里也许还留着些什么——那座城过去以锻造魔法盾牌闻名。她担心那里闹鬼，或者挤满了受幽魂侵染的怪物。结果事实证明，她更该担心的是进城那座桥的状况！” 阿斯特丽达摇头大笑。“她的马直接踩穿了腐烂的木板，我的马则把我甩下来，受惊跑了。那位小女士摔下去时扭伤了脚踝。最后我只好一路把她背回城里。” 你翻身骑上一匹鬃毛棕红的马，跟随艾瑞娜前往宫门。“她最后找到想找的东西了吗？” “算是吧！”艾瑞娜向街上与你们擦肩而过的两名长袍男子挥手。“她伤好后，我们又试了一次。那里果然挤满了长着角和尖刺尾巴的他妈小怪物，简直像哥布林、蝎尾狮和佩希加斯特在一棵丑树下生了一大窝崽。不过我们确实找到了锻炉！只是……那些锻造大师把技艺全带进了坟墓，一个字都没留下。至少我们在一处藏身洞里找到了几面盾牌，她把它们带回去研究了。直到今天，她还在设法破解其中的秘密。” 艾瑞娜用指节敲了敲绑在马匹侧腹、盾面呈蛇首形状的圆盾。“而我得到了一面当纪念品。”阿斯特丽达脸上浮现笑容。“今天你或许能看到它大显身手。它可以拨开飞射物；而且照那些农民的说法，我们这次大概会遇上刺甲兽。” [pc.bg hunter barbarian |刺甲兽，是吗？你以前和它们交过几次手。它们在老贝尔哈尔西部是个相当严重的祸患，既有带毒的飞射尖刺和锋利的爪子，又披着格外坚硬的甲壳。不过，它们的冷血特性使其极度畏寒。一年到了这么晚的时候，还能在如此靠北的地方看到它们，实在令人意外。 ] 你催马小跑，跟上艾瑞娜的速度。“[pc.dcb |带路吧。 |别让它们久等。 |好耶！”你欢呼道，“出发！ ]”

rows.original:
"This country really is beautiful," you find yourself saying, watching the rolling green highlands pass you by. 
    
    Small farmsteads dot the hills, manors surrounded by small clusters of workers' cottages and rows of winter vegetables near ready for harvest. Chest-high stone walls protect the estates, the only defenses you can spot beyond the thewy muscles of bare-chested farmhands. They wave whenever you pass near, shouting welcomes and blessings. 
    
    "Even if I weren't an Astrida, I'd still want to protect it," Eirina says. "The people here, they're as good-hearted as they are hard working." She waves back at a pair of young women sitting atop a fence, trying to hide a burning winterstem roll behind their backs. You and Eirina exchange smirks. 
    
    Another half hour passes, and you arrive at a small little estate by a riverside, plain glass windows the only real sign of wealth amidst austere grey stone. You can immediately see the evidence of problems afoot: huge gouges in the crop fields where the earth's been turned over by digging claws, and something's knocked a hole in the weather-worn outer walls big enough for you to ride your horse through — and you do, since the gate's closed and unmanned. 
    
    It's only when you're dismounting at the porch that the manse's door finally cracks open, and a well-built salamander woman in a frost-pink kilt peers out at you. "Oh! [pc.ra astrida
        |Two Astrida answer my call! The goddess truly does bless the faithful!
        |Lady Astrida! Thanks be to the goddess, you've come." She turns turn you. "And be welcome as well, friend. I appreciate your coming.
    ]"
    
    "Our pleasure. I'm Eirina, and this [pc.name]. You're Baroness Saraxeni, yes?" 
    
    The older woman nods, fully stepping out onto the porch. A much younger frostscale, barely ten, takes her place ogling you from the door until her mother's tail pulls it closed. "Yes, that's right. You can call me Sara, if it please, [pc.mf
        |my lady, good sir
        |my ladies
    ]." She gives you a pretty smile, trying to hide her nervousness behind gentility. Despite her noble rank, she gives you both a bow, drawing the eye inexorably to a quite substantial chest beneath that thick tartan. 
    
    "Consider your monster problem as good as solved!"
rows.translation:
“这个国家真的很美。”望着连绵起伏的绿色高地从身旁掠过，你不由自主地说道。 
    
    小型农庄点缀着丘陵；宅邸周围簇拥着工人的小屋，成排冬季蔬菜也即将迎来收获。齐胸高的石墙保护着庄园；除了赤裸上身的农工那一身粗壮肌肉，你看不见其他防御力量。每当你们从附近经过，他们都会挥手，高声送上欢迎与祝福。 
    
    “即使我不是阿斯特丽达，我也依然会想保护这里。”艾瑞娜说道，“这里的人既心地善良，又勤劳肯干。”她向坐在围墙上的两位年轻女子挥手；她们正试图把点燃的冬茎烟卷藏到背后。你和艾瑞娜相视坏笑。 
    
    又过了半个小时，你们抵达河畔一座小庄园。朴素的玻璃窗是严峻灰色石墙间唯一真正显露财富的东西。你立刻看出这里确实出了问题：农田里遍布巨大抓痕，土地被利爪翻起；还有某种东西在饱经风霜的外墙上撞出一个大洞，宽得足以让你骑马穿过——而你也确实这么做了，因为大门紧闭，无人看守。 
    
    直到你在门廊旁下马时，宅邸的大门才终于打开一条缝；一个体格健美、身穿霜粉色裙甲的火蜥蜴女人探出头来。“噢！[pc.ra astrida
        |两位阿斯特丽达回应了我的求助！女神果然会赐福忠诚的信徒！
        |阿斯特丽达女士！感谢女神，你终于来了。”她转向你，“也欢迎你，朋友。非常感谢你愿意前来。
    ]”
    
    “这是我们的荣幸。我是艾瑞娜，这位是[pc.name]。你就是萨拉克塞尼女爵，对吗？” 
    
    年长的女人点点头，完全走出门外。一个年幼许多、还不到十岁的霜鳞孩子取代她的位置，在门边好奇地打量你，直到母亲用尾巴把门关上。“没错。你们愿意的话，可以叫我萨拉，[pc.mf
        |女士和先生
        |两位女士
    ]。”她向你露出漂亮的微笑，试图用优雅举止掩盖紧张。尽管拥有贵族身份，她依然向你们二人鞠躬，也让人的视线不可避免地被厚实格纹布下相当丰满的胸脯吸引。 
    
    “你的怪物问题可以当作已经解决了！”

Eirina shrugs. "Alright, well, like I said — job to do. Maybe you can come along on the next one?"
    
    She hefts up her war spear and claps your shoulder. "See you tomorrow!"
rows.translation:
艾瑞娜耸耸肩。“好吧，就像我说的——还有任务要做。也许下次你可以一起来？”
    
    她扛起战用长矛，拍了拍你的肩膀。“明天见！”

rows.translation: 萨拉克塞尼的庄园究竟种着什么？那些看起来不像谷物。

rows.translation: 你或许能用一些熟透的冬莓，为自己和艾瑞娜调制冰霜武器油。
