rows.original: Try and get to know the curvy matron of the house a little better.
rows.translation: 试着进一步了解这位身材丰满的女主人。
rows.raw: "Try and get to know the curvy matron of the house a little better."

rows.original: You remember Vasko saying he was a farmboy, and Saraxeni looks about his age. What're the odds she knows him?
rows.translation: 你记得瓦斯科说过自己曾是农家子弟，而萨拉克塞尼看起来和他年纪相仿。她认识他的可能性有多大？
rows.raw: "You remember Vasko saying he was a farmboy, and Saraxeni looks about his age. What're the odds she knows him?"

rows.original: You've no more questions. Time to hunt some monsters.
rows.translation: 你没有其他问题了。该去猎杀怪物了。
rows.raw: "You've no more questions. Time to hunt some monsters."

rows.original: "They're horrible beasts, near the size of a pony," the baroness says with a visible shudder, making her ample chest quake. "Covered in spikes and scales, with noses like... like an extra arm probing around in front of them, and claws like hatchets." [pc.bg hunter barbarian |You and Eirina exchange a glance. That's a quillock alright. |Eirina gives you a glance. "Sure sounds like a quillock." ] "Have they attacked anybody?" "Yes! Me!" Sara's cheeks flush, but she pulls up the hem of her tunic to reveal a trio of fresh, pink scars on her midriff, from navel to hip. "I heard a horrible noise just before sundown and went out to investigate. I saw something tearing up one of the fields, throwing dirt up everywhere, and hit it with my staff as hard as I could. I swear, it barely felt it! The monster just whipped around and slashed me! If I was a heartbeat slower on my feet he'd have had my kidneys for dessert." She pulls her shirt back down and frowns. "I've been terrified to let my children out of the house ever since, and none of the workers are feeling any braver. I hardly blame them, but we're going to lose what's left of the harvest if this continues much longer." You ask her, "Do these quillocks only come out at night?" "No! That's the confounding part, they're active in the day — so we can't work for fear of running into them! We hear their ungodly snorting and digging around in the fields at all hours, though, I swear..." "I'd only work in the daylight hours too, if I was a little gribblie," Eirina mutters. "Gets so damn cold at night up here."
rows.translation: “那些是可怕的野兽，几乎和矮种马一样大。”女爵明显打了个寒颤，丰满的胸脯随之抖动，“浑身尖刺和鳞片，鼻子像是……像多长了一条手臂，在身体前方到处探动，爪子则像短柄斧一样。” [pc.bg hunter barbarian |你和艾瑞娜对视一眼。没错，那就是刺甲兽。 |艾瑞娜看了你一眼。“听起来确实像刺甲兽。” ] “它们袭击过人吗？” “当然！袭击了我！”萨拉双颊泛红，却还是掀起上衣下摆，露出腰腹上三道从肚脐延伸到髋部的新鲜粉色伤痕。“日落前不久，我听见一阵可怕的动静，就出去查看。我看见某种东西正在毁坏一片田地，把泥土扬得到处都是，于是用法杖使出全力打了它。我发誓，它几乎毫无感觉！那怪物转身就给了我一爪！当时我的动作只要再慢一个心跳，它就会拿我的肾脏当甜点。” 她把衣摆放下，皱起眉头。“从那以后，我一直不敢让孩子们离开房子，工人们也没有谁更勇敢。我并不怪他们，但要是再持续下去，剩下的收成也会全部毁掉。” 你问她：“这些刺甲兽只在夜间出没吗？” “不是！这正是令人困惑的地方。它们白天也会活动——所以大家根本不敢下田，生怕遇到它们！不过我们日夜都能听见它们那邪门的哼叫和刨土声，我发誓……” “如果我是只小怪物，也只会在白天干活。”艾瑞娜低声说道，“这上面晚上冷得要命。”
rows.raw: ' "They're horrible beasts, near the size of a pony," the baroness says with a visible shudder, making her ample chest quake. "Covered in spikes and scales, with noses like... like an extra arm probing around in front of them, and claws like hatchets." [pc.bg hunter barbarian |You and Eirina exchange a glance. That's a quillock alright. |Eirina gives you a glance. "Sure sounds like a quillock." ] "Have they attacked anybody?" "Yes! Me!" Sara's cheeks flush, but she pulls up the hem of her tunic to reveal a trio of fresh, pink scars on her midriff, from navel to hip. "I heard a horrible noise just before sundown and went out to investigate. I saw something tearing up one of the fields, throwing dirt up everywhere, and hit it with my staff as hard as I could. I swear, it barely felt it! The monster just whipped around and slashed me! If I was a heartbeat slower on my feet he'd have had my kidneys for dessert." She pulls her shirt back down and frowns. "I've been terrified to let my children out of the house ever since, and none of the workers are feeling any braver. I hardly blame them, but we're going to lose what's left of the harvest if this continues much longer." You ask her, "Do these quillocks only come out at night?" "No! That's the confounding part, they're active in the day — so we can't work for fear of running into them! We hear their ungodly snorting and digging around in the fields at all hours, though, I swear..." "I'd only work in the daylight hours too, if I was a little gribblie," Eirina mutters. "Gets so damn cold at night up here." '

rows.original:
You point back down the hill to the estate's old stone wall. "Did the monsters do that?"
    
    Sara makes an embarrassed noise, and rubs at her elbow. "Ah, no. That was... during the Lion Witch's War. Our estate was raided several times by the barbarians, and, well, we never had the money to see everything properly repaired. Especially after my lord husband died."
    
    [pc.dcb
        |"Ah."
        |You wince. "Sorry."
        |"Oh no! I'm so sorry."
    ]
    
    "Mmm. A lot of the outer buildings were burned, and our villagers went closer to the city. Those that weren't captured by marauders. The crown's helped some, but things have been hard out here ever since. We barely make enough from our produce to keep up the house. But you don't need to hear about our problems, I'm sorry!"
    
    Eirina puts up a reassuring hand. "It's alright. It's good to hear what troubles the realm's facing, even of a more mundane nature."
rows.translation:
你指向山坡下庄园那道古老的石墙。“那是怪物干的吗？”
    
    萨拉尴尬地哼了一声，揉着自己的手肘。“啊，不是。那是……雄狮女巫战争期间留下的。我们的庄园曾多次遭到蛮族袭击，而且，我们一直没有足够的钱把所有地方妥善修复。尤其是在我的丈夫去世以后。”
    
    [pc.dcb
        |“啊。”
        |你皱起脸。“抱歉。”
        |“噢，不！真的很抱歉。”
    ]
    
    “嗯。许多外围建筑都被烧毁了，村民们也搬去了离城市更近的地方——那些没有被掠夺者抓走的人。王室提供过一些帮助，但从那以后，这里的日子一直很艰难。农产品的收入勉强只够维持宅邸。不过你不必听我们诉苦，对不起！”
    
    艾瑞娜安慰地抬起一只手。“没关系。了解王国正面临哪些困境是件好事，即便只是这种较为寻常的困境。”

rows.original:
"Oh, winterberries, mostly," she answers softly, coiling a lock of cyan hair around a claw. "We're only of the only estates in the principality far enough north that they'll grow. You've already missed winemaking season, though, but there's some late bloomers still on the bushes. Right now the fields are mostly onions, turnips, and peppers — and my poor red peppers seem to be what those awful monsters are after!"
    
    Sara sighs sadly. "The whole crop is just about ruined."
rows.translation:
“主要是冬莓。”她轻声回答，用一根爪子卷着一缕青色头发，“我们是公国里少数几个位置足够靠北、能种活冬莓的庄园之一。不过你已经错过酿酒季了，灌木上倒还有些晚熟的果实。目前田里主要种着洋葱、芜菁和辣椒——而我那些可怜的红辣椒，似乎正是那些可恶怪物的目标！”
    
    萨拉伤心地叹了口气。“整片作物几乎全毁了。”

rows.original:
"Oh, little Vasko, yes. I remember him." Sara points back the way you came, down the road. "His family lives maybe an hour's walk back south from here. Just commonfolk, working the land. It's remarkable their son rose so high. Why, when I was younger, no more than my daughter's age, I'd see him and his friends playing in the road. I'd throw winterberries at them sometimes; he pulled my pigtails until I cried once!" She laughs, and shakes her head. "I heard his father whipped his rear red for laying hands on a noble girl; he never bothered me again."
    
    "Does he ever come back up this way?"
    
    Sara nods. "A few times a year, to visit his family. Their baron is always so proud when he does — that's the only reason I hear about it. He preens that a chancellor of the court has come to visit, as if Vasko's made the trip to see him! Arrogant pr— partridge." She glances away, biting her lip. 
    
    [vasko.around
        |Eirina smirks. "I hope he's not still pulling your pigtails."
        
        "Haha, no, I haven't talked to him in years. The last time I saw him, he seemed so... angry, about everything. I was afraid he'd snap if I said one wrong word. I just let him look around the fields like he'd wanted, and left it at that." She sighs. "A shame. With that position of his, if he could mend that chip on his shoulder he could marry into a highborn house. He's handsome enough for it."
    ]
rows.translation:
“哦，小瓦斯科，是的，我记得他。”萨拉指向你们来时的方向，也就是道路南边，“他家离这里往南大约一个小时路程。只是普通农户，以耕作为生。他们的儿子竟能爬到如此高位，实在了不起。哎呀，我小时候——也就和我女儿现在差不多大——常看见他和朋友们在路上玩。我有时会朝他们扔冬莓；有一次他一直扯我的辫子，直到把我弄哭！”她笑着摇摇头，“听说他父亲因为他对贵族女孩动手，把他的屁股抽得通红；从那以后，他再也没来招惹我。”
    
    “他还会回到这一带吗？”
    
    萨拉点点头。“每年回来几次，探望家人。每当他回来，他们的男爵总是骄傲得不得了——我也只有因此才会听说。那人炫耀宫廷大臣前来拜访，仿佛瓦斯科是专程来看他一样！傲慢的混——鹧鸪。”她移开目光，咬了咬嘴唇。 
    
    [vasko.around
        |艾瑞娜坏笑起来。“希望他现在不会再扯你的辫子了。”
        
        “哈哈，不会；我已经很多年没和他说过话了。上次见到他时，他看起来对……一切都充满怒火。我生怕说错一个字，他就会爆发。我只是让他按照自己的意思在田里四处看看，然后便没再打扰。”她叹了口气，“真可惜。凭他的地位，如果能放下心里的怨气，完全可以迎娶高门贵族。他也确实长得足够英俊。”
    ]

rows.original: "Me?" Sara says, cheeks darkening just a touch. She rests a hand over her chest, and her aurora-tipped tail flares behind her. "I'm Saraxeni en Corina, a pleasure to make your acquaintance, my [pc.mf |lord |lady ]...?" "[pc.name][kiyoko.married | Ōtomo ][kythie.isMarried | en Tychris ][etheryn.married | var Ridell ]," you say, taking the lady's hand and giving it a kiss. [kythie.isMarried |"Oh, my! You're Lady Kythie's new [pc.mf |husband |w-wife ]! I'm sorry, your highness, I didn't recognize you!" [pc.isDK |"Next time you will, I'm sure." |You give her a disarming smile. "It's quite alright." ] ] "Such a [pc.mf |gentleman |gracious lady ]!" Sara giggles. "My daughter Stelania and son Ademn are inside. By the grace of Prince Evander, we are lords over this parcel of land, and I have the honor to be a companion of Lady Tethys when the hosts of Tychris march." You let your eyes wander over the soft, motherly curves and plush thighs in front of you. "You don't strike me as a soldier, Sara." She laughs into the back of her hand. "Oh, no, no. I am a mage. Not a particularly skilled one," she adds, glancing at Eirina, "but I spent my youth studying the arcane arts, and a bit of the sword and military tactics. My father held the same role to Prince Evander's father, and his father before him... well, you understand. I only wish that talent was enough to protect my own home! But my lightning magic seems to just bounce off these creatures!" "That's what we're here for," you say reassuringly. "You've got nothing to worry about." "I feel better already," Sara says. Her toe-claws clack excitedly against the stone porch. "Perhaps you two would like to come inside and have some food and wine with us? There's some olive bread near ready to come out of the kiln..." Eirina cuts you a glance. "We'd love to, but we really should take care of the monster problem first, don't you think, [pc.name]?" "Oh!" Sara gasps. "Of course, how silly of me." "But afterwards," you say, returning Eirina's look. "Afterwards." Eirina nods.
rows.translation: “我吗？”萨拉说道，双颊微微泛红。她把一只手放在胸口，带有极光尾焰的尾巴在身后明亮起来。“我是科丽娜家的萨拉克塞尼，很高兴认识你，我的[pc.mf |大人 |女士 ]……？” “我是[pc.name][kiyoko.married |·大友 ][kythie.isMarried |·恩·提克里斯 ][etheryn.married |·瓦尔·里德尔 ]。”你说道，牵起女士的手，在手背上轻吻一下。 [kythie.isMarried |“噢，我的天！你就是凯西女士新婚的[pc.mf |丈夫 |妻、妻子 ]！抱歉，殿下，我没有认出你来！” [pc.isDK |“我相信下次你就会认出来了。” |你露出令人放松的微笑。“完全没关系。” ] ] “真是一位[pc.mf |绅士 |优雅的女士 ]！”萨拉咯咯笑道，“我的女儿斯特拉妮娅和儿子阿德姆都在屋里。承蒙埃万德王子恩典，我们是这片土地的领主；每当提克里斯大军出征时，我也有幸作为泰西斯女士的随从同行。” 你的目光在眼前那柔软而充满母性魅力的曲线与丰腴大腿上游移。“萨拉，你看起来不像士兵。” 她用手背掩着嘴笑了起来。“噢，不，不。我是一名法师，而且算不上特别出色。”她补充道，同时瞥向艾瑞娜，“不过年轻时，我学习过奥术，也学过一点剑术和军事战术。我的父亲曾为埃万德王子的父亲担任同样的职务，他的父亲在他之前也……嗯，你明白的。我只希望自己的才能足以保护家园！可我的闪电魔法似乎只会从这些生物身上弹开！” “这正是我们来到这里的原因。”你安慰道，“你不必担心。” “我已经感觉好多了。”萨拉说道。她的趾爪兴奋地敲击石质门廊。“也许你们愿意进屋，和我们一起吃些食物、喝点酒？窑炉里有些橄榄面包，很快就能出炉……” 艾瑞娜瞥了你一眼。“我们很愿意，不过还是应该先解决怪物的问题，对吧，[pc.name]？” “噢！”萨拉倒吸一口气，“当然，我真糊涂。” “不过可以等事情结束以后。”你回应艾瑞娜的目光。 “事情结束以后。”艾瑞娜点点头。

rows.original: "Feel free to help yourself to the berries," Sara says, trying not to swish her tail too hard with interest. "They may be a little too ripe for eating, but you're more than welcome to whatever you want from the gardens, young [pc.mf |man |lady ]!" You give her a nod and head down to the bushes nearest the manse, hurriedly collecting two handfuls of overripe blue-red berries. They're already so soft that several of them just turn to mush on you, but that's fine, it's their destiny anyway. "Do you have somewhere I can set up some tools?" you call back to the porch. "Preferably open to the air?" "There's an old barn out back," Sara says. "Help yourself. Only ones you might bother are the crows." You give her a nod and set off to work. All you need to do is get a fire going, create a thick paste, boil down the winterberries, and then refine them down through a couple of good strains into a thick, viscous oil that's unpleasantly cold to the touch. Mix that in with the earthy paste, and you're good to go. It won't last long, but excite the paste against a metal surface and it'll get ice cold! "Oh, honey, it smells like wet horse out here!" Sara complains as you return, pinching her nose. Eirina just laughs. "That's alchemy for you, my lady! But I think I know what [pc.name] is about. Good thinking!" "Well, I [pc.ra astrida |expect nothing less from an Astrida |can see [pc.heShe] must be quite clever, to travel with an Astrida. ]"
rows.translation: “浆果请随意采摘。”萨拉说道，努力不让兴奋的尾巴摆得太厉害，“它们可能熟过头，不太适合直接吃，不过花园里的东西随你取用，年轻的[pc.mf |先生 |女士 ]！” 你朝她点点头，走向宅邸附近的灌木丛，迅速采了满满两捧熟过头的蓝红色浆果。它们已经软到有几颗直接在你手里化成了果泥，不过没关系，反正这就是它们注定的归宿。 “有没有地方能让我摆开工具？”你朝门廊喊道，“最好是露天的？” “后面有座旧谷仓。”萨拉说道，“随便用吧。可能会被你打扰到的也只有乌鸦。” 你点头回应，随即动手。只需要生起火，制成浓稠的糊状基料，把冬莓煮烂，然后经过几次充分过滤，将其提炼成黏稠的油；这油摸起来冷得令人不适。再把它与带有泥土气息的糊料混合，便大功告成。成品维持不了多久，但只要在金属表面激活糊料，就会变得如寒冰般冰冷！ “噢，亲爱的，这里闻起来像匹湿马！”你回来时，萨拉捏着鼻子抱怨道。 艾瑞娜只是笑了起来。“炼金术就是这样，女士！不过我想我知道[pc.name]打算做什么了。好主意！” “嗯，我[pc.ra astrida |相信阿斯特丽达理应有这般本事 |看得出[pc.heShe]必然相当聪明，才有资格与阿斯特丽达同行。 ]”

rows.original:
"Ready to head out?"
    
    Eirina gives you a nod. "Always."
    
    "Don't worry, Sara, we'll be back soon," you say. "Just stay inside until we're done."
    
    The baroness gives you a demure smile and steps back towards her door. "Goddess watch over you both! You don't know what this means to us." 
    
    When the door closes behind you both, you [pc.bg hunter barbarian
        |take a deep breath and head towards the fields. "Follow me. I'll catch the beasts' trail."
        
        "Oh, well. After you, then!"
        |give Eirina a look. "So what now?"
        
        "I'll try and find a trail, I guess! Tracking's not my strongest suit, but quillocks have pretty distinctive claw-feet. Shouldn't be too hard."
    ]
    
    The tracks are easy to spot: deep, chicken-like gouges in the earth all around the baroness's fields, where the earth's been turned up and her crops have been torn to shreds.

rows.original:
You lean in and plant a kiss on Eirina's brow. "I'm going to [pc.isMage

rows.original:
You're roused from your sleep by your lover sitting up on the bed's edge, stretching all those glorious back-muscles out right in front of you. It's enough to [pc.hasRealCock
        |give you a little stiffy right then and there
        |send a tremble of warmth between your legs
    ]. "[var0
        |Morning
        |Afternoon
        |Evening
    ], beautiful," you murmur, reaching out to grab those muscles. You just end up with a handful of fat, scaly tail, wrapping around your wrist. 
    
    "Hey, [pc.name]. Did I wake you?"
    
    You shake your head. "About time I got up too."
    
    "Good. Just hold still a second, and..." Eirina lifts a hand and incants a spell. The bed under you vibrates, just for a split second, and you suddenly smell rose petals and lilac all in the air. The scent of sex vanishes under it, almost entirely washed away. And your skin starts to feel downright pristine, too. "There! A little old rune-magic, from Old Belhar. Courtesy of my predecessor's predecessor."
    
    "Handy." You clamber over to the 'mander before she can get up, putting your arms around her. She leans back into the embrace, content to let you kiss her neck and shoulders, working your way up to her lips. You taste her lips, gently parting them with your tongue. "But that's even nicer."
    
    "Mmm. Better stop, or I'll end up derelicting my duty all over the place."
    
    "That'd be terrible," you say, slipping a hand up to her breast. One good squeeze and she's stiffening, chest heaving into your hand. "There we go. Just wanted you to keep thinking of me."
    
    "Believe me. I can't really stop." Eirina squirms out of your grasp, shaking her head. "Come on, already, before I pounce on you."
    
    "That'd be terrible," you echo.
    
    She boops your nose with a warm tail-tip, and hands you your top. Alright, alright...
rows.translation:
你的爱人坐起身来到床边，就在你面前舒展那一身壮美的背部肌肉，将你从睡梦中唤醒。这景象足以[pc.hasRealCock
        |让你当场微微勃起
        |让一股温热的颤栗掠过双腿之间
    ]。“[var0
        |早上好
        |下午好
        |晚上好
    ]，美人。”你低声说道，伸手想抓住那些肌肉，最后却只握住一大把粗壮的鳞片尾巴；尾巴随即缠上你的手腕。 
    
    “嘿，[pc.name]。我把你吵醒了吗？”
    
    你摇摇头。“我也该起床了。”
    
    “很好。保持不动一下，然后……”艾瑞娜抬起手，吟唱一道法术。你身下的床铺振动了短短一瞬，空气中忽然弥漫起玫瑰花瓣和丁香的香气。性爱留下的味道被它覆盖，几乎彻底洗净，就连你的皮肤也开始感觉洁净如新。“好了！这是老贝尔哈尔传下的一点古代符文魔法，来自我前任的前任。”
    
    “真方便。”趁这位火蜥蜴还没起身，你爬到她身边，用双臂抱住她。她向后靠进你的怀抱，满足地任由你亲吻自己的脖颈和肩膀，一路吻到嘴唇。你品尝着她的双唇，用舌头轻轻将其分开。“不过这感觉更好。”
    
    “嗯。最好停下来，否则我可要把职责抛到九霄云外了。”
    
    “那可太糟糕了。”你一边说，一边把手伸到她的乳房上。只用力捏了一下，她的身体便骤然绷紧，胸膛在你手中急促起伏。“好了。只是想让你继续惦记着我。”
    
    “相信我，我根本停不下来。”艾瑞娜扭动着挣脱你的怀抱，摇了摇头。“快点起来，不然我真要扑到你身上了。”
    
    “那可太糟糕了。”你重复道。
    
    她用温暖的尾尖轻点你的鼻子，把上衣递给你。好吧，好吧……

rows.original: You continue to pet Eirina's hair, listening to the cadence of her breath slowing, slowing... until it turns into a soft snore. Lights out, little 'mander. Once you're sure she's out cold, you slip out from under her, replacing your body with your still-warm pillow. She stretches a little, wrapping her arms around it. Even her tail tries to curl around you, swishing under the covers. Gods, she is cute, though. You shake the thought and start prowling. First, the captain's chests of drawers. You pull them open one by one, quietly shifting through folded kilts, tunics, a few formal robes... not a trace of underwear amongst them, but also nothing but clothing. Not even jewelry. You slide them closed, one after another, emptyhanded. Her nightstands prove to be only a little more helpful: she's got a couple of daggers, blank parchment and inkwells, sitting dangerously close to a few bottles of scented oil. [var0 |You draw in a sharp breath as glass clinks against glass, and Eirina's ears twitch... but that's all the reaction you get. Good. Gentle a you can, you slide the drawer closed. Nothing actually useful in there. Well, there go the obvious places. She's got an arming stand and weapon rack, but they're obvious, and well-worn. Unlikely. One last place to look, then: you lower yourself to the ground, peering underneath the bed. Sure enough, there's several wooden chests and cases under there, tucked out of sight. You brush their brass claps with your fingertips, one after the other, exerting just a little pressure. Most of them give — not locked. All but one. With all the delicacy in the world, you lift the case up and pull it a little closer. It's heavy, solid as a rock and etched with runes. [pc.isMage |Runes of warding, anti-scrying, preservation. Serious business, this. But no alarm spell, at least as far as you can see. Bit of an oversight, but you suppose in the basement of the Astrida's stronghold they aren't really worried about somebody tampering with things. You'd never be able to get down here yourself if [pc.ra astrida |you weren't one of them yourself |not for one of them falling for you ]. |You have no clue what they mean, but they don't react to you manhandling them at least. That's a good start... ] You take a deep breath and gingerly try to lift the lid. Locked tight. Damn it. Well, [pc.cl thief |you've got some lockpicks for that. You slide them out of your pack and get to work, pushing tumblers up one after the other until you hear that almost-imperceptible click of success. |the good news is that the lady with the key is probably here in the room with you. You've just got to find it. A process that's really rather quick, it turns out. Eirina's sword belt's fallen to the ground just a few paces away, and she's got a bronze ring of keys hanging off the back of it. Glancing one last time at their slumbering owner, you surreptitiously slide the keys off her belt and start going through them. Sure enough, one fits. ] You pop the lock and lift the lid. All that's inside is a single book, unmarked, plainly bound. The only embellishment is a gold-thread bookmark halfway through. You crack the cover and peer inside. On the very first page is a single sentence, inked in a flowing hand: Spells Inscribed Upon the Body of Ynes, of Courlund, as Recorded by Paladin Eirina of the Most Holy Order Astrida Now this could be useful. |And you're just a little too quick in your investigations: a pair of bottles click together, loud enough that Eirina snorts. You hurriedly close the drawer and grab your [pc.armor], trying to make it look like that made the noise. "Ugh. [pc.name]? What're you doing?" "Oh, just... just getting dressed. I thought you were dead asleep." Eirina stretches. "Light sleeper. Gotta be when you travel alone.[pc.bg soldier | You were a professional once, right? Got the look about you. rows.raw: ' You give her a cruel smirk and shake your head. "No." "Buh- but whyyyy?" Eirina pouts. "You suck." You just reach down and flick the tent rubbing your hip. "Your body doesn't seem to think so." "My body's going crazy!" she hisses back. The 'mander puts her hands on her hips, like that'll budge you, before finally huffing and pulling away from you. "Suck suck suck suck, you suck." Eirina grabs her spear from where its leaning against the wall and shoves past you, towards Ynes's desk. She leans over it, whispers something to the buxom witch, and the pair of them disappear down into the under-labyrinth. That is something, alright... '

rows.original:
"A ring for a giant? Uh, hold on here..." Eirina laughs. "I think I know what Kythie's talking about, but I can't just let you walk off with Philandros's ring! It's a relic from the Godswar, the very symbol of our order. We keep it enshrined down in the sanctuary. Sisters pray to it for guidance every day!"
    
    You sigh. "Can't you let me borrow it for a day?"
    
    [pc.ra astrida
        |Eirina gives you a sympathetic look. "I wish I could, but even for a member of the Order that's a tall ask.
        |"Absolutely not!" Eirina crosses her arms. "I'm sorry, really, but that ring is precious to us. I can't just let somebody, even a Champion, wander off with it in the forest. Even by my standards that's irresponsible."
    ]
    
    God damn it. "Do you have any ideas, then? The poor giant's been out there for gods-know how long."
    
    "Yeah, and I'm curious as to why... what the hell would the Blackscale Prince have hidden out in the woods of Hawkstone?" Eirina rubs her chin. "I know there was a big battle near there, where the Astrida fought. Some old fort, we were trying to hold back Wraithtouched from overrunning past the River Ridell. And then there was a lot of monster hunting the mountains after the war. Still is, once or twice a year, down near the fjords. But right in the middle of the forest?" 
    
    She shrugs. "I can't give you the ring, but maybe I have something just as good. Kythie might have been wrong about a writ. Hold here a second."
    
    The Astrida claps your shoulder and jogs off towards the downstairs door. You watch her go, [eirina.fucked
        |appreciating the bounce of all that muscular ass barely hidden by her kilt
        |feeling more than a little bewildered. Prince Evander's not in the basement, is he?
    ]
    
    Ynes [ynes.pregStage 3
        |waddles
        |swoops
    ] over to you with a cup of tea. "Well, you should feel honored, having the First Spear of the Order running from you. Even a dragon couldn't manage that. What did you say?"
    
    You just give her a look, which makes the witch cackle with mirth. She hands you the cup and slips into one of the nearby chairs, [ynes.pregStage 2
        |letting you caress her baby bump
        |thumbing through one of the books left lying out
    ] while you wait.
    
    It only takes a minute or two for Eirina to return, carrying a wooden box under her arm. "Alright! Here, this might just do it for you." She slaps the box into your waiting hand. "Take a look."
    
    Sure, you'll bite. You crack it open, revealing a time-yellowed old roll of parchment, complete with a broken wax seal depicting the Tychrisian arms. "What is this?"
    
    "A writ, from Prince Philandros himself. It's been with the Order since... actually before it was technically founded. We actually have several of these, and I'd like it back all the same, but I don't necessarily mind letting this walk out the door. It's not unique in the world."
    
    Ynes arches an eyebrow. "It certainly is precious, though, if that's what I think it is."
    
    "Yeah, so, this was like a... like a letter of introduction from the prince. Tychris was spared the worst of the fighting, since it was Nareva's stronghold, but Philandros wanted to take to the fight to the Wraiths. So he sent out chosen men to go and recruit the best soldiers, spellcasters, and scoundrels from all over the empire and bring them to Tychris. This letter gave the bearer the right to speak and bargain with his authority."
    
    "And before you ask," Ynes says, "it doesn't mean anything anymore. Don't go trying to get royal privileges with that, for goodness' sake. It's obviously centuries out of date."
    
    Eirina smirks. "Yeah, but so's your giant. She'd recognize the signature, the seal, all of it."
    
    You take the box and stow it. "We'll see [pc.isDK
        |if she falls for it
        |what she thinks
    ]."
    
    "Good luck!" Ynes says, heading back to her desk. "And don't forget to drop that in the returns bin when you're done."
    
    "Ha, yeah, I guess that's one way to do it. So, anything else you need?"
rows.translation:
“给一个巨人弄戒指？呃，先打住……”艾瑞娜笑道。“我想我知道凯西在说什么，可我不能就这么让你把菲兰德罗斯的戒指带走！那是诸神之战留下的圣物，是我们教团最根本的象征。我们把它供奉在下面的圣所里。姐妹们每天都向它祈祷，求取指引！”
    
    你叹了口气。“你就不能让我借一天吗？”
    
    [pc.ra astrida
        |艾瑞娜同情地看了你一眼。“我也希望我能，但就算是教团成员，这个请求也太过了。
        |“绝对不行！”艾瑞娜抱起双臂。“我很抱歉，真的，但那枚戒指对我们来说太珍贵了。我不能让任何人，哪怕是冠军，带着它跑进森林里到处乱晃。就算按我的标准，那也是不负责任。”
    ]
    
    真该死。“那你有什么主意吗？那可怜的巨人不知道在那儿待了多久了。”
    
    “是啊，而且我也好奇是为什么……黑鳞王子究竟把什么东西藏在了鹰棘镇的林子里？”艾瑞娜搓着下巴。“我知道那附近打过一场大战，阿斯特里达参战的那场。有座旧堡垒，我们当时想拦住亡魂侵染者，不让他们越过里德尔河。”她又说：“战后那些年，山里猎杀魔物的活儿很多。现在也还有，一年一两次，就在峡湾附近。可偏偏在森林正中央？” 
    
    她耸耸肩。“戒指我不能给你，但也许我有一样同样好用的东西。关于通行文书，凯西也许说错了。在这儿等一下。”
    
    这位阿斯特里达拍了拍你的肩膀，朝楼下的门小跑过去。你看着她离开，[eirina.fucked
        |欣赏那被她的短裙勉强遮住的肌肉臀部一颠一颠
        |感到相当困惑。埃万德王子不会就在地下室里吧？
    ]
    
    伊内斯[ynes.pregStage 3
        |摇摇摆摆地
        |飘一样地
    ]端着一杯茶走向你。“嗯，你该感到荣幸，教团的首席长矛竟为你跑前跑后。连一头龙都做不到这一点。你刚才说了什么？”
    
    你只是看了她一眼，惹得这女巫咯咯直笑。她把杯子递给你，滑进旁边的一张椅子里，[ynes.pregStage 2
        |任你抚摸她的孕肚
        |翻着随手摊在那儿的书
    ]，而你等着。
    
    只过了一两分钟，艾瑞娜就回来了，腋下夹着一个木盒。“好了！来，这个也许正合你用。”她把盒子拍进你等着的手里。“看看吧。”
    
    行，你就看看。你把它撬开，里面是一卷被岁月熏黄了的旧羊皮纸，还带着一枚破碎的蜡封，上面刻着提克里斯王室的纹章。“这是什么？”
    
    “一份通行文书，菲兰德罗斯王子亲笔的。它一直由教团保管，从……实际上从教团正式成立之前就在了。这种东西我们其实有好几份，我一样希望它回来，但也不一定介意让它出门一趟。它在世上并非独一无二。”
    
    伊内斯挑起一道眉毛。“不过它确实珍贵，前提是我想的那东西没错。”
    
    “对，所以，这就像是……像是王子的一封引荐信。提克里斯因为是娜瑞瓦的据点，避开了战事最糟的部分，但菲兰德罗斯想把战火烧到亡魂身上去。于是他派出亲选的人，去从帝国各地招募最好的士兵、施法者和亡命之徒，把他们带到提克里斯来。这封信赋予持有者以他的权威发言和谈条件的权利。”
    
    “而且省得你问，”伊内斯说，“它现在已经没有任何效力了。看在老天的份上，别拿它去讨要什么王室特权。它显然已经过时几百年了。”
    
    艾瑞娜勾起嘴角。“是啊，可你的巨人也是过时的。她会认得那个签名、那枚印章，全部都会认得。”
    
    你接过盒子收好。“那就看看[pc.isDK
        |她会不会上钩
        |她怎么想
    ]。”
    
    “祝你好运！”伊内斯说着走回她的书桌。“还有，用完了别忘了把它扔进归还箱里。”
    
    “哈，是啊，我猜这也算一种办法。那么，你还需要别的什么吗？”

rows.original: Pushing through the crowd in the plaza, you're greeted by a curious sight — that of a folding merchant's stall set up be one of the entrances, complete with an assortment of goods laid out on it. This wouldn't be so out of place in any city, if not for the fact that no one's manning it — despite a number of fairly valuable pieces of art being out on display, there's a conspicuously empty space where the stallholder should be. Upon closer inspection, though, there's a small sign hanging over the stall's front, written in cute, neat handwriting despite the charcoal-on-wood lettering: HELLO AND GOOD MORNING/DAY/NIGHT! Please feast your eyes upon the wondrous menagerie of GREAT ART that I've on offer today, woof! Every piece worth the price! Prices are noted below every item, please put payment in the jar! Stock changes every day, so come back often, woof! If you wish to pawn your cast-offs, simply place them under the stall and help yourself to the amount you're owed! I sincerely believe in Tychrisian nobility and virtue, and that no upstanding subject of the principality would pull any shenanigans, woof! Especially not within a stone's throw of the palace! You're considering the novelty and plausibility of this whole scheme when one of the passing 'manders simply reaches over, scoops up a box of fancy candies and drops a not inconsequential number of hawks into the jar. Well. It does help that you're in the palace district, where the locals have more than enough money to be tempted by a single stall's daily takings. This… [pc.bgmulti noblescion scholar acolyte slumrat |you remember your tutors explaining to you that how even the countryside of old Belhar was so peaceful and civilized that farmers and tradesmen would display wares by the roadside unattended, and people would pay the right prices for them. In some cases, there weren't even any prices denoted, and people just paid what they thought the produce was worth. That such a system could actually function was a result of the trust each Belharan citizen had for the other… the pinnacle of civilization in recorded history, as it were. It all seemed so far-fetched… and yet it's happening before your eyes now. |you remember reading through old histories of how even the countryside of old Belhar was so peaceful and civilized that farmers and tradesmen would display wares by the roadside unattended, and people would pay the right prices for them. In some cases, there weren't even any prices denoted, and people just paid what they thought the produce was worth. That such a system could actually function was a result of the trust each Belharan citizen had for the other… the pinnacle of civilization in recorded history, as it were. It all seemed so far-fetched… and yet it's happening before your eyes now. |as an acolyte, you remember hearing sermons about how life in old Belhar was supposed to be, that it was so blessed by the gods that farmers and tradesmen would display wares by the roadside unattended, and people would pay the right prices for them. In some cases, there weren't even any prices denoted, and people just paid what they thought the produce was worth. The seed of piety that took root in the imperium blossomed into the noble civic-mindedness of the age, which was why it had the kind of strength to vanquish all other competitors. That such a system could actually function was a result of the trust that Belharan citizens had in the gods, mirrored in each other… it feels so far-fetched, especially with the way things are in the heartlands today. But seeing the people of Tychris actually act that way before your eyes at least proves that such things are possible. |this screams to your well-honed guttersnipe's senses as being wrong, as being an unbelievably easy mark — the hungry street rat that the younger you was would have seen it as an opportunity to pilfer what you could, eat anything edible and sell the rest for food. And yet… this shop which operates on nothing but peoples' integrity somehow manages to work. Tychris is nothing but truly special. |this is quite impressive and speaks to the city's ethos, if nothing else. ] Well, given that Tychris is the local bastion of civilization and that the Order Astrida is headquartered here, if such a thing were to be possible anywhere in the Marches, it'd have to be in the principality. Well, the system looks simple enough. Take wares, drop money in the jar; put items to be pawned, take money from the jar. What happens when everything on display is gone, who brings in new stock, who collects all the payment at the end of the day — that's the problem of whoever's behind this stall. You're just here to buy and sell, if it comes to that.
rows.translation: 你挤过广场上的人群，迎面撞见一桩怪事——其中一个入口旁支着一顶折叠商摊，上面摆满了各式货品。这在任何城市里都不算稀奇，只是摊子前压根没人看管——明明陈列着好几件相当值钱的艺术品，摊主该站的位置却空空如也。 不过凑近一看，摊子前方挂着一块小牌子，是用木炭写在木头上的字，笔迹却可爱又工整： 你好，早安/午安/晚安！ 请尽情欣赏今日我为您奉上的这场了不起的「伟大艺术」百宝展，汪！每一件都物有所值！价格标在每件货物下方，付款请放进罐子里！货品每天都会换新，请常来看看，汪！若您想典当旧物，只需把它放在摊子下面，然后自己取走应得的钱款即可！ 我由衷相信提克里斯人的高贵与美德，相信公国里任何一位体面的子民都不会耍什么花样，汪！尤其是在离宫殿一箭之遥的地方！ 你正琢磨这套做法有多新奇、多可信，一名路过的火蜥蜴人伸手一探，抄起一盒精致糖果，往罐子里丢下数目相当可观的鹰币。 嗯。好在你在宫殿区，本地人手头宽裕得足以被一个小摊的日收入勾住。这…… [pc.bgmulti noblescion scholar acolyte slumrat |你想起导师们讲过，旧贝尔哈的乡下治安与文明程度之高，农夫和商贩会把货品摆在路边无人看管，人们自会照价付钱。有时甚至连价格都不标，大家就按自己认定的价值付账。 这样一套规矩居然真能运转，靠的是每个贝尔哈兰公民对彼此的信任……堪称有史以来文明的巅峰。听起来都那么难以置信……可此刻它就在你眼前发生。 |你想起读过的旧史书里说，旧贝尔哈的乡下治安与文明程度之高，农夫和商贩会把货品摆在路边无人看管，人们自会照价付钱。有时甚至连价格都不标，大家就按自己认定的价值付账。 这样一套规矩居然真能运转，靠的是每个贝尔哈兰公民对彼此的信任……堪称有史以来文明的巅峰。听起来都那么难以置信……可此刻它就在你眼前发生。 |身为侍僧，你想起听过的布道，说旧贝尔哈的生活本该是何等模样：那片土地蒙受神明如此厚爱，农夫和商贩会把货品摆在路边无人看管，人们自会照价付钱。有时甚至连价格都不标，大家就按自己认定的价值付账。虔敬的种子在帝国扎根，开出了那个时代高贵的公民之心，也正是这份心性让它有力量击溃所有竞争者。 这样一套规矩居然真能运转，靠的是贝尔哈兰公民对神明的信任，以及彼此之间映照出的信任……听上去实在难以置信，尤其想到腹地如今的世道。但亲眼见到提克里斯人当真如此行事，至少证明这种事是可能的。 |这在你这副久经磨练的街头混混直觉里简直是错得离谱，是个好骗到难以置信的肥羊——要是从前那个饿着肚子的街头小子，早就把它当成顺手牵羊的机会，能吃的吃掉，剩下的换钱买食。可偏偏……这家只靠人们良心运转的铺子，居然真就开得下去。 提克里斯真是与众不同。 |这相当了不起，至少说明了这座城市的品格。 ]好吧，既然提克里斯是本地文明的堡垒，而阿斯特里达教团又正好把总部设在这里，那要是边境地区哪里能有这种事，也只能是在这座公国了。 嗯，这套规矩看起来够简单。取走货物，往罐子里投钱；放下要典当的东西，从罐子里取钱。等到陈列的货品全卖光了会怎样，谁来补货，谁在一天结束时收走所有钱款——那是摊子背后那个人的麻烦。你只管买卖，真要做的话。

You're considering the novelty and plausibility of this whole scheme when one of the passing 'manders simply reaches over, scoops up a box of fancy candies and drops a not inconsequential number of hawks into the jar. Well. It does help that you're in the palace district, where the locals have more than enough money to be tempted by a single stall's daily takings. This… [pc.bgmulti noblescion scholar acolyte slumrat |you remember your tutors explaining to you that how even the countryside of old Belhar was so peaceful and civilized that farmers and tradesmen would display wares by the roadside unattended, and people would pay the right prices for them. In some cases, there weren't even any prices denoted, and people just paid what they thought the produce was worth. That such a system could actually function was a result of the trust each Belharan citizen had for the other… the pinnacle of civilization in recorded history, as it were. It all seemed so far-fetched… and yet it's happening before your eyes now. |you remember reading through old histories of how even the countryside of old Belhar was so peaceful and civilized that farmers and tradesmen would display wares by the roadside unattended, and people would pay the right prices for them. In some cases, there weren't even any prices denoted, and people just paid what they thought the produce was worth. That such a system could actually function was a result of the trust each Belharan citizen had for the other… the pinnacle of civilization in recorded history, as it were. It all seemed so far-fetched… and yet it's happening before your eyes now. |as an acolyte, you remember hearing sermons about how life in old Belhar was supposed to be, that it was so blessed by the gods that farmers and tradesmen would display wares by the roadside unattended, and people would pay the right prices for them. In some cases, there weren't even any prices denoted, and people just paid what they thought the produce was worth. The seed of piety that took root in the imperium blossomed into the noble civic-mindedness of the age, which was why it had the kind of strength to vanquish all other competitors. That such a system could actually function was a result of the trust that Belharan citizens had in the gods, mirrored in each other… it feels so far-fetched, especially with the way things are in the heartlands today. But seeing the people of Tychris actually act that way before your eyes at least proves that such things are possible. |this screams to your well-honed guttersnipe's senses as being wrong, as being an unbelievably easy mark — the hungry street rat that the younger you was would have seen it as an opportunity to pilfer what you could, eat anything edible and sell the rest for food. And yet… this shop which operates on nothing but peoples' integrity somehow manages to work. Tychris is nothing but truly special. |this is quite impressive and speaks to the city's ethos, if nothing else. ] Well, given that Tychris is the local bastion of civilization and that the Order Astrida is headquartered here, if such a thing were to be possible anywhere in the Marches, it'd have to be in the principality. Well, the system looks simple enough. Take wares, drop money in the jar; put items to be pawned, take money from the jar. What happens when everything on display is gone, who brings in new stock, who collects all the payment at the end of the day — that's the problem of whoever's behind this stall. You're just here to buy and sell, if it comes to that. "

rows.original: You look for Electra by the plaza entrance — despite her stall being all set up and laid out, there isn't a sign of so much as her shadow, nor whisper of her loud, over-enthusiastic voice. Nor, for that matter, is her gigantic backpack anywhere to be seen, replaced by several crates packed under her stall. You're wondering if she's just gone off somewhere for a while when a sign hung over the stall's front catches your attention, neat small letters written on wood in charcoal: HELLO AND GOOD MORNING/DAY/NIGHT! I'm going to be indisposed for the next several months, but that won't stop me from bringing to you beauty and delight from all over the world, woof! Please feast your eyes upon the wondrous menagerie of GREAT ART that I've on offer today, even if I can't grave you with my lovely face! Every piece is absolutely worth the price — which is noted below every item, so please put payment in the jar, woof! Stock changes every day, so come back often, woof! If you wish to pawn your cast-offs, simply place them under the stall and help yourself to the amount you're owed! I sincerely believe in Tychrisian nobility and virtue, and that no upstanding subject of the principality would pull any shenanigans, woof! Especially not within a stone's throw of the palace! — Electra Well, if this isn't just peachy. You're musing over this development when one of the passing 'manders simply reaches over, scoops up a box of fancy candies and drops a not inconsequential number of hawks into the jar. It's a little hard to believe, [pc.bg slumrat |especially with every single instinct you have screaming how easy a mark this would be, ]but if anyone can pull it off with the people of Tychris it'd be someone with Electra's charisma. It does help that you're in the palace district, where the locals have more than enough money to be tempted by a single stall's daily takings — easy to be virtuous when it doesn't cost anything. Well, the system looks simple enough. Take wares, drop money in the jar; put items to be pawned, take money from the jar. Why Electra is indisposed, how long she'll be gone, who collects the money and restocks the stall — those and more are questions that may never be answered. At least it's still business as usual and Electra is fine, wherever she is… it's she who's still running things from afar, right? Right? Whatever the case, until the little dog[silly|go]returns — whenever that is — there's only commerce to be had.
rows.translation: 你去广场入口找伊莱克特拉——她的摊子明明支得好好的、货也摆得整整齐齐，却连她的影子都看不见，更别提她那嗓门洪亮、热情过头的说话声了。她的巨型背包也不见了踪影，取而代之的是塞在摊子下面的几只板条箱。 你正猜想她是不是暂时去了别处，摊子前方挂着的一块牌子却吸引了你的注意，木头上写着工整的小字，用的是木炭： 你好，早安/午安/晚安！ 接下来几个月我有些不便，但这挡不住我把世界各地的美与喜悦带给你们，汪！请尽情欣赏今日我为您奉上的这场了不起的「伟大艺术」百宝展，哪怕我无法用这张可爱的脸亲自为您增光！ 每一件都绝对物有所值——价格标在每件货物下方，所以付款请放进罐子里，汪！货品每天都会换新，请常来看看，汪！若您想典当旧物，只需把它放在摊子下面，然后自己取走应得的钱款即可！ 我由衷相信提克里斯人的高贵与美德，相信公国里任何一位体面的子民都不会耍什么花样，汪！尤其是在离宫殿一箭之遥的地方！ ——伊莱克特拉 好吧，这可真是妙极了。 你正琢磨着这桩变故，一名路过的火蜥蜴人伸手一探，抄起一盒精致糖果，往罐子里丢下数目相当可观的鹰币。这有点让人难以置信，[pc.bg slumrat |尤其是你浑身每一个本能都在尖叫这有多好骗， ]但要说谁能对提克里斯人玩转这一套，那得是伊莱克特拉这样有魅力的人才行。好在你在宫殿区，本地人手头宽裕得足以被一个小摊的日收入勾住——不用付出代价的时候，当个有德之人总是容易的。 嗯，这套规矩看起来够简单。取走货物，往罐子里投钱；放下要典当的东西，从罐子里取钱。 伊莱克特拉为何不便，她会离开多久，谁来收钱、谁来补货——这些以及更多问题，也许永远不会有答案。至少生意照旧，而伊莱克特拉无论身在何处都平安无事……毕竟还是她在远处打理这一切，对吧？ 对吧？ 无论如何，在那只小狗[silly|回]来之前——不管那是什么时候——这里只剩下买卖可做。

rows.original: The palace plaza is crowded during the day, but the throng is especially thick by one of the entrances. [pc.bg slumrat|Discreetly slipping|Nudging your way] through it, you discover the reason for this particular gathering: a small stall stands with wares on display, obviously not of local make — some of them you recognize as having been brought up from the heartlands, while others have even more obscure origins. All manner of finished goods are laid out and for sale — trinkets and porcelain, apparel, preserved sweets — the kind of things which people living in and around the palace would have the interest and means to purchase. Leaning against the stall is an enormous rucksack large enough to hold two goblins in its depths, brimming over with merchandise. And in the midst of it all, the proprietor — the stand may be 'mander-sized, but she isn't. If anything, the floppy-eared half-lupine's so petite that she has to sit on a high stool in order to even approach eye level with her customers. That hasn't dampened the little dog[silly|go]'s enthusiasm any — there's a permanent smile etched out front and a perpetually wagging bushy tail in the back as she buys and sells with no small glee. Stall, backpack and merchandise — how someone so petite manages to lug around an entire ensemble that much larger than she is boggles the mind, but it's just her minding the stand. [party.oneComp cait azyrran |"Oh, wow!" Cait squeals. "She's so cute! I want to hug her and squeeze her and pet her — " Interesting, isn't it? Small and adorable isn't what usually comes to the mind when one thinks of half-lupines, especially in the Marches, but it takes all kinds to make a world. "Everyone else is already doing it, but I kind of want to buy something from her just to cheer her up, she's so cute! Look, she must be a foot shorter than me, maybe more! I could just pick her up and be away with her!" As glorious as the display of mercantilism before you is, you don't think the proprietor herself is for sale. |"Well, if that isn't just adorable," Azyrran muses, chuckling at the sight. "I'm tempted to just pick her up and take her home — she'll fit right in with those colors of hers." As adorable as the little merchant is, you don't think that'd be particularly wise. "You're right, [pc.name]. That would be stealing, the people around these parts probably don't take well to being raided. Not everyone's a beefolk, after all." As glorious as the display of mercantilism before you is, you somehow doubt that Azzy's ability to buy the proprietor is the problem here. ] As you draw close to the little golden dog, she [kohaku.anyKids |stares at you as if suddenly struck by a bolt out of the blue. For a split second, confusion, terror and… embarrassment write themselves all over the petite half-lupine's face, and you're wondering just what's up when you spy a golden-furred puppy trying to clamber out of the gigantic backpack, grasping at the air towards you and giggling. The recovery is remarkable, but not perfect. Affecting nonchalance as she haggles with a prospective customer, the little dog-merchant gently but firmly pushes her puppy down into the backpack and out of sight. Only then does she conclude her business and return her attention to you, beaming brightly as if nothing had transpired. |[pc.ra kitsune |beams and gives you a half-bow from behind her stand. There's a certain something or the other to this little half-lupine — you can almost place your finger on it, but the last piece of the puzzle evades you. Or maybe it doesn't and you know exactly what's up, but while you have a sneaking suspicion as to what it might be it doesn't serve anyone's interests to end the charade in public. If this is really Kohaku, she'll have no choice but to comply with someone so much higher up than her in the food chain, or at least that's how you think this works. On the other hand, the character of this little floppy-eared dog[silly|go] she's taken doesn't know what a kitsune is, and if there's one thing about Kohaku, it's that she never breaks character. While you've been musing, the little golden dog finishes up her business with the last customer and turns her gaze to you, all friendly smiles and eager attentiveness. |[kohaku.met |ears perk up and she gives you a little wave, half-standing on her high stool to get a better view of you over the generally tall 'manders. There's a certain something or the other to this little half-lupine — you can almost place your finger on it, but the last piece of the puzzle evades you. Or maybe it doesn't and you know exactly what's up, but while you have a sneaking suspicion as to what it might be it doesn't serve anyone's interests to end the charade in public. Maybe it is. Maybe it isn't. But if it is Kohaku behind that mask, you know full well that she never breaks character while on business. And if it isn't… does that make this little golden retriever of a half-lupine any less friendly? Of course not. And now that you're at the head of the crowd, she takes a deep breath, ready to prove said gregariousness in the most direct fashion ever possible. |It's as if some nasty-minded deity had gathered together all the cuteness and adorableness he could find, sprinkled it below the waist with a generous helping of sex appeal, and set it loose upon the world to effect a terrible campaign of brutal mercantilism and economic ruin. Well, maybe that last is a bit of an exaggeration, but given the brisk business that this petite dog[silly|go] is doing for being a mere peddler she must be making an absolute killing. Tychris may not be as luxuriantly opulent as Khor'minos is, but it's still pretty rich. And as various 'manders walk off with their purchases and you're pushed right up against the stall, the little half-lupine rises from her high stool, beaming and ready to greet you. ] ] ] "[hours 0 12 18|GOOD MORNING|HELLO|GOOD EVENING], WOOF!" Ugh, your ears, there's no need to shout. But that's an impressive voice coming out of someone that petite.[silly| One might even be tempted to call her a barker.] "It's good for letting people know you've got what they want for sale, woof! But sure, for you I'll tone it down just a little! You're the famous [pc.name], [pc.title], after all!" She knows who you are? "Of course I do! Everyone knows that Prince Evander and his wife have invited you to the palace to celebrate your glory, Champion! What an honor it must be to host someone of your esteem, woof![pc.bg noblescion |Why, there's even talk that you might be here to sweep the princess off her feet!" Is… is that possible? "You do have the qualifications, don't you? I'm not saying that it's necessary, woof, nor would I dare to speak for the prince and his wife on that matter, but… as far as I understand it, it's possible, yes. And wouldn't that be so romantic and sweet?" |"] You look the little golden dog[silly|go] up and down. Does this mean you get a discount for being the savior of the city? "NO!" Somehow, you suspected this might be the case, but it was worth a try. Well then, since she already knows all about you, what's her name? "Yes, yes! I'm Electra, and a trader of great art, woof! Well, I sell other things too, but when I'm in Tychris it's all about the fine beauty — the principality's glassware has been unparalleled for centuries, some say even before the Godswar, woof! If you have any, I'll buy it all!" And she's selling… "Things people around these parts like, woof! Take a look for yourself!" You do just that — laid out on Electra's stall are gems and gewgaws, trinkets and baubles, with a smattering of of just about everything else from suspiciously fresh produce to cosmetics. Similarly, her backpack is filled with peoples' pawned-off glassware and metalwork — fitting for the city of art and magic that Tychris is. "Some of this stuff comes all the way from distant Valgarde, Macah and Yvennes — I'm very proud of my selection of wares, woof! You know it's got to be good if it traveled all the way here to get to you! Good prices for reliable goods, fair remuneration for anything you want to pawn off! Best prices in the palace district, mostly because I don't have any property to pay taxes on, woof!" You look back and forth across the palace plaza. Electra certainly has picked a good spot — despite this being a public space, no one else is peddling wares this close to the palace. Neither has she gotten in trouble with any authority. There's something entirely odd about this folding stall and its petite proprietor, but that doesn't bother her clientele who are willing to put up with a street peddler in order to get at her foreign offerings. "Take your time and browse all you want. I'll be here until evening, woof!" [pc.isCunning |There's just one more thing… "Yes, woof?" That. There. She said %"woof". "Oh. It's just a thing I do when I get excited, which is all the time, woof. Can't help but bark, I'm just so cheerful to be able to do business with everyone in town! Think of it as a verbal tic — having a positive attitude does bring in all the customers, woof!" Yes, that's fine, and it wasn't your point. Said point was that Electra didn't bark, she said %"woof", and keeps on doing it. "Do I, woof?" She does, and just did it again. "I barked, woof." There it goes again. She said it instead of actually barking. "Someone would notice if I were getting up to that kind of mischief, woof." The little golden dog waggles a hand at her clientele. "Everyone else's just fine. You wouldn't happen to have a cold or something, would you? It's important to wrap up well this time of year, and all the outfits champions, adventurers and the like are wearing these days don't look very warm, woof." On one hand, Electra has to be messing with you. On the other, none of the 'manders browsing her wares show any signs of having noticed the oddities in her verbal tic. Unless they're all in on the gag, that is… Electra beams at you with a big, cheery smile full of little dog friendliness. "Does it really matter that much, anyway? I'm just here to sell things, woof." [kohaku.anyKids |There is a point to that… but at the same time, Electra's enormous backpack is vibrating violently with the efforts of its occupant, and while the sounds coming from within are rather muffled they definitely don't sound like a puppy of any kind. ]Guess it'll just have to be one of those mysteries that never get solved. ]
rows.translation: 宫殿广场白天人潮涌动，而其中一个入口旁的拥挤格外厉害。[pc.bg slumrat|你悄悄溜|你侧身挤]进去，才发现这场聚会的缘由：一座小摊摆着货品，显然不是本地出品——其中一些你认得是从腹地运来的，另一些的来路则更加冷僻。 各式成品陈列待售——小玩意与瓷器、衣物、蜜饯——都是住在宫殿内外的人既有兴趣又有财力购置的东西。靠在摊子边的是一只巨大无比的背包，深得能装下两个哥布林，里面塞得满到溢出来。 而在这一切当中站着摊主——摊子是火蜥蜴人的尺寸，她可不是。这位垂耳半狼族姑娘娇小得不得不坐在一张高脚凳上，才能勉强与顾客平视。这丝毫没减损这只小狗[silly|崽子]的热情——前面永远挂着一副笑容，后面永远甩着一条蓬松的尾巴，做起买卖来乐在其中。 摊子、背包和货品——一个这么娇小的人是怎么拖着整套比她大出这么多的家伙到处跑的，实在令人费解，而看摊的就只有她一个。 [party.oneComp cait azyrran |「哦，哇！」凯特尖叫起来。「她太可爱了！我想抱抱她、揉揉她、摸摸她——」 有意思吧？说起半狼族，人们通常想到的可不是娇小可爱，在边境地区尤其如此，可大千世界，什么样的人都有。 「别人都已经在做了，可我还是想从她那儿买点什么，就为了让她高兴，她太可爱了！你看，她肯定比我矮一英尺，说不定还不止！我简直可以直接把她抱起来带走！」 尽管眼前这幅商业盛景何等壮丽，你并不觉得摊主本人是拿来卖的。 |「哎呀，这可真是可爱得不行，」阿兹兰看着这情景笑出声来。「我都想直接把她抱回家去了——就她那身颜色，跟我们家还挺搭。」 这只小商人虽然可爱得紧，你却不觉得那是个明智的举动。 「你说得对，[pc.name]。那就是偷窃了，这附近的人多半不太喜欢被人打劫。毕竟不是人人都是蜂人。」 尽管眼前这幅商业盛景何等壮丽，你总觉得问题不在于阿齐买不买得起摊主。 ] 等你走近那只金色小狗，她[kohaku.anyKids |像是突然被晴天霹雳劈中一般瞪着你。有那么一瞬间，困惑、恐惧和……尴尬写满了这位娇小半狼族的脸，你正纳闷出了什么事，却瞥见一只金毛小狗崽正努力从那个巨型背包里爬出来，朝着你伸手抓空气，咯咯直笑。 她的恢复力惊人，但并不完美。她一边跟一位潜在顾客讨价还价，一边装出若无其事的样子，轻轻地却坚决地把小狗崽按回背包里藏好。直到做完这笔生意，她才把注意力转回你身上，笑得灿烂，仿佛什么都没发生。 |[pc.ra kitsune |她从摊子后面露出笑容，朝你微微鞠了一躬。这位半狼族小姑娘身上总有那么点说不清道不明的东西——你几乎就要抓住它了，可最后一块拼图总是溜走。也许并没有溜走，你其实很清楚是怎么回事，只是尽管你隐约猜到那可能是什么，当众戳穿这场把戏对谁都没好处。 如果她真是琥珀，那面对食物链上高她这么多的存在，她只能乖乖顺从——至少你以为规矩是这样的。可另一方面，她眼下扮演的这只垂耳小狗[silly|崽子]压根不知道狐妖是什么，而要说琥珀有什么特点，那就是她从不演砸角色。 你还在出神，那只金色小狗已经做完了最后一位顾客的生意，把目光转向你，一脸友善的笑容与热切的专注。 |[kohaku.met |她的耳朵竖了起来，朝你轻轻挥了挥手，半站在高脚凳上，好越过普遍高大的火蜥蜴人看清你。这位半狼族小姑娘身上总有那么点说不清道不明的东西——你几乎就要抓住它了，可最后一块拼图总是溜走。也许并没有溜走，你其实很清楚是怎么回事，只是尽管你隐约猜到那可能是什么，当众戳穿这场把戏对谁都没好处。 也许是。也许不是。但如果面具后面真的是琥珀，你很清楚她在做生意时从不演砸角色。而如果不是……那这位半狼族金毛寻回犬就少了几分友善吗？当然没有。 如今你已站到人群最前，她深吸一口气，准备用最直接的方式证明自己确实如此和善可亲。 伊莱克特拉冲你露出一个大大咧咧、满是狗狗友善的愉快笑容。「话说回来，那真的那么重要吗？我只是在这儿卖东西而已，汪。」 [kohaku.anyKids |这话不无道理……但与此同时，伊莱克特拉那只巨大的背包正因为里面那位的动作而剧烈震动，包里传出的声音虽然闷闷的，却绝对不像任何一种小狗崽。 ]看来这只能算又一桩永远解不开的谜团了。 ]
rows.raw: " The palace plaza is crowded during the day, but the throng is especially thick by one of the entrances. [pc.bg slumrat|Discreetly slipping|Nudging your way] through it, you discover the reason for this particular gathering: a small stall stands with wares on display, obviously not of local make — some of them you recognize as having been brought up from the heartlands, while others have even more obscure origins. All manner of finished goods are laid out and for sale — trinkets and porcelain, apparel, preserved sweets — the kind of things which people living in and around the palace would have the interest and means to purchase. Leaning against the stall is an enormous rucksack large enough to hold two goblins in its depths, brimming over with merchandise. And in the midst of it all, the proprietor — the stand may be 'mander-sized, but she isn't. If anything, the floppy-eared half-lupine's so petite that she has to sit on a high stool in order to even approach eye level with her customers. That hasn't dampened the little dog[silly|go]'s enthusiasm any — there's a permanent smile etched out front and a perpetually wagging bushy tail in the back as she buys and sells with no small glee. Stall, backpack and merchandise — how someone so petite manages to lug around an entire ensemble that much larger than she is boggles the mind, but it's just her minding the stand. [party.oneComp cait azyrran |"Oh, wow!" Cait squeals. "She's so cute! I want to hug her and squeeze her and pet her — " Interesting, isn't it? Small and adorable isn't what usually comes to the mind when one thinks of half-lupines, especially in the Marches, but it takes all kinds to make a world. "Everyone else is already doing it, but I kind of want to buy something from her just to cheer her up, she's so cute! Look, she must be a foot shorter than me, maybe more! I could just pick her up and be away with her!" As glorious as the display of mercantilism before you is, you don't think the proprietor herself is for sale. |"Well, if that isn't just adorable," Azyrran muses, chuckling at the sight. "I'm tempted to just pick her up and take her home — she'll fit right in with those colors of hers." As adorable as the little merchant is, you don't think that'd be particularly wise. "You're right, [pc.name]. That would be stealing, the people around these parts probably don't take well to being raided. Not everyone's a beefolk, after all." As glorious as the display of mercantilism before you is, you somehow doubt that Azzy's ability to buy the proprietor is the problem here. ] As you draw close to the little golden dog, she [kohaku.anyKids |stares at you as if suddenly struck by a bolt out of the blue. For a split second, confusion, terror and… embarrassment write themselves all over the petite half-lupine's face, and you're wondering just what's up when you spy a golden-furred puppy trying to clamber out of the gigantic backpack, grasping at the air towards you and giggling. The recovery is remarkable, but not perfect. Affecting nonchalance as she haggles with a prospective customer, the little dog-merchant gently but firmly pushes her puppy down into the backpack and out of sight. Only then does she conclude her business and return her attention to you, beaming brightly as if nothing had transpired. |[pc.ra kitsune |beams and gives you a half-bow from behind her stand. There's a certain something or the other to this little half-lupine — you can almost place your finger on it, but the last piece of the puzzle evades you. Or maybe it doesn't and you know exactly what's up, but while you have a sneaking suspicion as to what it might be it doesn't serve anyone's interests to end the charade in public. If this is really Kohaku, she'll have no choice but to comply with someone so much higher up than her in the food chain, or at least that's how you think this works. On the other hand, the character of this little floppy-eared dog[silly|go] she's taken doesn't know what a kitsune is, and if there's one thing about Kohaku, it's that she never breaks character. While you've been musing, the little golden dog finishes up her business with the last customer and turns her gaze to you, all friendly smiles and eager attentiveness. |[kohaku.met |ears perk up and she gives you a little wave, half-standing on her high stool to get a better view of you over the generally tall 'manders. There's a certain something or the other to this little half-lupine — you can almost place your finger on it, but the last piece of the puzzle evades you. Or maybe it doesn't and you know exactly what's up, but while you have a sneaking suspicion as to what it might be it doesn't serve anyone's interests to end the charade in public. Maybe it is. Maybe it isn't. But if it is Kohaku behind that mask, you know full well that she never breaks character while on business. And if it isn't… does that make this little golden retriever of a half-lupine any less friendly? Of course not. And now that you're at the head of the crowd, she takes a deep breath, ready to prove said gregariousness in the most direct fashion ever possible. |It's as if some nasty-minded deity had gathered together all the cuteness and adorableness he could find, sprinkled it below the waist with a generous helping of sex appeal, and set it loose upon the world to effect a terrible campaign of brutal mercantilism and economic ruin. Well, maybe that last is a bit of an exaggeration, but given the brisk business that this petite dog[silly|go] is doing for being a mere peddler she must be making an absolute killing. Tychris may not be as luxuriantly opulent as Khor'minos is, but it's still pretty rich. And as various 'manders walk off with their purchases and you're pushed right up against the stall, the little half-lupine rises from her high stool, beaming and ready to greet you. ] ] ] "[hours 0 12 18|GOOD MORNING|HELLO|GOOD EVENING], WOOF!" Ugh, your ears, there's no need to shout. But that's an impressive voice coming out of someone that petite.[silly| One might even be tempted to call her a barker.] "It's good for letting people know you've got what they want for sale, woof! But sure, for you I'll tone it down just a little! You're the famous [pc.name], [pc.title], after all!" She knows who you are? "Of course I do! Everyone knows that Prince Evander and his wife have invited you to the palace to celebrate your glory, Champion! What an honor it must be to host someone of your esteem, woof![pc.bg noblescion |Why, there's even talk that you might be here to sweep the princess off her feet!" Is… is that possible? "You do have the qualifications, don't you? I'm not saying that it's necessary, woof, nor would I dare to speak for the prince and his wife on that matter, but… as far as I understand it, it's possible, yes. And wouldn't that be so romantic and sweet?" |"] You look the little golden dog[silly|go] up and down. Does this mean you get a discount for being the savior of the city? "NO!" Somehow, you suspected this might be the case, but it was worth a try. Well then, since she already knows all about you, what's her name? "Yes, yes! I'm Electra, and a trader of great art, woof! Well, I sell other things too, but when I'm in Tychris it's all about the fine beauty — the principality's glassware has been unparalleled for centuries, some say even before the Godswar, woof! If you have any, I'll buy it all!" And she's selling… "Things people around these parts like, woof! Take a look for yourself!" You do just that — laid out on Electra's stall are gems and gewgaws, trinkets and baubles, with a smattering of of just about everything else from suspiciously fresh produce to cosmetics. Similarly, her backpack is filled with peoples' pawned-off glassware and metalwork — fitting for the city of art and magic that Tychris is. "Some of this stuff comes all the way from distant Valgarde, Macah and Yvennes — I'm very proud of my selection of wares, woof! You know it's got to be good if it traveled all the way here to get to you! Good prices for reliable goods, fair remuneration for anything you want to pawn off! Best prices in the palace district, mostly because I don't have any property to pay taxes on, woof!" You look back and forth across the palace plaza. Electra certainly has picked a good spot — despite this being a public space, no one else is peddling wares this close to the palace. Neither has she gotten in trouble with any authority. There's something entirely odd about this folding stall and its petite proprietor, but that doesn't bother her clientele who are willing to put up with a street peddler in order to get at her foreign offerings. "Take your time and browse all you want. I'll be here until evening, woof!" [pc.isCunning |There's just one more thing… "Yes, woof?" That. There. She said %"woof". "Oh. It's just a thing I do when I get excited, which is all the time, woof. Can't help but bark, I'm just so cheerful to be able to do business with everyone in town! Think of it as a verbal tic — having a positive attitude does bring in all the customers, woof!" Yes, that's fine, and it wasn't your point. Said point was that Electra didn't bark, she said %"woof", and keeps on doing it. "Do I, woof?" She does, and just did it again. "I barked, woof." There it goes again. She said it instead of actually barking. "Someone would notice if I were getting up to that kind of mischief, woof." The little golden dog waggles a hand at her clientele. "Everyone else's just fine. You wouldn't happen to have a cold or something, would you? It's important to wrap up well this time of year, and all the outfits champions, adventurers and the like are wearing these days don't look very warm, woof." On one hand, Electra has to be messing with you. On the other, none of the 'manders browsing her wares show any signs of having noticed the oddities in her verbal tic. Unless they're all in on the gag, that is… Electra beams at you with a big, cheery smile full of little dog friendliness. "Does it really matter that much, anyway? I'm just here to sell things, woof." [kohaku.anyKids |There is a point to that… but at the same time, Electra's enormous backpack is vibrating violently with the efforts of its occupant, and while the sounds coming from within are rather muffled they definitely don't sound like a puppy of any kind. ]Guess it'll just have to be one of those mysteries that never get solved. ] "

rows.original: You step forward to inspect the goods on display — each of them could be very loosely defined as fine art, despite their myriad origins and purposes. With no one watching either the merchandise or the money jar, it really speaks to the ethos of the city that the honor system works well enough for someone like Electra to trust it. Or at least, if anyone's watching, it's not obvious… That, and the constant stream of people passing through the palace plaza means no end of eyes on anyone intending to get up to funny business. You vaguely wonder at that — surely someone has seen whoever it is who collects the money and restocks the stall, right? Surely, right? …Well. Time to see what's on offer, anyway.
rows.translation: 你上前查看陈列的货物——每一件都只能勉强算是「美术品」，尽管它们的来路与用途五花八门。既没人看着货，也没人看着钱罐，这实在很能说明这座城市的品格：这套靠自觉的规矩好用得连伊莱克特拉这样的人都能放心托付。或者说，就算有人在盯梢，也看不出来…… 再说，宫殿广场上人流不断，任何想动歪脑筋的人都会落在无数双眼睛底下。你隐隐觉得奇怪——总该有人见过那个收钱、补货的人吧？总该有吧？ ……算了。总之先看看有什么可买的吧。

rows.original: Electra has set up her stall by the plaza entrance, doing a brisk business with the people of the palace district. Wares laid out and rucksack leaning against her stall, the petite pup has no shortage of customers perusing her wares, drawn by her cuteness, her exotic goods, or both. [rand |Sniffing the air and catching your scent, the petite pup perks up as you approach, tail wagging and eyes brightening as she concludes her latest transaction and gives you her undivided attention. "Oh, hi! Look, everyone — it's the savior of Tychris [pc.himHer]self come to buy things! My goods are this good, that even someone so [pc.ra kitsune|eminent — I mean, ]illustrious is interested in them, woof!" Never missing an opportunity to tout her goods, is she? Well, since your patronage is clearly improving her business prospects, would she consider giving you a discount? "Mmmmh." Electra raises a finger to her lips. "Maybe, woof." Given the empathic no you received the first time you asked, you'll take that win. "My prices are very reasonable anyway — just look at all the people going away happy with their deals, woof! Wouldn't you want to be one of them? Also remember that I'll also buy anything you want to pawn off, just having been used by you will surely mean some of your champion-ness will have rubbed off on it! "But no hurry! Tychris has been here before the Godswar, and it'll be here for the rest of today. Take your time and let me know if there's something you like, woof!" |She's doing such brisk business that the stall display's half-empty, and she hasn't had the time to bring out more merchandise from her backpack. "Oh!" The petite golden pup's ears perk up as she hears you coming, and she starts panting and wagging her tail, oozing canine friendliness from every pore. "You are here! You are here!" So you are. And what has she brought to the table today? For her to attract a good clientele in the city's wealthiest district means wares that go from just beyond the fine, doesn't it? "All kinds of things that I've collected from all over, woof! Mostly heartland fare, but some things from even further south. Take your time and browse a little, let me know if you like anything — because other people certainly do! If you don't buy quickly, it might be gone![silly| Capitalism, ho!]" |As you watch, the little golden pupper takes a huge bite out of something horrendously sweet and sticky, glazed with enough sugar to qualify it as absolutely sinful. Noticing your approach, Electra crams the entire pastry into her mouth with remarkable speed for someone so petite, swallowing hard and wiping her lips before you've made it to her stall. "HIIIIIII!" Yes, hello. You know she's excited to see you, but can she not try destroying your eardrums? "BUT I'M NOT DOING ANYTHING OF THE SORT, WOOF!" Just as quickly as it began, the rush of energy works its way through Electra, and her tail's wagging slows just a little. Keeping up with doing all this business sure takes a lot of energy, doesn't it? "I WOULDN'T KNOW, this is second nature to me, woof! Anyway, I've recently come into a whole bunch of Valgardian candies, so I melted a couple and put them on a bun! It's great, and me enjoying a treat shows the customers how good the candies are, right? People with too much money like exotic candies, woof! Take a look, and even if you're not in the mood for sweets, maybe something else will catch your eye!" |Electra is bubbly throughout all of this, but it's only when she spots you that her tail starts wagging and her enthusiasm froths over. "Hi! Fancy seeing my favorite customer, the [pc.title], come up to my humble stall, woof!" Come now, she doesn't need to put on airs, even for you — it really doesn't suit her. And that bit about being her favorite customer? Well, you're flattered. "Yes! Even though who happens to be my favorite customer changes depending on who I'm speaking with at the moment, here and now you are truly, genuinely, and unequivocally my favorite! But… if everyone is her favorite, then no one is, right? "No, woof! Because you, and only you, [pc.name], the great savior of Tychris, happen to be my favorite customer! When it comes to me, I've only one bestest best buyer in the whole wide world!" Do you get a discount for being her favorite customer? "NO! But, owning one of my amazing wares aside, there may be other benefits to your patronage, woof! "So! Buy something?" ]
rows.translation: 伊莱克特拉把摊子支在广场入口旁，和宫殿区的人们做着红火的买卖。货品摊开、行囊靠在摊边，这只娇小的小狗从不缺顾客挑选她的货品，吸引他们的是她的可爱、她的异国货品，或者两者兼有。[rand |嗅了嗅空气、捕到你的气味，这只娇小的小狗在你走近时精神一振，尾巴甩动、眼睛放光，做完手上最后一笔交易，把全部注意力都给了你。 「哦，你好！大家看——提克里斯的救世主[pc.himHer]亲自来买东西了！我的货就是这么好，连[pc.ra kitsune|这么显赫——我是说，]这么有名望的人都感兴趣，汪！」 她可真是一刻都不放过推销的机会。那么，既然你的光顾显然在改善她的生意前景，她愿不愿意给你打个折？ 「嗯……」伊莱克特拉把一根手指抵在唇边。「也许吧，汪。」 想到第一次开口时得到的那声斩钉截铁的「不」，你决定见好就收。 「反正我的价钱已经非常公道了——你瞧瞧，大家都带着淘到的好货开开心心地走了，汪！难道你不想也算一个？还有，你想典当什么我也都收，只要被你用过，那上面肯定沾了几分你的冠军之气！ 「不过不用急！提克里斯在神战之前就在这儿了，今天剩下的时间里它也还会在。慢慢看，有喜欢的就告诉我，汪！」 |她的生意红火到摊上的货已经空了一半，她还没腾出手从背包里再拿些货出来。 「哦！」那只娇小的金色小狗听见你走过来，耳朵一竖，开始喘气甩尾，每一个毛孔都在往外渗着狗的友善。「你来了！你来了！」 是啊，你来了。那她今天带了什么好东西？能在城里最富的区吸引到好主顾，她的货想必不止是「还行」而已吧？ 「我从各处收来的各种东西，汪！多数是腹地的货，还有些是从更南边来的。慢慢看、随便挑，有喜欢的就告诉我——因为别人肯定也喜欢！你要是买得慢，可就没了！[silly| 资本主义万岁！]」 |你看着那只金色小狗崽咬下一大口甜得发腻、黏糊糊、裹着足以称为罪恶的糖衣的东西。注意到你走近，伊莱克特拉以与她那娇小身形极不相称的速度把整块点心塞进嘴里，用力咽下去，在你走到摊前之前已经抹干净了嘴唇。 「你——好——啊——！」 好，你好。你知道她见你很兴奋，可她能不能别试图震聋你的耳朵？ 「可我根本没在干那种事啊，汪！」 那股劲头来得快去得也快，转眼就在伊莱克特拉身上泄了个干净，她尾巴的摆动也慢了一点点。天天这么做生意，确实很耗精力吧？ 「这我可不知道，对我来说这是天性，汪！话说回来，我最近弄到一大批瓦尔加德糖果，就化了两块放在小圆面包上！味道棒极了，而且我自己吃得开心，也正好让顾客看看这糖有多好，对吧？钱多的人就喜欢异国糖果，汪！看看嘛，就算你不想吃甜的，说不定有别的东西合你眼缘！」 |伊莱克特拉整个过程都活泼得很，但只有在看见你的时候，她的尾巴才开始甩动，热情才整个溢出来。 「嗨！没想到我最喜欢的客人，[pc.title]，会光临我这个小摊子，汪！」 行了行了，她用不着这样端架子，就算是对你也没必要——这真的不适合她。至于「最喜欢的客人」那套？嗯，你受宠若惊。 「对呀！虽说我最喜欢的客人是谁，会随我当下在跟谁说话而变，可此时此刻，你真真切切、货真价实、毫不含糊地就是我最喜欢的那位！ 可……要是人人都是她最喜欢的，那就等于谁都不是，对吧？ 「不对，汪！因为只有你，唯有你，[pc.name]，提克里斯伟大的救世主，才碰巧是我最喜欢的客人！对我来说，这偌大的世界上只有一位最最最棒的买家！」 身为她最喜欢的客人，你能拿到折扣吗？ 「不行！不过除了拥有一件我那些了不起的货品之外，你的光顾也许还有别的好处，汪！ 「所以！买点什么吧？」 ]
rows.raw: " Electra has set up her stall by the plaza entrance, doing a brisk business with the people of the palace district. Wares laid out and rucksack leaning against her stall, the petite pup has no shortage of customers perusing her wares, drawn by her cuteness, her exotic goods, or both. [rand |Sniffing the air and catching your scent, the petite pup perks up as you approach, tail wagging and eyes brightening as she concludes her latest transaction and gives you her undivided attention. "Oh, hi! Look, everyone — it's the savior of Tychris [pc.himHer]self come to buy things! My goods are this good, that even someone so [pc.ra kitsune|eminent — I mean, ]illustrious is interested in them, woof!" Never missing an opportunity to tout her goods, is she? Well, since your patronage is clearly improving her business prospects, would she consider giving you a discount? "Mmmmh." Electra raises a finger to her lips. "Maybe, woof." Given the empathic no you received the first time you asked, you'll take that win. "My prices are very reasonable anyway — just look at all the people going away happy with their deals, woof! Wouldn't you want to be one of them? Also remember that I'll also buy anything you want to pawn off, just having been used by you will surely mean some of your champion-ness will have rubbed off on it! "But no hurry! Tychris has been here before the Godswar, and it'll be here for the rest of today. Take your time and let me know if there's something you like, woof!" |She's doing such brisk business that the stall display's half-empty, and she hasn't had the time to bring out more merchandise from her backpack. "Oh!" The petite golden pup's ears perk up as she hears you coming, and she starts panting and wagging her tail, oozing canine friendliness from every pore. "You are here! You are here!" So you are. And what has she brought to the table today? For her to attract a good clientele in the city's wealthiest district means wares that go from just beyond the fine, doesn't it? "All kinds of things that I've collected from all over, woof! Mostly heartland fare, but some things from even further south. Take your time and browse a little, let me know if you like anything — because other people certainly do! If you don't buy quickly, it might be gone![silly| Capitalism, ho!]" |As you watch, the little golden pupper takes a huge bite out of something horrendously sweet and sticky, glazed with enough sugar to qualify it as absolutely sinful. Noticing your approach, Electra crams the entire pastry into her mouth with remarkable speed for someone so petite, swallowing hard and wiping her lips before you've made it to her stall. "HIIIIIII!" Yes, hello. You know she's excited to see you, but can she not try destroying your eardrums? "BUT I'M NOT DOING ANYTHING OF THE SORT, WOOF!" Just as quickly as it began, the rush of energy works its way through Electra, and her tail's wagging slows just a little. Keeping up with doing all this business sure takes a lot of energy, doesn't it? "I WOULDN'T KNOW, this is second nature to me, woof! Anyway, I've recently come into a whole bunch of Valgardian candies, so I melted a couple and put them on a bun! It's great, and me enjoying a treat shows the customers how good the candies are, right? People with too much money like exotic candies, woof! Take a look, and even if you're not in the mood for sweets, maybe something else will catch your eye!" |Electra is bubbly throughout all of this, but it's only when she spots you that her tail starts wagging and her enthusiasm froths over. "Hi! Fancy seeing my favorite customer, the [pc.title], come up to my humble stall, woof!" Come now, she doesn't need to put on airs, even for you — it really doesn't suit her. And that bit about being her favorite customer? Well, you're flattered. "Yes! Even though who happens to be my favorite customer changes depending on who I'm speaking with at the moment, here and now you are truly, genuinely, and unequivocally my favorite! But… if everyone is her favorite, then no one is, right? "No, woof! Because you, and only you, [pc.name], the great savior of Tychris, happen to be my favorite customer! When it comes to me, I've only one bestest best buyer in the whole wide world!" Do you get a discount for being her favorite customer? "NO! But, owning one of my amazing wares aside, there may be other benefits to your patronage, woof! "So! Buy something?" ] "

rows.original:
Electra is absolutely tiny — even though she's a half-lupine, she's clearly not from around these parts where the lupines tend towards thick, tall and imposing. The little dog[silly|go] can't be more than five feet tall, perhaps even a good chunk less than that; after all, she has to use a high stool to even deal with her 'mander customers. Height-wise, she may be petite, but Electra is very definitely womanly; [kohaku.wellFed
        |both her bosom and hips are large in a matronly manner, resulting in an hourglass-ish figure that pushes her close to, but not quite into shortstack territory. There're hints here and there that she might have once been somewhat slimmer, but along with all the extra mass that's stuck to her the rock-hard consistency of her derriere has softened.
        
        Still, without all the walking a travelling merchant does, especially with such a huge backpack that holds stall and wares alike, it's likely this petite dog[silly|go] would be even more plump that she already is.
        |while her bosom may merely be handfuls, her wide hips, enormous thighs and deliciously round ass push out prominently against the skirts of her outfit, giving her an unmistakable pear shape. Given that the latter two look firm enough that you could [silly
        |pulverize a boulder with one blow from
        |bounce a coin off
        ] them, it's doubtless that she does a lot of walking on the regular, even if there's no visible muscle definition to be had.
        ]
        
        Which isn't a bad thing; it makes this canine cutie even more adorable than she already is.
        
        But where Electra has a good body, her face is absolutely made for merchanting. Large floppy ears stick out from her carefully braided golden hair, seeming like they're bending under their own weight; for all that they may seem to be covering themselves, she can hear her customers perfectly well. But even under the folds, tufts of pale cream hair stick out every other way in a mess — is it even possible for lupines to trim their ear fur[pc.ra lupine|? You wouldn't know, having never done it yourself, and honestly the prospect sounds quite daunting.|?]
        
        Despite clearly meticulous attempt to keep it under check, though, the fur of a golden retriever, even one as tiny as Electra, won't be tamed that easily. Above her shoulders, it's all prim and proper in its braids, bangs framing her cheeks and red eyes; below that, though, the veneer of respectability quickly frays apart and falls all the way down to her [kohaku.wellFed|enormously stacked|pert, squeezable] derriere in a golden waterfall. [kohaku.anyKids
        |Electra herself seems genuinely tired and harried — no doubt because of the brisk business she's doing — and hasn't noticed her hairdo unraveling, or so you think…
        |The effect seems mostly natural, but there're signs of that unkempt beauty being a carefully cultivated thing, like a bonsai pretending that it's never been shaped with conscious intent.
        ]
        
        And then, there's her face — the very epitome of canine friendliness. Sparkling eyes, a tiny nose, and an open-mouthed doggy smile that's a permanent fixture on her lips. You can't get any more affable than a golden retriever, and the fluffiness of her doggy fur only turns the cuteness up to eleven. Buying something you don't need at ridiculous prices just to make this little creature happy is a distinct possibility; it's as if some nasty-minded deity had gathered together all the cuteness and adorableness he could find, sprinkled it below the waist with a generous helping of sex appeal, and set it loose upon the world to effect a terrible campaign of brutal mercantilism and economic ruin.
rows.translation:
伊莱克特拉实在娇小得过分——虽说她是半狼族，却显然不是本地出身，这一带的狼族都偏向厚实、高大、有压迫感。这只小狗[silly|崽子]顶多五英尺高，说不定还矮上一大截；毕竟她跟火蜥蜴人顾客打交道都得踩高脚凳。论身高她或许算娇小，可伊莱克特拉毫无疑问是个十足的女人；[kohaku.wellFed
        |她的胸脯和臀部都大得带着主妇的丰腴，造就了一副近乎沙漏的身形，离「矮壮」只差一步之遥。各处都留着些痕迹，说明她从前也许苗条一些，只是随着身上多出来的那些分量，她那硬得像石头般的臀部也变软了。
        
        不过话说回来，要不是走街串巷的商人整日奔波，尤其还背着能装下摊子和货品的大背包，这只娇小的小狗[silly|崽子]多半会比现在更丰腴。
        |她的胸脯也许只能算一把可握，可她那宽阔的胯、粗壮的大腿和圆润得诱人的屁股，把衣物的裙摆顶得格外突出，造就了一目了然的梨形身段。既然后两处看着结实得足以[silly
        |一拳砸碎
        |弹起一枚
        ]石头，那毫无疑问她平时走了很多路，尽管表面上完全看不出肌肉线条。
        ]
        
        这倒不是坏事；它让这只犬娘本就可爱的模样更加可爱了。
        
        但伊莱克特拉的身材虽好，她那张脸才是天生做生意的料。一对大垂耳从她精心编好的金发里支棱出来，看着仿佛被自身重量压弯了；虽说耳朵像是把自己盖了个严实，她却能把顾客的话听得清清楚楚。可即便在耳褶底下，也有一撮撮奶油色的浅色绒毛乱七八糟地往外翘——狼族到底能不能修剪耳毛[pc.ra lupine|？你自己没剪过，当然不知道，老实说光想象就挺吓人的。|？]
        
        尽管她显然费了心思打理，可金毛寻回犬的毛，哪怕长在伊莱克特拉这么娇小的身上，也不是那么容易驯服的。肩膀以上，一切都在发辫里端庄得体，刘海衬着她的脸颊与红眼睛；可肩膀以下，那层体面的表象很快就散了架，一路垂落到她那[kohaku.wellFed|硕大丰满|挺翘可捏]的臀部，汇成一道金色的瀑布。[kohaku.anyKids
        |伊莱克特拉本人似乎真的又累又烦——想必是因为生意太忙——还没发现自己的发型散了，至少你是这么以为的……
        |那效果看着大半是天生的，却又有迹象表明这份不修边幅的美是精心养出来的，像一盆假装自己从未被人有意修剪过的盆景。
        ]
        
        然后是她的脸——犬类友善的极致体现。亮晶晶的眼睛、小小的鼻子，还有一张永远挂在唇边的咧嘴狗笑。没有比金毛寻回犬更和善的了，而她那身毛茸茸的狗毛更是把可爱度拉到了十一分。为了逗这个小家伙开心，花荒唐的价钱买下自己用不着的东西，完全是可能发生的事；就好像某位心存恶趣的神明把世上能找到的可爱与讨喜全都收集起来，在腰以下慷慨地洒上一大把性感，然后把它放进世间，发动一场残酷的商业征战与经济浩劫。
