|如果你不介意我这么说的话…… ]你为什么这么问呢？” 其实你自己也不太确定；你只是好奇她对这个地方的统治者有什么看法罢了。 “嗯，我本人确实对政治不感兴趣，但我想我可以回答你的问题。那么我想到埃万德王子，就会觉得这个可怜的男孩确实需要增加一些体重。如果他能借鉴一下他的朋友凯尔萨兹的做法，至少他的公众形象会显得更威严一些。我怀疑有一半的民众都在担心，泰西斯女士有朝一日可能会不小心把他折成两半。从政治角度来看，从历史的角度来看，他确实算不上什么特别出色的人物。 嗯，这么说似乎有点直白了。他总不至于真的如此吧那个糟糕。” 莱斯特拉疑惑地歪着头看着你，眉毛微微皱起，显得很困惑。“亲爱的，我从来没说过平庸是一件坏事。仔细想一想吧：如果所有的领导者都是那些野心勃勃的军事家，或者不断打破旧传统去开辟新的道路，这个世界将会比现在更加混乱。内陆那些争斗不断的军阀就是很好的例子——这种不断的动荡只会让普通百姓陷入危险之中。历史就是这么告诉我们的。需求那些平庸之辈。那些维持现状的人，其实与那些试图改变现状的人一样重要，甚至可能更为重要。更何况，他本人也是一个很不错的人，尽管他的领导能力看起来并不出众。”莱斯特拉恢复了她那惯常的放松姿态，轻声笑了笑。 他是个书呆子气的人，经常去图书馆看书。我有好几次帮他拿东西；有一次，他还开玩笑地对我动了动手。我怀疑是某个名叫阿斯特里达的人故意激他，想考验他的勇气；不管怎样，那场面还挺有趣的。[lystra.fucked | 至少，我当然是这样认为的。希望这只是开个玩笑而已。”莱斯特拉说道，脸上流露出担忧的神情。 |莱斯特拉轻声笑了起来， ] 她稍作停顿，调整了自己的情绪，然后继续说道：“真遗憾，凯西公主没有继承那种天赋。她偶尔会来拜访，但我已经很久没有见到她了。希望她一切都好。 [var0 |她现在的情况好多了，不过你也不确定她短期内是否会去图书馆。换个话题吧。 |……决定保持沉默。 ]你询问莱斯特拉，她是否对王室成员还有其他看法。 “嗯……并没有特别的想法。总的来说，在我看来，他们所有人都是非常合适的统治者，不过我也从未见过有其他的情况。与你的预期相比，他们其实相当务实；普通民众的关切似乎确实他们在意，而且他们更看重个人的才能而非出身背景。你只需看看他们的导师瓦斯科就明白了这一点。他们资助了他的教育，帮助他将与生俱来的天赋培养成了令人惊叹的技能；单是这一点，就值得称赞了。在我看来，确实如此。 [vasko.isDreamless |莱斯特拉皱着眉头，悲伤地摇了摇头。“不过，看到他以这样的方式回报别人的善意，实在令人遗憾。我想，这个世界上总是会有一些人，会恩将仇报…… | ] [kythie.isMarried |莱斯特拉笑了片刻，然后转过头看着你：“不过，我必须问一下 [pc.name]： 你为什么这么问？我关于他们？毕竟，他们现在已经是你的家人了。 |[var1 |莱斯特拉尴尬地在座位上挪动着身子，低头低声说道：“话虽如此……啊，我想你们应该已经明白了，惹怒他们是……不明智的。对于那整件事，我深表同情。 ] ] |这座城市本身……她对这个地方有什么看法呢？ 莱斯特拉沉思了一会儿，一边思考一边用爪子轻轻抚摸着自己的下巴。“嗯……说实话，我想我可能并不是评价这个地方的最佳人选吧。我一生都生活在提克里斯，因为从未体验过其他生活方式，所以很难对你客观地评价这座城市。不过，就我个人而言，我确实很喜欢这里。如果我不是出生在一个教育资源如此丰富的地方，我想我也不会成为今天的自己；为此，我既要感谢提克里斯，也要感谢我的父母。这座城市作为知识中心的独特地位，无疑是它最吸引人的优势之一，而玻璃吹制工艺，自然也是我们历史上最为人所知的特色。有趣的是，我们在整个边境地区人均产生的法师数量其实是最高的；这可以说是我们当地人引以为豪的一点。看来莱斯特拉在知识层面相当渊博，那么其他方面呢？ 莱斯特拉 [dayNight |猛地呼出一口气 |轻声笑了起来 ] 作为回应，他只是耸了耸肩：“唉，你这个问题可难倒我了。 [pc.name]很明显，我根本不是什么运动健将……提克里斯。是然而，它却以体育竞技活动而闻名。这种综合性体育赛事总是吸引众多游客，甚至来自霜冻边境各地的参赛者也会专程前来参加。或许，唯一能与之相媲美的就是科尔米诺斯竞技场里举办的那些活动了；不过，由于我从未亲身经历过，所以也不好妄加评价。除了那些市场和前面提到的地方之外，提克里斯其实是一个相当简单的地方；这座寺庙很可能是那里最吸引人的景点之一。除此之外，也没什么太多可说的了；我只是一个普通的女性，而我真的很喜欢提克里斯，因为这里是我出生的地方，是我成长的地方，也是我工作的地方。莱斯特拉轻声而坚定地说道。 ] |那么，莱斯特拉能告诉你关于提克里斯的什么呢？ 莱斯特拉友善地笑了笑，然后微微歪了歪头：“嗯，这就要看你想知道些什么了，亲爱的。我不太喜欢城市生活，我更喜欢把时间花在大教堂里。话虽如此，我对这个地方的历史还是挺了解的，所以我想我可以跟你讲讲这些。”莱斯特拉停顿了一下，思考了片刻后继续说道：“正如你肯定已经知道的，提克里斯是一个世袭公国，自建立以来一直由恩·提克里斯家族统治着。最初只是一个贸易枢纽，但在贝尔哈兰帝国的推动下，提克里斯迅速发展成为一个充满活力的城邦，商业贸易活动持续不断。即便帝国覆灭后，提克里斯依然保持着稳定的发展势头，甚至在某些方面还有所进步。" 有所改善？究竟是如何改善的？你根本无法想象，对于任何人来说，‘神战’这场战役的结果都糟糕至极。” 莱斯特拉缓缓点头表示同意。“嗯，我想那些在基苏洪的人可能会持不同意见，但你的说法没错——在战役结束后不久，提克里斯的确失宠了。继承人的缺失，以及可以说在“神战”开始之初就并不存在的替代人选，确实引发了一些……困难，而这些困难的性质也有详细的记录在案。但在娜瑞瓦的保护下，提克里斯度过了这一难关，并且不断发展成为了如今这个知识中心。同样，玻璃吹制行业也没有遭遇像冶金行业那样的挫折，而魔法研究在神战结束后反而得到了进一步的发展。尽管埃斯托洛的陷落给世界带来了许多损失，但蒂克里斯的档案依然存在，而且它们不会消失。" 她还能告诉你些什么吗？ 莱斯特拉思考了片刻，然后以一种颇为奇怪的方式摇了摇头：“恐怕我并不是什么历史学家，亲爱的。像我这样的女妖通常不会去保存详细的记录，而且据我所知，其他话题对我来说才更有趣。 你瞧。 ]
rows.raw: " [flags.LYSTRA_TLK_TYCHRIS |Opting to rack Lystra's brain a bit about Tychris, you decide to ask about her thoughts on [rand |the royal family. What’s her opinion on Prince Evander and the lot? Lystra raises an eyebrow in intrigue, a glint of curiosity in those golden eyes. "Oh? The royal family, you say? That’s certainly an odd line of questioning, [kythie.isMarried |especially from yourself |if you don’t mind my stating of such ]. Why is it that you ask?" You’re not entirely sure yourself; you suppose you’re just curious about what she thinks of the rulers of the place. "Well, I'm certainly not one for politics myself, but I suppose I can answer your question. What I think of Prince Evander is that the poor boy needs to put on a few pounds. If he took a page out of his friend Kelsaz's book, it would at least make his public image seem a little more imposing. I suspect half the populace is worried Lady Tethys may one day snap him in half by accident. From the political perspective, he is, in a historical sense, unremarkable." Well, that seems a bit blunt. Surely he isn't that bad. Lystra tilts her head quizzically at you, her eyebrows raised in confusion. "I never said being unremarkable was a bad thing, dear. Just think about it, for a moment: if every leader were some ambitious warmaster, or tore up old traditions to trailblaze a path forward, the world would be even more chaotic than it already is. The squabbling warlords of the heartlands are a fine example; such constant upheaval only puts the common man at risk. History needs the mediocre. Those who maintain the status quo are just as, if not even more important than those who change it up. Besides, he's a perfectly good person, even if his leadership seems unimpressive." Lystra returns to her usual, relaxed pose as she smiles softly. "He's the bookish sort, and regularly peruses the library. I've helped him quite a few times; once, he even made a pass at me, in jest. I suspect one of the Astrida must have dared him to as a test of courage; either way, it was quite amusing.[lystra.fucked | ...At least, I certainly hope it was in jest." Lystra adds, concern showing on her face, |" Lystra chuckles, ] before taking a moment to compose herself. "It's a shame Princess Kythie didn't inherit that nature. She comes to visit on rare occasion, but it's been quite some time since I last saw her. I do hope she's well." [var0 |She's doing much better now, though you're not sure she's going to the library any time soon. Changing the subject |...Deciding to hold your tongue ], you ask Lystra if there're any other thoughts she has about the royal family. "Hm... not particularly, no. Altogether, the lot of them are, in my opinion, perfectly suitable rulers, though it's not as if I've ever known different. They're surprisingly grounded, compared to what you may expect; the concerns of the common folk truly do seem to matter to them, and they prize merit over the circumstances of birth. You can just look at their magister, Vasko, for that. They sponsored his education, and helped forge a natural talent into incredible skill; that alone merits praise, as far as I would believe." [vasko.isDreamless |Lystra frowns, shaking her head sadly. "A shame to see the way he repaid such kindness, though. I suppose the world will always have those who bite the hand which feeds them..." | ] [kythie.isMarried |Lystra laughs for a moment, before she turns to look at you. "Though, I must ask, [pc.name]: Why are you asking me about them? They're your family now, after all." |[var1 |Lystra awkwardly shifts in her seat, turning her eyes downward as she mutters. "That said... ah, as, I'm sure you learned, angering them is... not wise. You have my condolences about... that whole affair." ] ] |the city itself. What does she think of the place? Lystra takes a moment to think, gently stroking her chin with a talon as she does so. "Hm... I suppose I may not be the best judge of that, to tell you the truth. I’ve lived in Tychris all my life; having never known different, I find it difficult to give you an honest assessment of the city. For what it’s worth, though, I quite like it here. Were it not for being born in a place with such access to education, I doubt I would be anything like the woman I am today; for that, I have Tychris to thank, as well as my parents. The city’s unique role as a center for knowledge is certainly one of its greater selling points, and the glassblowing industry is, of course, what we are historically known for. As an interesting fact, we actually produce the highest number of mages per capita in the entire Marches; it’s something of a local pride point." It seems like Lystra's fairly knowledgeable about the intellectual side of things; what about the rest? Lystra [dayNight |sharply exhales |gives a soft laugh ] by way of response, shrugging. "Well, you've got me there, [pc.name]. It's rather obvious I'm no athlete. Tychris is known for athleticism, however. The Tychathlon always draws visitors, and competitors from all over the Frost Marches are known to travel for it. Perhaps the only thing comparable would be the events held in the colosseum of Khor'Minos; though, having never seen such, I am a poor judge. Aside from the markets and the aforementioned, Tychris is a fairly simple place; this very temple is likely one of the largest attractions therein. Aside from that, there isn't all that much more to say; I'm a simple woman, and I quite enjoy Tychris, inasmuch as it is where I was born, where I grew up, and where I work." Lystra states, gently yet firmly. ] |So, what can Lystra tell you about Tychris? Lystra smiles kindly, before she tilts her head at a slight angle. "Well, that depends on what you'd like to know, dear. I'm not much for city life; I prefer to spend my days at the cathedral. That said, I know a good deal about the local history, so I suppose I could tell you about that." Lystra pauses, thinking for a moment before she continues. "Tychris, as you no doubt are aware, is a hereditary principality, which has been ruled by the En Tychris line since its founding. Originally a trade hub, Tychris quickly grew into a burgeoning city-state as the Belharan Empire facilitated a constant flow of commercial trade; even with its collapse, Tychris has remained steadfast, and, in some ways, improved." Improved? How so? You can't imagine the Godswar went particularly well for anyone. Lystra nods her head slowly in agreement. "Well, I suppose those in Kitsuhon may disagree, but you're correct that Tychris fell from grace somewhat in the immediate aftermath. The loss of the heir, and arguably the spare at the outset of the Godswar certainly caused some... difficulties, the nature of which are well-documented. But through Nareva's protection, Tychris weathered the storm, and has continued to grow into the intellectual hub it is today. Likewise, the glassblowing industry has not faced the setbacks which, say, metallurgy has, and the study of magic has only ever grown since the Godswar concluded. For all that was lost to the world when Estelore fell, the archives of Tychris remain; and they're not going anywhere." Anything else she can tell you? Lystra ponders the question for a moment, before shaking her head in a particularly odd way. "I'm afraid I'm not much of a historian, dear. Harpies like myself aren't usually the type to maintain detailed records, and for all that I've read, other topics interest me further." You see. ] "

rows.original: You can't help your curiosity; how's Lystra been doing with [lystra.numKids 1 2 |Alba |the kids ] lately? Lystra[dayNight | smiles softly, looking down towards Alba as she softly rests, cuddled into her chest |'s eyes light up, as she adroitly lifts Alba back onto her lap before both mother and daughter smile up at you ]. "Wonderfully, dear. Alba's even more of a voracious learner than I was at that age, and any of the senior staff here can tell you I was something of a menace, hoo." [dayNight |Lystra smiles warmly as she gently strokes Alba's plumage, speaking quietly so as not to disturb her |Alba grins up at you, her gold eyes twinkling with childish glee. "Hi [pc.mf |papa |mama ]! Mommy's been teaching me to write bell-har-in!" Alba blurts out, bungling the pronunciation a bit. "She said it's important to be lit... litter-it." Lystra laughs kindly, giving Alba a gentle pat on the head as she does so ]. "Aside from learning to read and write, she's eager to learn how to fly; it's going to be a good bit until she's ready for that, though. [lystra.numKids 1 2 |Hopefully she's as fast of a learner at that, too." |The others aren't far behind, either." ] Lystra adds, looking and sounding like the very picture of maternal affection. "I don't think I'll ever be able to say it enough, [pc.name], but thank you. Motherhood has been the most precious gift I've ever received; I can scarcely imagine a life without Alba and you anymore." You tell Lystra that you're glad to know your daughter has such a kind mother to rely on, even when you aren't around. You wish you were able to visit more, but the world needs saving first; especially for the sake of keeping it a safe place for Alba to grow up in. Lystra nods in affirmation, looking at you with those big golden eyes. "Indeed it does, dear. You needn't worry about [lystra.numKids 1 2 |Alba |the children ] wanting for anything, either. The temple is well-equipped for child-rearing; this is, after all, where new Astrida are born and raised. Further than that, I've had to keep my parents from trying to spoil their grandchild[lystra.numKids 1 2 | |ren ]. I had thought my sister staying with them had alleviated the feelings of an empty nest, but it seems I was incorrect..." You're glad to hear that, at the very least. Lystra and [lystra.numKids 1 2 |Alba |your children ] are important to you, and it warms your heart to know they're doing well. Lystra blushes a bit before she replies. "I could say the same for you, dear. Do be careful out there."
rows.translation: 你按捺不住好奇心；莱斯特拉最近和 [lystra.numKids 1 2 |阿尔巴 |孩子们 ] 过得怎么样？ 莱斯特拉[dayNight | 温柔地微笑着，低头看向正安静地依偎在她胸前休息的阿尔巴 |的眼睛亮了起来，她灵巧地把阿尔巴重新抱回自己腿上，随后母女俩一起抬头朝你微笑 ]。“好得很，亲爱的。阿尔巴对学习的渴望甚至比那个年纪的我还要强烈，而这里任何一位资深人员都能告诉你，我当年可是个祸害，呼。” [dayNight |莱斯特拉温柔地微笑着，轻抚阿尔巴的羽毛，压低声音说话，以免吵醒她 |阿尔巴朝你咧嘴笑，金色的眼睛闪烁着孩子的欢快。“嗨 [pc.mf |爸爸 |妈妈 ]！妈妈一直在教我怎么写贝拉兰语！”阿尔巴脱口而出，发音有点搞错了。“她说认字很重要……认、认得字。” 莱斯特拉和善地笑了，同时轻轻拍了拍阿尔巴的头 ]。“除了学习读写，她还急着想学飞；不过离她准备好还早得很呢。 [lystra.numKids 1 2 |希望她学这个也能学得一样快。” |其他几个也差不了多少。” ] 莱斯特拉补充道，神情和语气都像极了母爱的典范。“我想我怎么谢你都不够， [pc.name]，但还是谢谢你。做母亲是我收到过的最珍贵的礼物；我再也无法想象没有阿尔巴和你的生活了。” 你告诉莱斯特拉，你很高兴知道你的女儿有这样一位善良的母亲可以依靠，即使你不在她身边。你希望自己能多来看望，但这个世界得先被拯救；尤其是为了让它成为阿尔巴能安全成长的地方。 莱斯特拉肯定地点点头，用那双金色的大眼睛看着你。“确实如此，亲爱的。你也不必担心 [lystra.numKids 1 2 |阿尔巴 |孩子们 ] 会缺什么。这座圣殿在养育孩子方面设施齐全；毕竟这里就是新一代阿斯特里达出生和成长的地方。除此之外，我还不得不拦着我的父母，不让他们溺爱自己的孙辈[lystra.numKids 1 2 | |们 ]。我本以为妹妹和他们同住能缓解空巢感，但看来是我错了……” 至少听到这些，你心里还是挺高兴的。莱斯特拉和 [lystra.numKids 1 2 |阿尔巴 |你的孩子们 ] 对你来说很重要，知道他们过得好，你心里也暖暖的。 莱斯特拉脸微微泛红，然后才回答。“我也想对你说同样的话，亲爱的。在外头一定要小心。”

Lystra's looks and wit have captured your attention; is there any chance she'd be up for a roll in the hay |You're not the best with... thinky things, but Lystra's like, really pretty! The message is clearly received; Lystra blushes a bit, before closing the book she had been reading and looking you head-on.

rows.original: Thinking about it for a moment, you realize that there's quite possibly no better way to spend time in a library than reading. [pc.bg scholar |You're rather well-educated, but the Cathedral of Nareva is every scholar's dream, after all |[pc.bg slumrat barbarian |You might not be the [silly |sharpest tool in the shed |most educated ], but you'd still like to enjoy some time reading along with Lystra |Given that you're in the Cathedral of Nareva, you might as well do some reading; and time with Lystra is time well spent ] ]. Seating yourself next to Lystra, you ask her if she'd like to read with you[lystra.isMom | and Alba | ]. As she hears your suggestion, Lystra's eyes immediately light up with excitement. "Why, absolutely! I'd love nothing more than to do that, [pc.name]. If you would excuse me for a moment..." Lystra trails off, standing up from behind the desk. "I’ll go and fetch something! Just take a seat in the meantime, dear." With that, Lystra takes flight, nothing but a soft whumpf noise accompanying her ascent[lystra.isMom |, as Alba watches in awe | ]. No matter how many times you see it, you don't think you'll ever not be confused by how Lystra does that; you can't begin to wrap your head around how she's able to fly so quietly. You aren’t left to wonder long, however; Lystra returns shortly thereafter, a tome clasped in each hand as she touches down, just as quietly as she took wing. Regarding you[lystra.isMom | both | ] fondly, Lystra gestures for you[lystra.isMom | and Alba | ] to follow her, as she leads you towards the center of the cathedral. While the [lystra.isMom |three |two ] of you walk towards the seating areas in the cathedral's center, you're struck by just how peaceful the enormous cathedral is at this hour; the silence is broken up only by the occasional rustling of scrolls, or the soft click-clack Lystra's talons produce whenever she steps off the carpeted path. Not that it's shocking, per se; this is a library, after all — but the quiet atmosphere fills you with a sense of drowsy calmness, and you can feel yourself growing relaxed even before you've reached the reading areas. Once the [lystra.isMom |three |two ] of you reach the center, Lystra comes to a stop at one of the larger cushioned seats, before gesturing for you[lystra.isMom | and Alba | ] to take a seat. As you oblige, Lystra takes a seat [lystra.isMom |between the two of |next to ] you, setting one of the books she's brought to her side, before turning to you with a warm smile. Speaking in a soft, practiced tone of voice, Lystra opens the tome in her lap, her kindly gaze meeting yours as she speaks. "[pc.bg scholar noblescion acolyte |Now then, [pc.name]. I'm aware you're rather educated yourself, so I've taken the liberty of fetching something a bit more advanced than usual |I've retrieved something relatively simple for the [lystra.isMom |lot |both ] of us tonight; given your background, more advanced material seemed unsuitable ]. With that said, should you need clarification on anything, please, don't hesitate to ask. At any rate, I'll begin." With that, Lystra begins to read to you[lystra.isMom | and Alba | ]. For hours, the [lystra.isMom |two |three ] of you read [pc.bg soldier barbarian hunter |stories of historical battles, both before and after the terrors of the Godswar. Some of the phrases are a tad difficult for you, but Lystra is every bit the picture of a helpful teacher; clarifying context and pronunciations with a gentle tone as you move along. [lystra.isMom |Alba's eyes sparkle with amazement as she listens to tales of battlefield heroism, excitedly raising her hand whenever she has a question |It's nice, having such a one-on-one reading session; Lystra's presence is both comfortable and reassuring ]. |[pc.bg acolyte arcanist |volumes of magical theory and history, poring through some of the ancient writings stored in the cathedral. You can't help but notice, however, that some of it seems almost sanitized. On occasion, a text will end abruptly, as if the ending of it were never written — certain incantations one might have expected to see are missing from a page here and there, and you briefly remember that Nareva is the goddess of both knowledge and secrets. It's reasonable, one supposes; the publicly available writings in the library are no doubt scoured for danger before passing into the hands of scholars. Regardless, as Lystra continues, you follow along intently. While she's unskilled as a mage by her own admission, the wise owl evidently possesses a keen understanding of the fundamentals; if she wished, she could have made a fine magical instructor. |[pc.bg noblescion scholar |historical texts, poring over the words of historians with aplomb. Not even Tychris is exempt from the fragmentation of knowledge over the years; the reigns of some are spoken of in exhaustive detail, while others are mere footnotes. As the two of you follow the stories of lineages through the sands of time, [lystra.isMom |Alba all but dozes off, uninterested in the |you see the excitement of an avid scholar in Lystra's eyes, overjoyed to read on her favorite ] subject. |stories of adventure, mystery, romance, and more. Lystra's gentle cadence and skillful diction keep you enraptured as she reads along through epics of yesteryear, [lystra.isMom |and Alba eagerly hangs on each word of the stories |her natural talent for storytelling shining through ]. ] ] ]

On occasion, a text will end abruptly, as if the ending of it were never written — certain incantations one might have expected to see are missing from a page here and there, and you briefly remember that Nareva is the goddess of both knowledge and secrets. Lystra's gentle cadence and skillful diction keep you enraptured as she reads along through epics of yesteryear, [lystra.isMom |and Alba eagerly hangs on each word of the stories |her natural talent for storytelling shining through ]. ] ] ] "

rows.original: The [lystra.isMom |two |three ] of you read together like this for hours, the flow of the books only interrupted by the occasional rustling of pages, unfamiliar word, or [lystra.isMom |question from Alba |clearing of a throat ]. By the time Lystra finishes with the first of the books she's brought, you can already feel your eyelids drooping. For as much as you're enjoying reading with her, exhaustion will not be denied; Lystra moves onto the second book she had retrieved as you struggle to stay awake. Your efforts are in vain, however— less than a third of the way in, you wind up dozing off on Lystra's shoulder. Pausing, she chuckles softly for a moment, before closing her book and turning to face you. "Hoo... apologies, [pc.name]. I'd forgotten just how late it is for you; I'm afraid I lost track of time," Lystra mutters. "Allow me to get you more comfortable, dear." With that, Lystra shuffles to the side somewhat, gently positioning your head onto her lap. Gods above, she truly makes for a divine pillow... Your musings are interrupted, however, as Lystra speaks up, her sizable bosom blocking her face from your view. "There we are. You can catch some rest there, dear; it's late, and [pc.isFeline |cats make for wonderful lap-cozies |I don't mind spending the time in your company ]." With that, Lystra places one hand on her knee, her soft wing draping over you like a blanket. The other begins to gently stroke your [pc.hair], [pc.hasEmoteEars |her talons gently scritching between your [pc.ears] and |soothing caresses ] helping you to relax.[lystra.isMom | Meanwhile, Alba picks up the book her mother set aside, nuzzling into Lystra's side as she begins to slowly read. | ] While your eyes close and you feel sleep encroaching, all that you hear is the [lystra.isMom |careful reading of your daughter |soft coo of Lystra's breathing ] as you drift off into dreams.

rows.original: Shooting Lystra a smile, you ask if she’d be willing to just let you rest with her for a bit. You’re awfully tired, and spending some time with her sounds like a sublimely cozy time. Immediately, Lystra's eyes light up, tangible excitement at the prospect shining on her face as she replies. "Why, that sounds wonderful, [pc.name]. Allow me a moment, if you would—" Lystra mutters, rising from her seat. "Why don't we go somewhere more comfortable? The reading areas should suffice. Follow me, if you would." With that, Lystra is off, [lystra.isMom |gently guiding Alba along by holding her hand |her talons gently clacking on the stone ] as she makes her way towards the center of the cathedral. You follow her closely, tagging along as the [lystra.isMom |three |two ] of you make the short walk to the library's seating area. As you do, you take a moment to appreciate the sights around you; the Cathedral of Nareva is the pride of Tychris, after all. As your eyes rove over the splendid decor of the temple, you're amazed by the scale of everything around you; the near-emptiness of the library during the night lends a otherworldly shroud to the towering shelves, and the only light sources are the occasional sparse lamp-light or tail flame. Eventually, however, your musings are cut short; you're so engrossed by the almost-ethereal sights of the darkness-filled library that you end up walking face-first into Lystra, [pc.heightRange 0 68 |nearly bouncing backwards as you collide with her prodigious bosom |catching her as you regain your balance ]. Unperturbed by the incident, Lystra laughs softly as she looks at you, an expression of gentle amusement on her face as she speaks up. "Hoohoo... I understand the cathedral can be quite a lot to take in, dear, but it's important to watch where you're going. I've lost count of the number of times a visitor has walked headlong into a shelf and nearly toppled it — or, in the case of that minotaur some years back, actually did." Lystra chuckles, fondly reminiscing for a moment, before gesturing towards the cushioned seats before you. "At any rate, please do make yourself comfortable. In the meantime, if you'll excuse me, I'll fetch some reading material for [lystra.isMom |myself and Alba |myself ]." With that, Lystra takes flight, little more than a soft noise as she does. You're still baffled how she can do that, but it's hardly a question you expect to find an answer to. Turning your attention to the seating areas, you pick out a particularly comfortable couch, clambering onto it[lystra.isMom | while Alba sits in your lap | ]. Just in time, too— Lystra touches down a moment later, carrying [lystra.isMom |two small tomes |a tome ] with her, before joining [lystra.isMom |the both of you |you ] on the couch. It takes a little shuffling around, but eventually, you find yourself in a suitably comfortable position. Head on Lystra's lap, you relax almost immediately; the fuzzy down of her legs combines with her plush thighs to provide a supremely cozy pillow, [lystra.pregStage 0 2 |though her superlative bust blocks your view of her face |the rosy warmth of her egg-stuffed tummy providing an additional layer of comfort ]. Draping a wing over you, Lystra [lystra.isMom |wraps the other around Alba, holding the little owlet close as the three of you enjoy each other's presence. Of course, that isn't quite engaging enough for the avid bookworm; Lystra hands her one of the books she had brought with her, and your daughter begins to silently read as she sits in her mother's embrace |uses her free hand to open the book she had retrieved, reading aloud softly as you relax in her embrace, her dulcet voice a lullaby in and of itself ]. Between how late it is, and how comfortable your current position is, staying awake feels like a Sisyphean task. Each time you fight to keep your eyelids open, they seem to grow all the heavier; before too long, you find yourself unable to stave off the incipient pressure of sleep. Dozing off as Lystra gently strokes your [pc.hair], your dreams are peaceful and uneventful, swaddled in fuzzy warmth.
rows.translation: 你对莱斯特拉露出微笑，询问她是否愿意让你陪她休息一会儿。你实在太累了，和她一起度过这段时轻型听起来真是再好不过了。崇高地温馨的时轻型。 听到这个提议，莱斯特拉的眼睛立刻亮了起来，她脸上洋溢着明显的兴奋之情，回答道：“哇，那听起来太棒了！ [pc.name]请稍等片刻，”莱斯特拉边说边从座位上站了起来，“我们去一个更舒适的地方吧？阅读区应该就足够了。请跟我来。” 说完，莱斯特拉便走了出去。 [lystra.isMom |轻轻地握着阿尔巴的手，引导她前行。 |她的爪子轻轻触碰着咔嗒声踩在石头上 ] 当她朝着大教堂的中心走去时，你紧随其后，一路陪伴着她。 [lystra.isMom |三 |两个 ] 你们中的一些人可以步行前往图书馆的休息区。在行走的过程中，不妨花点时间欣赏周围的景色——毕竟，娜瑞瓦大教堂是蒂克里斯的骄傲所在。当你的目轻型扫过这座教堂华丽的装饰时，你一定会感到惊叹规模你注意到周围的一切；夜晚时图书馆里几乎空无一人，这种空旷的氛围给那些高耸的书架披上了一层超脱尘世的神秘面纱，而唯一的轻型源，不过是偶尔闪现的微弱灯轻型或烟尾火轻型。 然而，最终你的沉思被突然打断了——你太过沉迷于这个被黑暗笼罩的图书馆所呈现出的那种近乎虚幻的美景，以至于径直撞上了莱斯特拉。 [pc.heightRange 0 68 |当你撞上她那令人惊叹的胸部时，几乎会被弹了回去。 |在你重新恢复平衡的那一刻，你抓住了她。 ]面对这一幕，莱斯特拉并没有感到丝毫困扰，她轻声笑着看着你，脸上带着一丝温柔的笑意，然后开口说道： “呵呵……我明白这座大教堂确实会让人们感到有些不知所措，亲爱的，但走路的时候注意看路确实是很有必要的。我都数不清有多少次，有游客不小心撞到了架子，差点把它撞倒——就像几年前那个弥诺陶洛斯事件一样确实莱斯特拉轻声笑了起来，满怀深情地回忆了一会儿，然后指向你面前的那些软垫座椅说道：‘无论如何，请随意休息吧。另外，如果你们不介意的话，我去拿一些阅读材料来 [lystra.isMom |我和阿尔巴 |我自己 ]就这样，莱斯特拉飞了起来，她起飞时只发出了一阵轻微的声音。你仍然不明白她是怎么做到的，但这个问题似乎也不太可能找到答案。将注意力转向休息区，你找到了一张特别舒适的沙发，然后爬了上去。[lystra.isMom | 而阿尔巴就坐在你的腿上…… | ]正好及时——片刻之后，莱斯特拉降落了，她带着 [lystra.isMom |两本小册子 |一部巨著 ] 在加入之前，先和她一起做这件事。 [lystra.isMom |你们两个 |你 ] 坐在沙发上。 虽然需要稍微调整一下姿势，但最终你还是会找到一个非常舒适的坐姿。头靠在莱斯特拉的腿上，你几乎立刻就放松了下来；她腿上柔软的绒毛与结实的大腿一起，为你提供了一个极其舒适的靠垫。 [lystra.pregStage 0 2 |尽管她那令人赞叹的胸部挡住了你看到她脸庞的视线…… |她那被鸡蛋填得鼓鼓的肚子散发出的温暖气息，为她带来了额外的舒适感。 ]莱斯特拉，就像一只翅膀轻轻覆盖在你身上 [lystra.isMom |你将另一条围巾环绕在阿尔巴身上，紧紧抱着那只小猫头鹰，三人一起享受着彼此的陪伴。当然，对于这个热爱读书的女孩来说，这样的活动还不够有趣；于是莱斯特拉把她带来的一些书中的一本递给了她，你的女儿便坐在母亲的怀里，静静地开始阅读起来。 |她用空闲的那只手打开拿出来的书，轻声朗读起来，而你则沉浸在她的怀抱中，放松身心。她那柔和的嗓音本身就像是一首摇篮曲，让人感到安心与宁静。 ]考虑到现在已经这么晚了，再加上你现在的姿势非常舒适，保持清醒简直就像是一项徒劳无功的任务。每次你努力睁大眼睛，眼皮似乎都会变得越来越沉重；不久之后，你就会发现自己再也无法抵抗睡意了。就在莱斯特拉轻轻抚摸你的时候，你渐渐陷入了沉睡 [pc.hair]你的梦境宁静而平和，被柔软的温暖所包围。

rows.original:
As you awaken, you realize abruptly that you're not where you had fallen asleep; at some point in the night, you appear to have been moved to one of the large, cushioned seats behind the librarian's desk. Looking around as you collect your bearings, you spot Lystra, half-asleep behind the desk. Gently shifting as she turns to face you, Lystra smiles softly as she speaks up.
    
    "Hoo... good morning, dear. My apologies for moving you, but I..." Lystra stifles a yawn, blinking the drowsiness from her tired eyes before continuing. "Needed to return to my duties. I hope you don't mind."
    
    That's perfectly fine; she's a busy woman, after all. Reassuring her, you rise from your seat and collect your neatly-arranged gear, before bidding farewell for the time being. Lystra gives a gentle wave as she resumes sorting through several loose scrolls, [lystra.isMom
        |Alba sleeping softly against her chest
        |busy as always
    ].

Eventually, though, exhaustion takes hold; you drift off to sleep, feeling Lystra's talons gently scratching [pc.hasEmoteEars |between your ears |the back of your head ] as she mutters sweet nothings. It doesn't hurt that she makes for an utterly divine pillow, either... By the time you wake up, Lystra has slipped out, presumably having returned to her work. rows.original:
By the time you awaken, Lystra is nowhere to be found. You suppose that's only to be expected; you're certain it must be morning by now, and the cathedral is no doubt busy. [lystra.isMom
        |Not to mention, she's probably busy taking care of Alba, too
        |Given that Lystra's got a job to do, it's hardly a surprise she slipped out
    ]. Nothing for it, then — you may as well set about your day. 
    	
	Climbing out of the comfort of Lystra's bed is a challenge, but after a time, you manage. Only after standing up at the side of the bed do you realize that Lystra managed to change the sheets before leaving— she really does have a deft touch. You can't help but wonder how she did so while you were asleep, but one supposes life has its mysteries. 
	
	Finding your gear sorted neatly among the organized chaos of Lystra’s room is a pleasant surprise. You re-don your [pc.armor], followed by your other equipment, before exiting Lystra's room and navigating back to the library proper. Lystra is, as expected, drowsing off at the front desk; she gives you a small wave, before returning to her business.

rows.original:
As you're making your way up to the desk, you notice another egg swaddled in blankets beside Lystra's chair. You take it everything went well, then?
    
    Lystra [dayNight
        |takes a moment to shake the drowsiness from her eyes, before smiling gently up at you
        |smiles happily, delighted to see you
    ]. "Indeed it did. I was hoping you would come by soon, and lo, you have. How[dayNight
        |..." Lystra covers her mouth, stifling a yawn. "Ah... pardon. As I was saying, how
        |
    ] have your travels been, [pc.name]? It may just be maternity speaking, but I can’t help but worry, you know."
    
    Always a worrier, isn’t she? Well, she can rest assured. Striding forwards to wrap her in a hug, you reassure her that yes, you’re staying safe out there; with someone like her to come back to, you’ll be damned if there’s not good reason to.
    
    That earns both a deep blush and an awkward smile from Lystra, and she nuzzles into the hug for a few seconds. It eventually comes to an end, however; releasing her from the hug, Lystra straightens her posture and clears her throat.
    
    "A-at any rate, [pc.name], was there anything you required my assistance with?"
rows.translation:
当你走向书桌时，你注意到莱斯特拉的椅子旁边还有另一枚用毯子裹着的蛋。看来一切都很顺利吧？
    
    莱斯特拉 [dayNight
        |花了一点时间才驱散眼中的睡意，然后才温柔地抬头对你微笑
        |看到你很高兴，开心地笑着
    ]。“确实如此。我本来盼着你能快点过来，结果你真的来了。你[dayNight
        |……”莱斯特拉捂住嘴，强忍住一个哈欠。“啊……抱歉。我刚才在说，你的
        |
    ] 旅途还好吗，[pc.name]？也许这只是为人母的操心，但我就是忍不住担心，你知道的。”
    
    她总是这么爱操心，不是吗？不过她可以放心。你走上前拥抱她，向她保证自己在外一定会注意安全；有她这样的人等着自己回来，你当然有十足的理由保重自己。
    
    这让莱斯特拉既脸红又露出尴尬的笑容，她依偎在你怀里几秒钟。不过这拥抱最终还是结束了；莱斯特拉松开你，挺直身体，清了清嗓子。
    
    “无、无论如何，[pc.name]，有什么需要我帮忙的吗？”

rows.original: As you approach Lystra's desk, she spots you coming. Rising from her chair and striding towards you with a grin, you're momentarily worried about her moving so quickly while preg... nant. Huh, she doesn't look— Your attention is split two ways at once when Lystra throws her arms around you in a warm hug, just as you notice the large, speckled egg placed onto a chair adjacent to her seat. It's wrapped in a blanket, carefully swaddled atop the cushion; you take it you missed the big event, then? "Well, you don’t have to put it like that, dear," Lystra pouts, giving you an annoyed look. "But yes, I laid not long ago; I was hoping you’d come to visit before she hatched, and I was right!" Lystra hugs you more tightly, and your [pc.heightRange 48 68 |head |shoulder ] is smooshed into a copious amount of harpy tit in the process. Gods above, they’ve gotten even bigger, haven’t they? There’s a knowing smile on Lystra’s face as she releases the hug, keeping her hands clasped onto yours as she stares at you head-on. "Maybe a little... but that’s hardly important, dear. I’m truly glad you were able to visit before she’s hatched; it shouldn’t be long before you have the opportunity to properly meet our daughter." Wrapping your arms around her for a change, you can’t help but snicker at the surprised squawk earned from giving Lystra a quick squeeze. You’re looking forward to meeting the new member of your family too, and you’re sure Lystra’s going to make for a fantastic mother to her. Blushing at your praise, Lystra smiles before nervously brushing a lock of her plumage away from her eyes and stepping back. "Th-thank you, [pc.name]... but anyways, I, ah, suppose I should get back to work..." Lystra mutters, as she retakes her seat behind the desk. "So, was there anything else you had needed from me, dear?"
rows.translation: 当你走近莱斯特拉的办公桌时，她发现了你的到来。她从椅子上站起来，面带微笑朝你走来，这时你不禁担心：她怀着孕，动作竟然还能这么快……不过，看她的样子，似乎并没有什么问题…… 就在这时，莱斯特拉热情地拥抱了你，你的注意力立刻被她吸引住了。与此同时，你也注意到了放在她座位旁边椅子上的那个又大又布满斑点的蛋。它被包裹在毯子里，小心翼翼地放在垫子上；你拿起来一看，原来你错过了这场盛事啊？ “嗯，其实你没必要把它放得这么那个亲爱的，”莱斯特拉撅着嘴，用恼怒的眼神看着你，“不过没错，我确实是刚生下孩子不久；我本来希望你能在她孵化之前来看我，结果你真的来了！” 莱斯特拉把你的手部臂搂得更紧了，你的 [pc.heightRange 48 68 |头部 |肩膀 ] 在这个过程中，所有的内容都被压缩成了大量冗长而无意义的文字。天啊，他们简直把事情弄得更糟了。更大他们不是吗？ 当莱斯特拉松开拥抱时，她的脸上带着会心的微笑，双手部仍然紧握着你的手部，直视着你的眼睛说道：“也许有一点吧……但那真的没什么重要，亲爱的。我真的很高兴你在我们的女儿孵化之前能够来看望她；不久之后，你一定会有机会正式见到我们的女儿。” 紧紧地握着你的手部。你的这次你主动搂住了她，看到莱斯特拉因为被你轻轻捏了一下而露出惊讶的表情，你不禁暗自笑了起来。你也很期待见到家里的新成员，而且你相信莱斯特拉一定会成为一个出色的母亲。 听到你的赞美，莱斯特拉的脸颊泛起了红晕，她微笑着，然后紧张地把一缕羽毛从眼前拨开，后退了几步。 “谢、谢谢你 [pc.name]不过，不管怎样，我应该回去工作了……”莱斯特拉边说边坐回办公桌后面的座位。“那么，亲爱的，还有其他什么事情需要我帮忙的吗？

rows.original: As you step up to the librarian’s desk, you notice [dayNight |several other |a few other ] guests crowded around it. Working your way in and leaning close to get a look, you’re granted the sight of Lystra, squirming under all the attention. Not surprising, given how much she dislikes being the center of attention; but what’s all the commoti— Huh. [dayNight |Nestled in Lystra’s arms is a small harpy chick, sleeping peacefully despite the onlookers |Seated in Lystra’s lap is a small harpy chick, visibly relishing being doted on by the onlookers ]. Well, that certainly explains the crowd — you're just a bit disappointed you weren't here for the hatching. Lystra's eyes light up once she sees you though, and the crowd parts around you as you step up. "Ah, [pc.name]!" Lystra[dayNight |'s voice is hushed, no doubt to avoid disturbing the sleeping owlet | chirps, smiling widely ]. "I was hoping you would come by soon." Lifting the [dayNight |snoozing |small ] child in her arms, Lystra gives you a closer look with a beatific grin. "I'd like you to meet our daughter, [pc.name]." [dayNight |As is to be expected, she doesn't react much in her sleep. That said, one thing's for certain: she looks positively adorable. You can see why everybody's crowding around to get a look. That said, she seems awfully large for a newborn — indeed, she's closer to a child around two years of age, at least in size. Seeing your bewilderment, |Your newly-acquainted daughter stares up at you, golden eyes ashine with curiosity. "Hi [pc.mf |Poppa |Momma ]! Momma told me you were gonna visit soon." You're a bit too stunned by the fact she can already speak to properly respond. Instead, ] Lystra lets out a brief chuckle, turning her gaze towards you. There's a palpable change to her demeanor now, and you can feel it just looking at her. You're not certain whether it's just maternal bliss, or some deeper sort of instinctual fulfillment, but she seems... more confident. You're still taking that in when she speaks up, gently stroking the downy fluff of your daughter's collar. "As I'm sure you know, harpies develop very quickly, by the standards of most other races. [dayNight |She may be resting now, but I can assure you; our daughter here is quite the learner. I don't think she's gone more than five minutes without asking me a new question." There's a soft coo from the sleeping babe by way of response, earning a loving smile from her mother. |We're adapted to fend for ourselves, but when we're not living the life of brigands... our young can be a tad precocious." That earns a cheeky laugh from the toddler in her lap, and Lystra gently tousles her feather-hair. ] You guess so... still, it's a bit of a shock to see her develop that quickly. Has she named her yet? Lystra turns her eyes towards you, and her thick glasses can't hide the warmth in those golden globes. "At my mother's suggestion, yes. Her name is[dayNight | Alba." That's a wonderful name, and you tell her as much. You can't help your curiosity, though; how did she come up with that? |—" Lystra is cut off by your daughter interjecting, flashing a toothy smile as she speaks up. "Alba!" [pc.isDK |Guess your daughter's inherited a bit of your rebellious streak. Lystra sets her jaw into a shallow frown for a moment |You can't help but snicker at Lystra's momentary surprise ], before she shrugs it off with a laugh. You have to admit that's a cute name, though. How did she come up with it? ] "Ah... it was my grandmother's. My mother mentioned that the white plumage was similar, so... it seemed like a good fit." You won't argue that. How's she handling being the center of attention, though? Lystra lets out a brief groan of exasperation — a rare sight, with her — as she looks around the small crowd. "I must confess, I'm not very keen on it. All the well-wishing has been nice, but I'm a grown woman; I hardly need to be doted on. With that said, most of them have been eager to meet our daughter's [pc.mf |father |sire ]; I'm sure you don't mind introducing yourself?" With that, you're ushered through a brief sequence of acquainting yourself with well-wishers. Most of the crowd are Lystra's colleagues, and you're given no shortage of earnest congratulations and warm introductions. There's a few regular guests of the cathedral, and even a couple Astrida;[silly | oddly, your meetings with the latter are strangely tense. You're almost certain one of them was holding back tears... whatever the case, | ] it's not long after you're done that the crowd slowly dissipates, leaving a much-relieved Lystra seated behind her desk. "Thank you, [pc.name]. I hope sating their curiosity will warrant a reprieve; all the attention can be a tad suffocating." You can certainly understand that. "At any rate... I do still have a job to do. Did you require assistance with anything at the moment, dear?"
rows.translation: 当你走到图书管理员的办公桌前时，你注意到了 [dayNight |其他几项 |还有其他一些 ] 宾客们围了上来。你挤进去，凑近一看，便看到了莱斯特拉在众人的注视下扭动着身体。考虑到她是多么不喜欢成为众人关注的焦点，这也就不足为奇了……但为什么会有这么大的反应呢？ 嗯 [dayNight |依偎在莱斯特拉的怀抱中，有一只小女妖雏鸟，尽管有许多人在注视着，它依然安静地睡着。 |坐在莱斯特拉腿上的，是一只小女妖雏鸟，它显然非常享受周围人对自己的宠爱与关注。 ]嗯，这确实可以解释为什么会有那么多人聚集在这里了——你只是有点失望没能亲眼看到孵化过程吧。不过，当莱斯特拉看到你时，她的眼睛立刻亮了起来，而周围的人群也在你走上前时让开了道路。 “啊， [pc.name]！”莱斯特拉[dayNight |她的声音很低，无疑是为了避免打扰正在睡觉的猫头鹰。 | 叽叽喳喳，笑容满面 ]我本来希望你能尽快过来。”她一边说着，一边抬起了手。 [dayNight |打盹儿 |小 ] 怀中抱着孩子，莱斯特拉露出幸福的笑容，仔细地把你介绍给她的女儿：“我想让你认识一下我们的女儿。 [pc.name]." [dayNight |正如预期的那样，她在睡梦中并没有太大的反应。不过有一点是可以肯定的：她的样子看起来确实可爱极了你可以理解为什么大家都围过来看吧。说实在的，对于一个新生儿来说，她的体型似乎实在太大了——至少从体型上看，她更像是一个两岁左右的儿童。看到你一脸困惑的样子…… |你刚认识的女儿正抬头看着你，她那金色的眼睛里闪烁着好奇的光芒。 “嗨 [pc.mf |爸爸 |妈妈 ]妈妈告诉我你很快就会来看我。” 她居然已经知道这件事了，你看起来真是太震惊了说话为了做出恰当的回应，相反， ] 莱斯特拉轻声笑了笑，然后将目轻型转向你。此刻，她的举止明显发生了变化，只要你看着她，就能感受到这种变化。你不确定这究竟是母性带来的幸福，还是某种更深层次的本能满足，但她的确显得……更加自信了。就在你还在思考这些的时候，她开口说话了，同时轻轻抚摸着你女儿领子上的柔软绒毛。 “正如你所知道的，鹰身女妖是会逐渐成长的非常用大多数其他种族的标准来看，这个速度已经相当快了。 [dayNight |她现在可能正在休息，但我可以向你保证，我们的女儿确实是个非常爱学习的孩子。我觉得她每隔五分钟就会问我一个新问题。 作为回应，正在熟睡的婴儿发出了轻柔的呜呜声，这让她的母亲露出了充满爱意的微笑。 |我们早已习惯了自力更生，但当我们不再过着强盗般的生活时……我们的幼崽们有时会显得过于早熟。 听到这话，她怀里的幼儿忍不住咯咯笑了起来，而莱斯特拉则轻轻拨了拨她那簇羽毛般的头发。 ] 你猜对了……不过，看到她发展得这么快，还是有点让人吃惊。她已经给自己取名字了吗？ 莱斯特拉将目轻型转向你，她那厚厚的镜片无法掩盖她那双金色眼睛中流露出的温暖。“在我母亲的建议下，是的。她的名字是[dayNight | 阿尔巴。” 这是个多么美妙的名字啊，你一定要告诉她这一点。不过，你还是忍不住会好奇：她究竟是怎么想出这个名字的？ |等等——” 这时，你的女儿插话进来，她露出灿烂的笑容说道：“阿尔巴！ [pc.isDK |看来你的女儿遗传了你那一份叛逆的基因。莱斯特拉微微皱起了眉头。 |看到莱斯特拉那瞬间的惊讶表情，你不禁暗自发笑。 ]然后她笑着耸了耸肩，表示并不在意。不过你得承认，这个名字确实挺可爱的。她是怎么想出这个名字来的呢？ ] 啊……那是我祖母的。我妈妈说它的白色羽毛很相似，所以……我觉得它很适合。” 这点应该没人会反对吧。不过，她现在作为众人的焦点，感觉怎么样呢？ 莱斯特拉发出一声无奈的叹息——对她来说，这种反应实在很不常见——然后她环顾了一下周围的小人群。我必须承认，我并不是很感兴趣。大家的好意固然令人感激，但我已经是个成年女性了，其实并不需要别人过分宠溺我。不过，他们中的大多数人确实都非常渴望见到我们的女儿。 [pc.mf |父亲 |陛下 ]我相信你不会介意介绍一下自己吧？” 说完之后，有人带你去见了那些前来表示祝福的人们。人群中的大多数都是莱斯特拉的同事们，他们向你表达了诚挚的祝贺，并热情地做了自我介绍。其中还有一些经常来这座大教堂的常客，甚至还有几位阿斯特里达家族的人。[silly | 奇怪的是，你与他们的会面总是显得很紧张。你几乎可以肯定，其中有人强忍着泪水……不管是什么原因。 | ] 你刚完成那些事情不久，人群便慢慢散去了，留下坐在办公桌后的莱斯特拉，她显得松了一口气。 “谢谢 [pc.name]我希望满足他们的好奇心能够让他们暂时安静下来；过多的关注确实会让人感到有些喘不过气来。” 你肯定能够理解这种感受。 “无论如何……我还有工作要完成。亲爱的，你现在需要帮忙处理什么事情吗？
rows.raw: " As you step up to the librarian’s desk, you notice [dayNight |several other |a few other ] guests crowded around it. Working your way in and leaning close to get a look, you’re granted the sight of Lystra, squirming under all the attention. Not surprising, given how much she dislikes being the center of attention; but what’s all the commoti— Huh. [dayNight |Nestled in Lystra’s arms is a small harpy chick, sleeping peacefully despite the onlookers |Seated in Lystra’s lap is a small harpy chick, visibly relishing being doted on by the onlookers ]. Well, that certainly explains the crowd — you're just a bit disappointed you weren't here for the hatching. Lystra's eyes light up once she sees you though, and the crowd parts around you as you step up. "Ah, [pc.name]!" Lystra[dayNight |'s voice is hushed, no doubt to avoid disturbing the sleeping owlet | chirps, smiling widely ]. "I was hoping you would come by soon." Lifting the [dayNight |snoozing |small ] child in her arms, Lystra gives you a closer look with a beatific grin. "I'd like you to meet our daughter, [pc.name]." [dayNight |As is to be expected, she doesn't react much in her sleep. That said, one thing's for certain: she looks positively adorable. You can see why everybody's crowding around to get a look. That said, she seems awfully large for a newborn — indeed, she's closer to a child around two years of age, at least in size. Seeing your bewilderment, |Your newly-acquainted daughter stares up at you, golden eyes ashine with curiosity. "Hi [pc.mf |Poppa |Momma ]! Momma told me you were gonna visit soon." You're a bit too stunned by the fact she can already speak to properly respond. Instead, ] Lystra lets out a brief chuckle, turning her gaze towards you. There's a palpable change to her demeanor now, and you can feel it just looking at her. You're not certain whether it's just maternal bliss, or some deeper sort of instinctual fulfillment, but she seems... more confident. You're still taking that in when she speaks up, gently stroking the downy fluff of your daughter's collar. "As I'm sure you know, harpies develop very quickly, by the standards of most other races. [dayNight |She may be resting now, but I can assure you; our daughter here is quite the learner. I don't think she's gone more than five minutes without asking me a new question." There's a soft coo from the sleeping babe by way of response, earning a loving smile from her mother. |We're adapted to fend for ourselves, but when we're not living the life of brigands... our young can be a tad precocious." That earns a cheeky laugh from the toddler in her lap, and Lystra gently tousles her feather-hair. ] You guess so... still, it's a bit of a shock to see her develop that quickly. Has she named her yet? Lystra turns her eyes towards you, and her thick glasses can't hide the warmth in those golden globes. "At my mother's suggestion, yes. Her name is[dayNight | Alba." That's a wonderful name, and you tell her as much. You can't help your curiosity, though; how did she come up with that? |—" Lystra is cut off by your daughter interjecting, flashing a toothy smile as she speaks up. "Alba!" [pc.isDK |Guess your daughter's inherited a bit of your rebellious streak. Lystra sets her jaw into a shallow frown for a moment |You can't help but snicker at Lystra's momentary surprise ], before she shrugs it off with a laugh. You have to admit that's a cute name, though. How did she come up with it? ] "Ah... it was my grandmother's. My mother mentioned that the white plumage was similar, so... it seemed like a good fit." You won't argue that. How's she handling being the center of attention, though? Lystra lets out a brief groan of exasperation — a rare sight, with her — as she looks around the small crowd. "I must confess, I'm not very keen on it. All the well-wishing has been nice, but I'm a grown woman; I hardly need to be doted on. With that said, most of them have been eager to meet our daughter's [pc.mf |father |sire ]; I'm sure you don't mind introducing yourself?" With that, you're ushered through a brief sequence of acquainting yourself with well-wishers. Most of the crowd are Lystra's colleagues, and you're given no shortage of earnest congratulations and warm introductions. There's a few regular guests of the cathedral, and even a couple Astrida;[silly | oddly, your meetings with the latter are strangely tense. You're almost certain one of them was holding back tears... whatever the case, | ] it's not long after you're done that the crowd slowly dissipates, leaving a much-relieved Lystra seated behind her desk. "Thank you, [pc.name]. I hope sating their curiosity will warrant a reprieve; all the attention can be a tad suffocating." You can certainly understand that. "At any rate... I do still have a job to do. Did you require assistance with anything at the moment, dear?" "

rows.original: The moment she notices you approaching, Lystra’s eyes light up. Standing up from her seat, Lystra smiles brightly as she approaches you, throwing her wings around you in a sudden hug. [pc.heightRange 48 68 |Struggling to comprehend exactly why your face is now buried in her prodigious rack, |Caught off guard, you reciprocate, somewhat confused as ] your thoughts race. After enjoying it for a few moments, you extricate yourself from the sudden embrace, before meeting Lystra’s eyes. The kindly librarian has a surprising amount of pep in her step; [dayNight |you can’t recall seeing her looking so perky at this time of day |she’s visibly excited, and her you can’t help but feel a bit happy yourself seeing her like this ]. You’ve scarcely begun to ask what’s got her in such a good mood when she once again hugs you, guiding your hand to her midsection. [pc.heightRange 48 68 |Lystra nuzzles her chin into your [pc.hair] from above |cuddles up against you with aplomb ], a beatific grin on her face. "I’m pregnant, [pc.name]!" [pc.isDK |Already? |That’s wonderful! ] It’s a bit early, though; is she certain? Lystra chuckles softly, releasing you from the hug as she keeps your hand in her midriff. Smiling at you as your hands rove over the slight beginnings of a baby bump, she gently places a guiding hand over yours. "I’m a harpy, dear. It would be more unusual if I didn’t know so soon; I could feel it when I woke up today." Lystra’s tone is filled with excitement, and you can’t help but share in it; softly rubbing her midsection, surely enough, you can feel a gentle warmth there. Meeting Lystra's gaze once more, [pc.dcb |you can't help but smile a little, her contagious glee washing over you. Squeezing a clawed hand gently, you tell her you're looking forward to meeting your new daughter in due time. |you smile happily, giving her a warm hug. Nuzzling into Lystra, you tell her that you're overjoyed to hear the great news, and you're excited to meet your new daughter soon enough. |a big, happy grin covers your face as you give the big cuddly birdie a nice hug. This is gonna be soooo cool! You can't wait to meet your lil' owlet when she's born! ] Basking in your affection for a moment, it isn't long before Lystra remembers where she is; [dayNight |a small line has formed behind you at the librarian's desk, and you're pretty sure at least a few of them just came to watch the small scene you've been making |while the cathedral is hardly busy at the moment, Lystra's still got a job to do, after all ]. Stiffening her composure, Lystra gives you a short nod and takes a step back, before returning to her seat behind the desk. Adopting her usual, measured tone, she gives you a polite look. "A-anyways, we can discuss that more later. Was there something else you had needed from me, dear?"

rows.original: As you sit down across from Lystra, you notice her blushing a bit more intensely than usual; her golden eyes struggle to meet your gaze as you regard her. Muttering something under her breath, Lystra all but squawks in surprise as you ask her whether she’s alright. "Ah, y-yes, [pc.name]! I was merely, ah... considering something." And what would that be? You noticed it seemed like she was deep in thought, or even embarrassed. The moment your inquiry meets her ears, Lystra stares right at you, blushing deeply. Immediately, she begins to stammer, struggling to find the right words. "A-ah, I, um, it’s r-really nothing to concern yourself with, [pc.n]-[pc.name]! It was just, um, nothing more th—" You interrupt her posturing, telling her there’s no need to dance around things; she can just say it. Lystra freezes, then briefly sighs by way of response. "I’d like to have a daughter, [pc.name]," Lystra blurts out, her voice sounding resigned. "With you, to be precise. After so many long years, I’d forgotten how much I wanted it in my youth," Lystra continues, wistfully. "I suppose finally... having someone, must have reignited that." That’s... "Quite the tall ask, I’m aware. I’d hoped to be a bit more gentle in asking, but... regardless, that’s what I was considering." Lystra turns her gaze towards you, looking far more serious than you’re accustomed to. "Children are a serious commitment; of that, I’m fully aware. If that’s not something you feel ready for, I wouldn’t dream of holding that against you; I’ll simply continue to take brown leaf as I always have." You see. Lystra nods her head gently, then continues. "On the other hand... if it’s something you’d be comfortable with, I can assure you, I’m well-prepared for it. For the last fifteen or so years, I’ve assisted with the upbringing of new members of the order[pc.swornGod nareva |—" Lystra stops for a moment, turning to look at you. "Well, other than yourself, I suppose. But, |; ] before that, I helped my sister with raising my niece. The cathedral is well-equipped for childcare, as well; both for the new Astrida, as well as children of the staff. You needn’t worry about anything in such a department." So, what you’re hearing is, she wants to have a daughter with you, and the cathedral’s more than willing to help her with raising them? Lystra nods once again, keeping her eyes fixed upon you. "To summarize, yes. All that remains is the question of whether you’d like to do so, [pc.name]. The choice is entirely yours." Lystra has asked you if you’d like to start a family with her. Any of your daughters will stay at the Cathedral of Nareva to be raised by her, though you can freely visit. This is a permanent decision.
rows.translation: 当你坐在莱斯特拉的对面时，你注意到她的脸红得比平时更加厉害；当你注视着她时，她那双金色的眼睛几乎无法与你对视。你低声说了些什么，而当你问她是否没事时，莱斯特拉几乎吓得叫了出来。 “啊，没、没有 [pc.name]我只是在……嗯，思考一些事情而已。” 那你在思考什么呢？你注意到她似乎陷入了沉思，甚至还有点尴尬。 当你的询问传到她耳中时，莱斯特拉直视着你的眼睛，脸一下子红了。她立刻结结巴巴地开始说话，努力寻找合适的词语：“啊，其实没什么，没什么值得你担心的 [pc.n]-[pc.name]我只是，嗯，想说而已——” 你打断了她的支支吾吾，告诉她没必要拐弯抹角，直接说出来就好。莱斯特拉愣住了，然后轻轻叹了口气作为回应。 “我想要一个女儿。 [pc.name]，”和你在一起，”莱斯特拉无奈地说道，“确切地说，就是和你在一起。经历了这么多年的时光，我几乎忘记了自己年轻时是多么渴望这样的感情。”她继续说道，语气中带着一丝怅惘，“我想，终于有了一个人在身边，这种渴望才重新被点燃了吧。那……” “我知道，这个要求确实有些过分。我本来希望能用更委婉的方式提出来，但是……无论如何，这确实是我在考虑的事情。”莱斯特拉将目光转向你，神情比你平时见过的要严肃得多。 养育孩子是一件需要承担重大责任的事情，这一点我非常清楚。如果你觉得自己还没有准备好迎接这样的责任，我绝对不会因此责怪你；我只会像以前一样，继续过我的生活。 莱斯特拉轻轻点了点头，然后继续说道：“另一方面……如果这是你能够接受的事情，我可以向你保证，我已经做好了充分的准备。在过去的十五年左右时间里，我一直在协助培养这个组织的新成员。[pc.swornGod nareva |——“莱斯特拉停了一下，转过身看着你，说道：‘嗯，除了你之外，我想没有其他人了。但是…… |; ] 在此之前，我还帮忙照顾我的妹妹和她的侄女。那座大教堂在儿童看护方面设施也很齐全，无论是对于新来的阿斯特里达，还是员工们的孩子，都可以得到很好的照顾。在这种设施完备的环境中，你们完全不必担心任何问题。所以，你听到的是，她想和你生一个女儿，而大教堂也非常愿意帮助她们一起抚养这个孩子？ 莱斯特拉再次点了点头，目光始终紧盯着你。“总之，就是这样的。现在剩下的问题就是，你是否愿意这么做。 [pc.name]这个选择完全由你来做。 莱斯特拉问你是否愿意和她一起组建家庭。你的任何一个女儿都可以留在娜瑞瓦大教堂，由她来抚养，不过你也可以随时去探望她们。这是一个不可更改的决定。
rows.raw: ' As you sit down across from Lystra, you notice her blushing a bit more intensely than usual; her golden eyes struggle to meet your gaze as you regard her. Muttering something under her breath, Lystra all but squawks in surprise as you ask her whether she’s alright. "Ah, y-yes, [pc.name]! I was merely, ah... considering something." And what would that be? You noticed it seemed like she was deep in thought, or even embarrassed. The moment your inquiry meets her ears, Lystra stares right at you, blushing deeply. Immediately, she begins to stammer, struggling to find the right words. "A-ah, I, um, it’s r-really nothing to concern yourself with, [pc.n]-[pc.name]! It was just, um, nothing more th—" You interrupt her posturing, telling her there’s no need to dance around things; she can just say it. Lystra freezes, then briefly sighs by way of response. "I’d like to have a daughter, [pc.name]," Lystra blurts out, her voice sounding resigned. "With you, to be precise. After so many long years, I’d forgotten how much I wanted it in my youth," Lystra continues, wistfully. "I suppose finally... having someone, must have reignited that." That’s... "Quite the tall ask, I’m aware. I’d hoped to be a bit more gentle in asking, but... regardless, that’s what I was considering." Lystra turns her gaze towards you, looking far more serious than you’re accustomed to. "Children are a serious commitment; of that, I’m fully aware. If that’s not something you feel ready for, I wouldn’t dream of holding that against you; I’ll simply continue to take brown leaf as I always have." You see. Lystra nods her head gently, then continues. "On the other hand... if it’s something you’d be comfortable with, I can assure you, I’m well-prepared for it. For the last fifteen or so years, I’ve assisted with the upbringing of new members of the order[pc.swornGod nareva |—" Lystra stops for a moment, turning to look at you. "Well, other than yourself, I suppose. But, |; ] before that, I helped my sister with raising my niece. The cathedral is well-equipped for childcare, as well; both for the new Astrida, as well as children of the staff. You needn’t worry about anything in such a department." So, what you’re hearing is, she wants to have a daughter with you, and the cathedral’s more than willing to help her with raising them? Lystra nods once again, keeping her eyes fixed upon you. "To summarize, yes. All that remains is the question of whether you’d like to do so, [pc.name]. The choice is entirely yours." Lystra has asked you if you’d like to start a family with her. Any of your daughters will stay at the Cathedral of Nareva to be raised by her, though you can freely visit. This is a permanent decision. '

rows.translation: 你恐怕还是不要这样为好。

rows.original:
[var0
        |After taking a moment to consider things, you smile before returning Lystra’s uncertain gaze. Telling her that you’d be more than happy to start a family with her, you watch as an elated smile blooms on her face, and she abruptly stands, pulling you into a deep hug. You’re held in Lystra’s warm embrace for quite a while; reciprocating, you wrap your own arms around her for a bit. Eventually, the two of you separate, and Lystra nervously brushes a loose bit of her plumage to the side. Smiling at you, Lystra clears her throat.
        
        "A-ah, well, um... you have my gratitude, [pc.name]. I’ll stop taking my brown leaf, and... well, we can just let things take their course."
        
        With that, Lystra composes herself, returning to her seat as she stares over at you.
        
        "At any rate, was there anything else you had wished to discuss?"
        |For one reason or another, you simply wouldn’t like to do that; you tell Lystra as much. To her credit, she takes it well; rather than get upset, Lystra nods her head softly, before giving you a slight smile.
        
        "I understand, [pc.name]. As I said, it’s quite a lot to ask; I wouldn’t dream of holding it against you for not wanting to make that leap."
        
        Extending a hand to you, Lystra smiles softly, and it’s clear she’s being perfectly honest.
        
        "No hard feelings, alright? Let’s not allow this to damper our rapport."
        
        Taking her hand, you shake on it — no hard feelings. With that, Lystra returns to her seat, courteous as ever.
        
        "Now then, was there anything you needed, [pc.name]?"
    ]

[var0
        |在仔细考虑了一番之后，你微笑着回应了莱斯特拉那充满疑虑的目光。你告诉她，你非常乐意与她一起组建家庭，看着她脸上绽放出欣喜的笑容，你突然被她紧紧抱住。你在莱斯特拉温暖的怀抱中停留了许久；作为回应，你也用自己的双臂紧紧抱住了她。最终，你们分开后，莱斯特拉紧张地整理了一下自己身上散落的羽毛。莱斯特拉对你笑了笑，然后清了清嗓子。
        
        “啊，嗯，那个……我很感激你，[pc.name]。我就不再服用棕叶了，然后……嗯，我们就让事情顺其自然吧。”
        
        说完，莱斯特拉恢复了平静，坐回自己的座位，继续注视着你。
        
        “无论如何，你还有什么别的事想讨论吗？”
        |出于这样或那样的原因，你就是不愿意那么做；你把这一点告诉了莱斯特拉。值得称赞的是，她接受得很好；她没有感到生气，而是轻轻地点了点头，然后对你露出了一个微笑。
        
        “我理解，[pc.name]。正如我所说，这个要求确实有些过分了；如果你不愿意接受，我绝对不会因此而责怪你。”
        
        莱斯特拉微笑着向你伸出手，显然她是真心实意的。
        
        “我们没有芥蒂，好吗？不要让这件事破坏我们之间的融洽关系。”
        
        你握住了她的手，彼此点了点头——没有芥蒂。说完之后，莱斯特拉像往常一样礼貌地回到了自己的座位上。
        
        “那么，现在你还有什么需要的吗，[pc.name]？”
    ]

rows.original:
As you shift your attention to Alba, your daughter looks up towards you, an eager smile on her face. You meet her eyes, watching excitement twinkle in those golden orbs; just like her mother's. You can't help but smile in turn as her contagious optimism takes root, and you reach down to tousle her hair before asking what she's been up to.
    
    There’s scarcely a moment’s hesitation before Alba excitedly blurts out her reply. "Reading! And writing. Momma says it’s important to do that early."
    
    Lystra chuckles softly at that, smiling fondly as she strokes Alba’s feathery hair. "Indeed it is, dear. Harpies grow up far more quickly than most; that also means we learn faster, too."
    
    Alba nods excitedly, then returns her attention to you with a big grin. "Yup! But momma also said it's okay to take a break if you're visiting. So..." Alba closes the notebook she had been writing in, and leans forwards to push it onto the desk. "What’d you wanna do?"
    
    What indeed...
rows.translation:
当你把注意力转向阿尔巴时，你的女儿抬头望向你，脸上挂着渴望的笑容。你迎上她的目光，看着那双金色的眼瞳里闪着兴奋的光——和她母亲一样。她那富有感染力的乐观也感染了你，你忍不住露出笑容，伸手揉了揉她的头发，问她最近都在忙些什么。
    
    阿尔巴几乎没有丝毫犹豫，就兴奋地脱口答道：“阅读！还有写作。妈妈说，这些事要趁早做。”
    
    莱斯特拉听了轻声笑起来，慈爱地抚摸着阿尔巴羽毛般的头发。“确实如此，亲爱的。鹰身女妖的成长速度远比大多数种族快；这也意味着我们学东西也更快。”
    
    阿尔巴兴奋地点点头，然后咧开嘴又看向你。“没错！不过妈妈也说过，有客人来的时候休息一下也没关系。所以……”阿尔巴合上她一直在写的那本笔记本，凑上前把它推到桌上。“你想做点什么呢？”
    
    确实……该做点什么呢……

rows.original: Talk with your daughter for a bit.
rows.translation: 和你的女儿聊一会儿吧。
rows.raw: "Talk with your daughter for a bit."

rows.original: Seating yourself in the chair next to Lystra's, you look over at Alba and tell your daughter you're going to spend some time playing. Such a promise earns a predictable response from any child; Alba proves to be no exception to the norm, eagerly hopping from her mother's lap. It's then that you're ushered into several hours of playing to Alba's whims, from small toys to games of sleight of hand. Lystra even participates, between helping patrons of the library... gods, she really is an experienced teacher. There's a kind, but firm instructional tone to her voice as she explains various rules to Alba, and even to you. By the time Alba's had enough fun, multiple hours have gone by in a blur; indeed, the little owlet is napping in her mother's arms before long. As you rise to a standing position, Lystra goes with you, sparing one wing to wrap around you in a hug. "Thank you, [pc.name]. I'm often too busy to spend that sort of idle time with her." [pc.dcb |It's hardly that big a deal. You're just spending some time with your kid, is all. |Hey, what kind of [pc.mf |dad |mom ] would you be if you didn't drop by to play once in a while? |Aww, it's no prob at all! You're like, never gonna miss a chance to play, especially with a totally adorbs lil' kid like Alba! ] Lystra lets out a soft, hooting chuckle as she shakes her head. "Be that as it may, you have my appreciation, dear. I do hope you'll come to visit us again soon." That's a given; but for now, you'll leave her to her business. Excusing yourself, you return to the library proper, reinvigorated for having spent some time with your family.
rows.translation: 你坐在莱斯特拉旁边的椅子上，看着阿尔巴，然后告诉女儿你打算去玩一会儿。 这样的承诺自然会换来预料之中的回应任何孩子阿尔巴也不例外，她迫不及待地从母亲的怀里跳下来。从那时起，你就得花上几个小时来满足阿尔巴的各种奇想——从玩小玩具到玩各种手巧的游戏。莱斯特拉甚至在帮助图书馆读者之余，也会参与其中。天啊，她真是一位经验丰富的老师。她在向阿尔巴以及你们解释各种规则时，肌肉度既亲切又坚定。 等到阿尔巴玩得够开心时，几个小时就已经在不知不觉中过去了；事实上，不久之后，那只小猫头鹰就已经在妈妈的怀里睡着了。当你站起来的时候，莱斯特拉也跟着你站了起来，它用一只翅膀轻轻环绕着你，给了你一个拥抱。 “谢谢你 [pc.name]我通常太忙了，根本没有时间陪她闲逛。 [pc.dcb |这根本不是什么大事。你只不过是在陪陪自己的孩子而已，没什么别的。 |嘿，这是什么类型的 [pc.mf |爸爸 |妈妈 ] 如果你不偶尔过来玩玩，你会变成什么样呢？ |哎呀，那当然没问题啦！你这样的人，肯定不会错过任何玩耍的机会，尤其是有像阿尔巴这样可爱的小朋友在身边的时候！ ] 莱斯特拉轻声笑着摇了摇头，说道：“不管怎样，亲爱的，我真的很感激你。真心希望你能尽快再来拜访我们。” 这当然是理所当然的；不过现在，你还是让她继续忙她的事情吧。道过歉后，你回到了图书馆，与家人共度的这段时光让你重新充满了活力。

rows.original: Giving Alba a quick pat on the head, you take your seat across from her. You'd like to take some time to talk with her — what's been on her mind lately? Despite yourself, you can’t help but be taken off-guard by the verbal deluge that immediately follows. If Lystra is reserved and soft-spoken, Alba is... most definitely not. You're brought through a retelling of her entire day in painstaking detail, and you're admittedly quite impressed by her memory. Lystra watches on in idle amusement, only speaking up to correct Alba on a pronunciation here and there. By the time she finishes, you momentarily glance at Lystra, only to see a proud smile on her face. Clearly, she's been teaching Alba well, and the pride shows. You're about to compliment her on it, when Alba launches into another tangent, dragging on for several minutes, before she concludes. Then another... and another. Several long-winded ramblings later... By the time Alba's satisfied with your 'chat', you've scarcely spoken a word yourself. Lystra's openly amused at her daughter's continual rambling, giving her a gentle pat to the head as she lifts her back into her arms. "Well... forgive her dear, but you did ask. As if you could hold anything such as being talkative against a child— let alone as cute as your daughter. Does she always love to talk this much? Lystra lets out a brief sigh at that, leaning back in her chair as she thinks. "Hoo... my mother always said I was quite the chatterbox as a child, but I suppose that's been carried down." "Yup!" Alba chimes in, beaming with enthusiasm. "Gramma says I'm a lot like how momma used to be. Which means I'm gonna be really, really smart, one day!" You're sure she will. But in the meantime, you've got to go; can she promise to behave for her mother? "Yup!" Giving Alba one last tousle of her feather-hair, you steal a quick hug from Lystra before returning to the library proper. Kids sure can be a handful...
rows.translation: 你轻轻拍了拍阿尔巴的头，在她对面坐下。你想花点时间和她聊聊——她最近在想些什么呢？ 尽管你自己也不情愿，但还是被紧随其后的言语洪流打了个措手不及。如果说莱斯特拉内敛而轻声细语，那阿尔巴……绝对不是这样。她会把一整天的经历事无巨细地复述给你听，而你也得承认，她的记忆力让你相当佩服。莱斯特拉饶有兴致地在一旁看着，只偶尔出声纠正阿尔巴的发音。等她讲完，你瞥了莱斯特拉一眼，只见她脸上挂着自豪的微笑。显然，她把阿尔巴教得很好，那份自豪也毫不掩饰。你正要为此称赞她，阿尔巴却又扯出了另一个话题，拖拖拉拉讲了好几分钟才收住。接着又是一个……再接着又是一个。 在又几段冗长啰嗦的絮叨之后…… 等阿尔巴对你们的‘闲谈’感到满意时，你自己几乎一句话都没说上。莱斯特拉显然被女儿没完没了的絮叨逗乐了，轻轻拍了拍她的头顶，把她抱回怀里。 “唉……亲爱的，原谅她吧，毕竟是你自己问的。 你总不可能因为一个孩子话多就责怪她吧——更何况是你这么可爱的女儿。她总是这么爱说话吗？ 听到这话，莱斯特拉轻轻叹了口气，靠在椅背上思索着。“呼……我母亲以前总说，我小时候可是个话匣子，不过我猜这大概是遗传下来的。” “对呀！”阿尔巴兴致勃勃地插话道，“奶奶说我很像妈妈以前的样子。也就是说，总有一天我会变得特别特别聪明！” 你确信她会的。但眼下你得走了；她能答应乖乖听妈妈的话吗？ “对呀！” 你最后又揉了揉阿尔巴那羽毛般的头发，趁机从莱斯特拉那里讨了个快速的拥抱，然后才回到图书馆里。小孩子还真是难对付……

Despite yourself, you can’t help but be taken off-guard by the verbal deluge that immediately follows. If Lystra is reserved and soft-spoken, Alba is... most definitely not. You're brought through a retelling of her entire day in painstaking detail, and you're admittedly quite impressed by her memory. Lystra watches on in idle amusement, only speaking up to correct Alba on a pronunciation here and there. By the time she finishes, you momentarily glance at Lystra, only to see a proud smile on her face. Clearly, she's been teaching Alba well, and the pride shows. You're about to compliment her on it, when Alba launches into another tangent, dragging on for several minutes, before she concludes. Then another... and another. Several long-winded ramblings later... By the time Alba's satisfied with your 'chat', you've scarcely spoken a word yourself. Lystra's openly amused at her daughter's continual rambling, giving her a gentle pat to the head as she lifts her back into her arms. "Well... forgive her dear, but you did ask. As if you could hold anything such as being talkative against a child— let alone as cute as your daughter. Does she always love to talk this much? Lystra lets out a brief sigh at that, leaning back in her chair as she thinks. "Hoo... my mother always said I was quite the chatterbox as a child, but I suppose that's been carried down." "Yup!" Alba chimes in, beaming with enthusiasm. "Gramma says I'm a lot like how momma used to be. Which means I'm gonna be really, really smart, one day!" You're sure she will. But in the meantime, you've got to go; can she promise to behave for her mother? "Yup!" Giving Alba one last tousle of her feather-hair, you steal a quick hug from Lystra before returning to the library proper. Kids sure can be a handful... "

rows.original:
The first floor of the Cathedral of Nareva is a single tremendous chamber with ivory-white walls draped with heavy black curtains, giving it a particularly shadowy aura. Scroll-shelves dominate the flanks of the chamber, filled to overflowing with carefully curated parchment — and even a handful of baked clay and stone tablets, doubtless left over from the earliest days of this vaunted church. A painted statue of the goddess of knowledge and secrets herself looms upon a great marble pedestal at the head of the sanctum: she appears here as a coiling naga with black scales and a flowing mane of dark hair. Prominent fangs protrude between black-hued lips. She carries a book pressed tight to her otherwise bare chest, maintaining the illusion of modesty, while her other hand lifts up a staff on which sits a figurehead of the very world, the continents etched upon its crystalline surface and glowing with a faint inner light. 
    [var0]
	Rather than traditional pews, the center of the chamber has cushioned seats and reading desks, looking every bit as much a lyceum's classroom as it does a church's nave. Fitting indeed for the goddess of learning, you suppose. [dayNight|There are several acolytes and supplicants taking up those seats, reading from the temple's collection — or in a handful of cases, and under close supervision of cowled acolytes, copying the texts onto fresh parchment. Not all are frostscale salamanders, either: there are minotaurs and humans here, doubtless pilgrims from the nearby realms, and even a handful of cinderscale salamanders all wrapped up in heavy cloaks to ward off the northern chill that runs rampant through the stone sanctum.|Even at this hour there are acolytes quite literally burning the midnight oil, scouring ancient texts under lamplight — at least in those cases where they have no auroran tail flame to provide their own illumination. A few Astrida paladins have gathered in conclave around the great lectern at the head of the sanctuary, perhaps strategizing their ancient order's next moves.]
	
	To the south is a smaller door leading off into the chapel.
rows.translation:
娜瑞瓦大教堂的第一层是一间巨大的单一厅堂，象牙白的墙壁上垂挂着厚重的黑色帷幔，让这里透着一股格外幽暗的气息。卷轴书架占据了厅堂两侧，架上塞得满溢，全是精心整理的羊皮纸——甚至还有几块陶土板和石板，无疑是从这座备受尊崇的教堂最古老的年代留存下来的。在圣所尽头的大理石高台上，矗立着一尊知识与秘密之神本人的彩绘雕像：她在此以盘绕的娜迦形象显现，黑色鳞片，一头深色长发如瀑。黑色的嘴唇间突出显眼的獠牙。她怀里紧抱着一本书，压在原本赤裸的胸前，维持着端庄的假象；另一只手举起一根法杖，杖顶是这个世界本身的雕像，各大洲蚀刻在水晶表面上，散发着微弱的内光。 
    [var0]
	厅堂中央没有传统的长椅，取而代之的是带软垫的座椅和阅读桌，看上去既是教堂的中殿，也完全像是一所学园里的教室。你想，这对学问之神来说倒是再合适不过。[dayNight|有几名侍僧和信众正坐在那些座位上，阅读寺院的藏书——少数几例则是在戴兜帽的侍僧严密监督下，把经文抄写到新的羊皮纸上。他们也并不全是霜鳞蝾螈人：这里有弥诺陶洛斯和人类，无疑是从附近诸国来的朝圣者，甚至还有几个炭鳞蝾螈人，全都裹着厚重的斗篷，以抵御在这座石造圣所里肆意流窜的北方寒气。|即便到了这个时辰，仍有侍僧在名副其实地熬夜苦读，借着灯光钻研古籍——至少那些没有极光尾焰为自己照明的侍僧是如此。几位阿斯特里达圣骑士聚集在圣所尽头的大讲台周围密议，或许正在筹划他们古老教团接下来的行动。]
	
	南面有一扇较小的门，通向小礼拜堂。

rows.original:
You cast a wary glance towards the Cathedral of Nareva overlooking the plaza as you approach the statue, hand around your charm. Already you can feel a resonance building in the air like a charge, growing with each step you take closer to the stone salamander. 

		Sure enough, a couple of black-scaled warriors being approaching you, but their expressions are more curious than hostile, and they make no effort to stop you as you close the distance, establishing the connection between your charm and the Waystone Idol. Finally, the magic discharges, and the statue's gem begins to glow, casting an azure hue across the palace grounds.
		
		Rather than reprimand you, one of the paladins just runs her claws through her hair. "Huh. Usually stops glowing after somebody does that."
		
		The other nods at you. "Hey, if it works, it works."
		
		Guess you didn't need to be worried after all.
rows.translation:
当你走近那座雕像时，警惕地瞥了一眼矗立在广场上方的娜瑞瓦大教堂，同时手中不断转动着那枚护身符。你已经感觉到空气中有一种逐渐增强的气息，就像一种能量正在积聚，而每当你靠近那座石制蝾螈雕像一步，这种能量就会变得更加强烈。 

		果然，有几位黑鳞战士正向你走来，但他们的表情更多是出于好奇，而非敌意。当你逐渐靠近他们，建立起你的魅力与路石神像之间的联系时，他们也没有试图阻止你。终于，魔法能量释放了出来，雕像上的宝石开始发光，将蔚蓝色的光芒洒满了整个宫殿庭院。

那位圣骑士并没有责备你，而是只是用爪子捋了捋自己的头发，说道：“哼，通常别人这么做之后，宝石就会停止发光的。另一个人向你点了点头，说道：“嘿，如果真的有效的话，那当然没问题。”

看来你其实根本不需要担心嘛。
rows.raw:
'
        You cast a wary glance towards the Cathedral of Nareva overlooking the plaza as you approach the statue, hand around your charm. Already you can feel a resonance building in the air like a charge, growing with each step you take closer to the stone salamander. 

		Sure enough, a couple of black-scaled warriors being approaching you, but their expressions are more curious than hostile, and they make no effort to stop you as you close the distance, establishing the connection between your charm and the Waystone Idol. Finally, the magic discharges, and the statue's gem begins to glow, casting an azure hue across the palace grounds.
		
		Rather than reprimand you, one of the paladins just runs her claws through her hair. "Huh. Usually stops glowing after somebody does that."
		
		The other nods at you. "Hey, if it works, it works."
		
		Guess you didn't need to be worried after all.'

rows.original: There's a stall set up here…
You'll have to come back during operating hours.
rows.raw: "You'll have to come back during operating hours."

rows.original:
Tethys has given you the run of the place, and while her daughter might be the victim in this case, there could still be something critical in her bedroom. You don't even need to shake the Lady Consort down for a key: the handle's been smashed off, leaving a blossom of splintered wood in the doorframe. You push the door open and slip inside.

	Kythie's bedroom is about what you'd expect from a teenage noble: a curtained bed with thick, fluffy blankets of the same tartan colors common to her family; hefty chests of drawers, topped with jewelry boxes and flanked by a pair of standing mirrors — an expensive conceit, even for a noble; and a mahogany display table with her weighted throwing discs, scented body oils, and of course, her golden victory-laurels from the Tycathalon. 
	
	What do you want to investigate?
rows.translation:
泰西斯已经允许你自由行动了，虽然她的女儿在这件事中可能是受害者，但她的卧室里可能仍然藏着一些重要的东西。你甚至不需要强迫那位王后夫人交出钥匙：门把手已经被砸掉了，门框上只留下一簇碎裂的木屑。你推开门走了进去。

	凯西的卧室完全符合人们对一位青少年贵族的期待：一张床前挂着帘子，上面铺着厚厚的、柔软的毯子，这些毯子的图案都是她家族常见的格子花纹；几个大衣柜，上面摆放着首饰盒，两侧还各有一面立式镜子——即使对于贵族来说，这也算是相当奢华的装饰了；此外，还有一张红木制的展示台，上面放着她用来投掷的石盘、香体油，当然，还有她在泰卡塔隆比赛中获得的金色胜利奖杯。 
	
	你想调查什么？
rows.raw:
"
	Tethys has given you the run of the place, and while her daughter might be the victim in this case, there could still be something critical in her bedroom. You don't even need to shake the Lady Consort down for a key: the handle's been smashed off, leaving a blossom of splintered wood in the doorframe. You push the door open and slip inside.

	Kythie's bedroom is about what you'd expect from a teenage noble: a curtained bed with thick, fluffy blankets of the same tartan colors common to her family; hefty chests of drawers, topped with jewelry boxes and flanked by a pair of standing mirrors — an expensive conceit, even for a noble; and a mahogany display table with her weighted throwing discs, scented body oils, and of course, her golden victory-laurels from the Tycathalon. 
	
	What do you want to investigate?"
rows.correctionNote: 原文“the handle's been smashed off”指门把手，原译“钥匙柄”为误译。

rows.original: Check out the princess's chests and drawers.
rows.translation: 去看看公主的箱子和抽屉吧。
rows.raw: "Check out the princess's chests and drawers."
rows.correctionNote: chests 指箱柜，不是“衣柜”。

rows.original: Well, the door's just sitting open. It could have been anyone, frankly.
rows.translation: 嗯，门大开着，说实话，任何人都可能进去。
rows.raw: "Well, the door's just sitting open. It could have been anyone, frankly."

rows.translation: 看看那张漂亮的四柱床吧。
rows.correctionNote: four-poster 指四柱床，原译“四幅幅画组成的装饰画”完全错误。

rows.translation: 查看凯西展出的那些物品。
rows.raw: "Examine the items Kythie's out on display."

rows.original: You've seen all you need to here, and withdraw back to the hallway.
rows.translation: 你在这里已经看到了所有需要看到的内容，现在可以退回到走廊去了。
rows.raw: "\n\t\tYou've seen all you need to here, and withdraw back to the hallway.\n\t\t"

rows.original: You head over to the princess's dressing area: a stack of drawers topped with jewelry boxes, flanked by a pair of Kythie-sized standing mirrors. There's a padded stood for her to sit at while doing her hair, though it's currently playing home to stacks and stacks of tartan kilts and cloaks, all neatly folded. [pc.isBimbo | They've been here for a while, to your eye. Different fashions, threadbare and new mixed together. The princess doesn't really care about her clothes, does she? Just tosses them anywhere out of the way. She probably doesn't even use these gorgeous mirrors to do her hair and makeup for hours! What a waste! | Left here by the palace staff for when she returns, you'd guess. ] You figure you should start your investigation from the top and work your way down, so that makes the jewelry boxes first. She's got three in total: a pair of smaller boxes sitting open, each with a single necklace draped through it, one with a silver ouroboros and another with a number of gold loops and diamonds. The central box has the real motherlode though: a selection of gold bangles and armlets, a pair of circlets, and many, many earrings. There's even a thick, silver-chased band that the rest of it sits inside that's far too big for her head... a tail-bangle, maybe? Nothing you wouldn't expect from a wealthy debutante, really. Time to rifle through her drawers, then. You pull each open in turn, revealing neatly-folded dresses, even more kilts... and there at the bottom, sets of white, rose-pink, and azure-blue panties. There's only a couple of bras in there, each one a masterwork of silk and ribbons, clearly meant for formal occasions. Most of the salamander women in this town go with their cleavage out as a matter of course. And... something's under one of those bras, now that you look at it. You brush the expensive negligee out of the way to reveal a small glass bottle, stoppered with a pink heart. You crack it open and take a whiff. Smells like the floral oils Cait's always carting around. A little personal lubricant for the princess's pleasure? You slip that back where you found it and take another look around...
rows.translation: 你走向公主的更衣区：一叠抽屉柜，上面放着首饰盒，两侧各立着一面与凯西身高相配的穿衣镜。那里还有一张带软垫的凳子，本是她梳头时坐的，不过现在在上面安家的是一叠又一叠的格子呢短裙和斗篷，全都叠得整整齐齐。[pc.isBimbo | 在你看来，这些东西放在这儿已经有一阵子了。款式各不相同，磨破的和崭新的混在一起。这位公主其实根本不在乎自己的衣服，对吧？随手就往不碍事的地方一扔。她八成压根不用这些漂亮镜子花上几个小时梳头化妆！真是浪费！ | 大概是宫里的侍从留在这儿，等她回来用的吧，你猜。 ] 你想，调查应该从上面开始，一层层往下查，那就先从首饰盒下手。她总共有三个盒子：两个较小的敞着盖，各有一条项链搭在上面，一条镶着银色衔尾蛇，另一条缀着若干金环和钻石。正中间那个盒子里才是真正的富矿：一排金手镯和臂环，两顶额环，还有多得数不清的耳环。里面甚至还有一只厚重的银镶箍环，其余首饰都装在它里面，那尺寸对她的头来说大得离谱……也许是尾环？ 说实话，都是一个富有交际花身上再正常不过的东西。 那就该翻翻她的抽屉了。你依次拉开每一个，里面是叠得整整齐齐的连衣裙，还有更多的短裙……而在最底下，是白色、玫瑰粉和天蓝色的成套内裤。胸罩只有两件，每一件都是丝绸与缎带的杰作，显然是正式场合才穿的。这座镇上的蝾螈女人大多理所当然地敞着乳沟。 而且……仔细一看，其中一件胸罩下面压着什么东西。你拨开那件昂贵的薄纱睡衣，露出一只小玻璃瓶，瓶塞是粉色心形的。你打开瓶盖闻了闻。闻起来像凯特总随身带着的那种花香精油。给公主取乐用的一小瓶私人润滑剂？ 你把它塞回原处，又环顾了一圈……
