rows.original: "About me? Surely I am not a suspect!" You shake your head. "I'm just looking for [pc.isCunning |context |a clearer picture ] here." A momentary bristle passes from the Lady Consort's features, and her shoulders relax backwards. "Very well. Of course. I will spare you the obvious pageantry, then." She takes a breath, shaking off the severity of her normal courtly demeanor. "My family are landholders north of the city, on the frontier of Tychris's domain. We are its shield against the barbarians of the tundra. But we were not immune to the decline that has affected so many bloodlines in the principality; Kythie is the last of my line, and I doubt very much that I would be alive if it were not for my father's love for a foreign priestess." "The decline?" Tethys sighs. "An affliction has long gripped Tychris. One of the malingering repercussions of the Godswar, still blighting us centuries after. The bloodlines of our nobility run thinner each year, producing weaker offspring, and fewer of them. I love my husband very much, [pc.name], but go outside and look upon the statue of his ancestor-king who won the holy war alongside Nareva herself; then compare him to Evander. Prince Philandros would have thought Evander to be his smallest daughter at a glance." [pc.bg scholar |You've heard of such things happening in other isolated reaches of the old Empire. Some consider it to be a punishment from the gods for inbreeding. ] She laughs, but there's a fond smile on her face. Tethys crosses her arms beneath her prodigious bosom — there's certainly no thinning of her bloodline to worry about, if that manifests as skinny and frail heirs. "So your father found the cure?" "We believe that foreign blood will reinvigorate the city. That is why Father took a Jassiran to be his partner, and why we have reached out to Felurze to wed Kythie. Other noble families are beginning to follow suit, in the wake of Kythie's public engagement. I am glad to have been a part of this, in my small part. Perhaps even moreso than my pride as a soldier. " "Did you follow your father's footsteps, as a shield of the realm?" That gives a proud chest-puff out of the 'mander. "I did! I am Strategos for my husband, master of his soldiers. I trained for the position since I was a child, I fought against many foes before I married Evander, and it is my honor to have protected Tychris during the Lion Witch's War afterwards." "Tell me about that?" "Ah, I should not be surprised the war's not so famous beyond our borders," Tethys says, trying to mask some amount of disappointment. "About eighteen years ago, a group of leothran barbarians descended from the northern tundra and began raiding the frontier villages. They enslaved our citizens, burned farms, destroyed bridges that connect us to our people. A shamaness lead the pack, much more powerful than any that had threatened the city for generations — strong enough to lay waste to village militias all by herself. The Order Astrida recalled its paladins to hunt her, but before they could march, a tribesman defected to us and told us of his kins' movements, of their plans to celebrate the solstice in an isolated valley near my family's holdings; I was in a position to seize the initiative and thrust north with the princely guard under cover of night while the Astrida were still coming to their camps." There's a certain relish in Tethys's voice now. "A hard march, but I know the land well. We moved with speed, and caught the witch and her allies while they were still hung over from their merry-making, barely ready for battle — the state in which they had once found our people. Even still, the witch was powerful! She shattered the forest around us with thunder and scoured our shields with lightning. Still and all, we fell on her like warhawks!" The salamander's fists clench before her, and her tail blazes bright. "My men fought with unequalled valor, driving the tribe's warriors to route, until I found myself locking blades with the Lion Witch herself. She gave me the greatest battle of my life! Staff and spear clashed, and her spells burnt my shield black, burned it to cinders. I thought I had finally met my match, until in her hubris she left her spellcasting hand exposed, ready for a killing cantrip; I skewered it with my war knife!" Tethys allows herself a momentary, sadistic smirk. "How she howled! A little pain crippled a mage that powerful, forced her to flee." "Did you kill her?" "No," Tethys sighs. "She did not die by my hand. Her kinsmen broke, bearing their wounded shaman back to the tundra... and her thane-husband left me a terrible wound in trying to separate us. Still, the leothrans were scattered by my guard, and the witch proved easy prey for the Astrida to hunt, once the warband was routed." [pc.bg soldier hunter barbarian |A fine story... though you know tribal cultures like that tend to hold grudges for generations. A humiliating defeat might leave them bitter even today. |Well, routing a whole barbarian tribe is certainly an accomplishment. ] "Did those leothrans ever give you trouble again?" "No, thank the goddess. We taught them a painful lesson, and it's bought us a generation of peace from our neighbors in the north. And that remains my second greatest accomplishment." "And what's the first?" Tethys looks at the door and smiles. "You can guess, I'm sure."
rows.translation: 关于我？我肯定不是嫌疑人吧！” 你摇了摇头，说道：“我只是想了解一下而已。 [pc.isCunning |背景信息 |更清晰的画面 ] 好吧。” 王妃的脸色瞬间变得柔和起来，她的肩膀也放松了下来。“当然可以。那我就不搞那些繁琐的仪式了。”她深吸一口气，摆脱了平时那种正式、端庄的举止，显得更加自然了。我的家族拥有城北的土地，位于提克里斯领地的边境。我们是抵御苔原上那些野蛮人的屏障。然而，我们也无法逃脱这场影响整个公国众多家族的衰败趋势；凯西是我家族的最后一代成员，如果没有我父亲对那位外国女祭司的深情，我恐怕早已不在人世了。这种衰败……” 泰西斯叹了口气：“提克里斯长期以来一直深受其害。这是神战留下的后遗症之一，几个世纪以来一直在折磨着我们。我们贵族的血脉一年比一年稀薄，后代也越来越弱小，数量也越来越少。我非常爱我的丈夫。 [pc.name]，但是，你不妨走到外面去看看他那位曾与娜蕾瓦一同赢得那场神圣战争的祖先国王的雕像，然后再将他与埃万德进行比较。菲兰德罗斯王子一看就会觉得，埃万德简直就像他的小女儿一样。 [pc.bg scholar |你肯定听说过，在旧帝国的其他偏远地区，也发生过类似的事情。有些人认为，这是上天对近亲繁殖行为的惩罚。 ] 她笑了，但脸上带着一丝温暖的笑容。泰西斯将双臂交叉在自己那丰满的胸前——如果这意味着她的后代会变得瘦弱不堪，那么她的血统显然并没有退化。“所以你父亲找到了治愈方法？我们相信，外来的血液能够为这座城市注入新的活力。正因为如此，父亲才会选择一位贾西兰人作为自己的伴侣，也正因为如此，我们才会联系费卢尔泽家族，让凯西与他们的女儿结婚。在凯西公开宣布订婚之后，其他贵族家族也开始纷纷效仿这一做法。能够以自己微小的力量参与到这件事中来，我感到非常荣幸。或许，这种自豪感甚至超过了作为一名军人所感受到的自豪。 你是追随你父亲的脚步，成为这个王国的守护者吗？” 听到这个问题，她自豪地挺起了胸膛：“是的！我是我丈夫的军师，是他军队的统帅。从小我就为这个职位而努力训练，在嫁给埃万德之前，我已经与许多敌人交过战。而在后来的‘狮女巫之战’中，能够保护提克里斯，对我来说是一种荣誉。 跟我说说这件事吧？” “啊，战争在我们国境之外并不出名，这也难怪，”泰西斯说道，试图掩饰自己内心的些许失望，“大约十八年前，一群来自北方苔原的莱奥斯兰野蛮人开始袭击边境的村庄。他们奴役了我们的公民，烧毁了农田，毁坏了连接我们与同胞们的桥梁。有一位女萨满率领着这些侵略者，她的力量远超那些几代以来一直威胁这座城市的敌人——她强大到足以独自消灭所有村庄的民兵组织。阿斯特里达教团召回了它的骑士们去追捕她，但在他们出发之前，有位部落成员投奔了我们，他向我们透露了他族人的动向——他们打算在我家族领地附近的某个偏远山谷里庆祝至日节。因此，我有机会先发制人，在夜幕的掩护下率领王室卫队向北方进发，而那时阿斯特里达的骑士们还正在返回他们的营地呢。" 泰西斯的语气中现在带着一丝兴奋。“虽然路程艰辛，但我对这片土地非常熟悉。我们迅速行进，在女巫和她的盟友们还沉浸在欢乐之中、几乎还没准备好战斗的时候就抓住了他们——他们当初就是以这样的状态袭击了我们的人。即便如此，那女巫依然实力强大！她用雷电摧毁了我们周围的森林，用闪电击碎了我们的盾牌。但尽管如此，我们还是像战鹰一样扑向了她！ 蝾螈将双拳紧握在身前，它的尾巴也亮起了炽烈的光芒。“我的部下们以无与伦比的勇气作战，迫使敌方的战士们纷纷退避，直到我最终与那位狮女巫展开了决斗。那场战斗，成为了我一生中最难忘的经历！她的法杖与我的长矛相撞，她的法术将我的盾牌烧得通黑，直至化为灰烬。我原以为自己终于遇到了对手，然而就在她傲慢自大的那一刻，她露出了释放法术的手掌，正好让我使出致命的诡计——我用战刀刺中了她的手！泰西斯暗自露出了一丝幸灾乐祸的笑容。‘她当时叫得多惨啊！仅仅是一点痛苦，就让那样强大的法师陷入了困境，迫使她不得不逃跑。 是你杀了她吗？” “不，”泰西斯叹息道，“她并不是死在我的手里。她的族人溃败了，他们把受伤的萨满带回了苔原……而她的丈夫在试图将我们分开时，给了我一个致命的伤。不过，我的卫兵已经把那些莱奥斯人驱散了，而当那支战帮被击溃后，那个女巫也就成了阿斯特里达轻易捕捉到的猎物。 [pc.bg soldier hunter barbarian |一个不错的故事……不过你知道，这样的部落文化往往会让怨恨延续数代人。一次耻辱性的失败可能会让他们至今仍心怀怨恨。 |嗯，将整个野蛮人部落都纳入自己的统治范围，这确实是一项了不起的成就。 ] 那些莱奥特兰人后来还给你惹过麻烦吗？” “没有，多亏了女神。我们给了他们一个惨痛的教训，因此我们北边的邻居们在这一代人里都没有再给我们带来麻烦。而这一点，可以说是我第二大的成就。” “那第一大的成就是什么呢？” 泰西斯望了望门口，笑了笑：“你应该能猜到的，我相信。
rows.raw: ' "About me? Surely I am not a suspect!" You shake your head. "I'm just looking for [pc.isCunning |context |a clearer picture ] here." A momentary bristle passes from the Lady Consort's features, and her shoulders relax backwards. "Very well. Of course. I will spare you the obvious pageantry, then." She takes a breath, shaking off the severity of her normal courtly demeanor. "My family are landholders north of the city, on the frontier of Tychris's domain. We are its shield against the barbarians of the tundra. But we were not immune to the decline that has affected so many bloodlines in the principality; Kythie is the last of my line, and I doubt very much that I would be alive if it were not for my father's love for a foreign priestess." "The decline?" Tethys sighs. "An affliction has long gripped Tychris. One of the malingering repercussions of the Godswar, still blighting us centuries after. The bloodlines of our nobility run thinner each year, producing weaker offspring, and fewer of them. I love my husband very much, [pc.name], but go outside and look upon the statue of his ancestor-king who won the holy war alongside Nareva herself; then compare him to Evander. Prince Philandros would have thought Evander to be his smallest daughter at a glance." [pc.bg scholar |You've heard of such things happening in other isolated reaches of the old Empire. Some consider it to be a punishment from the gods for inbreeding. ] She laughs, but there's a fond smile on her face. Tethys crosses her arms beneath her prodigious bosom — there's certainly no thinning of her bloodline to worry about, if that manifests as skinny and frail heirs. "So your father found the cure?" "We believe that foreign blood will reinvigorate the city. That is why Father took a Jassiran to be his partner, and why we have reached out to Felurze to wed Kythie. Other noble families are beginning to follow suit, in the wake of Kythie's public engagement. I am glad to have been a part of this, in my small part. Perhaps even moreso than my pride as a soldier. " "Did you follow your father's footsteps, as a shield of the realm?" That gives a proud chest-puff out of the 'mander. "I did! I am Strategos for my husband, master of his soldiers. I trained for the position since I was a child, I fought against many foes before I married Evander, and it is my honor to have protected Tychris during the Lion Witch's War afterwards." "Tell me about that?" "Ah, I should not be surprised the war's not so famous beyond our borders," Tethys says, trying to mask some amount of disappointment. "About eighteen years ago, a group of leothran barbarians descended from the northern tundra and began raiding the frontier villages. They enslaved our citizens, burned farms, destroyed bridges that connect us to our people. A shamaness lead the pack, much more powerful than any that had threatened the city for generations — strong enough to lay waste to village militias all by herself. The Order Astrida recalled its paladins to hunt her, but before they could march, a tribesman defected to us and told us of his kins' movements, of their plans to celebrate the solstice in an isolated valley near my family's holdings; I was in a position to seize the initiative and thrust north with the princely guard under cover of night while the Astrida were still coming to their camps." There's a certain relish in Tethys's voice now. "A hard march, but I know the land well. We moved with speed, and caught the witch and her allies while they were still hung over from their merry-making, barely ready for battle — the state in which they had once found our people. Even still, the witch was powerful! She shattered the forest around us with thunder and scoured our shields with lightning. Still and all, we fell on her like warhawks!" The salamander's fists clench before her, and her tail blazes bright. "My men fought with unequalled valor, driving the tribe's warriors to route, until I found myself locking blades with the Lion Witch herself. She gave me the greatest battle of my life! Staff and spear clashed, and her spells burnt my shield black, burned it to cinders. I thought I had finally met my match, until in her hubris she left her spellcasting hand exposed, ready for a killing cantrip; I skewered it with my war knife!" Tethys allows herself a momentary, sadistic smirk. "How she howled! A little pain crippled a mage that powerful, forced her to flee." "Did you kill her?" "No," Tethys sighs. "She did not die by my hand. Her kinsmen broke, bearing their wounded shaman back to the tundra... and her thane-husband left me a terrible wound in trying to separate us. Still, the leothrans were scattered by my guard, and the witch proved easy prey for the Astrida to hunt, once the warband was routed." [pc.bg soldier hunter barbarian |A fine story... though you know tribal cultures like that tend to hold grudges for generations. A humiliating defeat might leave them bitter even today. |Well, routing a whole barbarian tribe is certainly an accomplishment. ] "Did those leothrans ever give you trouble again?" "No, thank the goddess. We taught them a painful lesson, and it's bought us a generation of peace from our neighbors in the north. And that remains my second greatest accomplishment." "And what's the first?" Tethys looks at the door and smiles. "You can guess, I'm sure." '

rows.original: "Hm, I am not inclined to gossip about my family, Champion," Tethys says. "But Evander's ancestors have ruled this city for four hundred years, since its initial founding. From Belharan suzerainty, through the Godswar, and now more than two centuries of independence. I should say that have done well by this city, and they are well loved by the people within it." "Tactful as ever," you say, "but I was hoping for something more personal. Tell me about your husband, at least?" You can see a moment of hesitation cross Tethys's face, before her features finally soften. "My dear flame. We have been companions since childhood, him and I. Our fathers were close as brothers, and though I was a woman grown before they finally decided we should be wed, I knew all my life I was to be his shield. His Strategos." The statement makes Tethys swell with pride, all the way to her tail-flame. "Were you in love?" Tethys's smile only deepens. "I couldn't tell you when it began, but yes, I think so. For a long time. There is a deep comfort in being with someone for so long, knowing someone so well. Truly sharing your life with them." Tethys pauses, resting a hand over her heart. "We were both delighted when our parents made the decision." "Were there any other contenders for Evander's hand? Or yours?" "A few," Tethys says. "For Evander's, anyway. I had no serious suitors of my own. But my husband is still a prince, and every prince will have those who wish to bind themselves to his power. Only one was seriously considered from here in Tychris, if your reasoning is what I suspect: Lady Zainem, a sorceress of the court, from a long lineage of magical excellence. She is a good friend to our family, though also one of our harshest critics, whenever our edicts and her philosophy clash. I would hardly suspect her of treachery!" [pc.bg scholar |Lady Zainem... you vaguely recognize the name from your readings back home. She's written a few treatise on the relationship between the health of the body and the mind; that one cannot be a powerful sorcerer while possessing a frail physical form. Very focused on exercise and meditation. ] "So every other suitor was from other cities?" Tethys nods. "Yes, and most have their own husbands now. It's been two decades, [pc.name]. I doubt any of them would feel slighted over a man they hardly knew that long." Fair enough. "Alright. Aside from the three of you, is there anyone else in the royal family?" "We are... a small family, [pc.name]. My injuries from the Lion Witch's War precluded me from having more children than Kythie, and Evander had only one sibling of his own, now passed from illness. We have two nieces, twins, just a year older than Kythie. Marianthe and Nephele. They and their mother chiefly reside in an estate outside the city that the family owns." "Do they get along well with Kythie?" Tethys smiles. "Oh, yes. They all love each other dearly." [pc.bg noblescion minstrel |Be that as it may, those girls would be the heirs to the city if something happened to Kythie. They certainly have something to gain from her insanity... |Then you suppose they're not the most likely suspects. ]
rows.translation: “嗯，我不太喜欢谈论自己的家族，冠军，”泰西斯说道，“但埃万德的祖先从这座城市最初建立时起就统治着它，至今已有四百年。从贝尔哈兰的宗主统治，历经神战，到如今独立已超过两个世纪。我不得不说，他们对这座城市治理有方，也深受城中百姓的爱戴。” “你还是一如既往地圆滑，”你说，“但我本来想听些更私人的内容。至少跟我说说你的丈夫吧？” 你能看到泰西斯脸上闪过一丝犹豫，随后她的神情终于柔和下来。“我亲爱的火焰。我和他从小就是伙伴。我们的父亲亲如兄弟，虽然直到我长大成人，他们才最终决定让我们成婚，但我这一生都知道自己注定要成为他的盾牌。他的统帅。”这句话让泰西斯自豪得连尾焰都昂扬起来。 “你们相爱过吗？” 泰西斯笑得更深了。“我说不上这份感情是何时开始的，但没错，我想是有的。而且已经很久了。与一个人相伴如此之久、如此了解对方，真正与他分享自己的人生，其中有一种深沉的安宁。”泰西斯顿了顿，把一只手按在心口。“父母做出这个决定时，我们两个都很高兴。” “还有别人争取过埃万德的手吗？或者你的？” “有几个，”泰西斯说，“至少埃万德这边有。我自己没有认真的追求者。但我的丈夫毕竟还是位王子，而每个王子身边都会有人想把自己绑上他的权势。如果你怀疑的方向和我猜的一样，那么在提克里斯本地，真正被认真考虑过的只有一个：宫廷女术士扎伊奈姆女士，出身于一个世代擅魔法的家族。她是我们家的好友，不过每当我们的法令与她的理念冲突时，她也是我们最严厉的批评者之一。我绝不会怀疑她背叛！” [pc.bg scholar |扎伊奈姆女士……你在家乡读过的书里隐约见过这个名字。她写过几篇关于身体与心智健康之间关系的论文，认为体魄孱弱之人无法成为强大的术士。她非常注重锻炼与冥想。 ] “那么其他所有追求者都来自别的城市？” 泰西斯点了点头。“是的，而且他们大多现在都有了自己的丈夫。已经过去二十年了，[pc.name]。我不认为他们会因为一个自己几乎没认识多久的男人而感到被冒犯。” 有道理。“好吧。除了你们三个之外，王室还有别的成员吗？” “我们……是个很小的家族，[pc.name]。我在雄狮女巫战争中受的伤，让我除凯西之外无法再生育，而埃万德也只有一个兄弟姐妹，如今已因病去世。我们有两个侄女，是一对双胞胎，只比凯西大一岁，名叫玛丽安特和内菲尔。她们和她们的母亲主要住在家族在城外拥有的一处庄园里。” “她们和凯西相处得好吗？” 泰西斯笑了。“哦，是的。她们彼此都深爱着对方。” [pc.bg noblescion minstrel |即便如此，如果凯西出了什么事，那些女孩就会成为这座城市的继承人。她们肯定能从她的疯狂中得到些好处…… |那么你认为她们不是最有可能的嫌疑人。 ]

rows.original: The question makes Tethys visibly uncomfortable. Her tail dims, and she looks to the floor. "I should have noticed it sooner, [pc.name]. But Kythie's at that age where, well, the heart begins to yearn in ways it hadn't before..." Tethys sighs heavily, voice dropping quiet. "We just thought she was learning things about herself, you must understand. We were upset, but-" "Slow down, slow down. What happened?" Tethys scratches at her arm scales. "I planted the aurum wreathe on my daughter's head at the Tycathalon this year, [pc.name], won through her hard work, not her bloodline. A high honor for us both. Something she could boast about the rest of her life. What she should not have done is grab hold of the runner-up and kiss on her on the stage in front of the entire city." That could certainly cause a kerfuffle, yes. "The worst part is, the city cheered for it! They loved seeing their future ruler letting loose. If only they knew!" Tethys groans, rubbing her temples. "The woman in question gave Kythie a piece of her mind, as did her parents, behind the scenes. That seemed to be that. A few days later, a blizzard rolled through and trapped us all indoors... and then we had one of our most trusted maidservants begging a private audience to report Kythie attempting to seduce her." "Twice so quickly... did you think something was amiss?" "Not amiss, per se," Tethys says awkwardly. "We punished her for her behavior, of course. Unwanted advances are beneath a princess of the realm. But in truth, Evander and I were preparing for a more serious talk about her future. We didn't attribute her behavior to external factors yet." You quirk a brow. "Talk about what?" Tethys shifts her weight and glances at the door. "That perhaps she would struggle in her marriage commitments to the prince of Felurze, if it was two women she was pressing herself upon in these moments of vulnerability." "Ah." "But, of course, our fears were misplaced. We restricted Kythie to her chambers, only for her to fall upon one of the guards soon after. She's strong, [pc.name]. Strong enough to hurt a grown man trained for combat. But she is also a gentle soul. That is when we knew something was truly amiss." No kidding. "And she's been in this tower ever since, huh?" "With one reprieve. When the Order Astrida first unbound the curse..."
rows.translation: 这个问题让泰西斯明显很不自在。她的尾巴暗了下去，目光落在地上。“我本该早点注意到的，[pc.name]。但凯西正处在那个年纪，嗯，心开始以从前不曾有过的方式渴望起来……”泰西斯重重叹了口气，声音低了下去。“我们只以为她是在了解自己，你得理解。我们当时很不高兴，但是——” “慢点，慢点。发生什么了？” 泰西斯挠了挠手臂上的鳞片。“今年泰卡塔隆大赛上，我亲手把那顶金花环戴在女儿头上，[pc.name]，那是她靠自己的努力赢来的，不是靠血统。这对我们两人都是极高的荣誉。是她余生都可以炫耀的事。而她不该做的，是在全城人面前抓住亚军，在台上亲了她。” 那确实会引起一阵骚动，没错。 “最糟的是，全城还为这事欢呼！他们就爱看自己未来的统治者放纵一回。要是他们知道真相就好了！”泰西斯揉着太阳穴呻吟道。“那个女人私下把凯西狠狠训了一顿，她的父母也是。事情似乎就这么过去了。几天后，一场暴风雪袭来，把我们都困在屋里……然后我们最信任的一名女仆请求私下觐见，报告说凯西试图勾引她。” “这么快就两次……你们没觉得不对劲吗？” “严格来说，不算不对劲，”泰西斯尴尬地说。“我们当然为她的行为惩罚了她。不受欢迎的示好不是一国王女该做的事。但说实话，埃万德和我当时正准备就她的未来进行一次更严肃的谈话。我们那时还没有把她的行为归因于外部因素。” 你挑了挑眉。“谈什么？” 泰西斯挪了挪身子，瞥了一眼门口。“谈她或许难以履行对费卢尔泽王子的婚姻义务——如果她在那些脆弱的时刻，扑上去的是两个女人。” “啊。” “不过，当然，我们的担心是多余的。我们把凯西关在她的房间里，结果她不久就扑倒了一名卫兵。她很强壮，[pc.name]。强壮到足以伤到一个受过战斗训练的成年男人。但她也是个温柔的灵魂。那时我们才知道，真的出了什么问题。” 可不是嘛。“那之后她就一直待在这座塔里，是吧？” “只有一次例外。当阿斯特里达教团第一次解开那道诅咒时……”
rows.raw: ' The question makes Tethys visibly uncomfortable. Her tail dims, and she looks to the floor. "I should have noticed it sooner, [pc.name]. But Kythie's at that age where, well, the heart begins to yearn in ways it hadn't before..." Tethys sighs heavily, voice dropping quiet. "We just thought she was learning things about herself, you must understand. We were upset, but-" "Slow down, slow down. What happened?" Tethys scratches at her arm scales. "I planted the aurum wreathe on my daughter's head at the Tycathalon this year, [pc.name], won through her hard work, not her bloodline. A high honor for us both. Something she could boast about the rest of her life. What she should not have done is grab hold of the runner-up and kiss on her on the stage in front of the entire city." That could certainly cause a kerfuffle, yes. "The worst part is, the city cheered for it! They loved seeing their future ruler letting loose. If only they knew!" Tethys groans, rubbing her temples. "The woman in question gave Kythie a piece of her mind, as did her parents, behind the scenes. That seemed to be that. A few days later, a blizzard rolled through and trapped us all indoors... and then we had one of our most trusted maidservants begging a private audience to report Kythie attempting to seduce her." "Twice so quickly... did you think something was amiss?" "Not amiss, per se," Tethys says awkwardly. "We punished her for her behavior, of course. Unwanted advances are beneath a princess of the realm. But in truth, Evander and I were preparing for a more serious talk about her future. We didn't attribute her behavior to external factors yet." You quirk a brow. "Talk about what?" Tethys shifts her weight and glances at the door. "That perhaps she would struggle in her marriage commitments to the prince of Felurze, if it was two women she was pressing herself upon in these moments of vulnerability." "Ah." "But, of course, our fears were misplaced. We restricted Kythie to her chambers, only for her to fall upon one of the guards soon after. She's strong, [pc.name]. Strong enough to hurt a grown man trained for combat. But she is also a gentle soul. That is when we knew something was truly amiss." No kidding. "And she's been in this tower ever since, huh?" "With one reprieve. When the Order Astrida first unbound the curse..." '

rows.original: "Tychris bears the honor of hosting Nareva's grandest temple north of the Holy City itself," Tethys says bitterly, "but they have only offered false hope, when they offered any at all! I-" Tethys cuts herself short, balling her fists. For a moment you worry that she'll be the one striking the door, but a heartbeat passes, and she merely rests her palm against the wood. "I apologize," Tethys finally says. "But I have grown more than frustrated with our divine patrons. Each and every day since the curse began, we have prayed to the goddess for relief, and we petition her servants just as frequently. This is the center of Nareva's worship in the North, the heart and soul of the goddess of magic's dominion over our people, and yet..." "Has Tychris always been the center of her worship here?" you ask, trying to steer the conversation away before Tethys loses her grip entirely. [pc.bg acolyte |And before Tethys commits a little too much heresy for her guards to ignore. ] Indeed, she takes another deep, centering breath, and nods. "Since the Godswar. Once, it is said, she kept her home in the Sailgraves — Estelore, perhaps; that old Belharan coven of madmen sprung up around her. But when the world was on the brink of ending, the goddess chosen our city to make her stand at. We were her last bastion in this part of the world, and her compact with us was for her protection everlasting." "But her priests haven't been able to help..." Tethys sighs deeply. "They have tried, goddess bless them. Two of the Order Astrida, including the Order's leader herself, came to our aid... but they failed. Each time, Kythie's curse has returned in mere days. Now they refuse to meet me at all! Every message is returned with platitudes that they are investigating, telling me that in time they will succeed." She clenches her fists. "These childless monks will never understand how I cannot." It might be worth investigating the temple to see why they've been so unhelpful.
rows.translation: 提克里斯有幸成为娜瑞瓦在圣城以北地区最宏伟的神庙的守护者，”泰西斯苦涩地说道，“但他们所提供的，只不过是虚假的希望罢了——如果他们真有什么诚意的话！我……”泰西斯突然停住了话，双手紧握成拳。有那么一瞬间，你甚至担心她会失控她我会去敲门，”她说道，但片刻之后，她只是将手掌轻轻放在门上。 “我很抱歉，”泰西斯终于开口说道，“但我对我们那些神圣的庇护者感到无比失望。自从诅咒开始以来，每一天我们都在向女神祈祷，请求她解除这个诅咒，同时也经常向她的仆从们求助。这里是北方地区人们崇拜娜瑞瓦的中心，也是这位魔法女神统治我们人民的象征与灵魂所在……然而…… “那么，提克里斯一直以来都是这里人们崇拜的对象吗？”你问道，试图在泰西斯彻底失去控制之前转移话题。 [pc.bg acolyte |而在泰西斯犯下那些连她的守卫们都无法忽视的“异端行为”之前…… ] 的确，她又深吸一口气，让自己平静下来，然后点了点头。“从神战开始之后。据说，有一段时间她住在赛尔格雷夫斯地区——也许是埃斯托洛尔吧；那时，那些由疯子们组成的贝尔哈兰教团开始围绕在她身边。但是当世界即将走向毁灭的时候，那位被选中的女神我们的这座城市是她最后的依靠。在我们这个地区，我们是她最后的屏障，而她与我们签订的契约，正是为了获得永恒的保护。” “但是她的祭司们却无能为力……” 泰西斯深深地叹了口气。他们已经尽力了，愿女神保佑他们。包括组织领袖在内的两名‘阿斯特拉达组织’成员前来帮助我们……但他们失败了。每次，凯西的诅咒都在短短几天内再次降临。现在，他们根本拒绝见我！每条回复都只是些敷衍之词，说他们正在调查中，还告诉我只要再等等，他们就会成功。“她紧握着双拳，继续说道：‘这些没有孩子的僧侣永远也不会理解，为什么我无法做到。 或许值得去调查一下那座寺庙，弄清楚为什么它们一直如此毫无帮助。

rows.original: "Our palace isn't a fortress, but it is well guarded," Tethys says firmly. "I have trained our armsmen myself, and they are supplied by the best smiths in the North, supported by the most well-educated magicians a city could ever supply, here in the shadow of Nareva's own temple." [pc.bgMulti soldier slumrat |You've heard plenty of nobles say something similar, and get robbed blind all the same. |A fine boast, but well-armed soldiers aren't a deterrent to those skilled enough to slip their notice in the first place. |Fine, fine. ] "So there's no chance anyone had access to Kythie without you knowing?" "Of course not. Our daughter is our pride and joy, and the hope of a nation. No one in Tychris is better protected than Kythie." "And the palace itself? Who controls who comes and goes?" Tethys begins to bristle under the questioning now. "Captain Tyna, of course. She manages the day to day of guarding our persons, the treasury, and the grounds." "From the entire complex?" you ask. "Even the temple? You share your outer walls with it." "... A number of people are permitted in the walls each day, yes, but each is accounted for by night's end. In all my years we have never found temple supplicants meandering the grounds past nightfall. Come now." She's never found any. [pc.cl thief |Despite her insistences, it seems to you like Tychris Palace would be pretty easy to sneak around in. The grounds are open, the palace itself is sprawling and blessed with so, so many windows... it would be child's play to break into if you could sneak past the guards. Or if you had a proper disguise... ]
rows.translation: 我们的宫殿虽然不是堡垒，但防守措施十分严密，”泰西斯坚定地说道，“这些卫兵都是我亲自训练的，他们配备了北方最优秀的铁匠制造的武器，同时还得到了这座城市里最有学识的魔法师们的支持——这一切，都发生在娜瑞瓦神庙的庇护之下。 [pc.bgMulti soldier slumrat |你肯定听过很多贵族说类似的话，但最终还是被抢得一干二净。 |说得挺响亮的，不过装备精良的士兵对于那些手段高明、能够悄无声息地完成行动的人来说，根本构不成任何阻碍。. |好吧，好吧。 ] 所以，绝对不可能有人在你不知情的情况下接触到凯西吧？” “当然不可能。我们的女儿是我们引以为傲的人，也是整个国家的希望。在提克里斯，没有谁比凯西受到更严密的保护。” “那么宫殿本身呢？谁来决定谁可以进出这里？” 听到这个问题，泰西斯开始感到不悦了。“当然是泰娜船长了。她负责管理我们的人身安全、财宝以及整个基地的日常事务。” “整个基地的事务都由她来负责吗？你问得倒好……就连那座寺庙也不例外？它的外墙其实与我们共享的。” “……每天确实有很多人被允许进入那片区域，但到了晚上，所有人都必须被清点确认。这些年来，我们从未发现有任何寺庙的信徒在日落后还在这片地方游荡。快来吧。” 她从来都没有创建任何。 [pc.cl thief |尽管她一再坚持，但在你看来在提克里斯宫殿里，偷偷行动其实相当容易。场地已经开放，宫殿本身规模庞大，而且拥有无数窗户……如果你能悄悄绕过守卫，或者有合适的伪装，那么闯入宫殿简直易如反掌。 ]

rows.original: "Few with power," Tethys says. "We have battled barbarians on and off for generations since the Godswar. Monsters of all kinds, too. But since the Lion Witch's War, we have enjoyed a generation of peace." She pauses, considering. "Although, we must admit, we are not well loved by all out neighbors." Now you're getting somewhere. "Khor'minos, Felurze, Rosetree, even little Hawkethorne... we have good relations with them all. But the new Count of Maidenbridge has been a difficult pill to swallow, and his early reign was tense. If the River Maiden hadn't been flooded at the time, we might have marched to war against him." Oh, this is good. "Why? What did he do?" "Killed the previous count," she says glumly. "Thore was a bandit king, a self-made warlord commanding a band of mercenaries, outlaws, and exiles from across the northern Heartlands. They acted as sellswords to the count, and then turned on him. Burned half the city and killed its rulers without mercy. By the time we'd heard what had happened, that warlord had proclaimed himself the new count! We were allies with Maidenbridge, and overnight they were taken from us!" "But you never did go to war?" Tethys shakes her head. "Evander forbade it, against my counsel. The damage was done, he reasoned, and the best thing we could do for the people of Maidenbridge was to keep the peace, give them the opportunity to rebuild. Still, I marched our soldiers to the border to make sure that his rebellion did not spread. There were skirmishes. Several of the brigands were put to the sword before the we came to terms. But, against all odds, peace did reign. Count Thore proved to be a-" Tethys pauses, frowning, "a capable ruler, not disposed to cruelty towards his subjects. Still, our relationship has remained rocky, and Thore has not shied from showing his frustration in our communiques. More than once I have thought ill tidings that befall the city might have his duplicitous hand behind them, but this would be a new low." Barbarians and a neighboring warlord, all of whom might hold some kind of a grudge...
rows.translation: 掌握权力的人并不多，”泰西斯说道，“自神战以来，我们已经与野蛮人进行了数代人的斗争，也遭遇过各种各样的怪物。但自从狮女巫之战之后，我们终于享受了一代人的和平。” 她停顿了一下，似乎在思考着什么。“不过，我们必须承认，我们并没有受到太多人的喜爱所有我们的邻国们……” 现在你终于说到点子上了。 “科尔米诺斯、费卢尔泽、罗塞特里，甚至小小的鹰棘镇……我们与他们所有人都有着良好的关系。但是，新的梅登布里奇伯爵实在让人难以接受，他在位初期带来的紧张局势令人担忧。如果当时梅登河没有发生洪水，我们或许早就对他发动战争了。 哦，这可真糟糕。‘为什么？他做了什么？’” “他杀了之前的伯爵，”她沮丧地说道，“托雷原本是个土匪头目，一个白手起家的军阀，他率领着一群雇佣兵、逃犯以及来自北方腹地的流亡者。他们原本为那位伯爵效力，后来却背叛了他——他们烧毁了半个城市，残忍地杀死了当地的统治者。等我们得知这些事情时，那个军阀已经宣布自己成为了新的伯爵！我们原本与梅登布里奇是盟友，然而一夜之间，他们就被夺走了！ 但是你从来没有真正参加过战争，对吧？” 泰西斯摇了摇头。“埃文德禁止我这么做，尽管我并不认同他的看法。他认为，伤害已经造成了，对我们梅登布里奇的人们来说，最好的做法就是保持和平，给他们重新建设的机会。尽管如此，我还是率领我们的军队前往边境，以确保他的叛乱不会蔓延。期间发生了一些小规模冲突，有几名叛乱者在我们达成协议之前就被处决了。然而，尽管困难重重，最终还是恢复了和平。索尔伯爵被证明是一位……泰西斯皱着眉头停顿了一下，“一位有能力的统治者，他并不倾向于对自己的子民施以残酷对待。然而，我们的关系一直很紧张，索尔也在我们的通信中毫不掩饰自己的不满。我不止一次怀疑，这座城市所遭遇的那些不幸事件，或许都与他的阴险狡诈有关，但这次的行为实在已经达到了新的低点。 那些野蛮人以及邻近的军阀们，他们或许都怀有某种怨恨……

rows.original: "You may not see it here, today, Champion, but Tychris is prospering. We are known throughout the world for our glassworks and the skill of our mages, and both bring us wealth and prestige. Our farmlands have had good years, enough to stock the granaries, and trade has continued apace from our neighbors. I struggle to imagine anyone in the city feels betrayed by our rule; certainly not enough to target their future princeps." [pc.bg slumrat courtesan minstrel |An easy analysis from the ivory tower, but you wonder if that's actually true. |Fair enough. ] "So you've had no troubles recently?" "Every city has its troubles!" Tethys says. "We've had some disagreements with the millers' association of late — it's becoming more expensive to import good wood from Hawkethorne, and the millers wish to pass the costs on to our people. The tavernkeepers and farmers alike have turned the court into a gallery for their brawl with the millers." She sighs with frustration. "We've had a series of small bandit raids from beastkin in the mountains, but nothing that our soldiers have not been equal to. The late summer brought flooding into the farmlands, and we are still dealing with the aftermath of that, both the beastkin raids and upset landholders. Which has lead to millers needing more wood to repair the mills after the floods, and... you get the point, I hope. Our squabbles are those of any city." "So aside from the royal family, who're the movers and shakers here?" "The temple, of course, exerts great influence over Tychris. We are Nareva's stronghold, and her worship is paramount among our people. Past that, a number of rural barons control the surrounding countryside — my own father was among them. Today Ruarc en Rhydan is the loudest voice among the county barons, and now the wealthiest. He himself won the argent wreathe in weight lifting, which has furthered his fame quite a bit. Beneath them are the farmers that support the city. The rural commons have flexed greater power these last years, with their growing prosperity; good rain has brought good harvests for a decade, and for the first time in our history we've begun exporting food. Coin flows in from city-states to our south while gems and furs come the northern tundra." So the church and the farmer-barons are both exercising influence outside the court... and the latter are making Tychris even richer by the year. "And what about the Tycathalon?" you ask. "How did that affect things here?" "Our biggest expense every four years," Tethys says, with a hint of pride. "But it is worth it. Athletes from around the region, even across the world, come to earn glory beneath the Temple of Nareva. And it brings travelers from all over to watch, too: merchants, craftsmen, nobles, sorcerers... and all their wealth. For two weeks the city is flooded with double its regular population, there's a celebration that never ends from dusk until dawn — and grand exhibitions of magical prowess in the temple. Even the magicians feel the need to flex their muscles during the Tycathalon." A great big gathering of wealthy and powerful people, right before Kythie caught her curse. The timing can't be a coincidence. "Was there anyone particularly noteworthy in attendance?" "Lady Anthiese of Altenspire, a famous sorceress of Altenspire, and her daughter Therese. Certainly the most notable to us, considering Therese won the argent wreathe after Kythie, and then suffered the first outburst of the curse in front of the whole city. Even if she had not, Therese is one of the rare salamanders born with horns — an eye-turning young lady if ever there was one. She made quite the splash. Even with Kythie, it seems..." Tethys clears her throat. "We also had the honor to host Baron Asher of Felurze, uncle to Kythie's betrothed; Aric Ignafaerus of Khor'minos, the famous javelin thrower who was too drunk to hit his targets this year; Halua of Khor'hofra, high priestess of Lumia; Ser Tristan and Dame Faunra, crusaders all the way from the Dukedom of Claremont who took the aurum wreathe in charioteering; Tajana the Lynx, an archmage illusionist from Callathia; Robert Kalter, an alchemist from Barania who won argent in wrestling... ah, and of course, Countess Arielle of Taelia, one of the many prospective heirs to the Alliance. Though rather than leading in the competition, she was leading most of the drunken revelry throughout the city..." You get it, you get it. "Anybody who'd have reason to want to upset the balance here in Tychris?" "If I could think of any, [pc.name], they'd have been in chains before you arrived." Tethys rests her hands on her hips. "My list of suspects is perilously thin. No one has reason to hurt Kythie of all people! There's a list a league long of worthies who should be courting her favor, but cursing her? I cannot think of why! We have maintained peace and stability for a generation in our domain. To strike at the crown would be to upset all that we have accomplished, and for what? Chaos?" You can certainly think of at least one group back east that would love to spread chaos out here...
rows.translation: 冠军，今天你可能在这里看不到，但提克里斯正在蓬勃发展。我们的玻璃制造业和法师们的精湛技艺让我们闻名于世，这两者都为我们带来了财富与声望。我们的农田也取得了良好的收成，储备了充足的粮食，而与邻国的贸易也持续保持着稳定的发展势头。我实在无法想象这座城市里会有人对我们的统治感到不满；更不可能有人会因此而企图推翻未来的王子。 [pc.bg slumrat courtesan minstrel |从象牙塔里出发，这种分析固然简单易懂，但人们不禁会怀疑：这究竟是不是事实呢？ |有道理。 ] 所以你最近没有遇到什么麻烦吧？” “每个城市都会遇到一些麻烦！”泰西斯说道，“最近我们和磨坊主协会发生了一些争执——从鹰棘镇进口优质木材的成本越来越高，而那些磨坊主们想把这些成本转嫁给我们的人们。酒馆老板和农民们把这片空地当成了他们与磨坊主们斗殴的场所。“她沮丧地叹了口气，“最近山上的一些兽人小股匪徒不断来袭击我们，但我们的士兵完全有能力应对他们。夏末时节，洪水侵袭了农田，我们至今仍在应对这场灾害带来的后果——既有兽人的袭击，也有土地所有者因此而产生的不满。这些情况导致磨坊主们需要更多的木材来修复被洪水破坏的磨坊。我希望你明白我的意思。我们的争吵其实和其他城市里的争吵没什么两样。” “那么，除了王室之外，这里还有哪些真正有影响力的人物或组织呢？” “当然是寺庙了。它在提克里斯拥有巨大的影响力。我们是娜瑞瓦的据点，而人们对她的崇拜在我们这里也是极其重要的。除此之外，还有许多乡绅控制着周边的乡村地区——我的父亲就是其中之一。如今鲁阿尔克·恩·瑞丹是这些郡级男爵中声音最响亮的一个。而他如今已成为最富有的人。他自己还在举重比赛中赢得了银质奖章，这一成就使他的名声更加显赫。在他们之下，是那些支撑着这座城市的农民。近年来，随着农民们日益富裕，他们的力量也变得更强大了；十年来，良好的降雨带来了丰富的收成，我们历史上第一次开始出口食品。南方的城邦向我们输送货币，而北方的苔原地区则送来了宝石和毛皮。 所以教会和那些拥有大量土地的贵族们都在宫廷之外发挥着影响力……而后者更是让提克里斯的财富逐年增加。“那么泰卡塔隆事件又是怎么回事呢？”你可能会问，“它对这里的情况产生了什么影响？这是我们每四年要承担的最大一笔开支，”泰西斯略带自豪地说，“但这一切都是值得的。来自整个地区，甚至来自世界各地的运动员都会来到娜瑞瓦神庙下争夺荣耀。同时，也有许多来自各地的游客会前来观看这场盛会：商人们、工匠们、贵族们、法师们……以及他们所有的财富。整整两周的时间里，这座城市里的人口数量会增加到平时的两倍，庆祝活动会从黄昏持续到黎明，从未间断——同时，寺庙里还会举办各种展示魔法技艺的盛大表演。就连那些魔法师们，在这个泰卡塔隆节期间也觉得有必要展示一下自己的本领。" 就在凯西遭到诅咒之前，正好举行了一场聚集了许多富人和权贵们的盛大聚会。这样的时间安排绝非巧合。“在出席的人当中，有没有特别值得注意的人物呢？” “有，那就是阿尔滕斯派的安西丝女士——阿尔滕斯派著名的女巫，以及她的女儿特蕾莎。她们无疑是这场聚会中最引人注目的人物。我们考虑到特蕾莎在凯西之后获得了银色花环，而且还在全城人的注视下首次遭遇了诅咒的发作……即便没有这些经历，特蕾莎也算是那些天生就长着角的稀有蝾螈之一了——她确实是一位令人瞩目的年轻女士。她引起了不小的轰动。就连和凯西在一起的时候，似乎也是如此……” 泰西斯清了清嗓子，继续说道：“我们还有幸邀请到了费卢尔泽的Asher男爵，他是凯西未婚夫的叔叔；还有Khor’minos的Aric 伊格纳法鲁斯，那位著名的标枪投掷手部，不过今年他喝得酩酊大醉，连目标都投不中；还有Khor’hofra的Halua，她是卢米娅的大祭司；还有来自Claremont公国的Ser Tristan和Dame Faunra，他们是通过马车比赛赢得银质奖牌的十字军战士；还有来自Callathia的Tajana the Lynx，她是一位擅长幻术的大法师；还有来自巴拉尼亚的长袍rt Kalter，他通过摔跤比赛赢得了银质奖牌。啊，当然还有泰莉亚的艾莉尔伯爵夫人，她也是其中的一位。很多联盟的潜在继承人们。不过，她在整个城市里参与的那些醉酒狂欢活动，反而让这场竞争陷入了混乱…… 你懂我的意思吧，“在提克里斯，究竟有没有人会想要打破这里的平衡呢？” “如果我能想到这样的人的话，[pc.name]，要是你在之前赶到，他们早就被锁在链子里了。”泰西斯双手部叉腰说道，“我的嫌疑人名单短得可怜——毕竟没人会有理由伤害凯西啊！应该有一大堆值得尊敬的人争相讨好她才对，但谁会诅咒她呢？我想不通为什么！在我们的领地，我们已经维持了整整一代人的和平与稳定。如果攻击王室，那就意味着会破坏我们一直以来所取得的一切成果，而这一切，又是为了什么？只是为了制造混乱吗？ 你肯定能想到，在东边，肯定有某个势力非常乐意在这里制造混乱。..

rows.original: You can see the way this is pushing Tethys to her limits, just the same as Kythie herself, and something about seeing a mother in distress — even one that looks big enough to smother you with her body — sends a pang through your heart. You take a step closer and rest a hand on Tethys's shoulder. "It's going to be alright," you tell her. "I will find a way to help your daughter. I promise. So just hold it together a little while longer." "I-" the noblewoman's voice catches in her throat, and she winces back from you — though not enough to brush your hand off completely. [pc.isCunning |Not used to such forwardness, is she? ]"Th-thank you, Champion. I am trying." She says that with such heaviness, you can feel her shrink a little in front of you. "You [pc.hasKids |have children of your own?" You nod. "I pray you never suffer anything like this. Watching your child suffer is an acute horror, and being impotent to help her is... it feels as though I am suffocating. Drowning. I fear you are my only way out. So, one parent to another: please, in the goddess's name, do whatever you must to help her." |don't have children of your own, do you?" You shake your head. "No." "Then you will not understand, not truly. How can you? A child rewrites your life, your very soul. And now I must watch mine suffer, impotent to help her. I feel so completely helpless here, as though I'm drowning in despair." ] "You called me," you assure her. "You took a risk for her, and I'll make sure it pays off. I swear it." Thethys finally relaxes, at least a little bit. "Thank you, Champion. You are right. Even still, one wonders how the world might be different, if I had pursued the path of a priest or sorceress rather than the blade and shield. Could I have found her cure myself, without resorting to such... such debasing means?" "Is this really so bad?" you ask. "Sex is as natural a cure as it gets." The [silly |milfmander |salamander matron ] sighs. "Not like this. Sex is meant to be between lovers, not a... a fleeting dalliance, and certainly not between strangers. If you had courted my daughter, perhaps things would be different, but there is something deeply humiliating about surrendering her to a foreigner who'd never set foot in our lands. Yet that is what makes you perfect to be her savior. Ironic, isn't it?" She's got a very romanticized view of sex, for such a beautiful woman. "I don't want to humiliate you or Kythie, Tethys." "I know," she says. "And yet... I feel as though I've done you as much a dishonor as my daughter. Even if you have a more... libertine view of things than I." The look she gives you seems genuinely regretful, despite how [pc.isDK |ridiculous |outlandish ] the situation is. You squeeze her shoulder a bit tighter. "It'll be alright." "I... thank you." Tethys crosses her arms and glances towards the door.
rows.translation: 你能看出这件事正把泰西斯逼到极限，就像凯西本人一样；而看到一位母亲如此痛苦——哪怕这位母亲看起来壮得能用身体把你闷死——还是让你心头一酸。你走近一步，把手搭在泰西斯的肩上。“会好起来的，”你告诉她。“我一定会找到办法帮你女儿。我保证。所以，再多撑一会儿。” “我——”这位贵妇的声音卡在喉咙里，她从你身边畏缩了一下——但还没到把你的手完全甩开的地步。[pc.isCunning |她还不习惯有人这么冒失吧？ ]“谢、谢谢你，冠军。我正在努力。” 她说这话时语气沉重得让你能感觉到她当着你的面缩小了一圈。“你[pc.hasKids |有自己的孩子吗？” 你点了点头。 “我祈祷你永远不必遭受这种事。看着自己的孩子受苦是一种尖锐的恐怖，而无力帮她……那感觉就像我在窒息，在下沉。我怕你是我唯一的出路。所以，为人父母者对为人父母者：求你了，看在女神的名分上，无论必须做什么，都请帮帮她。” |没有自己的孩子，对吧？” 你摇了摇头。“没有。” “那你就不会明白，永远不会真正明白。你怎么可能明白呢？孩子会改写你的人生，你的灵魂本身。而现在我只能看着我的孩子受苦，却无力帮她。我在这里感到彻底的绝望无助，仿佛正溺死在绝望里。” ] “是你叫来了我，”你向她保证。“你为她冒了风险，我保证这风险不会白费。我发誓。” 泰西斯终于放松下来，至少松了一点。“谢谢你，冠军。你说得对。可即便如此，人还是会想：如果我当年走的是祭司或女巫的路，而不是刀剑与盾牌，这世界会不会不一样。我是不是就能自己找到治好她的办法，而不必诉诸这种……这种自贬身份的手段？” “这事真有那么糟吗？”你问。“性已经是最天经地义的疗法了。” 这位[silly |蝾螈熟母 |蝾螈主母 ]叹了口气。“不该是这样的。性应当是爱人之间的事，而不是……一段露水姻缘，更不该发生在陌生人之间。如果你曾追求过我女儿，也许情况会不一样，可把她交给一个从未踏足我们国土的外乡人，实在有某种深切的羞辱感。然而正是这一点让你成了拯救她的最佳人选。很讽刺，不是吗？” 这么美丽的女人，对性的看法倒是浪漫得过了头。“我不想羞辱你，或者凯西，泰西斯。” “我知道，”她说。“可还是……我觉得自己对你和我女儿一样失了礼数。即便你对事情的看法比我更……放荡不羁。” 她给你的眼神里满是真切的悔意，尽管[pc.isDK |荒唐 |离奇 ]这场面再怎么离谱也一样。你把她的肩膀握得更紧了些。“会好起来的。” “我……谢谢你。” 泰西斯抱起双臂，朝门口瞥了一眼。

rows.original:
[flags.P_DILEMMA_CAIT_VISIT
        |"Can we talk to Kythie?" you ask, looking between Cait and Tethys.
        
        "They can!" the princess says from inside her cell. "I'm good for it." 
        
        Tethys gives you and your priestess a weary smile before unbarring the door. "You have your answer then, Champion."
        
        "We're coming in," Cait says gently. "Both of us." 
        
        Kythie's sitting on the bed's edge when you step in, and tries not to wince when the door's bar slides back into place. "Hey, Cait. [pc.name]. How's your investigation going?"
        
        "It's going," you assure her. "How are you feeling?"
        
        She sighs. "I'm okay as I can be. Cait's been a big help." Kythie's tail curls around the cleric's leg, pulling her into princess's lap. "But I feel like I'm going a little crazy in here! I haven't been outside in... in who knows how long. I miss the sun!"
        
        Cait rubs the 'mander's shoulders. "We'll find a fix, sweet thing. Trust [pc.name]. I know I do."
        
        Kythie gives you a hopeful look.
        |You exchange a look with Cait. "I think we're ready to talk to the princess." 
        
        Tethys nods. "She's been more calm, thanks to Sister Caitriss's efforts. I think she's in a state of mind to entertain visitors."
        
        "I am!" a voice says through the door. "I'm okay. Well, okay enough to talk. You can send them in."
        
        You give Tethys a nod, and the lady-consort unbars the door. 
        
        You and Cait step inside. This time, the princess isn't a sweaty mess of naked amazon — rather, she's dressed similarly to her father, with a short kilt and a tunic that leaves most of her chest bare. The effect on a large-breasted woman is... quite a bit more striking than on the willowy Prince Evander. A pair of thick cloth straps are trying to compete with the weight of her chest to hold it up, but is clearly struggling. The princess is quickly settling a fur mantle around her shoulders when you step inside, and her auroran tail has drooped behind her like a shamed puppy. 
        
        "Um, hi," she says awkwardly. Her cheeks and tail both burn a little brighter as you take her new appearance in, but she makes herself look you both in the eye. "Cait, right? And... you're [pc.name]? The Champion she talked about?"

[pc.isCunning |More than enough time for someone to get back to Hawkethorne from here, if the cult's involved. ] "Did anything change during the storm?" "Yeah," Kythie says. She [kythie.lowLibido |makes an embarrassed sound in her throat and droops her ears |bites her lip with a horny little smirk ]. "I'll say. I, uh, spent the entire time locked in my room knuckles-deep in myself. Thinking about that girl I'd kissed, my fiancee, the chubby harpy lady from the temple, the big muscly priest who'd officiated the Tycathalon with his whole chest out... it was [silly |real degen hours |just a week of degeneracy ] while everyone else was distracted with the tournament's aftermath. It wasn't until a couple days after the storm passed that anybody really noticed I was behaving strangely. Even me! I thought... well, I'd heard that a lot of Tycathalon athletes act promiscuously afterwards. Maybe it was hormonal, from the stress and the rush of victory." "What changed your mind?" Again, you're met with a [kythie.lowLibido |shamefaced expression |shameless look of lust ]. "One of the palace serving-girls walked in on me. In the moment, it seemed entirely natural to just spread my legs wider and crook my tail, like, 'come on in, let's have some fun!' The idea that what I was doing was wholly inappropriate never even entered my mind. I guess I was luck that she'd been with the palace a good long while, and recognize I wasn't myself. She ran off and told my parents immediately. I didn't even have the good sense to be embarrassed about it... or close the door." Kythie rests her elbows on her knees and sighs. rows.translation: “起初，这种变化很微妙。我记得是在泰卡塔隆之后，我才第一次注意到有些事情正在发生变化——那是我们每年秋天举办的盛大体育赛事，来自各地的人们都会前来参赛！那只是我第二次参赛，但我竟然在铁饼项目中赢得了金质奖环！”公主感到无比自豪，她的尾焰如同北极光般闪耀。“当妈妈把那枚奖环戴到我额上时，我欣喜若狂，我……我整个人都被淹没了。感觉我的心都像着了火一样。” 凯西的耳朵微微一动。“当时我也不知道自己是怎么了——嗯，现在想来，我大概知道原因了——但我没多想，就抓住了那个赢得银质奖环的女孩，在领奖台上亲了她一下。”她的脸颊涨红了。“尽管她并不怎么高兴，所有人还是鼓起了掌。他们怎么可能知道呢，对吧？”爸爸因此训了我一顿，但也就仅此而已。大家都以为我只是太兴奋了。说实话，我当时也是这么觉得的。 [var0 |“另一个女孩，她后来怎么样了？”凯特问道。 “领奖台上倒没什么，但当我们都离开人群的视线后，她用头撞了我。”凯西努力笑了笑。“她来自……嗯，那地方叫什么来着——阿尔滕斯派尔？对，她在那里算是个人物，因为她天生就长着角。对‘蝾螈人’来说这很少见。她大老远跑来参赛，结果只差一英寸又四分之一就输给了我，气得不行。原来她根本不怕用她那颗硬脑袋撞人！我脑袋上的淤青整整一周才好。” ] “那接下来发生了什么？”你问道。 “有一阵子什么也没发生。几天后，那场大暴风雪就来了，所有还没离开镇子的人几乎都被困在了屋里。而且——” “大暴风雪？” “是啊！简直疯了。我从没见过一年这么早就刮来这么猛烈的风暴。所有人都措手不及。” [var0 |你和凯特对视了一眼。那一定就是你俩相遇的那天，也就是卡拉被绑架的那天。 |那听起来就像你遇到凯特的那一晚。卡拉被绑架的那一晚。 ] “那这到底是在泰卡塔隆之后多久？” 凯西皱起了眉头：“我想是五天吧？” [pc.isCunning |如果邪教组织牵涉其中的话，从这里回到鹰棘镇完全有足够的时间。 ] “在暴风雨期间，有什么变化吗？” “是的，”凯西说。她 [kythie.lowLibido |她喉咙里发出尴尬的声音，然后把耳朵耷拉了下来。 |她咬着嘴唇，脸上带着一丝淫荡的笑容。 ]。“那还用说。我，呃，那段时间几乎一直把自己关在房间里，手指深埋在自己体内。我一直想着那个我吻过的姑娘，我的未婚妻，还有神庙里那个胖乎乎的鹰身女妖女士，以及那位挺着胸膛主持泰卡塔隆的肌肉发达的祭司……那真是 [silly |真正的堕落时光 |仅仅一周的堕落 ] 而其他人都在为锦标赛的余波分心。直到风暴过去几天后，才有人真正注意到我的行为有些异常。连我自己也没察觉！我当时想……嗯，我听说过很多泰卡塔隆的运动员在赛后都会变得很放荡。也许那是荷尔蒙的作用，是压力加上胜利的兴奋造成的。” “是什么让你改变了想法？” 于是，你迎上的是一个[kythie.lowLibido |羞愧的表情 |毫不掩饰的饥渴目光 ]。“有个宫女撞见了我。当时我觉得完全理所当然，就那样张开双腿、翘起尾巴，仿佛在说：‘进来吧，我们一起玩玩！’我根本没想过自己的行为有什么不妥。我想我运气不错，因为她已经在宫里待了很久，能认出我当时不是平时的自己。她跑了出去，立刻把这件事告诉了我的父母。我甚至都没有足够的理智为此感到尴尬……或者把门关上。” 凯西把肘部放在膝盖上，叹了口气。“从那以后，发生的事情就有点模糊不清了。我记得父母都对我大发雷霆。后来我经常在半夜醒来，去，呃，解决自己的需求。每次醒来都是一身冷汗，身体像着了火。我试图抓住一个路过我房间的武装卫士。那次没成功，我就和几个男人打了起来。然后泰娜队长把我按倒在地，接下来我就发现自己在了塔里，不停地尖叫、挣扎，因为我的整个身体仿佛都在燃烧，从胯下开始。” 她朝[var0 |凯特露出一个感激的微笑。“如果没有你，我至今还会是那样，凯特。” “这是我的荣幸，公主！你确实不好伺候，但值得。” |你露出一个感激的微笑。“如果没有你，我至今还会是那样，[pc.name]。” 你轻轻拍了拍她的肩膀。“我们会帮你度过这个难关的。” ]

rows.original: "I don't think so! Not that could do something like this, anyway!" Kythie sighs. "I'm sure Mom's been tearing her scales off thinking about every bandit lord and barbarian chieftain she's crossed blades with as Strategos. Our family used to fight giants, generations ago, but they've barely been seen in the last century — and I don't think they'd stoop to cursing." "Would a bandit or barbarian?" [pc.bg barbarian |You know your tribe had shamans, and you vaguely remember stories of clashing with Tychrisian soldiers decades ago, but that doesn't seem like something any of your people would do. ] Kythie shakes her head. "Maybe a rogue sorcerer? I hear those are always a problem down south, but the Order Astrida always hunt them down in the end. I know Mom killed one right when I was born. Maybe he had an apprentice or something, but... I don't know. Really we're pretty safe up here. We're friends with most of our neighbors. I don't know who'd be so mad at our family they'd try to hurt me." "If not your family, what about you personally? Do you know of anybody holding a grudge?" "Me?" Kythie seems genuinely taken aback by the question. "What did I do?" [var0 |Cait gives her a disarming smile. "Nothing, sweetheart. But sometimes people take innocent things so far the wrong way it drives them mad. So try and think about anybody whose behavior around you changed, or something like that." |You sigh. "That's what I'm trying to find out. Did somebody start treating you differently lately?" ] The princess pouts. "No! I don't know. The girl from Altenspire I beat out in the Tycathalon, Ariande, was righteously pissed off at me, but she's as much of a meathead as I am!" Kythie frowns. "Now that you mention it, her mother's a court magician in their home city, I think. I guess she could have, but why...?" "We don't know anything for certain," you say. [pc.isCunning |But Kythie's prime competition being a magician's daughter is a possible lead. The curse could have been intended to weaken Kythie before the competition just as easily as it could have been meant to punish her for winning... ] "Anybody else you can think of?" "I guess, uh, there's a girl down at the temple library. Ynes? The last couple times I've been there, I think she was flirting with me! She used to be a witch herself, I hear. Before she came to the temple." "Did you reciprocate?" Kythie shakes her head vigorously. "No, never. I would never. I won't pretend she's not beautiful, but there's something unsettling about her. Not to mention she's a thrall to the temple. I couldn't..." [pc.isCunning |Still, if a witch feels spurned... ] "And nobody else comes to mind?" "No," Kythie sighs. "Tychris is full of spellcasters, [pc.name]. Magister Vasko lives here in the palace, he'd know more of them than I do! Ask him..."
rows.translation: “我可不这么认为！反正他们也不可能做出这种事来！”凯西叹道。“我敢肯定，妈妈自从当上统帅，跟每一个交过手的强盗头目和野蛮人酋长都琢磨过一遍，愁得都快把自己的鳞片揪光了。我们家族在几代之前还跟巨人打过仗，但过去这一个世纪里几乎再没见过他们的踪影——而且我觉得他们也不至于自降身份去下诅咒。” “那强盗或者野蛮人呢？” [pc.bg barbarian |你知道你的部落曾有萨满，也隐约记得几十年前与提克里斯的士兵交战的故事，但这不像是你的族人会做的事。 ] 凯西摇了摇头。“也许是个流浪巫师？我听说南方总有这种麻烦，但阿斯特里达教团最终总能把他们铲除。我知道我出生那年妈妈就杀过一个。也许他有学徒之类的，不过……我不知道。说真的，我们这里挺安全的。我们和大多数邻居都是朋友。我想不出谁会恨我们家恨到想伤害我。” “如果不是你的家人，那你本人呢？你知道有谁对你怀恨在心吗？” “我？”凯西似乎真的被这个问题问住了。“我做了什么？” [var0 |凯特向她露出了一个让人放下戒备的微笑。“没什么，亲爱的。但有时候人们会把无辜的事情往坏处想得太远，把自己逼疯。所以试着想想有谁在你身边的行为变了，或者类似的事。” |你叹了口气。“这正是我想弄清楚的。最近是不是有人开始对你另眼相待了？” ] 公主撅起了嘴。“不！我不知道。在泰卡塔隆比赛里被我打败的那个来自阿尔滕斯派尔的姑娘，阿里安德，当时气得要命，可她跟我一样是个没脑子的肌肉笨蛋！”凯西皱起眉头。“你这么一说，我记得她妈妈是他们家乡城的宫廷法师。我猜她确实有可能，但为什么……？” “我们什么都不确定，”你说道。 [pc.isCunning |但凯西最大的竞争对手是位法师的女儿，这条线索或许有用。这个诅咒既可能本意是在比赛前削弱凯西，也同样可能是为了惩罚她获胜…… ] “还有别人你能想到吗？” “我想想，呃，神殿图书馆里有个姑娘。叫伊内斯？我最近去过那儿两趟，我觉得她在跟我调情！听说她以前自己也是个女巫，在来神殿之前。” “你有回应她吗？” 凯西用力地摇着头。“没有，从来没有。我绝不会。我不否认她很美，但她身上有种让人不安的东西。更别说她还是神殿的奴仆。我不可能……” [pc.isCunning |不过，如果一个女巫觉得自己被冷落了呢…… ] “那没有别人了吗？” “没有，”凯西叹道。“提克里斯到处都是施法者，[pc.name]。瓦斯科大师就住在这座宫殿里，他认识的人肯定比我多！去问他吧……”

rows.original: "No!" Kythie laughs. "I'm as magic as a rock on the side of the road. My parents hired a tutor to teach me spellcraft when I was young, but nothing stuck. Vasky — I mean, Magister Vasko — tried to get me to apprentice to him for a year anyway, but I didn't make it more than a couple of weeks before I had to tell him I couldn't hack it. And I don't give up easy!" "What made you give up?" Kythie shrugs. "I just... couldn't do it. As hard as I tried, it's like my fingers and tongue just won't work the way I tell them when I try and recite an incantation. And it's weird, I'm an athlete, I know how to push my body... except it all falls apart the moment I open a book." [var0 |Cait chuckles. "Some people have a real knack for magic. I'm told I'm one of them! And if some people can have a natural talent, I guess some people have a natural... un-talent." Kythie snorts. "Yeah, it's... something like that, feels like." |[pc.isMage |"Some people just aren't cut out for it," you say. "Spellcasting's hard, and dangerous, and if you try and push yourself to do it anyway you're likely to hurt yourself or others." "Thank you!" Kythie says, throwing a hand up. "I'm terrified of turning myself into a newt or something!" |"Alright," you say, "so you're no mage yourself. And you stopped practicing when?" "Ages back," Kythies says. "More than a year ago." ] ] You scratch your chin. Kythie definitely didn't do this to herself at least.
rows.translation: “不！”凯西笑着说，“我可一点魔法天赋都没有，就像路边的石头一样。我小时候，父母请了老师来教我施法，但我什么都没学会。瓦斯基——我是说，瓦斯科大师——还是想让我跟着他当一年学徒，但我连几周都没撑过去，就不得不告诉他我实在做不来。我可不会轻易放弃！” “是什么让你放弃了呢？” 凯西耸了耸肩。“我只是……做不到而已。无论我怎么努力，当我试图念诵咒语时，我的手指和舌头就是不肯按我的意思动。奇怪的是，我明明是个运动员，知道怎么逼自己的身体……可只要一翻开书，这一切就全垮了。” [var0 |凯特轻笑起来。“有些人天生就很有魔法天赋。据说我就是其中之一！而如果有些人天生就有这种才能，我想也总有人天生就……没这种才能。” 凯西哼了一声。“是啊，大概就是那种感觉吧。” |[pc.isMage |“有些人就是不适合干这个，”你说。“施法既困难又危险，如果你硬要逼自己去做，很可能会伤到自己或别人。” “谢谢！”凯西举起一只手说道。“我可害怕把自己变成一只蝾螈之类的！” |“好吧，”你说，“所以你自己不是法师。那你是什么时候停止练习的？” “很久以前了，”凯西说。“一年多以前。” ] ] 你挠了挠下巴。凯西绝对不是自己把自己弄成这样的，至少这一点可以肯定。

And it's weird, I'm an athlete, I know how to push my body... except it all falls apart the moment I open a book." [var0 |Cait chuckles. "Some people have a real knack for magic. I'm told I'm one of them! And if some people can have a natural talent, I guess some people have a natural... un-talent." Kythie snorts. "Yeah, it's... something like that, feels like." |[pc.isMage |"Some people just aren't cut out for it," you say. "Spellcasting's hard, and dangerous, and if you try and push yourself to do it anyway you're likely to hurt yourself or others." "Thank you!" Kythie says, throwing a hand up. "I'm terrified of turning myself into a newt or something!" |"Alright," you say, "so you're no mage yourself. And you stopped practicing when?" "Ages back," Kythies says. "More than a year ago." ] ] You scratch your chin. Kythie definitely didn't do this to herself at least. '

rows.original: "I, uh, well... that was... not my finest moment." Kythie squirms, eyes downcast. "One of the Order came to the tower when the curse really took me. I never even got her name, I was too far out of it by then, just about ready to bend the bars and climb out the window!" Kythie manages an awkward laugh. "I really made an ass of myself. The Astrida that came over was the first person I'd see except through a door in three days, and I threw myself at her. Like — well, you know. I'm pretty good at wrestling, but I had nothing on her; she had me pinned in a heartbeat! Heh, I bet it was at least awesome to watch — naked nineteen year old versus paladin in full war panoply!" You're sure it was. "So what did she do once she had you in submission?" "You don't have to phrase it like that!" Kythie laughs. "[var0 |That's more between me and Cait..." Cait gives you a wink. "But it wasn't like that," Kythie says. |That's more between you and me. It wasn't like that." ] "So what was it like?" Kythie wrings her hands. "It's hard to describe. She pinned my wrists and then squeezed, but I felt it inside my chest. Like the fist of Nareva herself was grabbing my lungs and trying to make me scream all the air out. It didn't hurt, not really, but it's like... I don't know! Like something in my soul was getting squeezed out." "Your soul?" "I don't know how else to say it. I've never felt my soul before, but I sure did then. It was wild, pressure like nothing else inside me... and then the fire was snuffed out! I felt great. And then promptly died of embarrassment." "[silly |RIP," you lament. |[pc.isCunning |Awfully talkative, for a ghost." Kythie snorts. "Well, I finally found somebody who'll listen! And I bet you want to know about the next time they came, huh?" You nod. |I guess you got better." Kythie snorts. "Yeah, I mean, had a paladin right there laying hands on me, bound to happen. Not for the last time, either." "What brought on the second visit?" ] ] The princess scratches her head. "I felt fine for a couple of days after the Astrida left. Felt myself again. Enough that I could apologize to the people I'd harassed, and the guardsman I roughed up. They were understanding, mostly. Dad had Mistress Hestia cooked up my favorite kreatopita and a cheesecake. I got to go outside and run around. It was good. And then on the third day, I woke up in a burning-hot sweat again, with my fingers already in myself. I managed to tell Mom it was starting again, at least! And then it was back to the tower, and another visit from an Astrida. This time it was Lady Eirina herself — the head of the Order here in Tychris!" [var0 |"That must be quite an honor, getting the personal attention of your goddess's representative," Cait says. "Do you know her well?" |"Do you know her?" ] "Eirina? Yeah, I mean, kinda. We've met before. I was there at her swearing in as the First Spear a couple years ago. She's not much older than me, so Dad wanted us to get friendly. We'll probably be working together a lot, when I'm princeps someday. I think we hit it off pretty well... which made it so much worse when my naked ass got beat down, again, by an Astrida, again, just one I have lunch with every few weeks." Kythie sighs. "The same thing happened again. I felt my soul squeeze, then the heat broke. Eirina examined me all over, waved some magic doohickies at me, mumbled a lot, and then told me I should be fine now!" "Obviously she was wrong..." [pc.bg acolyte scholar |You furrow your brow and consult what you know about the shadowy order. They're professional mage hunters and spell-breakers, trained from birth. If Kythie was actually cleared by the First Spear of the Astrida, whatever's going on here can't just be a regular garden variety curse. There's no way one of the most accomplished Astrida would just miss something; the curse almost certainly was broken. And then it just... came back. ] "Obviously," the princess groans. [pc.isCunning |"Did anything happen between the two attempts? Anything at all out of the ordinary?" Kythie shakes her head. "I don't... I don't know. We were celebrating. I partied, feasted, did a lot of exercise... I actually read a book! Oh, and visited the temple, like, every day. Lot of thankful prayers to Nareva. Right until her cure sorta wasn't." "So you didn't go anywhere?" Kythie shakes her head. "Didn't leave the walls. Just the palace grounds, courtyard, temple." Hmm. ]
rows.translation: 我，呃，那个……确实不是我表现最好的时刻。”凯西尴尬地低下了头。“就在诅咒开始真正影响我的时候，有个教团成员来到了塔里。我甚至都没记住她的名字，那时我已经完全失去了理智，几乎要强行折断铁栏杆从窗户逃走了！凯西勉强挤出了一个尴尬的笑声：“我真的搞砸了一切。那天来的阿斯特里达，是我三天来除了透过门看到的人之外，第一个见到的人，而我竟然直接扑了上去。嗯，你懂的……我的摔跤技术还算不错，但对她来说根本不是对手部，她一下子就把我按在了地上！呵呵，光是看那场面肯定也很刺激吧——一个赤条条的十九岁少女，对上全副武装的骑士！” “你确定吗？那她把你制服之后，又做了什么？” “你不用说得这么直白吧！凯西笑了。[var0 |这其实是我和凯特之间的事情……” 凯特向你眨了眨眼。 “但实际情况并不是这样的，”凯西说道。 |这事儿就咱们俩知道吧，其实并不是那样的。 ] 那么，那是一种什么样的感觉呢？” 凯西绞着双手部说道：“很难描述。她把我的手部腕固定住，然后被挤压了但我能感觉到那种感觉就在我的胸口。就好像娜雷瓦本人的拳头紧紧抓住了我的肺部，试图把我肺里的空气全部挤出来，让我发出尖叫。那种感觉确实存在。受伤其实也不是，只是感觉……我也不知道该怎么形容！就好像我灵魂中的某种东西正在被挤压出来。” “你的灵魂？” “我想不出别的词来表达了。我从来没有感觉到之前我从未有过这样的感受，但那次确实经历了。那种感觉简直疯狂极了，我体内仿佛充满了前所未有的压力……然后，那种激情突然就被熄灭了！我当时感觉棒极了，可紧接着，却因为尴尬而‘死’掉了。[silly |安息吧，”你悲叹道。 |[pc.isCunning |对于一个鬼魂来说，真是太爱说话了。” 凯西哼了一声：“好吧，我终于找到了一个愿意听我说话的人！我打赌你肯定想知道他们下一次来的时候发生了什么，对吧？” 你点了点头。 |我想你这次做得更好了吧。” 凯西哼了一声：“是啊，毕竟有个圣骑士在我身上动来动去，这种事难免会发生。而且这已经不是第一次了。” “那第二次来访又是怎么回事呢？ ] ] 公主挠了挠头：“在阿斯特里达离开后，我有几天感觉挺好的……真的没什么不适。我自己再说一次，我确实应该向那些被我骚扰过的人，以及那个被我弄伤的卫兵道歉。他们大多都表示理解。爸爸还让赫斯提亚女士为我做了我最喜欢吃的菜。克里托皮塔还有一份芝士蛋糕。我得以到外面去跑跑，感觉真是太好了。到了第三天，我又在满身大汗中醒来，手部指竟然又开始……那种不适感又出现了。至少我还能告诉妈妈，症状又复发了！然后我又回到了那座塔里，阿斯特里达又一次来找我。这次来的是艾瑞娜女士本人——她就是提克里斯地区这个组织的负责人啊！ [var0 |能够得到你的女神代表的亲自关注，想必是件非常荣幸的事情吧，”凯特说道，“你和她关系不错吗？ |你认识她吗？ ] 艾瑞娜？嗯，算是吧。我们之前确实见过面。几年前她宣誓成为‘第一长矛’的时候，我在场。她比我年纪大不了多少，所以爸爸希望我们能建立良好的关系。等我有朝一日成为王子，我们很可能需要经常一起合作。我觉得我们相处得还挺不错的……这也让事情变得糟糕多了我又被一个叫阿斯特里达的女孩子揍了一顿，还是那个每隔几周就会和我一起吃午饭的女孩。” 凯西叹了口气：“又发生了同样的事情。我感觉到自己的灵魂仿佛被挤压了一下，然后突然感到一阵剧痛。艾瑞娜仔细检查了我的身体，用了一些魔法治疗我，嘟囔了好一会儿，最后告诉我现在应该没事了！” “显然，她错了 [pc.bg acolyte scholar |你皱起眉头，努力回忆自己所了解的关于这个神秘组织的信息。他们是一群专业的法师猎手和法术破解者，从出生起就接受了专门的训练。如果凯西真的被阿斯特拉达的第一长矛解除了诅咒，那么这里发生的这一切绝对不可能是普通的诅咒现象。像阿斯特丽达这样能力出众的人，绝对不可能遗漏任何细节；这个诅咒，几乎可以肯定是坏了。然后它又……恢复了正常状态。 ] 显然，”公主叹道。 [pc.isCunning |在这两次尝试之间发生了什么吗？有没有什么不寻常的事情？” 凯西摇了摇头。“我不知道……我真的不知道。我们当时在庆祝，我参加了派对，吃了很多美食，还做了很多运动……实际上读书哦，而且每天都会去那座寺庙。会向娜瑞瓦献上许多感恩的祷告。直到她最终被治愈之前，一直都是这样。” “所以你根本没去过别的地方吗？” 凯西摇了摇头：“没有离开过宫殿的范围。只是在宫殿的院子里、寺庙里活动而已。” 嗯…… ]

rows.translation: 阿斯特里达教团的尝试
rows.correctionNote: 同上一条，另原文无句号故去掉句末句号。

rows.original: "My family? You're not thinking one of them-" You wave your hands. "No, no. I'm just [pc.isCunning |looking for context here |trying to learn about you all ]. You're an only child, right, Kythie?" She nods, though hardly enthusiastically. "Yeah. First and only. Don't worry — no siblings trying to make sure I can't take the throne." "What about your parents, do they have any nieces and nephews that might have designs?" "On my dad's side, yeah. Mom's parents were, uh, a couple of the moment, I guess you might say. She's an only child too." You arch a brow. "A couple of the moment?" Kythie chuckles awkwardly. "Yeah, well, my grandfather's a baron, he rules one of the villages up north on the border, but he never married. He [var0 |met a girl like Cait here, a mendicant priestess of Mallach, and contracted with her to bear him a child." "Just like my dad did to have me and Calla," Cait says. "Though it's pretty rare for a missionary to take something like that on by herself. She must have really loved him." "That's what I hear," Kythie shrugs. "But she left before I was born. Either way, it didn't win Grandpa any favors at court. I don't know about Jassira, but in Tychris, parents are expected to get married. Stay together. People give him weird looks even now." |eventually entered into a compact with a Mallachite missionary that came to preach in the principality, and she bore him a child." "Does something like that happen often?" "No!" Kythie laughs. "No, it really doesn't. Parents are supposed to stay together, aren't they? Get married and all. But my grandmother left to go back to Jassira before I was even born. People remember that about Grandpa more than anything." ] You glance over your shoulder at the door and whisper. "Does that mean your mother's a bastard, by the court's reckoning?" That makes Kythie squirm. "No. She's, I mean, it's a religious thing. A foreign religious thing, but still, the laws says children born by contract are legitimate just as much as the church does. So, no. It's just... yes, the way people sometimes treat her, you'd think they didn't believe in any of that. A lot of the court doesn't like that my parents are together. Even now." [pc.bg nobleScion |Someone the court considers lowborn being elevated to royal consort must have made Tethys some enemies, even if Kythie and her parents don't recognize it. Noble circles are hidebound at the best of times, and Tychris seems more conservative than most. Could that be a motive for the cursing? Hard to say. ] "So," you say, "how did your mother end up marrying Prince Evander then?" "It was, is, kind of a long story," Kythie shrugs. "But basically, Grandpa — on Dad's side — decided it was a good idea to have some foreign blood in his grandchildren. That we'd been isolated up here so long that we needed it. And Mom's the only noble in the whole city who doesn't have two parents born in the city. It was her or nobody." The princess's ears flick. "But it was a good match! They'd been friends growing up, and they love each other. I'm glad they're my folks." "But you said you have some cousins?" She nods. "Yeah. Dad had a brother, and he had a couple of kids..." [pc.isDK |"What killed him?" |"Sorry for your loss. What happend?" ] "He took sick. We had a real bad winter, maybe ten years ago now? Got a deep cough he never could shake. It was the same year Grandpa passed, too. That was... it was rough. Uncle Iavose's daughters are tough as nails, though. They make me look soft and dainty. And before you ask — they love me, they've protected me all my life. I'd sooner believe Nareva herself cursed me than either of them."
rows.translation: 我的家人？你该不会是说他们中的某个人吧……” 你挥了挥手部，说道：“不，不是的。我只是 [pc.isCunning |需要结合上下文来理解这句话的含义。 |正在努力了解你们所有人。 ]你是独生子女吧，凯西？” 她点了点头，但并不显得很热情。“是的，我是独生女。别担心，没有兄弟姐妹会试图阻止我继承王位。” “那你的父母呢？他们有没有侄子侄女可能会对王位产生兴趣？我爸爸这一边，嗯，是的。我妈妈的父母，呃，可以说他们属于那种‘一时风光’的人吧。我妈妈也是独生女。” 你挑了挑眉毛：“一时风光的人？” 凯西尴尬地笑了笑。嗯，我祖父是个男爵，他在北方边境的一个村庄里掌管着那里的事务，但他从未结婚。 [var0 |在这里，我遇到了一个像凯特这样的女孩——她是玛拉赫教派的一位修行女祭司，我和她约定，让她为我生一个孩子。” “就像我爸爸为了生下我和卡拉那样，”凯特说道，“不过，对于一位传教士来说，独自承担这样的责任其实是非常罕见的。她一定真的很爱他。” “我也是这么听说的，”凯西耸了耸肩，“不过她在我出生之前就离开了。不管怎样，这件事并没有让爷爷在宫廷里获得任何好处。至于贾西拉，我就不清楚了，但在提克里斯，人们普遍认为父母应该结婚。待在一起吧。现在人们看到他还是会用奇怪的眼神看着他。 |最终，她与一位来到这个公国传教的马拉克信徒传教士缔结了婚约，还为他生下了一个孩子。” “这种事情经常发生吗？” “不会的！”凯西笑着说，“真的不会。父母应该是永远在一起的，不是吗？应该结婚生子才对。但在我出生之前，我的祖母就已经回到了贾西拉。人们对祖父的这件事记得最为清楚。 ] 你回头瞥了一眼门，低声说道：“按照法庭的判断，这是不是意味着你的母亲是个私生女？ 那个这让凯西感到很不自在。“不行。我的意思是，这其实是一件与宗教有关的事情。外国的这虽然有点宗教色彩，但法律明确规定，通过契约诞生的孩子与通过正常婚姻诞生的孩子具有同等的法律地位，教会也认同这一观点。所以，答案是否定的。不过……有些人对待她的态度，确实让人觉得他们根本不相信这些道理。至今，很多法院也不认可我父母这种同居关系。 [pc.bg nobleScion |对于那些被法庭认为出身低微的人而言，能够成为王室的配偶，无疑会招致许多敌人的怨恨。即使凯西和她的父母没有意识到这一点。贵族阶层在最好的情况下也依然非常保守，而蒂克里斯似乎比大多数人都更加守旧。这会不会是那些诅咒行为的动机呢？很难说。 ] 那么，”你问道，“你母亲后来是怎么嫁给埃万德王子的呢？” “这其实是个挺长的故事，”凯西耸了耸肩，“但基本上就是，我爸爸那边的祖父觉得，让孙子们身上有一些外国血统会是个不错的主意。我们在这里与世隔绝了太久，真的非常需要这样的帮助。而且妈妈是整个城市里唯一一位父母并非都出生在这个城市的贵族。除了她，没有人能够胜任这个角色。”公主的耳朵微微动了动。“不过，这确实是一段很合适的婚配啊！他们从小就是朋友，而且彼此非常相爱。我很高兴他们成为了我的家人。 “但是你说你还有一些表亲吧？” 她点了点头。“是的。我爸爸有一个哥哥，而那个哥哥也有几个孩子 [pc.isDK |是什么导致了他的死亡？ |对您的损失我深表遗憾。到底发生了什么？ ] 他生病了。那是大约十年前吧，那个冬天实在非常寒冷。他一直咳嗽个不停，怎么也治不好。就在那一年，爷爷也去世了。那真是……一段艰难的时光。不过，Iavose叔叔的女儿们都非常坚强，她们让我觉得自己显得太脆弱、太娇弱了。在你问之前，我想说——她们真的很爱我。受保护的我一生都这么认为。比起他们中的任何一个，我更愿意相信是娜瑞瓦本人诅咒了我。

You're an only child, right, Kythie?" She nods, though hardly enthusiastically. "Yeah. First and only. Don't worry — no siblings trying to make sure I can't take the throne." "What about your parents, do they have any nieces and nephews that might have designs?" "On my dad's side, yeah. Mom's parents were, uh, a couple of the moment, I guess you might say. She's an only child too." You arch a brow. "A couple of the moment?" Kythie chuckles awkwardly. "Yeah, well, my grandfather's a baron, he rules one of the villages up north on the border, but he never married. He [var0 |met a girl like Cait here, a mendicant priestess of Mallach, and contracted with her to bear him a child." "Just like my dad did to have me and Calla," Cait says. "Though it's pretty rare for a missionary to take something like that on by herself. She must have really loved him." "That's what I hear," Kythie shrugs. "But she left before I was born. Either way, it didn't win Grandpa any favors at court. I don't know about Jassira, but in Tychris, parents are expected to get married. Stay together. People give him weird looks even now." |eventually entered into a compact with a Mallachite missionary that came to preach in the principality, and she bore him a child." "Does something like that happen often?" "No!" Kythie laughs. "No, it really doesn't. Parents are supposed to stay together, aren't they? Get married and all. But my grandmother left to go back to Jassira before I was even born. People remember that about Grandpa more than anything." ] You glance over your shoulder at the door and whisper. "Does that mean your mother's a bastard, by the court's reckoning?" That makes Kythie squirm. "No. She's, I mean, it's a religious thing. A foreign religious thing, but still, the laws says children born by contract are legitimate just as much as the church does. So, no. It's just... yes, the way people sometimes treat her, you'd think they didn't believe in any of that. A lot of the court doesn't like that my parents are together. Even now." [pc.bg nobleScion |Someone the court considers lowborn being elevated to royal consort must have made Tethys some enemies, even if Kythie and her parents don't recognize it. Noble circles are hidebound at the best of times, and Tychris seems more conservative than most. Could that be a motive for the cursing? Hard to say. ] "So," you say, "how did your mother end up marrying Prince Evander then?" "It was, is, kind of a long story," Kythie shrugs. "But basically, Grandpa — on Dad's side — decided it was a good idea to have some foreign blood in his grandchildren. That we'd been isolated up here so long that we needed it. And Mom's the only noble in the whole city who doesn't have two parents born in the city. It was her or nobody." The princess's ears flick. "But it was a good match! They'd been friends growing up, and they love each other. I'm glad they're my folks." "But you said you have some cousins?" She nods. "Yeah. Dad had a brother, and he had a couple of kids..." [pc.isDK |"What killed him?" |"Sorry for your loss. What happend?" ] "He took sick. We had a real bad winter, maybe ten years ago now? Got a deep cough he never could shake. It was the same year Grandpa passed, too. That was... it was rough. Uncle Iavose's daughters are tough as nails, though. They make me look soft and dainty. And before you ask — they love me, they've protected me all my life. I'd sooner believe Nareva herself cursed me than either of them." '

rows.original: "Well, there's a lot of people that live and work here," Kythie says. "Between servants, staff, men-at-arms, we probably have a hundred people on the grounds! I know a lot of them by name, but not everybody..." "Who has influence here, then? Other than you and your parents." Kythie clasps her hands and thinks. "I guess there's probably... three people with real influence, like that? Magister Vasko, of course. He's my parents' most important counselor. Then there's Mistress Hestia. She's sort of the head domestic, handles most of the cooking — for us and for the palace as a whole. Amazing baker. And then there's Captain Tyna, head of the guard. She reports to Mom, the city's Strategos, and makes sure the palace, and the city as a whole, stay safe." "Do you get along with all of them?" "Yeah!" Kythie insists. "Hestia dotes on me like an extra mom. Tyna and I spar all the time — and she doesn't have anything to be jealous of, she kicks my butt more often than not. And Vasko's always trying to teach me things, even if I think, deep down, he knows I'm too dense to really get his lessons about magic and whatever." [pc.isMage |"What kind of things does he try to teach you?" "I don't know... protection magic, I guess? He said it was important that I learn how to sense other mages casting their spells, and how to counter it. Maybe it would have helped keep me from getting cursed? He's a smart man, especially for someone from the commons. He must have been worried something like this could happen. I really should have tried harder to understand." You have to wonder, why would Vasko be so interested in teaching Kythie to combat mages? She's neither warrior nor mage. ] [var0 |Cait nibbles the tip of her thumb. "So Hestia handles most of your food, right? What's her story?" "She and my mom go way back, actually," Kythie says. "Mom's was the city's Strategos — our top general — even before she married dad. Hestia was one of her companions. When my mom hung up her spear after the Lion Witch's War, Hestia did too, and Mom invited her to come serve in the palace. I think she'd intended for Hestia to be a guard-captain or something, but she said she was done with fighting, and wanted to do something wholesome with the rest of her life. Turned out she's an amazing cook." You and Cait exchange a glance. Hestia certainly has opportunity to hurt the princess, but the motive seems lacking. ]
rows.translation: 嗯，这里居住和工作的人很多，”凯西说，“包括仆人、工作人员和卫兵，整个庄园里大概有上百人吧！我认识他们中的很多人，但也不是所有人……” “那么，这里谁才有真正的影响力呢？除了你和你的父母之外。” 凯西双手部交叠，陷入沉思。“我想，大概还有……三个人真正拥有这样的影响力吧？当然是瓦斯科大师。他是我父母最信任的顾问。还有赫斯提亚女士。她差不多算是家里的管家，负责为我们以及整个宫殿准备大部分食物。她是个非常出色的烘焙师。另外还有泰娜队长，她是卫队的负责人。她直接向城市的战略长官——也就是妈妈汇报工作，并确保宫殿以及整个城市的安全。你和他们所有人都能相处得很好吗？” “当然！”凯西坚定地回答，“赫斯提亚把我当亲生女儿一样疼爱。我和泰娜经常一起练习战斗，她根本没有什么可嫉妒的——事实上，她大多数时候都能把我打得落花流水。而瓦斯科总是试图教我各种东西，尽管在内心深处，我觉得他应该知道我实在太笨了，根本学不会。获得他关于魔法以及各种相关知识的讲解。 [pc.isMage |他试图教你哪些东西呢？” “我也不清楚……应该是防护魔法吧？他说，学会感知其他法师施放的法术并学会如何应对它们非常重要。也许这样就能避免我被诅咒吧？他是个聪明人，尤其是对于一个出身于平民家庭的人来说。他肯定预料到会发生这种事。我真应该更加努力地去理解这些内容。” 人们不禁会想瓦斯科为什么会对教导凯西如何对抗法师如此感兴趣呢？她既不是战士，也不是法师。 ] [var0 |凯特轻轻咬着拇指的指尖。“所以，大部分食物都是赫斯提亚负责准备的，对吧？她的背景是怎样的呢？” “其实，她和我的妈妈关系很久了，”凯西说道，“在我妈妈嫁给爸爸之前，她就已经是这座城市的战略顾问了——也就是我们的最高指挥官。赫斯提亚也是她的同伴之一。在狮女巫之战结束后，当我妈妈放下她的长矛时，赫斯提亚也跟着停下了战斗，于是妈妈邀请她来宫殿里工作。我想妈妈原本打算让赫斯提亚担任卫队队长之类的职务，但赫斯提亚表示她已经厌倦了战斗，想要用余生去做一些有意义的事情。原来她是个非常出色的厨师啊。” 你和凯特对视了一眼。赫斯提亚确实有机会伤害那位公主，但她的动机似乎不够充分。 ]

rows.original: "You mean, what do I do aside from being a pretty princess, right?" Kythie says with a smirk, adjusting her little gold tiara. "As of this year I'm an aurum wreathe athlete, that's what!" Kythie flexes, slapping a bicep that strains the gold armlet she's wearing. "I'm a champion discus thrower, and I'm pretty darn good at the thousand-yard sprint, the javelin, and wrestling." [var0 |"I'll say!" Cait laughs. She rubs at one of the mostly-healed bite marks on her arm. "You're a feisty one for sure." Kythie blushes. |"You're a real powerhouse, huh?" Kythie's tail swishes proudly. "Yep!" ] "Your parents don't exactly look like the sporting types," you muse, thoughts wandering between the plush goddess of a consort and her frail-looking twink of a husband. "How'd you end up so interested in it?" The princess snort-laughs and wiggles her ears. "Yeah, uh, I don't think Dad would survive a round in the ring with me, let alone Captain Tyna. But Mom used to be a warrior — a damned good one too! She hung up her spear to focus on raising me, though. But she made sure I grew up strong enough to protect myself at least." "Does that mean you know how to actually fight?" [pc.bg soldier |Any highborn would be expected to know how, of course, but there's a hell of a difference between training in the palace and actual experience. You've seen her peers learn that the hard way. ] "Wrestling is fighting! Just for submission rather than, like, killing somebody," Kythie insists. "But I'm a noble. I learned how to use a sword and spear, and fight in the shield wall and from horseback. I wouldn't say I have any particular talent for combat, but I'm not bad at it. I could lead the city's soldiers if I had to. It's just... part of that training was also learning how to fight bare-handed, and I kind of fell in love with that instead of poking holes in people. Captain Tyna taught me to love the thrill of it, and then that got me interested in the other sports at the Tycathalon, and I just... I don't know, I guess I've just got a talent for the discus." "When did you start competing?" Kythie thinks for a moment. "Um, I guess when I was about twelve, I started really training to compete. There are tournaments for children that I did well in, but you need to be sixteen to compete in the real ones. Mom took me to Drapsa and Khor'minos to compete there last year and the year before. And this year was the big Tycathalon." So three years. "Any major wins before this year?" "I took argent in Khor'minos! Though I didn't feel great about that..." You quirk a brow. "Why so?" The princess shifts uncomfortably. "Well, most events separate men from women as it is, you know, but Khor'minos is a little more sexist than Tychris. There were barely any women competing, and most of the lady-minotaurs didn't take it very seriously. The only reason I didn't take aurum there was that there was one more foreign competitor, a sellsword from Tronarii, where they use these bladed discs in battle. She was incredible, like she was dancing as she threw." [pc.bg soldier |Experience wins again. |"Damn." ] [var0 |Cait gasps. "Oh, I think I know who you mean! Tall, skinny human lady that looks like she was carved out of mahogany?" Kythie nods. "Yeah! I forget her name, but she's a big champion back south. She did a demonstration at the temple once. My sister was crushing on her for weeks..." ] Either way, it doesn't sound like Kythie's had enough of an athletics career to be worth sabotaging.
rows.translation: 你是说，除了当一个漂亮的公主之外，我还能做些什么，对吧？”凯西带着一丝笑意说道，同时调整着自己戴在头上的小金冠。“从今年开始，我已经成为了一名‘黄金花环’运动会的运动员，就是这个啦！” 凯西展示着自己的肌肉，用力甩动手臂，使得她戴在手臂上的金手镯发出了叮当声。“我可是掷铁饼项目的冠军，而且在一千码短跑、标枪项目和摔跤方面也表现得相当不错哦。 [var0 |真的吗！”凯特笑着说，她轻轻揉了揉手臂上那些已经基本愈合的咬痕。“你确实是个脾气火爆的人呢。” 凯西的脸颊顿时红了。 |你可真是个厉害的角色啊，嗯？” 凯西骄傲地摇动着尾巴：“没错！ ] 你的父母看起来可不太像运动型的人啊，”你想着，脑海中不断浮现出那位雍容华贵的王后与她那位看起来体弱多病的丈夫的形象。“你是怎么对运动产生兴趣的呢？” 公主发出一阵轻笑，还摇动着耳朵。是啊，我觉得爸爸要是和我一起上擂台，肯定撑不过一回合，更别提泰娜队长了。不过妈妈以前可是个战士，而且还是个非常出色的战士！不过后来她放弃了战斗，专心抚养我。不过她确实确保我长大后有足够的力气保护自己。这是不是意味着你真的知道该怎么做？战斗?" [pc.bg soldier |任何一个出身高贵的人都应该懂得这些，但在宫中接受训练与实际经验之间，还是存在着天壤之别的。你也亲眼看到过她的同龄人是如何通过惨痛的教训才学会这些的。 ] 摔跤其实就是战斗！只不过目的是让对手屈服，而不是杀死对方，”凯西坚持说道。“但我可是贵族出身。我学会了如何使用剑和长矛，也懂得如何在盾墙后作战，以及如何骑马作战。虽然我不能说自己在战斗方面有什么特别的天赋，但至少糟糕如果需要的话，我完全可以带领这座城市的士兵们作战。只是……那些训练内容中也包括学习徒手格斗，而我反而对这种战斗方式产生了浓厚的兴趣，而不是喜欢用武器刺伤别人。泰娜上尉教会了我享受那种战斗带来的刺激感，从那以后，我对泰卡塔隆竞技场里的其他运动项目也产生了兴趣。总之……我也说不清楚，大概我就是天生适合投掷铁饼吧。 你是从什么时候开始参加比赛的呢？” 凯西思考了一会儿，说道：“嗯，大概在我十二岁的时候，我开始认真训练，准备参加比赛。有一些针对儿童的比赛，我在那些比赛中表现得还不错，但要想参加真正的比赛，至少得十六岁才行。去年和前年，妈妈带着我去德拉普萨和科尔米诺斯参加比赛。而今年，就是那场重要的泰卡塔隆比赛。 所以，三年了。 “在今年之前，有什么重大的胜利吗？” “我在科尔米诺斯比赛中获得了银牌！不过当时我并没有为此感到高兴……” 你挑了挑眉毛：“为什么呢？” 公主显得有些不自在地挪了挪身子。嗯，大多数活动本来就会将男性和女性区分开来，但你知道，科尔米诺斯这个活动比提克里斯更加性别歧视。几乎没有任何女性参加比赛，而且大多数女弥诺陶洛斯们也并不把这次比赛当回事。我之所以没有去参加那里的比赛，只是因为还有另一位外国参赛者——他是一名来自特洛纳里的雇佣兵，在那里人们会在战斗中使用这种带刃的圆盘武器。她简直太厉害了，投球的时候简直就像在跳舞一样。 [pc.bg soldier |经验依然是最重要的。 |该死。 ] [var0 |凯特倒吸一口凉气：“哦，我想我知道你指的是谁了！那个高个子、身材苗条的女性，看起来就像是用红木雕刻出来的一样吧？” 凯西点了点头。 “对！我忘了她的名字，但她是在南方很有名的一位强者。她曾经在寺庙里进行过表演，我妹妹当时迷上了她，整整好几周都对她念念不忘呢…… ] 无论如何，听起来，凯西的田径生涯还没有发展到值得被破坏的程度啊。
