rows.original: "I guess you would have heard about that, huh?" Kythie says, fiddling with a braid. "Yeah, I have a fiancee. He's a prince from the city of Felurze, a little south of here. Our parents made the arrangement years ago. He'll be of age next year, and then come up to Tychris so we can be wed. I just hope to the gods he never finds out about any of this..." "You think he would be upset about what [var0 |you and Cait have |we've ] been doing?" She shakes her head. "I don't know, but I'm sure he'd never let me live it down. He's a little shit like that, always teasing me about something! If it's not about how I act, it's about some little this-and-that from ten years ago... and if he runs out of ammunition he'll just say I have fat tits." Kythie pouts, crossing her arms under her fat tits. "Sounds like you're good friends, at least?" "Eh, I mean, I guess. I only see him once or twice a year, but we get on. At least, we put in the effort to. Our parents are all really invested in seeing this marriage play out." "Why is that?" And more importantly, you wonder, who would benefit from destabilizing it. Kythie sighs. "That's, well it's, um, complicated. You've seen my dad. A stiff breeze would blow him over. Grandpa, Uncle, my great-aunt, it's all kind of the same. I'm the first member of the family born anything but sickly in living memory. The clerics of Nareva said we need to stop marrying nobles from our own court; that foreign blood will save us from the decline. Mom kinda proved that it's moving in the right direction, at least." [pc.bg scholar |It sounds like the point is to undo a little too much inbreeding up here in Tychris. Old Belhar used to have the same problem, as you recall; several emperors who came from the union of cousins proved to be unstable. Better to be physically frail than mentally, you suppose. |You wonder if the royal was already under some kind of curse... ] "So, do you really think he cares about your, well, maidenhead?" you ask. "It's certainly important to your parents." Kythie glances away. "I don't think he does, but his parents do. The feeling's mutual, I guess. Dad's not the only one concerned with bloodlines; my fiancee's parents only agreed to the arrangement on the assurance that their son would plant his seed in my womb, ensuring their blood became the next rulers of Tychris. And the best way to assure that is my chastity. The contract's ironclad, oathsworn before Nareva and Tira." "And what does your prince think about all of this?" "I, uh," Kythie's ears flatten against her head. "I don't know. It's our duty. He knows that as well as I do. He's a twerp, but still puts in the effort to be tolerable." [pc.bg minstrel noblescion courtesan |You've heard this story before. It's a rare thing for promised couples to be enthusiastically in love; the best they can hope for is a quiet toleration that blooms into better. But Kythie's response leaves you wondering. "You're an incredible woman, Kythie. He should be over the moon." "Yeah! But, like, I mean, he's just..." Kythie's cheeks flush, and she squeezes her own fingers. "He's always... he's never been interested in me like that. Not like Mom and Dad were when they were in our shoes. It's, I guess it's just kind of disappointing. I don't get the childhood friend romance, or the prince charming with love at first sight. And he just gets... me." Could it be that the Prince of Felurze would want to break off this engagement himself? ]
rows.translation: 我想你会我听说过这件事，对吧？”凯西一边说着，一边摆弄着自己的发辫。“是的，我有一个未婚夫。他是来自费卢尔泽城的王子，就在我们这里南边不远处。我们的父母几年前就安排好了这门婚事。他明年就成年了，到时候就会来到蒂克里斯，然后我们就可以结婚了。我只希望诸神能让他永远不要知道这些事情……” “你认为他会因为这些事情而难过吗？ [var0 |你和凯特有 |我们已经 ] 他最近在干什么呢？” 她摇了摇头：“我不知道，但我敢肯定，他绝对不会让我就此罢休的。他就是这种人，总是拿一些事情来取笑我！要不是我的行为方式，就是十年前的一些小事……要是他的‘弹药’用完了，他就只会说‘我的胸部很大’吧。”凯西撅着嘴，双臂交叉在胸前。 “听起来你们应该是很好的朋友吧？” “嗯，算是吧。我一年也就见他一两次面，不过我们相处得还不错。至少，我们付出了努力。我们的父母也都非常希望看到这段婚姻能够顺利发展。” “为什么呢？”更重要的是，你会想知道，谁会从破坏这段婚姻中获益。 凯西叹了口气。嗯，这个情况有点复杂。你们都见过我爸爸，一阵微风就能把他吹倒。爷爷、叔叔、我的姑婆们，也都是这种情况。在大家的记忆中，我是家里第一个没有天生体弱多病的成员。娜瑞瓦的神职人员们认为，我们应该停止与自己宫廷中的贵族通婚；他们认为，外来的血统能够帮助我们避免衰落。不过，妈妈的做法至少证明，我们正在朝着正确的方向前进。 [pc.bg scholar |看来，关键在于扭转提克里斯地区这种过度近亲繁殖的现象。正如你所记得的，老贝尔哈尔也曾面临同样的问题——几位由表亲联姻而产生的皇帝都被证明是不稳定的。或许，身体虚弱总比精神失常要好吧。 |你不禁怀疑，这位王室成员是否早已陷入了某种诅咒之中…… ] 那么，你真的认为他在意你的……贞操吗？”你问道，“不过这对你的父母来说肯定很重要。” 凯西移开了视线，说道：“我不这么认为。他也是这么想的，但他的父母却坚持这样做。我想，这种想法是相互的。父亲并不是唯一一个关心血统问题的人；我未婚妻的父母也是只有在得到保证——他们的儿子会将自己的后代留在我的肚子里，从而确保他们的血脉能够成为泰克里斯未来的统治者——之后，才同意这个安排的。而确保这一点的最佳方式，就是保持我的贞洁。这份契约是铁一般的，我在娜瑞瓦和蒂拉面前宣誓过。” “那么，你的王子对这一切是怎么看的呢？” “我，呃……”凯西的耳朵紧紧贴在脑袋上。我不知道。这是我们的职责。他和我一样明白这一点。他虽然是个小混蛋，但还是会努力让自己变得可以忍受。 [pc.bg minstrel noblescion courtesan |你以前肯定听过这个故事。对于那些被许下承诺的情侣来说，真正彼此深爱着对方其实是件难得的事；他们最多只能期待一种逐渐发展成更深厚感情的、表面上的宽容与接纳。但凯西的反应却让人不禁产生疑问：“凯西，你真是个了不起的女性。他应该高兴极了。” “是啊！但是，我是说，他其实……”凯西的脸颊涨得通红，她紧紧地捏着自己的手指，“他从来都没有这样对我……从来都没有像爸爸妈妈在我们这个年纪时那样对我。我觉得，这真的有点令人失望。我无法理解那种青梅竹马的恋情，也无法理解那种一见钟情的浪漫故事。而他，只是选择了……我。 难道费卢尔泽王子本人想要解除这段婚约吗？ ]
rows.raw: " "I guess you would have heard about that, huh?" Kythie says, fiddling with a braid. "Yeah, I have a fiancee. He's a prince from the city of Felurze, a little south of here. Our parents made the arrangement years ago. He'll be of age next year, and then come up to Tychris so we can be wed. I just hope to the gods he never finds out about any of this..." "You think he would be upset about what [var0 |you and Cait have |we've ] been doing?" She shakes her head. "I don't know, but I'm sure he'd never let me live it down. He's a little shit like that, always teasing me about something! If it's not about how I act, it's about some little this-and-that from ten years ago... and if he runs out of ammunition he'll just say I have fat tits." Kythie pouts, crossing her arms under her fat tits. "Sounds like you're good friends, at least?" "Eh, I mean, I guess. I only see him once or twice a year, but we get on. At least, we put in the effort to. Our parents are all really invested in seeing this marriage play out." "Why is that?" And more importantly, you wonder, who would benefit from destabilizing it. Kythie sighs. "That's, well it's, um, complicated. You've seen my dad. A stiff breeze would blow him over. Grandpa, Uncle, my great-aunt, it's all kind of the same. I'm the first member of the family born anything but sickly in living memory. The clerics of Nareva said we need to stop marrying nobles from our own court; that foreign blood will save us from the decline. Mom kinda proved that it's moving in the right direction, at least." [pc.bg scholar |It sounds like the point is to undo a little too much inbreeding up here in Tychris. Old Belhar used to have the same problem, as you recall; several emperors who came from the union of cousins proved to be unstable. Better to be physically frail than mentally, you suppose. |You wonder if the royal was already under some kind of curse... ] "So, do you really think he cares about your, well, maidenhead?" you ask. "It's certainly important to your parents." Kythie glances away. "I don't think he does, but his parents do. The feeling's mutual, I guess. Dad's not the only one concerned with bloodlines; my fiancee's parents only agreed to the arrangement on the assurance that their son would plant his seed in my womb, ensuring their blood became the next rulers of Tychris. And the best way to assure that is my chastity. The contract's ironclad, oathsworn before Nareva and Tira." "And what does your prince think about all of this?" "I, uh," Kythie's ears flatten against her head. "I don't know. It's our duty. He knows that as well as I do. He's a twerp, but still puts in the effort to be tolerable." [pc.bg minstrel noblescion courtesan |You've heard this story before. It's a rare thing for promised couples to be enthusiastically in love; the best they can hope for is a quiet toleration that blooms into better. But Kythie's response leaves you wondering. "You're an incredible woman, Kythie. He should be over the moon." "Yeah! But, like, I mean, he's just..." Kythie's cheeks flush, and she squeezes her own fingers. "He's always... he's never been interested in me like that. Not like Mom and Dad were when they were in our shoes. It's, I guess it's just kind of disappointing. I don't get the childhood friend romance, or the prince charming with love at first sight. And he just gets... me." Could it be that the Prince of Felurze would want to break off this engagement himself? ] "

rows.original: Kythie draws in a breath when you ask the question, and then glances sharply away. "That's, uhm, why do you ask...?" You cross your arms. "What's going on with you?" "Nothing!" Kythie insists. "I was just interested, that's all." "Interested in what? Those books aren't exactly easy reading, Kythie." The princess squirms uncomfortably under your inquiring gaze, before finally slumping her shoulders when you refuse to relent. "I was researching something. Someone." Her tail flops into her lap, and she rubs at the smooth blue scales. "Myself." "[pc.isDK|Narcisistic much?"|You think you're going to find yourself in a bunch of old books?"] Kythie waves her hands. "N-no, not like that! Just, sometimes I have strange dreams. Since before the whole curse thing even started, like since I was a kid. I have these really vivid dreams about dragons, and the sea — I've never been to the sea! I thought those books might help, but honestly, I barely understood anything in there. It might as well have been in Macahn for all I could tell. I tried talking to Vasko about it, asked him to help me puzzle out what they were saying, but after a few hours he was more frustrated with me than I was at the books! I just ended up taking them back to the temple..." "So, these dreams... have they changed at all lately?" "You mean since the curse? I... sort of..." Kythie [kythie.lowLibido |blushes a little, and her ears flatten against her scalp. |licks her lips, and her see the flame on her tail start burning a little more intently. ] "The dreams used to be about flying in the open sky, or breathing fire on monsters, or perching up on the top of the palace and just basking in the sun... but now every night I dream about being bred. I'm a huge and powerful and beautiful dragon, and [kythie.fucked |a hero — like you — |a beautiful paladin like Cait ] comes to lift my tail and just ravish me until I'm so full of eggs I can barely move." Kythie presses her thighs together. "And then I wake up and I'm knuckles-deep in myself, drenched in sweat, feeling like my womb's so empty! Like an ache I can't shake off." You [pc.isCunning |whistle |let out a breath ]. That's a hell of a thing. "When did these dreams start?" She shrugs. "I can't really remember a time before it. Dad used to read me stories about dragons, when I was a baby. He said we were descended from them. All salamanders are, and that's why Nareva chose Tychris as her new stronghold, during the Godswar! When the dreams started, I just thought it meant Nareva loved me. [kythie.lowLibido |Not so sure about that now... |Now it seems like she just wants me to get packed full of eggs, like a dragon broodmother! ] So... sorry I didn't really want to mention it before. It's weird!" [ashe.around |Ashe vibrates at your side. "Ask her what color of dragon she is in her dreams." Okay, sure. "Do you remember what you looked like as a dragon? What colored scales?" Kythie makes an embarrassed noise in her throat. "I... remember once I flew over a lake, and shone like a coat of gold and pearls in my reflection. When the light caught my scales, it was blinding. I was like Dad's crown reshaped into a winged tyrant that could rule an empire. I've never felt so powerful, or so beautiful..." You glance down at Ashe. "Sounds familiar..." "Really?" "I'll tell you about it sometime." |[var0 |If Kythie's dreaming of a dragon... you don't know if there's any actual connection, but you do know a dragon not all that far away that's suffering for want of someone with royal blood. Maybe that could be a cure for the horny princess? Ashe's draconic power might be able to break its hold on her! ] ]
rows.translation: 当你提出这个问题的时候，凯西突然吸了一口气，然后迅速将目轻型移开了。“那个，呃，你为什么这么问……？” 你双臂交叉：“你到底怎么了？” “没什么！”凯西坚称，“我只是有点好奇而已。” “好奇什么？什么那些书其实不太容易读，凯西。” 公主在你的询问目轻型下显得很不自在，最终在你坚持不让步的情况下，她只好耸了耸肩。“我当时在研究一些东西一个她的尾巴垂在腿上，她轻轻抚摸着那些轻型滑的蓝色鳞片。“就是我啊。[pc.isDK|有点自恋了吧？|你以为自己会在一堆旧书里找到什么吗？] 凯西挥了挥手部，说道：“不，不是那样的！只是有时候我会做一些奇怪的梦。其实早在整个诅咒事件开始之前，从我还是个孩子的时候就开始有了这样的梦。真的我经常做关于龙和海洋的生动梦境，不过这种事情我以前从未经历过。已经真是无济于事！我本来以为那些书能帮上忙，但说实话，我根本看不懂里面写的是什么。对我来说，那些内容简直就像是用Macahn语言写的一样。我试着跟瓦斯科讨论这些内容，请他帮我弄清楚那些文字的意思，但几个小时后，他对我感到沮丧的程度，甚至超过了我对那些书的困惑！最后，我只好把那些书重新放回寺庙里去了……” “那么，这些梦……最近有没有什么变化吗？” “你是说自从那个诅咒出现之后吗？我……有点吧……”凯西说道。 [kythie.lowLibido |她的脸微微一红，耳朵也贴在了头皮上。 |她舔了舔嘴唇，这时她看到自己尾巴上的火焰燃烧得更加旺盛了。 ] 过去的梦想总是关于在广阔的天空中飞翔，或是向怪物喷火，或是站在宫殿的顶端沐浴阳轻型……但现在却不一样了。每晚我都会梦到自己被繁衍出来的情景。我是一条庞大、强大而美丽的龙，而且 [kythie.fucked |像你这样的英雄 |像凯特这样美丽的圣骑士 ] 过来帮我把尾巴抬起来，就这样。迷住直到我肚子里塞满了东西，动都动不了。” 凯西把大腿紧紧夹在一起，继续说道：“然后当我醒来时，发现自己的身上沾满了自己的分泌物，满身是汗，感觉自己的子宫仿佛空荡荡的就像一种我无法摆脱的痛苦。 [pc.isCunning |口哨 |松了一口气 ]那可真是件了不起的事情……这些梦是从什么时候开始的呢？” 她耸了耸肩：“我真的想不起来在那个之前有什么特别的记忆。我小时候，爸爸经常给我讲关于龙的故事，他说我们都是龙的后裔。所有的蝾螈都是，也就是为什么在神战期间，娜瑞瓦会选择提克里斯作为她的新据点！当这些梦开始出现的时候，我以为只是因为娜瑞瓦爱我罢了。 [kythie.lowLibido |现在我不太确定了…… |现在看来，她似乎就是想让我变得像一条龙的雌性守护者一样，浑身布满蛋！ ] 所以……很抱歉，我之前其实并不想提到这件事。真是有点奇怪啊！ [ashe.around |阿什站在你身边，轻声说道：“去问问她，在梦中她想象中的龙是什么颜色的。” “好吧，没问题。”你问道，“你还记得自己变成龙时的样子吗？那鳞片是什么颜色的？” 凯西喉咙里发出一声尴尬的声响。我……记得有一次，我飞过一片湖泊，我的身躯在湖水中反射出金光与珍珠般的光芒。当光芒照射到我的鳞片上时，那光芒简直令人睁不开眼。那时，我就像爸爸的王冠被改造成了一个拥有翅膀的暴君，一个能够统治整个帝国的存在。我从未感觉自己如此强大，如此美丽……” 你低头看了看艾希，说道：“听起来有点耳熟……” “真的吗？” “改天我会告诉你这件事的。 |[var0 |如果凯西梦见了一条龙……虽然你不确定这两者之间是否存在真正的联系，但你知道，在不远处确实有一条龙，因为它缺乏拥有王室血脉的生物而陷入困境。或许，这正是治愈这位欲望旺盛的公主的关键？艾什拥有的龙之力，或许能够解除它对她的控制！ ] ]

rows.original: "So, who's Laz?" you ask. "And why does he need to apologize to you so badly?" "Oh, [kythie.lowLibido |fu- ahh! |fuck! ]" Kythie groans. "You didn't need to see that..." You put your hands on your hips. "It could be important." "It's not! It's private! That [kythie.lowLibido |Laz |stupid brat or a boy ] is Lazaran en Felurze — my betrothed. His uncle passed me a personal letter from my fiance when he came to see the Tycathalon, and that's all." The princess is seething — and something tells you it's about more than just having her mail read. [kythie.lowLibido |You [pc.isDK |frown |put a hand on her shoulder, feeling the warmth rising to the surface in her. Uh-oh. ] "Take it easy. Just tell me what happened." |You put your hands up, watching with alarm as Kythie starts huffing and puffing. "Take it easy. I just want to know what happened. No need to get worked up." ] Kythie [kythie.lowLibido |sighs, stepping away from you. |snarls, flinching away when you step closer. ] "It's none of your business, [pc.name]! It's not the curse making me angry, it's that idiot boy and his stupid- grah!" She doubles at the waist, clutching at her head. Her tail-flame blazes behind in, a roiling cascade of boreal colors. "Stupid, stupid, stupid! Right in my own gardens!" [pc.isBimbo |You quickly close the distance, grab Kythie's hands, and yank her into a big, squishy hug. The princess squirms, trying to fight back, before finally sighing and slumping into your embrace. "Sorry..." "It's okay," you say, petting her hair. "Do you want to talk about it?" A few long seconds pass. "My stupid fiance... Laz, he... I've known him since we were little. I thought we'd be together forever. But he doesn't love me! He never has!" Kythie groans. "There's a priestess, Glys, who's like... like a handmaiden to his family, I guess? Her mother was Laz's wetnurse. I thought she was nice, but she seduced Lazaran! I walked in on them kissing! It was bullshit and horrible and I keep seeing it every other time I close my eyes and, and, ahhhhh!" You stroke the princess's hair and hold her close. There, there. She chokes back an angry sob, before finally pushing away and flopping onto her bed. |"Calm down!" "Fuck you!" Kythie snaps, throwing herself onto her bed. "Fuck you, fuck him, fuck everybody!" rows.original: "Philandros? Philaaaaandros?" Kythie rolls the name in her mouth, scratching at her cheek. "Yeah, it's kind of hard not to know the name. He was the reigning princeps right when the Godswar broke out, I think. He had a son, Philander, that died right at the start of the war." She pauses to think. "He helped found the Order Astrida, right? Near the middle of the war, when things were desperate and Nareva'd become the city's patron directly. He's got a statue right outside, celebrating his heroism." "So he is one of your ancestors?" "Sort of," Kythie says. "I haven't exactly memorized the royal genealogy but I'm pretty sure we're actually descended from his nephew, who took the throne. Or maybe it was a cousin. None of Philandros's trueborn children survived the war." Ah. "So [kythie.lowLibido |why the question? |what's with the question, huh? ] [kythie.isCursed |Do you think my... ancestry has something to do with it? |That interested in me, are you? ]" "I met a giant in the forest, back near Hawkethorne. She said she'd sworn an oath to Prince Philandros, and won't let me past her because of it. I was hoping maybe you'd know why?" Kythie blinks. "A giant? Uh.... what?" You explain what happened: the jotun woman appearing out of seemingly nowhere, challenging you with an axe, then claiming she belonged to what now appears to be an ancient and long-dead monarch of Tychris. "I can't imagine! It's been, what, two hundred and fifty years? I guess the northern-er you are the longer you live, in the cold. I've heard that a few times from Vasko... But she can't have just been sitting there for all that time, right?" "Hard to say. But she's going to keep sitting there unless I find a way to convince her. Any ideas?" Kythie grimaces. "You're asking me for ideas? Oh gods, you must be desperate." She laughs nervously. "I don't know, and I doubt anybody alive in the city knows she's even there! If she's waiting for her prince to relieve her of her obligation, she's going to be waiting a lot longer too!" You let Kythie think on that a moment more, watching the princess's brows furrow. She's really rubbing those braincells together for you. "Uhm, well, maybe you could bring her something that belonged to Prince Philandros? I don't know if she'd care about a royal writ from Dad, but a symbol from the princeps! I know Lady Eirina has a ring that belonged to Philandros — it's like the signet of the whole Order Astrida. Show that to your giant lady and maybe she'll give you a pass!" "Hey, that's an idea," you tell her, [kythie.fucked |leaning in and planting a kiss on her lips. |clasping her shoulder. ] "[pc.isDK |See, you're smarter than you look." "Hey!" |Thanks!" Kythie swishes her tail. "N-no problem." ] Time to talk to Lady Eirina, then.
rows.translation: “菲兰德罗斯？菲——兰——德——罗斯？”凯西把名字在嘴里滚了一圈，挠了挠脸颊。“是啊，想不知道这个名字都难。我记得诸神之战爆发那会儿，在位的亲王就是他。他有个儿子叫菲兰德，战争刚一开始就死了。”她停下来想了想。“他是帮助创立阿斯特里达教团的人之一，对吧？那大概是战争中期，局势最绝望、娜瑞瓦直接成了这座城的守护神的时候。外面就有一座他的雕像，纪念他的英勇。” “所以确实是你的祖先之一？” “算是吧，”凯西说。“我也没把王室族谱背下来，但我相当确定我们其实是他侄子那一脉的后代，后来是那位侄子继承了王位。也可能是个表亲。菲兰德罗斯的嫡亲子女没有一个活过那场战争。” 啊。 “那么[kythie.lowLibido |你为什么问这个？ |问这个干嘛，嗯？ ] [kythie.isCursed |你觉得我的……血统跟这事有关系？ |就这么对我感兴趣，是吗？ ]” “我在鹰棘镇附近的林子里遇到一个巨人。她说她曾向菲兰德罗斯王子立下誓言，就因为这个不让我过去。我还指望你也许知道原因？” 凯西眨了眨眼。“一个巨人？呃……什么？” 你解释了事情的经过：那个约顿女巨人不知从哪儿冒了出来，提着斧头向你挑战，随后声称自己属于一位如今看来早已作古的提克里斯古代君主。 “我想不通！那都过去……两百五十年了吧？我猜越往北边去，人在寒冷里活得就越久。这话我从瓦斯科那儿听过好几次……可她总不能真在那儿干坐了那么久吧？” “难说。但除非我找到办法说服她，否则她会一直坐在那儿。有什么主意吗？” 凯西苦着脸。“你居然问我要主意？哦，天哪，你肯定是走投无路了。”她紧张地笑了笑。“我不知道，而且我怀疑城里活着的没人知道她在那儿！如果她是在等她的王子来解除她的义务，那她还得等更久呢！” 你让凯西再多想了一会儿，看着公主的眉头拧成一团。她为了你可真是把脑细胞搓得冒火。“呃，那个，也许你可以带一件属于菲兰德罗斯王子的东西给她？我不知道她会不会在意我父王颁发的王室文书，但从亲王本人那里来的信物就不一样了！我知道艾瑞娜女士有一枚属于菲兰德罗斯的戒指——那就像是整个阿斯特里达教团的印玺。把它拿给你的巨人女士看，说不定她就会放你过去了！” “嘿，这倒是个主意，”你告诉她，[kythie.fucked |凑过去在她嘴唇上亲了一下。 |握住她的肩膀。 ] “[pc.isDK |看吧，你比看上去要聪明。 “嘿！” |谢谢！” 凯西甩了甩尾巴。“没、没问题。” ] 那么，该去找艾瑞娜女士谈谈了。

rows.original: "Why? Oh, I could hardly count the reasons, Champion!" Tethys growls, fixing you with a withering look. "Thore is nothing but an upjumped bandit masquerading as a lord, and his misbegotten son is no better than his father. They killed Count Julius in cold blood when he dared to stand up against their company's demand for tribute and now squat on his grave like a pack of vultures. They burned his daughter alive! And then there's the brutal stranglehold over trade he's exerting — one can hardly move goods across the River Maiden without Thore taking a princely cut. He commands the safest crossing of the river for fifty leagues in either direction and is delighted to remind anyone who'll listen. Damned mongrel peasant delights in rubbing his new position in the face of everyone around him!" The lady-consort pauses, and takes a deep breath. "And that is why Felurze is so important, Champion. The city commands the second safest crossing of the Maiden. It's no Belharan stone, but it's stood unharmed for ten years. It's become a lifeline for our city's goods to reach southern markets. You must understand how dangerous it already is, moving anything to Old Belhar. Risking the Maiden in the process is too much. She's savage, particularly this time of year." "Ten years," you murmur. "But Kythie's been betrothed to Lazaran longer, hasn't she? Before Count Thore took over, too." "Yes, yes. Count Julius only had the one daughter; no sons to speak of. I oft wondered if Maidenbridge suffered the same... weakness of the blood... that afflicts so many northern realms. It hardly matters now. Lazaran was always our pick. His parents are good friends, and staunch allies. His uncle Asher, too. Evander's been close with him since they were small." Tethys laughs dryly. "If my husband had been born a woman I suspect we'd have a prince-consort Asher today. Does that answer your question, Champion? I'll not have Kythie's hand bound to that of a usurper and murderer, and that is the end of that!" Yeah, you got it alright. [kythie.isCursed |Considering how steadfast Tethys is in refusing him, one wonders if that would be motive enough to make Count Thore resort to... darker means of encouraging her to accept the offer? ]
rows.translation: “为什么？哦，冠军，这理由我数都数不过来！”泰西斯低吼着，用一道能把人剜掉一层皮的目光盯住你。“托雷不过是个暴发户土匪，披着一张领主的皮；他那个孽种儿子也不比老子强。朱利叶斯伯爵胆敢站出来反抗他们商会索取的贡赋，就被他们冷血地杀害，如今他们又像一群秃鹫似的蹲在他的坟头上。他们还把他女儿活活烧死！再说他对贸易的那套残暴钳制——想沿梅登河运货，托雷不抽走一笔亲王级别的分成，你几乎寸步难行。他掌控着上下游各五十里格内最安全的渡口，还乐此不疲地提醒每一个愿意听的人。这该死的杂种泥腿子，就爱把自己新得的地位甩到周围每个人脸上！” 这位亲王妃顿了顿，深吸一口气。“所以费卢尔泽才这么重要，冠军。那座城控制着梅登河第二安全的渡口。它比不上一座贝拉兰石桥，可十年来一直安然无恙，已经成了我们城中货物运往南方市场的一条命脉。你必须明白，往旧贝尔哈运货本来就已经够危险了。再拿梅登河去冒险，代价太大。这条河很凶蛮，尤其是每年这个时节。” “十年，”你低声说。“可凯西跟拉扎兰订婚的时间更长，对吧？而且还是在托雷伯爵上位之前就订下的。” “是啊，是啊。朱利叶斯伯爵只有一个女儿，没有值得一提的儿子。我常想，梅登布里奇是不是也患上了那种……血脉上的虚弱……困扰着北方那么多王国的毛病。如今这些都无所谓了。拉扎兰一直是我们的人选。他父母是我们的好友，也是坚定的盟友。他叔叔阿舍尔也一样。埃万德从小就和他亲近。”泰西斯干笑一声。“要是我丈夫生来是个女人，我猜今天我们就会有一位王夫阿舍尔了。这样算回答你的问题了吗，冠军？我绝不会把凯西的手绑到一个篡位者和杀人犯手上，这事到此为止！” 嗯，你算是问明白了。 [kythie.isCursed |想想泰西斯拒绝得如此坚决，不知道这够不够成为动机，让托雷伯爵动用……更阴暗的手段逼她接受这门亲事？ ]

rows.original: You glance back at Cait. "Do you think you could help Kythie out, Cait?" The kitty-cleric blinks, raising her brows. "Me?" Her gaze quickly turns to Tethys. "Would you be okay with that? I'm not a Champion like my [pc.name] here, but I know a thing or two about sating desires! It'd be my pleasure to help, if you'd consent to it." "Goodness knows Kythie can't," Tethys says with a sigh. "If you know how to help my daughter, Cait, I'd be grateful." Cait looks between you both, and then slaps one of her own biceps. "I can treat the symptoms, anyway. You 'manders don't go into heat, do you? So something's causing it, something magic or poisonous, or maybe yeah, a curse. I don't know what I can do about that. But she's going nuts, and I, well, I'm a Mallachite. There's no greater sin to my god than twisting passion into suffering. [pc.name] was right to call me. I'll do everything I can to help. Just... I hope you know what that means?" "I do." Tethys glances away, chewing on her lip. "In other circumstances I'm sure you two would have been good friends, Cait. If you are confident in your ability, then... then I will ask you to be more than that to her, for as long as it takes for us to find a cure. Please, sister, ease her suffering." Cait gives her a firm nod. "I'll try. No, I will." She looks to you and flashes a smile. "Don't worry about me. She might be strong, but I've got [silly |reach and |feline ] flexibility on my side. And a whole lot of Mallachite training." Yeah she does. "Good luck, Cait." [flags.CAIT_KISS |Cait leans in and kisses you. "Don't wait up. Go find her cure." |"I don't need luck. I've got skill!" ] Tethys opens the door and ushers Cait inside. The pink kitten gives you a wink, and then she's gone. All you hear from inside is more banging around, Cait hissing, and then a number of heavy, fleshy impacts. The lady-consort winces. "I... will she be alright?" "She's fine," you say with confidence. "Now I'll get back to work." "Godspeed, Champion."
rows.translation: 你回头看向凯特。“凯特，你觉得你能帮帮凯西吗？” 这位猫娘牧师眨了眨眼，挑起眉毛。“我？”她的目光很快转向泰西斯。“你介意我这么做吗？我可不像我这位[pc.name]那样是冠军，但安抚欲望这种事我还是懂一点的！只要你同意，我很乐意帮忙。” “天知道凯西自己是没办法的，”泰西斯叹了口气说，“凯特，如果你知道该怎么帮我女儿，我会很感激。” 凯特看了看你们两人，然后拍了拍自己的一条肱二头肌。“总之，我可以治标。你们火蜥蜴人不会发情，对吧？所以肯定是有什么东西在作祟，某种魔法或者毒素，又或者，对，是个诅咒。那个我该怎么办，我也不知道。但她快疯了，而我，嗯，我是马拉克信徒。对我的神来说，没有什么罪比把激情扭曲成痛苦更重了。[pc.name]叫我来是对的。我会尽力帮忙。只是……我希望你明白那意味着什么？” “我明白。”泰西斯移开目光，咬着嘴唇。“换作别的情况，我相信你们俩一定会成为好朋友，凯特。如果你对自己的本事有信心，那么……那么我就请你对她做得比朋友更多，直到我们找到解药为止。拜托了，姐妹，减轻她的痛苦吧。” 凯特坚定地朝她点了点头。“我会试试。不，我一定会。”她看向你，露出一个笑容。“别担心我。她也许很强壮，但我有[silly |臂展和 |猫科 ]的柔韧性在我这边。还有一大堆马拉克信徒的训练。” 她确实有。“祝你好运，凯特。” [flags.CAIT_KISS |凯特凑过来吻了你。“别等我了。快去找治她的解药吧。” |“我不需要运气。我有的是本事！” ] 泰西斯打开门，把凯特领了进去。那只粉色的小猫朝你眨了眨眼，然后就消失了。你只能听见里面又一阵乒乓乱响、凯特的嘶声，接着是好几下沉重而肉感的撞击声。 这位王后皱了皱眉。“我……她会没事吧？” “她没事的，”你信心十足地说，“现在我得回去干活了。” “诸神保佑你，冠军。”

rows.original: The curvy consort's cheeks turn crimson, and her eyes dart away. "That's not... any of your business, Champion. Really." You put your hands on your hips. "You told me to investigate. Don't stonewall me over this." There's a mix of anger and shame on Tethys's face, and for once the plush salamander's slow to answer, weighing her words. Finally, she sighs. "It's an old job, something I had Vasko's predecessor working on too. Vasko's been trying various things for me, to help, but-" "Help with what, Tethys?" "Fertility!" she says, barely a hiss over [kythie.highLibido |the pounding of her daughter against the door |the whip of the wind past the tower. She certainly doesn't want Kythie to overhear ]. "Evander and I wanted more children, but the gods clearly had other plans! But we never stopped wanting, even today. I thought... I hoped, and prayed, that Vasko might find a solution. But my prayers go answered, then as now." "Why all the secrecy, then?" "Do you think I want the court to know I can't have children, Champion? That my childbearing years were robbed from me by war? It is a mark of shame, that I could not give my Evander the family he wanted. I failed him! I failed Kythie! I remember the way she'd look at her cousins and beg me for a sister, too... but there's nothing I can do. Nothing! Even the Lumians give me platitudes rather than solutions. Vasko's just another disappointment in a long, painful parade of them." Tethys draws in a deep, steadying breath. "Are you satisfied?" Yeah, that answers that...
rows.translation: 这位曲线玲珑的王妃双颊绯红，目光飘向别处。“那可不是……你该管的事，冠军。真的。” 你双手叉腰。“是你让我去调查的。别拿这种话搪塞我。” 泰西斯的脸上混杂着愤怒与羞愧，这位丰腴的蝾螈人难得地迟迟没有作答，斟酌着自己的措辞。终于，她叹了口气。“那是件老差事，我以前也交给瓦斯科的前任办过。瓦斯科一直在为我尝试各种办法，想帮上忙，可——” “帮什么忙，泰西斯？” “生育力！”她说，那声音轻得几乎只是一声嘶鸣，勉强盖过 [kythie.highLibido |她女儿撞门板的声响 |掠过塔楼的风声。她当然不希望凯西偷听到 ]。“埃万德和我本想再要几个孩子，可神明显然另有安排！但我们从未停止过渴望，直到今天也一样。我以为……我希望过、祈祷过，瓦斯科或许能找到办法。可我的祈祷从未得到回应，从前如此，如今依然。” “那又何必瞒得这么严实？” “你以为我想让宫廷知道，我生不出孩子吗，冠军？我生育的岁月是被战争夺走的？我没能给我家埃万德他想要的家庭，这是我的耻辱。我对不起他！我对不起凯西！我记得她看着她的堂表亲们，央求我给她添个妹妹的样子……可我什么都做不了。什么都做不了！就连卢米亚人人也只会给我空洞的慰藉，而不是解决的办法。瓦斯科不过是那一长串令人痛苦的失望里，又一个罢了。” 泰西斯深深吸了一口气，稳住自己。“你满意了吗？” 是啊，这就算问明白了……

rows.original: "I know who's responsible for Kythie's curse," you tell the consort. "And it's been dealt with." "You- you what!?" Tethys's eyebrows vanish into her bangs. She draws a sharp breath, blinks, and fixes you with a her gaze. "Explain. Please. Not that I am unhappy with the news, but I feel like I've been kept in the dark." Probably for the best, considering the culprit... You take a breath of your own. "It was Vasko. He was planning on selling her out to a new suitor, once you couldn't handle watching her suffer anymore waiting on her fiance." Tethys's lips twist with every word you say, emotions flying across her features, from shock to seething rage in the span of seconds. Her fists ball, and her tail-flame blazes. "That bastard! After everything we've done for him. Elevating base-born scum like him, out of the goodness of our hearts, and he repays us with betrayal! Hurting my daughter! I'll have him flayed!" [vasko.isDreamless |"The Order Astrida has already done worse," you tell her. "Lady Eirina took custody of him. He's being made Dreamless now." The salamander's fist strikes the wall. "Damn it! Is that justice, for all the pain and suffering my girl's gone through? He- ah!" She groans, rubbing her face. "I apologize, Champion. You've done well, truly. I only wish to have seen him suffer in kind for what he's done. But I suppose to a man who's made his way in the world wholly on a talent for magic, perhaps having his one redeeming quality be stripped away is punishment enough for now." |"You don't need to worry about Vasko anymore," you assure her. "Or rather, Vaska." She gives you a flat look. "Pardon?" You lean up against the wall. "Well, if he wanted to hurt your daughter, I figured the best thing to do was make sure he'd never want to hurt anybody again. Stripped all [pc.isBimbo |those nasty, mean, evil thoughts right out — and gave her a rockin' set of titties while I was at it. She's so hot now, and just like me. Basically harmless! |his malice out and replaced it with cheery, cock-hungry bimbofication. He's basically harmless now. ] The matron-salamander's expression barely changes. "You... you did what?" "Want to come see?" you suggest, gesturing towards the stairs. "You have nothing to worry about from her now." "Her," Tethys murmurs. "You really just... turned Vasko into a woman!? And you think that will undo the damage he — she — has done?" You shake your head. "It won't undo it, but I've made sure it won't happen again. All Vaska's going to be doing for the rest of her life is drooling over your guards' dicks. You might want to look into hiring a new magister." You can tell Tethys is coping with a wild swing of emotions: anger, confusion, outrage, shock. Finally she seems to just settle on annoyance. "Very well. I will... investigate what you have done, but for now, I shall trust your judgement. You've left me little choice." ] Tethys sighs, but squares her shoulder. "With the traitor dealt with, there should be no chance of the curse afflicting Kythie once she is cured, correct?" You nod. "Then I will contact Lady Eirina and arrange for another uncursing. I would like you to attend, [pc.name]. You [kythie.fucked |have... given my daughter much comfort, since arriving |are responsible for her salvation, after all ]. [var0|You as well, Lady Caitriss. My daughter's grown quite fond of you." Cait blushes, tail wagging. "O-of course, Lady Tethys! It'd be my honor." Tethys turns her attention back to you. "]Tomorrow at sunrise. Meet us in the great hall. We shall conduct our business then." "Tomorrow, then." Tethys puts her hand on the door with a faint smile. "Rest easy, Kythie. You'll be freed of this curse before you know it. This time for good."

rows.original: "Tethys, I think we need to face facts," you tell her gently. "I think the only cure for Kythie is what she's been screaming for." The consort's gaze hardens. "Explain yourself, Champion. And choose your words carefully." You take a deep breath. "Kythie's body isn't cursed. She's been changed, and the only thing that can ease her suffering for more than a few moments is fulfilling that craving. She's in heat, Tethys. Her body's just craving a baby." Tethy's shoulder flinches; you realize it's taking every bit of self control she has not to just lay you out for that. She takes a breath through her nose and thumps her fist on the stone wall, refusing to look at you for a few moments. "You're lying. Or incompetent. Or just another charlatan like the Astrida! There must be a way past this!" "There is, Tethys! There's a way to calm her down tomorrow! You just need to stop burying your head in the sand, for Kythie's sake!" The way her tail blazes with fury is a sight to behold, but she still doesn't lash out. "You know I'm right, Tethys," you say. "Kythie needs this." "Kythie has a fiance!" she seethes. "Too young to bed, by the gods' own laws. What would you have me do?"

rows.original: "You too?" Tethys snarls. "You and Vasko both hiss into my ear, like a pair of serpents. My girl deserves better than to be sold like a mare to a bandit playing as a lord!" You sigh. "Tethys you aren't selling her, you're saving her. Maidenbridge wants her, and they won't mind the state she's in. They won't ask questions. The count's heir will treasure her!" "And I would be an oathbreaker! Felurze will-" "Think about your daughter!" you all but shout, cutting her off. "Do you want to listen to her humping the wall for another year?" That makes Tethys flinch, glancing towards the door. "That's unfair, Champion." You seize the initiative. "But it's true. She's suffering, Tethys. You're the only one who can actually help her. You've just got to let her go." "She's my child. My baby girl. I... how can I...?" "Talk to the man from Maidenbridge. Tell him you accept. He'll take care of the rest." You say. Hopefully you're right. "Kythie can be on her way tomorrow." Tethys rubs at her eyes. "Is there truly no other hope? There must be-" "It's her body, Tethys. It knows what it needs. We just have to help her get it." You can see the will draining from Tethys's face, right along with her color. She slumps against the wall, still grinding her fist into the stone, breathing heavily through her nose. "You... gods damn you to the pit, but you're right. Kythie can't wait a year for Lazaran to mature. No oath is worth her suffering like this." Tethys squares her shoulders and pushes away from the wall. "I am sorry, Champion. This is difficult for me. But you give good council. I will... speak with Gaspare. Perhaps the vulture-lord he serves really is desperate enough to take Kythie, in this state." She shakes her head. "We will... speak in the morning. Come to the Great Hall. I will have made my final decision by then." You nod. "Tomorrow, then."
rows.translation: “你也是？”泰西斯咆哮道。“你和瓦斯科都凑到我耳边嘶嘶作响，像两条蛇。我的女儿值得比这更好的——不该像个母马一样，被卖给一个扮作领主的匪徒！” 你叹了口气。“泰西斯，你不是在卖她，你是在救她。梅登布里奇想要她，而且不会在意她现在的状况。他们不会多问。伯爵的继承人会珍爱她的！” “那我不就成了背誓之人！费卢尔泽会——” “想想你的女儿！”你几乎是吼出来的，打断了她。“你还想听她抱着墙蹭上一年吗？” 这话让泰西斯一颤，朝门口瞥了一眼。“这不公平，冠军。” 你抓住这个时机。“但这是事实。她在受苦，泰西斯。只有你才能真正帮到她。你只需要放手让她走。” “她是我的孩子。我的宝贝女儿。我……我怎么能……？” “去和梅登布里奇来的人谈。告诉他你接受。剩下的他会处理。”你说。但愿你说得没错。“凯西明天就能上路。” 泰西斯揉着眼睛。“真的没有别的指望了吗？一定还有——” “这是她的身体，泰西斯。它知道自己要什么。我们只要帮她得到就行。” 你能看见泰西斯脸上的意志正一点点流失，血色也随之褪去。她颓然靠在墙上，拳头仍在石面上磨着，用鼻子重重地呼吸。“你……神明把你打入深渊去吧，可你说得对。凯西没法再等拉扎兰一年长大成人。没有任何誓言值得她这样受苦。” 泰西斯挺直肩膀，从墙边推开身子。“我很抱歉，冠军。这对我来说很难。但你的建议很好。我会……去和加斯帕雷谈谈。也许他侍奉的那位秃鹫领主真的急到愿意接受凯西现在这副模样。”她摇了摇头。“我们……早上再谈。到大殿来。到那时我会做出最终决定。” 你点点头。“那就明天。”

You lean against the wall and let her stew in it, coming to the conclusion as much as it pains her. "I will... talk to Evander. Another year of hearing my daughter scream and howl cannot be worth an oath made a lifetime ago. Come and seek us in the great hall, tomorrow morning. We will deliver our decision then." You nod. "The sooner you decide, the sooner I can start helping Kythie." |[kythie.fucked |I've already fucked her. |I'm a Champion, you know. ] Who's better qualified?" Tethys snorts. "You're lucky I want to keep this whole affair quiet. I'd have you whipped in any other circumstance! Count yourself fortunate you've had the privilege to [kythie.fucked |so much as touch |behold ] my daughter, peasant." She practically spits the word. "All of this, and you're just hungry for a way to elevate yourself, aren't you? At my daughter's expense, no less!" She jabs a finger at you. "You're trying to shatter my hope to bed my daughter, and I will not stand for it. Not now, not ever. Get out! Get out! You see the guards, normally just out of earshot of your quiet conversations, starting to approach. Okay, okay... you blew it. Fuck! ] "

rows.original:
"You know who's cursed my little girl?" Tethys's eyes light up, and her fist clenches. "Tell me, please. I'll strangle the life out of the scoundrel myself."
    
    Well, who will you accuse?
rows.translation:

    那么，你要指控谁？

rows.original: You suspect the court's own magister is behind all this!

rows.raw: "You suspect the court's own magister is behind all this!"

rows.original: The Count of Maidenbridge is clearly conspiring to get Kythie for himself.
rows.translation: 梅登布里奇的伯爵显然在图谋把凯西弄到手。
rows.raw: "The Count of Maidenbridge is clearly conspiring to get Kythie for himself."

rows.original: You think Prince Lazaran, or someone in his inner circle, is behind all of this.

rows.raw: "You think Prince Lazaran, or someone in his inner circle, is behind all of this."

rows.original: Tethys narrows her eyes. "Please, don't get my hopes up, Champion. I can't stomach it!"
rows.translation: 泰西斯眯起眼睛。“拜托，别让我空欢喜一场，冠军。我可受不了！”
rows.raw: "\n    Tethys narrows her eyes. \"Please, don't get my hopes up, Champion. I can't stomach it!\"\n    "

rows.original:
"I think Ynes of Courlund is behind all of this," you tell her. "She certainly has plenty of reasons to hate this city."

"Who?" Tethys asks, brow furrowing.

"She works at the temple," you say. "She seems really suspect to me."

Tethys puts her hands on her hips. "What evidence do you have, Champion?"

You grimace. "None, but-"

"Please! You have to give me something..." Tethys groans. "If she works for the temple, I can hardly march across the street and demand the Astrida hand her over. I'd spark a crusade. As tempting as it is. Get me evidence!" 

You take a step back. "I'll keep looking!"
rows.translation:
“我认为这一切都是科伦德的伊内斯干的，”你告诉她。“她当然有充分的理由憎恨这座城。”

“谁？”泰西斯问道，眉头皱了起来。

“她在神殿里做事，”你说。“我觉得她非常可疑。”

泰西斯双手叉腰。“你有什么证据，冠军？”

你表情一僵。“没有，但是——”

“拜托！你总得给我点东西……”泰西斯呻吟道。“如果她在神殿做事，我总不能直接冲过街去，要求阿斯特里达把人交出来。那会引发一场圣战。虽然这念头挺诱人的。给我拿到证据！” 

你退后一步。“我会继续查的！”

rows.original: Tethys snarls. "I should have known! That blackhearted scoundrel has wanted Kythie for years. Now that she's of age, he's seized his chance!" The curvy consort strikes her palm to the wall. "But how? How has he managed to do this? His agent has only just arrived." [flags.GASPARE_TLK_THORE |"Thore has a witch as his concubine, and she's the mother of his son, Theo," you tell her. "She must be trying to elevate her son, since Thore didn't marry her." Tethys frowns. "Of course. I knew he had a pyromancer in his court, but I never realized she was the mother of his heir. I only knew the blackguard had married a commoner. If she's behind this..." She pauses, rubbing her chin. "A job for the Astrida, perhaps, rather than war. A chance to redeem themselves for failing to break my daughter's curse. They can haul her before me and force her to explain how she keeps hexing Kythie!" Well, if Tychris' relationship with Maidenbridge was already rocky, this will surely tank it. Tethys strikes fist to palm. "So be it. I will convey our desire to Lady Eirina. Surely she will see me on official business of the Order, now. In the meantime, [pc.name], I will command her to send an Astrida to break the curse once more. Return at dawn tomorrow, in the grand hall. We shall reward you for your diligence then." |You shrug. "I don't know." "Then what do you know?" Tethys snaps back. "How do you know Thore's responsible?" "It's obvious!" you insist. Tethys groans. "Find me some shred of evidence, [pc.name]. Please. rows.original:
Tethys glowers at you. "I hope you have some proof for this accusation, [pc.name]! Why on earth would Kythie's betrothed curse her? And how?"
    
    [flags.KYTHIE_BED
        |"I found a letter between Lazaran and Kythie," you tell her. "He doesn't love her, Tethys. In fact, he's in love with his priest companion. Kythie found out, and the two of them fought. Seems like she actually attacked him..."
        
        That only deepens Tethys's scowl. "So... what? You believe that Lazaran was so upset that hired some witch to come and curse my daughter? That still doesn't answer who's behind it, or how they're managing this!"
        
        "Could the priestess not be behind this?" you suggest. "She has the most to gain from breaking the prince and princess up — she'd be sure to win Lazaran's hand and become his consort."
        
        Tethys growls, but she doesn't say it's impossible. Finally, she says, "I find this hard to believe. Still, I will... look into this. But you must provide harder evidence if you mean to accuse a prince. I cannot act without hard evidence."
        
        Fine, you'll keep looking.
        |You fidget on the spot. "Call it a hunch. They just don't seem like a good match."
        
        She scowls harder. "Champion! If you have no evidence, keep such opinions to yourself. They are unwelcome."
        
        Fine, fine. You'll keep looking.
    ]

泰西斯怒视着你。“我希望你对这项指控有证据，[pc.name]！凯西的未婚夫究竟为什么诅咒她？又是怎么做到的？”
    
    [flags.KYTHIE_BED
        |“我找到了一封拉扎兰和凯西之间的信，”你告诉她。“他不爱她，泰西斯。事实上，他爱上的是他那位祭司同伴。凯西发现了，两人就吵了起来。看起来她当时真的动手打了他……”
        
        这话只是让泰西斯的眉头皱得更深。“所以呢？你认为拉扎兰气得雇了个女巫来诅咒我女儿？这仍然没说明是谁在背后操纵，也没说明他们是怎么做到的！”
        
        “会不会是那位女祭司在背后搞鬼？”你提议道。“拆散王子和公主，她能得到的最大——她一定能赢得拉扎兰，成为他的王妃。”
        
        泰西斯低吼了一声，但并没有说这不可能。最后她说：“我觉得这很难相信。不过，我会……查一查。但如果你想指控一位王子，就必须拿出更硬的证据。没有铁证，我不能行动。”
        
        好吧，你会继续查下去的。
        |你局促地站在原地。“就当是直觉吧。他们看起来实在不般配。”
        
        她的脸色更阴沉了。“冠军！既然你没有证据，就把这种意见憋在自己肚子里。没人想听。”
        
        好吧，好吧。你会继续查的。
    ]

经过那样一场酣畅淋漓的欢爱，你、凯特和凯西摊在床上，喘着气，互相嬉闹地亲吻、揉摸。尽管[kythie.isCursed|那被诅咒的性欲|性欲依旧高涨]，公主还是令人佩服地让自己平静了下来。毕竟你和[cait.married|你的荡妇老婆|凯特]确实是个了不得的组合。你们两人交换了一个眼神，一起翻过身，在凯西的乳头上留下告别的一吻，让这位[kythie.isDragon|龙女|火蜥蜴人]最后呻吟了一声，然后你们俩才跳下床。 

        [kythie.isDragon|“这笔账我一定会报的！”凯西半心半意地低吼着，在你离开时拍了一下你的[pc.butt]。|“你们俩……呃！”凯西噘着嘴，用尾巴朝你的屁股扫来。你轻松躲过了这记半心半意的攻击。]“算你们走运，我的腿都快没知觉了。”
        
        “重点就在这儿啊！”凯特咯咯笑着说。
        
        你朝公主抛了个飞吻。“好好休息，凯西。”
        
        蔚蓝的美人缩回床上，照做了。
rows.raw:
'
        After all that vigorous lovemaking, you, Cait, and Kythie sprawl out on the bed, catching your breath and trading playful kisses and gropes. Despite her [kythie.isCursed|accursed libido|still-heightened sex drive], the princess is managing to calm herself down admirably. You and [cait.married|your slut-wife|Cait] do make a hell of a team, after all. The two of you exchange a wink, and both roll over to plant a parting kiss on Kythie's nipples, making the [kythie.isDragon|dragoness|salamander] moan one last time before you both bail out of the bed. 

        [kythie.isDragon|"There will be vengeance for that!" Kythie growls half-heartedly, swatting at your [pc.butt] as you leave.|"You two... ugh!" Kythie pouts, swiping at your backside with her tail. You dodge the half-hearted strike with ease.] "You're lucky I can barely feel my legs."
        
        "Thaaaat's the point!" Cait giggles.
        
        You blow the princess a kiss. "Rest up, Kythie."
        
        The azure beauty nestles back into her bed, doing just that.
         
    '

rows.original:
When you step into this small room off the central hall, you're immediately hit by the sulfurous smell of alchemical admixtures burbling away, drawing your attention to a black cauldron sitting on the room's fireplace. Grey-green steam rises from inside, clinging thickly to the brick. 
    
    You've entered a laboratory, of that there's no doubt. The trestle table running through the middle of the room is overflowing with glass tubes and mixers, open books full of [pc.isMage
        |arcane runes and spell-script
        |magical nonsense
    ] are splayed out three volumes deep in places, taken from shelves that occupy every wall but the further of them, where an open door besides the fireplace reveals a messy, unkept bed and clothes strewn across the ground. 
    
    The place is a mess, and the man inside seems to like it that way. 
    
    A tall salamander man in black robes is stalking between the shelves and table, muttering to himself as he flips the pages of a tome. Magister Vasko, you remember, the same man who was following the princeps and his consort when you first arrived. He's so engrossed in his work that not only has he not noticed you come in, he can't even be bothered to keep his tail from dragging on the floor as he paces. 
    
    You cough and rap your knuckles on the door. 
    
    "Shit!" 
    
    The magister snaps his tome shut and whirls to face you. His tail slams into one of the bookshelves behind him, sending parchment stacked up atop the tomes tumbling to the ground. He sucks in a sharp breath, squeezing his eyes closed a moment, before his shoulders slump. "Apologies, Champion, I didn't see you come in."
rows.translation:
当你走进中央大厅旁这间小房间时，一股炼金药剂咕嘟冒泡散发出的硫磺味立刻扑面而来，把你的注意力引向房间壁炉上的一口黑色大锅。灰绿色的蒸汽从锅里升起，浓稠地附着在砖墙上。 
    
    毫无疑问，你走进了一间实验室。横贯房间中央的搁板桌上堆满了玻璃管和搅拌器，翻开的书里尽是 [pc.isMage
        |奥术符文与法术文字
        |魔法胡言乱语
    ]，有些地方叠了三卷之厚；这些书取自四面墙上的书架——唯独最里面那面墙除外，那里壁炉旁一扇敞开的门露出一张凌乱不堪、无人打理的床，衣物散落一地。 
    
    这里一片狼藉，而里面的那个男人似乎就喜欢这样。 
    
    一个身穿黑色长袍的高大火蜥蜴人男子正在书架和桌子之间来回踱步，一边翻着一本大部头的书页，一边自言自语。你记得，他就是瓦斯科大师，也就是你初到时跟在元首和他的配偶身后的那个人。他太专注于自己的工作了，不仅没注意到你进来，连踱步时尾巴拖在地上都懒得管。 
    
    你咳了一声，用指关节敲了敲门。 
    
    “该死！” 
    
    大师啪地合上书，猛地转身面向你。他的尾巴重重撞上身后的一个书架，把堆在书册顶上的羊皮纸全都扫到了地上。他倒吸一口气，闭眼片刻，随后肩膀垮了下来。“抱歉，冠军，我没看见你进来。”

rows.original: You made him spill all that paper. Help him tidy up — the way this place looks, he might never do it on his own.
rows.translation: 你让他把那些纸都弄乱了。帮他把它们整理好吧——看现在这个样子，他肯定自己永远也整理不完的。
rows.raw: "You made him spill all that paper. Help him tidy up — the way this place looks, he might never do it on his own."

rows.original: Keep your distance and ask what he's doing. He doesn't seem that bothered by the mess.
rows.translation: 保持距离，问问他在做什么。他似乎对这种混乱毫不在意。
rows.raw: "Keep your distance and ask what he's doing. He doesn't seem that bothered by the mess."

rows.original: You quickly step in and squat down next to the shelf, starting to gather up the scattered parchment. Vasko mutters [pc.bg scholar |a hissing curse in the draconic tongue |something that sounds like a curse in a language you don't know ], scratching at his arm-scales, before finally bending his knees and joining you. [pc.isMage |While you're gathering these papers up, you inevitably catch glimpses of what's written on them: shorthand notes around diagrams of magic circles, and partial copies of transmutation spells. The most complex and dangerous breed of magic. ] His hands brush over yours a moment, awkwardly fumbling to corral the mess. "Again, apologies," Vasko, says, collecting the papers from you and stuffing them haphazardly back into his bookshelves. "I get lost in my work, you understand. Especially with, well, current circumstances being what they are." "Oh?" "Oh!" Vasko echoes. "Yes, you're not the only one investigating solutions to our princess's problem, [pc.name]. Some are just less, ah, hands on than others." You remember he didn't seem that enthused about your presence in the first place either, and he doesn't sound any happier about it now. "So, Champion, what can I do for you?" he asks, smoothing out his robes. "I assume you interrupted me for a purpose, yes?"
rows.translation: 你迅速上前，蹲在架子旁边，开始收拾那些散落的羊皮纸。瓦斯科低声说道 [pc.bg scholar |用龙语发出的嘶嘶作响的诅咒 |某种在你不懂的语言中听起来像咒语的东西 ]它抓挠着自己的臂甲，最终还是屈服了，跪了下来，加入了你的行列。 [pc.isMage |在你整理这些文件的过程中，不可避免地会看到上面写的一些内容：魔法阵图旁标注的速记笔记，等等。转化法术的部分副本最复杂、也最危险的魔法类型。 ] 他的手部轻轻触碰了一下你的手部，笨拙地试图整理那些凌乱的文件。“再次为我的失误道歉，”瓦斯科边说边从你手部中接过那些文件，随意地把它们塞回书架里。“你懂的，我总是会陷入工作中而忘乎所以。尤其是在目前这种情况下。” “哦？” “哦！”瓦斯科重复道，“没错，你并不是唯一一个在为解决我们公主的问题而努力的人。 [pc.name]有些就是数量较少而已，嗯亲自动手部比起其他人来说，他似乎更不喜欢你的存在。” 你记得，一开始他似乎也不太欢迎你的加入，现在听起来他也没有变得更高兴。 “那么，冠军，我能为您做些什么呢？”他整理着自己的长袍问道，“我想您找我肯定是有事吧？

rows.original: "What's got you so preoccupied?" you ask, nodding towards his book. Vasko's eyes narrow a moment, before he sets the book back into his shelf. "Some of us are pursuing less, shall we say, hands on methods of combating the crisis of the day," he says, giving you an appraising look. "[kythie.caitHelping |I understand you brought a specialist. Even still, |I must say, ] I was against involving you in this. I will be frank about that. But if you can ease her suffering," he enunciates every syllable of the word with discomfort, "then you will have no opposition from me. But I will be working every waking moment to find her cure on my own terms. You understand, I'm sure." "You'd hardly be doing your job otherwise." "Exactly," he says, leaning back against one of the shelves. "It is my duty to solve the magical maladies that might befall Tychris, and her royal family. I am not eager to see my duties being filled by an outsider... but, as I said, Kythie is important to me. I do not enjoy seeing her in this state. Even if I am sure there must be some less debauched means of helping her than Her Grace demands." You remember he didn't seem that enthused about your presence in the first place either, and he doesn't sound any happier about it now. "That aside, Champion, I'm sure you interrupted me for some reason, yes?"
rows.translation: 你为什么这么专注地想着这件事？”你问道，同时朝他的书点了点头。 瓦斯科的眼睛微微眯了起来，随后他把书放回了书架。“有些人，嗯，可以说是在追求一些不那么重要的东西。亲自动手部这些都是应对当前危机的方法，”他说着，同时用评价的目光看着你。[kythie.caitHelping |我明白你请来了专家，不过即便如此…… |我必须说， ] 我本来是反对让你参与这件事的，这一点我必须坦白。但如果你能减轻她的痛苦，”他每个字都说得有些不情愿，“那我就不会反对你。不过，我会利用自己所有的时间去寻找治愈她的方法，而且会按照我自己的方式来行动。你明白的，我敢肯定。” “否则，你就根本算不上是在履行你的职责。” “正是这样，”他说道，靠在其中一个书架上，“解决可能降临在蒂克里斯以及她的王室家族身上的魔法灾难，是我的职责所在。我并不希望自己的职责被外人取代……但正如我所说，凯西对我来说非常重要。看到她处于这种状态，我真的很难过。即使我确信必须总该有一些不那么放荡的方式来帮助她吧，而不是像Her Grace要求的那样。” 你记得，他一开始似乎也不太欢迎你的出现，现在听起来他也没有变得更高兴。 “不过，Champion，你找我肯定是有原因的，对吧？

rows.translation: 来看看瓦斯科有什么要说的。

rows.original: See if the court's magister is up for a little fun.
rows.translation: 看看宫廷法师是否愿意玩点小游戏。
rows.raw: "See if the court's magister is up for a little fun."

rows.original: [silly|Homie ain't|Vasko isn't interested in] playing right now, considering the situation. Either get rid of the stress, or bring him something that'd make him really smile.
rows.translation: [silly|兄弟可没心情|瓦斯科也没兴趣]现在玩，考虑到眼前的情况。要么消除他的压力，要么给他带点能让他真心笑出来的东西。

rows.original: Vasko's up to something suspicious, no doubt about it. Confront him over his lurid research.
rows.translation: 瓦斯科一定在搞什么可疑的名堂，毫无疑问。就他那见不得人的研究当面对质。
rows.raw: "Vasko's up to something suspicious, no doubt about it. Confront him over his lurid research."

rows.translation: 对伊内斯的魔典感兴趣？

rows.original: Spend some time with [vasko.name] and [vasko.numKids 1 2|Chryse|your kids].
rows.translation: 与[vasko.name]和[vasko.numKids 1 2|克丽丝|你们的孩子]共度一段时光。

rows.original:
Dropping your voice to barely a whisper, you sidle up closer to the black-robed magician and ask, "If I had a copy of Ynes's spells..."
    
    Vasko freezes in place. His eyes cut slowly towards you. "And how would you get something like that, Champion? Something the Order Astrida has locked up tighter than Nareva's own knickers."
    
    You shrug, and slide the book out of your pack. "What does it matter? I have it. And I think you want it."
    
    To his credit, Vasko hesitates for a moment, eyes darting between you and the book at the door, analyzing the myriad possibilities in front of him — before he snatches the book, flipping its pages open. "Oh, [pc.name]... this is real, isn't it? Everything Tibercio uncovered. That got him killed, too." He glances at you again. "Why are you giving me this, [pc.name]? What are you planning?"
rows.translation:
你把声音压到几乎耳语，凑近那位黑袍法师，问道：“如果我手上有一份伊内斯的法术……”
    
    瓦斯科僵在原地。他的目光缓缓转向你。“那你要怎么弄到这种东西，冠军？那可是阿斯特里达教团锁得比娜瑞瓦本人的内裤还严实的东西。”
    
    你耸耸肩，从背包里抽出那本书。“那有什么关系？我有。而且我觉得你想要它。”
    
    值得一提的是，瓦斯科犹豫了一瞬，目光在你、书本和门口之间来回游移，盘算着眼前无数种可能——然后他一把夺过书，翻开书页。“哦，[pc.name]……这是真的，对吧？蒂布尔西奥查出来的所有东西。他也因此送了命。”他又瞥了你一眼。“你为什么要把这个给我，[pc.name]？你在打什么主意？”

rows.original: Vasko seems like the kind to enjoy something like this. You just wanted to see him happy.
rows.translation: 瓦斯科看起来就是会喜欢这种东西的人。你只是想看他开心。
rows.raw: "Vasko seems like the kind to enjoy something like this. You just wanted to see him happy."

rows.original: This is a subject of mutual interest to the both of you. You'd hoped Vasko might be able to decipher these magics, and discover anything hidden within.
rows.translation: 这对你们两人来说都是共同感兴趣的话题。你希望瓦斯科或许能解读这些魔法，发现其中隐藏的东西。
rows.raw: "This is a subject of mutual interest to the both of you. You'd hoped Vasko might be able to decipher these magics, and discover anything hidden within."

rows.original: Why shouldn't you give him the book?
rows.translation: 你为什么不该把书给他？
rows.raw: "Why shouldn't you give him the book?"

rows.original:
"Happy?" Vasko murmurs, flipping through the book. "My [pc.mf|good man|dear], I'm ecstatic. This is a treasure trove — and one the Order Astrida has gone to great pains to hide from public eye, without outright condemning its existence to the flames. What wonderful genius, what transformative transmutation!" 

    His eyes continue burning through the pages, devouring each symbol one after the other. It takes him a visible effort to snap the book closed, looking away with a wild-eyed stare. His breath is so quick that the shoulder of his robe slips, revealing more pale, toned chest. "M-my apologies, I get... over-excited." Vasko takes a breath and runs his claws through his hair. "This is just so unexpected. I don't know what to say."
    
    "How about 'thank you?'" 
    
    Vasko takes a step forward, clasping your hands in his. "Thank you, yes. Thank you. This is an incredible gift. Now, I should... I should hide this away somewhere. You picked a hell of a place to do this, you know."
    
    "It's not like you ever leave the office."
    
    "I- I do! Just... not lately," Vasko huffs. "Right. Yes. You're right. I should... stop making a mess of this. Thank you. Let's leave it at that."
rows.translation:
“开心？”瓦斯科翻着书，低声念道。“我的[pc.mf|好先生|亲爱的]，我简直欣喜若狂。这是一座宝库——而且是阿斯特里达教团费尽心力要藏起来、不让世人看到的东西，却又没有公开宣判它的存在该被投入火焰。多么了不起的天才，多么具有转化力的变形术！” 

    他的双眼继续烧灼着书页，一个接一个地吞下每个符号。他费了明显的力气才把书合上，移开视线时眼神狂乱。他呼吸急促得连长袍的肩部都滑落下来，露出更多苍白、线条紧实的胸膛。“对——对不起，我……太兴奋了。”瓦斯科吸了口气，用爪子捋过头发。“这实在太出乎意料了。我都不知道该说什么。”
    
    “说句‘谢谢你’如何？” 
    
    瓦斯科上前一步，双手握住你的手。“谢谢，没错。谢谢你。这是一份不可思议的礼物。现在，我该……我该把它藏到什么地方去。你知道，你挑了个见鬼的地方做这件事。”
    
    “说得好像你什么时候离开过办公室似的。”
    
    “我——我有的！只是……最近没有，”瓦斯科气呼呼地说。“对。是的。你说得对。我该……别再把这搞得一团糟了。谢谢你。就这样吧。”
rows.raw:
'
    "Happy?" Vasko murmurs, flipping through the book. "My [pc.mf|good man|dear], I'm ecstatic. This is a treasure trove — and one the Order Astrida has gone to great pains to hide from public eye, without outright condemning its existence to the flames. What wonderful genius, what transformative transmutation!" 

    His eyes continue burning through the pages, devouring each symbol one after the other. It takes him a visible effort to snap the book closed, looking away with a wild-eyed stare. His breath is so quick that the shoulder of his robe slips, revealing more pale, toned chest. "M-my apologies, I get... over-excited." Vasko takes a breath and runs his claws through his hair. "This is just so unexpected. I don't know what to say."
    
    "How about 'thank you?'" 
    
    Vasko takes a step forward, clasping your hands in his. "Thank you, yes. Thank you. This is an incredible gift. Now, I should... I should hide this away somewhere. You picked a hell of a place to do this, you know."
    
    "It's not like you ever leave the office."
    
    "I- I do! Just... not lately," Vasko huffs. "Right. Yes. You're right. I should... stop making a mess of this. Thank you. Let's leave it at that."
    '

rows.original: "Ah, of course. A wise decision, if dangerous. Thank you for trusting me with this, [pc.name]. It's hard to believe I finally have Tibercio's work in my hands, after all these years." His words trail off, eyes devouring the pages. "This is a treasure trove — and one the Order Astrida has gone to great pains to hide from public eye, without outright condemning its existence to the flames. What wonderful genius, what transformative transmutation!" "Don't get lost in there, Vasko," you caution. With great effort, the magister snaps the book closed. "Of course. At least not until you're out of the room. Ha, a joke. A joke!" That doesn't sound like a joke. But either way, you've made a very happy 'mander today.
rows.translation: “啊，当然。明智的决定，虽然有些危险。谢谢你信任我，[pc.name]。真难相信，过了这么多年，蒂布尔西奥的成果终于到了我手里。”他的话渐渐低了下去，双眼贪婪地吞噬着书页。“这是一座宝库——而且是阿斯特里达教团费尽心力要藏起来、不让世人看到的东西，却又没有公开宣判它的存在该被投入火焰。多么了不起的天才，多么具有转化力的变形术！” “别在里面迷路了，瓦斯科，”你提醒他。 法师费了极大的力气才把书合上。“当然。至少等你出了这房间再说。哈，开个玩笑。开玩笑的！” 那听起来可不像玩笑。不过无论如何，你今天让一位‘螈’非常开心。

rows.original:
"Why- because this, what, stolen goods from the Order Astrida?" Vasko's eyes devour the pages as he speaks. "This is a treasure trove — and one the Order Astrida has gone to great pains to hide from public eye, without outright condemning its existence to the flames. What wonderful genius, what transformative transmutation! And yet, you'd just give it to me, of all people?"
    
    "I still don't see why not."
    
    "I- ha! I don't either, I suppose! I love a mad[pc.mf
        |man
        |woman
    ] like you!" Vasko's tail wags side to side, and he clutches the book to his chest. "You're a damned agent of chaos, [pc.name], but... I can't say I mind it." He shakes his head. "Thank you, for whatever insanity brought you to this course of action. I'll make good use of this..."
    
    That's what you were hoping to hear!
rows.translation:
“为什么——因为这个，怎么，从阿斯特里达教团偷出来的赃物？”瓦斯科一边说一边双眼吞噬着书页。“这是一座宝库——而且是阿斯特里达教团费尽心力要藏起来、不让世人看到的东西，却又没有公开宣判它的存在该被投入火焰。多么了不起的天才，多么具有转化力的变形术！可你偏偏要把它交给我，还是交给我这种人？”
    
    “我还是看不出有什么不可以。”
    
    “我——哈！我想我也看不出来！我就喜欢你这种疯[pc.mf
        |男人
        |女人
    ]！”瓦斯科的尾巴左右摇摆，把书紧紧抱在胸前。“你真是个该死的混乱使者，[pc.name]，不过……我没法说我介意。”他摇了摇头。“谢谢你，不管是什么疯病让你做出了这个决定。我会好好利用它的……”
    
    这正是你想听到的！

rows.original: Ask Vasko to tell you a little bit about himself. Your initial meeting was rather brusque, after all.
rows.translation: 让瓦斯科跟你讲讲他自己吧。毕竟，你们最初的见面方式相当生硬。
rows.raw: "Ask Vasko to tell you a little bit about himself. Your initial meeting was rather brusque, after all."

rows.original: How did Vasko end up in this position of high influence?
rows.translation: 瓦斯科是如何走到如今这个拥有如此大影响力的位置的呢？
rows.raw: "How did Vasko end up in this position of high influence?"

rows.original: What does Vasko know about the princess's dilemma?
rows.translation: 瓦斯科对公主面临的困境了解多少呢？
rows.raw: "What does Vasko know about the princess's dilemma?"

rows.original: So how are things in the principality, outside the palace?
rows.translation: 那么，在王宫之外，这个公国的情况究竟如何呢？
rows.raw: "So how are things in the principality, outside the palace?"

rows.original: Are there any other noteworthy magicians in the city? Does Vasko have any real competition?
rows.translation: 这座城市里还有其他值得注意的魔术师吗？瓦斯科真的有竞争对手吗？
rows.raw: "Are there any other noteworthy magicians in the city? Does Vasko have any real competition?"

rows.correctionNote: 该话题问的是瓦斯科从敞开的窗户看到了什么，「窗口视图」是软件界面用词。

rows.original: Vasko's one of the only people in the palace who keeps his window open, and his office is right above Kythie's favorite tree. Did he see something that night?
rows.translation: 瓦斯科是宫殿里为数不多会打开窗户的人之一，他的办公室正好位于凯西最喜欢的那棵树的正上方。那么，那个夜晚他是否看到了什么呢？
rows.raw: "Vasko's one of the only people in the palace who keeps his window open, and his office is right above Kythie's favorite tree. Did he see something that night?"

rows.original: You've slept together, but what does that mean to Vasko?
rows.translation: 你们虽然一起睡过，但这对瓦斯科来说意味着什么呢？
rows.raw: "You've slept together, but what does that mean to Vasko?"

rows.original: The words have barely left your mouth before Vasko's rolling his eyes. "Really? [kythie.isCursed |Our princess is cursed, and you're bothering me with small talk? |Must you? ]" He sighs. "Do you have nothing better to do, Champion?" [pc.dcb |"Somebody's touchy," you grumble. |"Surely you can spare a minute or two? I'd just like to get to know you." |"Aww, come on. Please?" you ask, giving him the puppy-dog eyes. ] Vasko throws his hands up. "What do you want from me? I'm the damned court magister: I cast spells for a living. "Well, how did you get this job?" you ask. It's like pulling teeth with [pc.isDK |this fucking nerd |this guy ]. "Many, many, many years of hard work. Unlike most of the people in this palace I wasn't born into the role... but I see you picked up on that, or why would you have asked?" He sighs. [pc.isCunning |And he's got a complex about it, excellent. ]"So you feel like you stand out a little?" "A little, oh, yes. Just a bit. A skosh." Vasko leans against his work table, scruffy blue hair fringing his face. "I am sure the highborn of the court are constantly asking themselves how the poor farmboy wormed his way into the palace. They certainly do little to disguise their jealousy that I have the princep's ear more readily than they." He snorts. "I'm sorry, what was the point of this inquest again?" [vasko.fucked |You put a hand on his shoulder. "I just wanted to get to know you a little better..." He bristles a moment, then sighs. "I'm sorry. You understand, I don't like to speak about myself here. The nobles look down on me just because I wasn't born in the city walls. Those bastards look down on anyone whose somethings-great grandfather wasn't taking it up the ass from Prince Philandros during the Godswar! This city is so mired in hidebound traditionalism that it can't recognize talent — and it hates it when talent surfaces anyway." |You put your hands up. "Just trying to talk." "Yes, well, let's keep our talk to matters of import. My business is none of yours, Champion." ]

rows.original: [vasko.fucked |Vasko rubs the bridge of his nose. "Why are you asking?" You give him a disarming smile. "Just curious. You said people were upset that you were the court's mage. I want to understand why." |"What, because I'm not highborn?" he says, giving you a dark look. "No," you say, "because you said everyone was against you here. If that's the case, how did you end up here anyway?" ] The salamander's shoulder relax, just a little. "Like I said, a lot of hard work. I suppose I should count myself lucky that I was born into Nareva's own domain, where even farm children are expected to be able to read. You can't say that about the poor in Old Belhar.[pc.bg slumrat |" "Yeah, tell me about it..." you murmur. You're one of the lucky few. Vasko gives you a surprisingly sympathetic look. " | ]I took to reading young and never stopped. Eventually my parents got tired of my howling for books and sent me to the temple. Kicked me out, really, at all of ten years old. They wanted me to become an acolyte; instead, I found the first man that looked wizardly and grabbed onto his tail like a lost babe. Yapped that I would be the best apprentice in the world if he'd take me in, that I'd do anything for him if he'd just show me how to cast a single spell." A faint smile plays across the magister's lips. "I had no idea he was the magister. I could have been whipped for grabbing such an august member of the court. Probably should have been." Vasko shakes his head. "But instead, he just scooped me up and asked what in the world I was doing in the plaza all by myself. It wasn't until years later I learned that he went around to my parents' farm that night and gave them a real piece of his mind, after I told him my story. All I knew was that he brought me to his home, fed me, and let me run loose in his library. I'd never been happier in my life... and seeing me devour those books cemented in my master's mind that I was worthy of his attention." "Even still..." Vasko says, looking to his shelves, "even after years spent in his tutelage, learning everything I could from him... years of grueling nights burning the wick down reading every damned book in his estate thrice over until I could recite them from memory, in the end my success came down to a quirk of fate as much as my own work." "Oh?" Vasko's lips twist. "My master and his husband had no children. No heir to pass on the title of magister to. Only by that good fortune was I even considered for the position... and Prince Evander made sure I worked my ass off to prove I was worthy of it. As did my master. Court Magister is a title coveted by every noble that can conjure and cantrip, and as my master ailed, I was made to compete against them all." "Clearly you won." "Clearly!" Vasko snarls. "Though not without enduring every manner of treachery — character assassination, sabotage, nothing was above those bastard brats short of outright killing me. And I am sure they would have tried, were we not all under the careful watch of the Order Astrida. [pc.isCunning|]Only the Court Magister has the right to operate without their oversight in this city[pc.isCunning|]; the rest of us were watched like hawks. Even still, their family and vassals would conspire... and I overcame them all!" You can feel the pride radiating from the salamander. For a frostscale, he's positively burning with it. "And now," he says, "I have comfortably put them all in their place. Those who challenged me find themselves cast to the edges of the realm, far from the city, and all their families can do is make their snide remarks. They have no real power. Not as I do."
rows.translation: [vasko.fucked |瓦斯科揉了揉鼻梁，问道：“你为什么这么问？” 你向他露出了一个让人放松的微笑，说道：“只是好奇而已。你之前说过，因为你是法庭的法师，所以有些人对此感到不满。我想了解一下原因。 |什么，就因为我不是贵族出身吗？”他说道，同时向你投来阴沉的目光。 “不，”你回答道，“是因为你大家都反对你，对吧？如果真是这样，那你究竟是怎么来到这里的呢？ ] 蝾螈的肩膀稍微放松了一些。“就像我说的，一个很多这是努力的结果。我想，能够出生在娜瑞瓦的领地，确实应该算是我的幸运——在这里，就连农家的孩子也被期望能够识字。但在老贝尔哈尔，穷人们可就没有这样的机会了。[pc.bg slumrat |是啊，跟我说说吧……”你低声说道。你是那少数幸运的人之一。 瓦斯科用一种出人意料的同情目光看着你。 | ]我开始沉迷于阅读，而且从未停止过。最终，我的父母受够了我不停地索要书籍，于是把我送到了寺庙。实际上，他们是在我十岁的时候把我赶了出去。他们希望我成为一名寺院弟子，然而我却找到了第一个看起来像巫师的人，就像一个迷路的小婴儿一样紧紧抓住他的尾巴不放。我当时拼命恳求他，告诉他如果他收我为徒，我一定会成为世界上最优秀的学徒；只要他教我如何施展一个法术，我愿意为他做任何事。” 法师的嘴角浮现出一丝淡淡的微笑：“我当时根本不知道他其实就是那位法师。我抓了一个如此高贵的宫廷成员，简直应该被罚一顿鞭子……或许真的应该如此。”瓦斯科摇着头说道，“但相反，他竟然把我抱起来，问我究竟为什么会一个人出现在广场上。直到多年后，我才得知，在我向他讲述了自己的遭遇之后，那个晚上他专门去了我父母的农场，把他们狠狠地训了一顿。当时我只知道，他把我带到了自己家里，给我吃了东西，还让我在他的图书馆里自由活动。我这辈子从未如此开心过……看到我现在的样子，你们应该也能感受到吧。吞噬那些书籍让我深信，自己确实值得他的关注。” “然而……”瓦斯科望着自己的书架说道，“即使在他指导下度过了许多年，从他那里学到了所有能学到的知识……即使花费了无数个夜晚，反复阅读他收藏的每一本书，直到能够将它们全部熟记于心……但最终，我的成功在很大程度上还是取决于命运的安排，而不仅仅是我的努力。哦？” 瓦斯科的嘴角微微扭曲：“我的主人和他的丈夫没有孩子，也没有继承人可以继承‘大师’的头衔。正是由于这个原因，我才有机会获得这个职位……而埃万德王子也确保我必须全力以赴，证明自己确实配得上这个位置。我的师父也是这样。对于每一个会施法、会使用戏法的高贵贵族来说，“宫廷法师”这个头衔都是他们梦寐以求的。而当我的师父身体不适时，我就被迫与他们所有人竞争。 “显然你赢了。” “当然！”瓦斯科怒吼道。尽管我不得不忍受各种各样的背叛行为——包括人格诋毁、蓄意破坏，甚至那些混蛋们不惜采取任何手段来置我于死地。我敢肯定，如果不是因为阿斯特里达组织一直在密切监视着我们，他们肯定会尝试真的把我除掉。 [pc.isCunning|]只有宫廷法师才有权在这座城市中独立行事，无需他人的监督。[pc.isCunning|]而我们其他人，则像猎鹰一样被他们监视着。即便如此，他们的家人和附庸们还是会密谋……但我成功地击败了他们所有人！” 你能感受到这种自豪感从这只火蜥蜴身上散发出来。对于一只霜鳞生物来说，这种自豪感简直令他浑身散发着光芒。“现在，”它说道，“我已经把他们全都摆到了该在的位置上。那些敢于挑战我的人，都被赶到了王国的边缘，远离了城市；他们的家人所能做的，也只是说些刻薄的话而已。他们根本没有真正的权力——不像我。
rows.raw: ' [vasko.fucked |Vasko rubs the bridge of his nose. "Why are you asking?" You give him a disarming smile. "Just curious. You said people were upset that you were the court's mage. I want to understand why." |"What, because I'm not highborn?" he says, giving you a dark look. "No," you say, "because you said everyone was against you here. If that's the case, how did you end up here anyway?" ] The salamander's shoulder relax, just a little. "Like I said, a lot of hard work. I suppose I should count myself lucky that I was born into Nareva's own domain, where even farm children are expected to be able to read. You can't say that about the poor in Old Belhar.[pc.bg slumrat |" "Yeah, tell me about it..." you murmur. You're one of the lucky few. Vasko gives you a surprisingly sympathetic look. " | ]I took to reading young and never stopped. Eventually my parents got tired of my howling for books and sent me to the temple. Kicked me out, really, at all of ten years old. They wanted me to become an acolyte; instead, I found the first man that looked wizardly and grabbed onto his tail like a lost babe. Yapped that I would be the best apprentice in the world if he'd take me in, that I'd do anything for him if he'd just show me how to cast a single spell." A faint smile plays across the magister's lips. "I had no idea he was the magister. I could have been whipped for grabbing such an august member of the court. Probably should have been." Vasko shakes his head. "But instead, he just scooped me up and asked what in the world I was doing in the plaza all by myself. It wasn't until years later I learned that he went around to my parents' farm that night and gave them a real piece of his mind, after I told him my story. All I knew was that he brought me to his home, fed me, and let me run loose in his library. I'd never been happier in my life... and seeing me devour those books cemented in my master's mind that I was worthy of his attention." "Even still..." Vasko says, looking to his shelves, "even after years spent in his tutelage, learning everything I could from him... years of grueling nights burning the wick down reading every damned book in his estate thrice over until I could recite them from memory, in the end my success came down to a quirk of fate as much as my own work." "Oh?" Vasko's lips twist. "My master and his husband had no children. No heir to pass on the title of magister to. Only by that good fortune was I even considered for the position... and Prince Evander made sure I worked my ass off to prove I was worthy of it. As did my master. Court Magister is a title coveted by every noble that can conjure and cantrip, and as my master ailed, I was made to compete against them all." "Clearly you won." "Clearly!" Vasko snarls. "Though not without enduring every manner of treachery — character assassination, sabotage, nothing was above those bastard brats short of outright killing me. And I am sure they would have tried, were we not all under the careful watch of the Order Astrida. [pc.isCunning|]Only the Court Magister has the right to operate without their oversight in this city[pc.isCunning|]; the rest of us were watched like hawks. Even still, their family and vassals would conspire... and I overcame them all!" You can feel the pride radiating from the salamander. For a frostscale, he's positively burning with it. "And now," he says, "I have comfortably put them all in their place. Those who challenged me find themselves cast to the edges of the realm, far from the city, and all their families can do is make their snide remarks. They have no real power. Not as I do." '

rows.original: Vasko sighs and plops himself down in a chair behind his workbench. "It's a curse, and an illusive one. Self-replicating, if the Order Astrida are to be believed — which, I should stress, is not something I recommend. Make up your own mind, the goddess of secrets' servants shouldn't be taken at face value any more than Keros's." [party.has kiyoko |Kiyoko huffs. ] [pc.ra kitsune |You furrow your brow at him. ]"And what do you think, then?" "I think it's biological in nature. An affliction of her womanhood... Tethys won't listen to me when I try and explain it, damn her pride, but the girl's in heat. She's randy as a cat, and for the same reason. She could solve this problem tonight if she'd let her daughter spread her legs properly." "You really think it would be that easy?" Vasko nods. "I'd stake my career on it. And I would have to — have offered to — to prove the point. But Tethys and Evander are obsessed with their daughter's asinine marriage pact, as if that will somehow save the principality all on its own, and refuse to confront reality: their daughter's body is craving a child, and it won't stop until that heat's been quenched by a man's seed." [pc.bg noblescion courtesan minstrel |You know that's a much harder ask for nobles than perhaps even Vasko is aware, or at least willing to acknowledge. Breaking marriage pacts is a good way to kick off a war, or invite an assassin's blade. |That's a hell of a bold claim... ] "So what's your solution, exactly?" Vasko glances past you, making sure nobody else is eavesdropping from the doorway. Even still, his voice drops to a whisper. "I know what spell Kythie's betrothed will use to check that she is a maiden, and I am developing a countermeasure. Something to fool their priest. She's got another year before her fiance is of age to come up here, plenty of time to grunt out a quick bastard and spirit it away to a monastery somewhere. This need not even damage the princess's reputation, if she remains sequestered during the months she shows..." "That's not much of a solution. What if the curse comes back after she's had her child?" Vasko shrugs. "By then she'll be on the cusp of marriage. Her husband can tend her needs. As Tethys herself keeps saying, I'm sure an energetic young man won't mind a wife desperate to drain him until she's with child. Most men fantasize of just that." A grim fate for the poor girl... "That's a [pc.isDK |shitty |poor ] solution. We have to be able to do better." Vasko scoffs. "Good luck, Champion. I'll be here when you see sense."
rows.translation: 瓦斯科叹了口气，一屁股坐到工作台后面的椅子上。“这是一种诅咒，而且是一种会迷惑人的诅咒。若阿斯特里达教团的话可信，它还能自我复制——我得强调，我并不建议相信他们。你自己拿主意吧，秘密女神那些仆人的话，不该比凯罗斯的仆人更值得当真。” [party.has kiyoko |清子哼了一声。 ] [pc.ra kitsune |你朝他皱起眉头。 ]“那么，你是怎么想的呢？” “我认为这本质上是生理性的。是她女性器官的毛病……我试着向她解释时泰西斯根本不肯听，该死的自尊心，但这姑娘正在发情。她像猫一样发骚，原因也一样。只要她肯让女儿好好张开双腿，今晚就能解决这个问题。” “你真觉得会有那么容易？” 瓦斯科点点头。“我愿意拿我的职业生涯打赌。而且我本来就得——本来已经提出要——证明这一点。但泰西斯和埃万德一心执着于女儿那荒唐的婚约，仿佛那东西单靠自己就能拯救整个公国，他们拒绝面对现实：他们女儿的身体在渴求一个孩子，在男人的种子浇灭那股热潮之前，它是不会停下的。” [pc.bg noblescion courtesan minstrel |你知道，对贵族来说，这件事比瓦斯科或许意识到的、或者至少比他愿意承认的要难得多。撕毁婚约很容易引发战争，或者招来刺客的刀锋。 |这可真是个大胆得吓人的说法…… ] “那么，你的解决方案究竟是什么？” 瓦斯科越过你的肩膀瞥了一眼，确认门口没有别人在偷听。即便如此，他的声音还是压成了耳语。“我知道凯西的未婚夫会用什么法术来查验她还是处女，我正在研究一种对策。用来骗过他们的祭司。她还有一年时间，她的未婚夫才到能上这儿来的年纪，足够她赶紧生下一个私生子，再把它偷偷送到某座修道院去。只要她显怀的那几个月里闭门不出，这甚至不会损害公主的名声……” “这算不上什么解决办法。要是她生完孩子后诅咒又回来了怎么办？” 瓦斯科耸耸肩。“到那时她就快结婚了。她的丈夫可以满足她的需求。就像泰西斯自己一直说的，我相信一个精力充沛的年轻人不会介意有个急于把他榨干到怀孕的妻子。大多数男人幻想的正是这个。” 这可怜姑娘的命运真惨……“这真是 [pc.isDK |烂透了 |可怜 ] 的解决办法。我们一定能做得更好。” 瓦斯科嗤笑一声。“祝你好运，冠军。等你想明白的时候，我还在这儿。”

rows.original: [kythie.isCursed |Vasko gives you a dark look. "You suspect the princess's curse is politically motivated, eh? Smart. I do as well. There's no shortage of other noble houses nipping at Evander's heels, ready for the moment the Tychrisian lineage finally dies out. It wouldn't surprise me if an offshoot house was ready to accelerate things while the royal family is small and vulnerable." "What's behind the hostility?" you ask. "Or are they just opportunistic?" "Hah, what's the difference? The nobility are all just sharks wearing salamander faces, entitled to all they can eat by din of strength. The moment they smell blood in the water..." He points upwards, towards the tower, "they'll be ready to tear Evander and Kythie apart." Vasko sneers, shaking his head. "The rural barons have been getting richer and richer these last years, on the backs of their farm laborers' produce. We've had a generation of good harvests here, the best since the Godswar — the land's finally beginning to recover, the Velunites say. The lords that own the land are the direct beneficiaries of it, and they're getting restless. Hungry for more than just wealth. They've been campaigning Evander to expand the borders, seize more land. Maybe all the way to Maidenbridge, to Hawkethorne." The magister pauses, gauging your reaction. "Of course, Evander refuses. He's a man of peace. His lords think he's weak." "Who would stand to benefit the most, is something happened to Kythie?" "Her cousins, of course. Should Kythie die or be declared unfit to rule, they would become the de facto heirs. But I have my doubts. They're city-girls, and have shown a fierce loyalty to Kythie herself. No, I would put the finger towards the rural nobles, at a guess. Baron Ruarc en Rhydan is the strongest of the landed lords, with the largest estate. The other barons listen to him, and he's had success in war against the Lion Witch. If the royal line faltered, he'd be strongly positioned to depose them." "And do you think he'd stoop to something like this?" "Who can say? His peers think he's an honorable man," Vasko says, "but every highborn is trained from a young age to put forward a genial face while they hide a dagger behind their back." |Vasko sighs, leaning back against the wall. "Things have stabilized, now that Kythie is better. A few public appearances have reassured the people that their princess is in good health and spirits after so long sequestered. Evander's taken the opportunity to bring in some of his barons, remind them of his power." "You don't exactly sound thrilled." He answers that with a glower. "I'm glad Kythie is feeling better. Don't doubt that for a second, [pc.name]. But the situation in the city has hardly changed. Perhaps you've bought His Grace another generation, but eventually he'll grow old, and Kythie will have to contend with a new crop of seething sycophants cloying their way into power around her, ready to stab her in the back. Kythie may be [kythie.isDragon |stronger than ever, but even a dragon isn't without a chink in its armor |healthy again, but she's no stronger in her position today than she was before you arrived ]. The bloodline is weak, and the barons are patient. You'll see." ]
rows.translation: [kythie.isCursed |瓦斯科用阴沉的目光看着你：“你怀疑公主的诅咒背后有着政治目的，是吧？挺聪明的。我也有这个想法。其他贵族家族可不少，都在盯着埃万德不放，一旦提克里斯家族最终绝迹，他们就会立刻抢夺权力。如果某个分支家族趁王室成员人数稀少、处境脆弱的时候加快行动，我一点也不会感到惊讶。” “这种敌意背后究竟隐藏着什么？”你问道，“还是说他们只是在伺机而动而已？” “哈，这有什么区别吗？那些贵族不就是一群戴着火蜥蜴人面具的鲨鱼吗？他们凭借力量来攫取一切他们想要的东西。一旦他们闻到水中有血腥味……”他指向上方，指向那座塔，“他们就会立刻迫不及待地想要拆散埃万德和凯西。” 瓦斯科冷笑着，摇了摇头：“这些年来，那些乡下的贵族们依靠农民们的劳动成果，变得越来越富有。我们这里这一代人的收成一直很好，是自神战以来最好的——据维伦信徒说，这片土地终于开始恢复了。拥有这些土地的领主们是这些利益的直接受益者，他们开始变得焦躁不安。他们的欲望不仅仅是财富——他们一直在游说埃万德扩大疆界，夺取更多的土地。也许他们的目标甚至是梅登布里奇，甚至是鹰棘镇。”这位大师停顿了一下，观察着你的反应。“当然，埃万德拒绝了。他是个崇尚和平的人，他的领主们认为他很软弱。” “如果凯西出了什么事，谁会从中获得最大的利益？” “当然是她的表亲们。如果凯西去世或者被认定不适合统治，他们就会成为事实上的继承人。但我对此表示怀疑。他们都是城市里的姑娘，而且一直对凯西本人表现出极大的忠诚。不，我猜，真正应该被怀疑的是那些乡下的贵族们。鲁阿尔克·恩·瑞丹男爵是所有领主中最强大的一个。他拥有最大的领地，其他男爵们也都听他的指挥。在对抗狮女巫的战争中，他也取得了胜利。如果王室血脉出现动摇，他的地位将使他完全有能力废黜他们。” “那你认为他会做出这种事吗？” “谁又能说得准呢？他的同僚们都认为他是个正直的人，”瓦斯科说道，“但每个贵族从幼年时期就开始学习如何表面装出友善的样子，而在背后却隐藏着杀机。” |瓦斯科叹了口气，靠在墙上。“现在凯西的情况好转了，局势也稳定下来了。她参加了几次公开活动，让人们看到，经过这么长时间的隔离，他们的公主身体健康、精神状态也不错。埃万德也趁这个机会，把他的那些男爵们召集过来，向他们展示自己的实力。” “你听起来可不太高兴啊。” 他怒视着回答道：“我当然很高兴凯西的情况好转了。这一点你绝对不要怀疑，[pc.name]。但这座城市的情况几乎没有任何改变。也许你为殿下争取到了又一代人的时间，但他终究会老去，而凯西将会面临另一批蠢蠢欲动的谄媚之徒——他们会削尖脑袋钻进她身边的权力圈，随时准备在背后捅她一刀。凯西或许 [kythie.isDragon |比以往任何时候都更强大，但即便是龙，也难免会有弱点。 |她已经恢复了健康，但如今她所处的处境，并没有因为你的到来而有所改变。 ]这个血脉太弱了，那些男爵们自然会耐心等待的。你等着瞧吧。” ]

rows.original: "Yes, considering the dangerous chemicals we work with, the magister has special dispensation to modify the windows in here," Vasko says, pointing towards the open glass beside his fireplace. "It's been that way for a hundred years, all I had to do with it is replacing the hinge every now and then. Now what's this about some night?" "A few months before the Tycathalon, Princess Kythie and Prince Lazaran had a chance encounter beneath the tree there," you say, walking to the window and pointing straight down. "You seem like the kind of man who'd be up at odd hours, maybe you overheard something?" Vasko sucks on his lower lip, making a visible effort to think back. "Mmm, I wouldn't know if it was Prinze Lazaran or not. I hardly know the boy. But I do vaguely recall a few months ago now, there was a commotion out there in the middle of the night. Kythie was screaming at somebody down there. I have no idea about what, but she was certainly furious." "Did you see anything?" "No, no. I'm not about to involve myself in teenage drama. If she'd sounded like she was in trouble, of course I would have, but it just seemed like an argument to me." Right...
