    ]"
    
    You cross you arms. "I'm not playing at anything. I'm trying to get to the bottom of this curse."
    
    Vasko takes a step backwards. For a moment, you're sure he's about to rabbit... but instead the magister just pulls a chair out from under his work desk and sloughs himself down into it. "Very well, Champion. Let's have it out, then. What do you want from me, exactly?"
    '

rows.translation: 瓦斯科到底在那锅里熬什么？

rows.original: Did Vasko have something to do with Kythie and Lazaran fighting in the garden?
rows.translation: 凯西和拉扎兰在花园里争吵，跟瓦斯科有关吗？
rows.raw: "Did Vasko have something to do with Kythie and Lazaran fighting in the garden?"

rows.original: "What are you trying to do to Kythie, exactly? What's the point of all this?" "All this, sorry?" Vasko says, glancing around. "My [vasko.fucked |dear |word ], I'm trying to help her. Despite what you apparently think, I really do have Kythie's best interests at heart. She's a sweet girl who's done nothing wrong, even if she's been raised in decadent privilege. The girl's suffering unnecessarily; I would like to ensure that comes to an end swiftly." "And exactly how do you plan to do that?" "Kythie needs to bred. Not just laid. Pregnant. With an heir to the city." Vasko says it casually, scratching at his nails. "That's the curse. Ovulation out of control. Now, she's got a fiance that she hates and is too young to bed besides. Terrible match by any metric. She'll be miserable for the rest of her life if she gives her self to Lazaran. Made a cuckold, too, the way the prince lusts after his confessor. I don't want that for Kythie." "And what do you want for her?" Vasko leans back in the chair, crossing one leg over the other. "She has other suitors. One, in particular, stands above all others. Prince Theodane of Maidenbridge. He's old enough, more than willing, and a good match for Kythie. His father's good, strong stock, common-born but ambitious. He's eager for the match. Has been for years. The solution I proposed before Thethys brought you here and exacerbated everything was just to ship her off to County Maidenbridge and let nature take its course."
rows.translation: “你到底想对凯西做什么？这一切究竟是为了什么？” “这一切？抱歉？”瓦斯科说着环顾四周。“我的[vasko.fucked |亲爱的 |天哪 ]，我是在帮她。不管你显然是怎么想的，我心里装的确实全是凯西的利益。她是个甜美的姑娘，什么错事都没做过，哪怕她是在骄奢的特权里长大的。这姑娘正在白白受苦；我希望让这一切尽快结束。” “那你究竟打算怎么做？” “凯西需要被配种。不只是上床。怀上孩子。为这座城市生下继承人。”瓦斯科说得漫不经心，一边抠着自己的指甲。“这就是那诅咒。排卵失控。她有个自己讨厌的未婚夫，而且对方还太年轻，上不了床。怎么衡量都是场糟糕的婚配。如果她把自己交给拉扎兰，这辈子都会过得很惨。那王子对他的告解神官馋成那样，她还得被扣上绿帽子。我不想让凯西落到那一步。” “那你又想让她得到什么？” 瓦斯科靠回椅背，翘起一条腿搭在另一条上。“她还有别的求婚者。其中有一个尤其出挑。梅登布里奇的西奥丹王子。他年纪够大，也极其情愿，对凯西来说是门好亲事。他父亲出身良好、血统强健，平民出身但雄心勃勃。他渴望这门婚事。已经渴望好几年了。在泰西斯把你带来、把事情全都搅糟之前，我提出的方案就是把凯西送到梅登布里奇郡去，让事情顺其自然地发展。”

rows.original: Vasko snorts. "No! You wound me. I don't do what I do for money, [pc.name]. I do it [silly |for the love of the game |because I believe in something ]. Hard to imagine for some [pc.dcb |black-hearted avenger |do-gooder dope |brainless bimbo ], I'm sure. Lazaran is just another weak-blooded simpleton born to privilege and decadence. Not unlike Kythie herself. Both of them are just symptoms of the systems that put them here: traditions of power handed down through blood, rather than merit. That's something Count Thore represents: the common man seizing power from the elites and handing it back to the people." You narrow your eyes. "You're talking about a bandit-king, Vasko." "Yes, he started as one, a decade ago. Times change, Champion. Today the county is actually run by a council of aldermen, elected by the people, with the lord as its head — a first among equals, not an autocratic sovereign. The city prospers through the collective effort of its people, not on the whims of one man. Something we could learn from here, I would say." "So you've done all this for politics!?" "I've not done anything, [pc.name]," Vasko insists, crossing his hands over a knee. "I'm explaining why I have been trying to convince Evander and Tethys to see reason, and take the path before them for the good of not just their daughter, but the realm entire." You sigh. "And you've been talking to Count Thore about this?" "No," Vasko says. "He made his intentions clear publicly. Has done for years. I don't need to conspire with a man to agree with him. That would be tantamount to treason, after all."
rows.translation: 瓦斯科嗤了一声。“不！你这话可伤人了。我做事不为钱，[pc.name]。我做这些[silly |是为了热爱这场游戏 |是因为我信仰着什么 ]。对某些人来说很难想象吧，[pc.dcb |黑心的复仇者 |行善的傻瓜 |没脑子的花痴 ]，我肯定。拉扎兰不过是又一个生在特权与骄奢之中的弱血蠢货。跟凯西本人没什么两样。他们俩都只是把他们推上这个位置的制度的症状：靠血统而非功绩传承的权力传统。而这正是托雷伯爵所代表的东西：平民从精英手中夺回权力，再把它交还给人民。” 你眯起眼睛。“你说的是个强盗国王，瓦斯科。” “没错，十年前他是从强盗起家的。时代变了，冠军。如今那个伯爵领实际上由一个参事会治理，由人民选举产生，领主只是它的首脑——平等者中的第一人，而非专断的君主。那座城市的繁荣靠的是民众的集体努力，而不是某一个人的心血来潮。要我说，我们这里也该学学。” “所以你搞这一切都是为了政治！？” “我什么都没做，[pc.name]，”瓦斯科坚持道，双手交叠搭在膝上。“我只是在解释，为什么我一直在试图说服埃万德和泰西斯认清道理，走上摆在他们面前的那条路——这不只是为了他们的女儿好，也是为了整个王国。” 你叹了口气。“那你跟托雷伯爵谈过这件事？” “没有，”瓦斯科说。“他的意图是公开表明的。已经表明好几年了。我认同一个人，不需要跟他密谋。毕竟那无异于叛国。”

rows.original:
"Oh, come on, that's elementary. Don't bore me with a pedestrian interrogation," the magister sighs. 
    
    You give him a stern look.
    
    "Ugh. Why do you think, Champion? She's interesting, and powerful — or she was, before the Astrida castrated her soul. I wish to preserve what she and her master learned, and... yes, have it for myself. Why not? Have I not earned my place as a royal magister? What magic should be beyond me, by rights? It's a passion for the magical arts, nothing nefarious."
    
    "That's it? You just... feel like you're entitled to it?"
    
    Vasko snorts. "You asked the stupid question, [pc.name]. [pc.isMage
        |Frankly it's disappointing you don't feel the same way.
        |Though you aren't a mage, so I suppose I can understand your own disinterest.
    ]"
rows.translation:
“噢，得了，这根本是入门常识。别拿这种平庸的审问来烦我，”宫廷法师叹道。 
    
    你严厉地瞪着他。
    
    “呃。你觉得是为什么，冠军？她很有趣，也很强大——至少在被阿斯特里达阉割了她的灵魂之前是这样。我想保住她和她的主人学到的东西，而且……没错，我想把它据为己有。有何不可？我这个王家宫廷法师的位置难道不是我挣来的吗？按理说，还有什么魔法该是我碰不得的？这只是对魔法技艺的热忱，没什么邪恶的。”
    
    “就这样？你就……觉得自己理所当然该得到它？”
    
    瓦斯科嗤笑一声。“问蠢问题的是你，[pc.name]。[pc.isMage
        |说实话，你居然没有同样的想法，这让我挺失望的。
        |不过你不是法师，所以我想我也能理解你为什么对此毫无兴趣。
    ]”

    ]"

rows.original:
"Ah, that... unrelated to your current line of inquiry I'm afraid," Vasko laughs. "Tethys has had me working on something for her for years now. That grail's the latest in my long series of investigations, nothing more."
    
    "Working on what?"
    
    Vasko's lips twist. "Ask Tethys. It's not my place to say."
    
    "That's it!?"
    
    "That's it." He spreads his hands. "My work is a state secret. I wouldn't even tell Kythie."
    
    You sigh.
rows.translation:
“啊，那个……恐怕跟你眼下查的事无关，”瓦斯科笑道。“泰西斯让我替她做一件事已经好几年了。那只圣杯只是我一长串调查里最新的一桩，仅此而已。”
    
    “做什么事？”
    
    瓦斯科撇了撇嘴。“去问泰西斯。这不是我该说的。”
    
    “就这样！？”
    
    “就这样。”他摊开双手。“我的工作是国家机密。连凯西我都不会告诉。”
    
    你叹了口气。

rows.original: "Care to explain that rank concoction?" you ask, pointing towards the cauldron. Vasko laughs hoarsely. "Not particularly, but since you're clearly commanding rather than asking... I am trying to reverse engineer the curse affecting Kythie. I believe it's chemical in nature, rather than arcane. Between some herbal compounds my agents have discovered in Hawkstone Barony and a bit of my own research, I'm fairly sure I'm close. I've told you before, Champion... we're working independently towards the same goal: helping Kythie." [pc.isCunning |The slight hint of a smile, the smugness in his voice... you're sure he's lying now. ] "So you just have the poison hurting Kythie lying around in your office, behind magic wards, and don't think that's suspicious?" "Of course it's suspicious. That's why the wards are there. You're the one going snooping; nobody else in the palace would have bothered with anything in my office, much less something warded so heavily." He's just going to brush this off, huh?
rows.translation: “不打算解释一下那锅恶臭的调制品吗？”你指着坩埚问道。 瓦斯科沙哑地笑了。“不太想，不过既然你显然是在命令而不是在询问……我正在试图逆向破解影响凯西的诅咒。我认为它的本质是化学性的，而非奥术性的。结合我的手下在鹰石男爵领发现的一些草药成分，再加上我自己的一点研究，我相当确定自己就快成功了。我说过的，冠军……我们是在各自独立地朝着同一个目标努力：帮凯西。” [pc.isCunning |嘴角那一丝若有若无的笑，他声音里的那股得意……你现在确定他在撒谎。 ] “所以你就把伤害凯西的毒药摆在办公室里、藏在魔法结界后面，还觉得这不奇怪？” “当然奇怪。所以才有那些结界。到处乱翻的人是你；宫里其他人根本不会去碰我办公室里的东西，更别说布了那么重结界的东西。” 他就打算这么把话题糊弄过去，是吧？

rows.original: Vasko's eyebrows raise. "Oh, what, you think I'm some sort of hypnotist now? That I can compel Lazaran to thrust his tongue down a priestess's throat in front of Kythie? Please. The kids are horny and stupid, they don't need my help for that." [flags.VASKO_TLK_WINDOW|Wait a minute. Vasko said he didn't know what happened — just that Kythie was screaming. He's lying!] The magister glances towards the open window. "Besides, the two of them are a terrible match. The sooner they realize that, the better it is for everyone. The princess deserves a man that will cherish her."

rows.original: "Well?" Vasko says. "Have you finished with this farce yet? Come now, Champion. We both have better things to do than point fingers at each other."
rows.translation: “怎么样？”瓦斯科说。“你这出闹剧演完了没有？得了吧，冠军。我们俩都有比互相指着鼻子更值得做的事。”
rows.raw: '\n    "Well?" Vasko says. "Have you finished with this farce yet? Come now, Champion. We both have better things to do than point fingers at each other." \n    '

rows.original: You're convinced that Vasko's the one responsible for Kythie's predicament. This can't be taken back.
rows.translation: 你确信瓦斯科就是造成凯西困境的元凶。这一步无法收回。
rows.raw: "You're convinced that Vasko's the one responsible for Kythie's predicament. This can't be taken back."

rows.original: Vasko stands up and stretches. "Well then, if we're quite finished..."
rows.translation: 瓦斯科站起身，伸了个懒腰。“那么，如果我们都说得差不多了……”
rows.raw: '\n    Vasko stands up and stretches. "Well then, if we\'re quite finished..."\n    '

rows.original: "I know you're behind Kythie's curse. Enough playing dumb." Vasko's genialness evaporates in an instant, replaced by a cold and calculating stare. He rises from his chair, slowly smoothing down the front of his robes. "[pc.fucked |My dear |Champion ], I would advise you not to throw such accusations around without proof.[vasko.anyKids | Think of our [vasko.numKids 1 |daughter |children ]. You're going to make life very difficult for [vasko.numKids 1 |her |them ]... ]" [var0|"I've got plenty," you tell him. "You paid for that salamander scholar to bring you a [silly|tainted|magic] grail, from a temple that sends people into heat. I saw a woman suffering just like Kythie is, and she was working for you. The curse Kythie's suffering isn't just a spell, it's poison — something you'd work on in a grail. You have opportunity, and motive, and means. And I'm ready to go to Lady Tethys with it." "And yet you're still talking to me," Vasko says. "Why? What's your game-plan here, [pc.name]?" |[var1|"I've got plenty," you tell him. "Your poison's an exact match for what's wrong with Kythie. You have opportunity, and motive, and means. And I'm ready to go to Lady Tethys with it." "And yet you're still talking to me," Vasko says. "Why? rows.original: You're actually of a mind to help Vasko. Down with the monarchy!
rows.translation: 你居然打算帮瓦斯科。打倒君主制！
rows.raw: "You're actually of a mind to help Vasko. Down with the monarchy!"

rows.original: "Do you, now?" Vasko murmurs. "And why would I do something like that? The way I see it, it's your word against mine — and I've known Tethys and Evander far, far longer. Everything you have is circumstantial, easily explained away." He clicks his little forked tongue, looking to the shelves. "You're just another [pc.bg noblescion |petty noble with no merit |vagrant biting at this old city's heels ], Champion. A backstop for a desperate woman. You're out of your mind if you think I'll willingly take the fall so you can claim glory. This city needs me." "Need you? You're poisoning the princess!" "The princess would thank me, if she had a mind left for it!" Vasko hisses. "Her worthless engagement will be broken, and she'll be free to find a better man — one that loves her. Cherishes her! A man like Count Thore's son!" "Bullshit." You jab a finger at him. "You're just selling the city out to Maidenbridge, aren't you?" Vasko snarls, runnings his claws through his hair. "No! I want her to go to Maidenbridge so her fucking parents won't have an heir here clogging things up. Another spoiled, blue-blooded brat to keep stepping on the throat of the common man. Without an heir to groom there'll finally be an opportunity to change this city for the better, while Evander is weaker than he's ever been. Imagine a common man with so much influence and power for the first time in this city's history! Imagine what I could accomplish!" Of course, it's all about seizing power for himself! And he just needs Kythie out of the way, hostage in another country, to do it. "You really think you're doing the right thing." "I know I am!" Vasko snorts. "Don't let blind loyalty to a noble paymaster cloud your judgement: this needs to happen; to do otherwise is only delaying the city's inevitable collapse. Another generation, maybe two, and we'll have bred a lord so spineless that she'll roll over for any tin pot warlord or demagogue. This is our best, last chance for meaningful change! You have a chance to be part of something great here, Champion. Don't fuck this up!" Either way, it's clear Vasko's got no intention of repenting.

        |Are you a fucking cliche? 'I'm taking you in' like it's a Western??

"Well! Is that so?" Vasko gives you an appraising look, steepling his fingers. "And just what is it you want to help me with?" ] "Stop playing dumb," you say. "Tell me what you're actually trying to do with Kythie." Vasko clicks his tongue, and leans back in his chair. "It's simple, really. For her own good, despite what it seems. You may think whatever you want of what I'm about, [pc.name], but I do care for the girl. She's done nothing wrong, yet. My aim is simply to ensure she never has a chance to." "Go on." "Her family have run this city into the ground, reduced us to a rump state begging to be conquered the moment a strong rival rises up. Pathetic, mewling nobles each weaker and more spineless than the last. But they command an old and prestigious name, and that carries value in this world, no matter how vapid that is in the face of actual talent at rulership. In the face of real strength. All I want is to make sure she's not married off to another inbred lordling; Kythie needs as husband of strong, virile blood — and the County of Maidenbridge needs the legitimacy of a noble house. Everyone who matters wins, and in the meantime, Tychris is left without an heir around the house for Evander and Tethys to hide their failures behind." "You're just getting her out of the way so you can take power." Vasko curls his nose. "So that I can undo the damage generations of inept rulership has inflicted on our society. So that I can guide the realm towards a more equitable new era, where commonfolk have a voice in governance, rather than bowing to the whims of farmer-barons and peacock generals. Kythie's the last hope of this failing monarchy. I get her out of the city, and I can start to exert real influence here. And another city that's already heading the right direction gains the legitimacy it needs to thrive!" He claps his hands together. "So, if you want to help, [vasko.fucked |darling |[pc.name] ], all you need to do is convince that old cow Tethys that her daughter's only got one hope to cure her plight — what I'd been trying to do before you butted in in the first place — and that's getting pregnant. Her fiance's too young to bed, so ship her off to Maidenbridge where Count Thore's son is ripe for it."

"What, become the next prince-consort myself?" Vasko snort-laughs, rolling his eyes. "Tethys and Evander would sooner lock Kythie in a tower than have her body be sullied by a common man like myself. [kythie.fucked
        |At least, that's what I thought before you came along. But it's too late for that, now. 
    ]No, they'd never go for it. And, as beautiful as Kythie is, I'd be making both of us miserable the rest of our lives. I care for the girl too much for that."
    
    "Not enough to not curse her."
    
    Vasko winces. "A little pain for now is nothing compared to a lifetime!"
rows.translation:
“什么，让我自己当下一任亲王夫婿？”瓦斯科嗤笑着翻了个白眼。“泰西斯和埃万德宁可把凯西锁进塔里，也不会让她的身体被我这种平民玷污。[kythie.fucked
        |至少在你出现之前我是这么想的。但现在说这个已经太晚了。 
    ]不，他们绝不会答应。而且，凯西再美，那样做也只会让我们俩余生都在痛苦中度过。我太在乎这姑娘了，不会那么干。”
    
    “还没在乎到不去诅咒她。”
    
    瓦斯科皱起脸。“眼下的一点痛苦，跟一辈子比起来算不了什么！”
rows.raw:
'
    "What, become the next prince-consort myself?" Vasko snort-laughs, rolling his eyes. "Tethys and Evander would sooner lock Kythie in a tower than have her body be sullied by a common man like myself. [kythie.fucked
        |At least, that's what I thought before you came along. But it's too late for that, now. 
    ]No, they'd never go for it. And, as beautiful as Kythie is, I'd be making both of us miserable the rest of our lives. I care for the girl too much for that."
    
    "Not enough to not curse her."
    
    Vasko winces. "A little pain for now is nothing compared to a lifetime!"
    '

rows.original: [var0 |Vasko leans back, stroking his scaly chin. "Hm! That... might also work, I suppose. You're noble, too, though clearly of stronger stock than anything left in the Frost Marches. You and Kythie'd make strong children. And your domain's not so close to Tychris that the prince would be able to use Kythie's future as a shield to hide his incompetence. I'd still like to help Maidenbridge, but I've made no vows to them — they have no idea I'm responsible either — so I suppose it's no harm, no foul. Better to have you on side than fucking with my plans. So, yes, if that's the path you want to pursue, I won't oppose you." |Vasko shakes his head. "The prince and consort would never consent to it, and if you try and... sneak it in, you'll be lucky if exile's the worst you face. No, she needs someone of standing," he nearly spits the word, "and able to marry her immediately. That's a short list around here, one neither of us is on. If you can pull nobility somewhere out of your ass within the next few days, by all means, but barring that — let's stick to the Maidenbridge plan. It's a sure-win." ] [pc.hasVirileCock |Alternatively, you could take things into your own hands and just impregnate Kythie yourself. They can throw you out of the palace, but they can't un-take their daughter's virginity. It'll ruin her engagement and fix the curse, and bring shame on her and her parents. One neat little package, isn't it? ]

rows.original:
"Now!" Vasko says, hopping to his feet and sweeping across the room. "You need to talk to Tethys. Convince her there's only one cure: packing that womb of her daughter's with virile seed, and the sooner the better. There's already an envoy of Maidenbridge here in the city, asking after Kythie's hand — good fortune, that. If you haven't already, you might want to talk to him. Just don't, uh, say anything about all of this. Better for everyone if he stays in the dark."
    
    "And what'll you be doing?" you ask him.
    
    Vasko gestures around. "Keeping her drugged, until Tethys finally gives. And once she's gone, I'll be ready to move in and take advantage of their weakness. I have a raft of reforms they just need to press the seal to, starting with landholding rights for farmers and fairer taxes for the city's commonfolk."
    
    Right then. To Tethys...
rows.translation:
“那么！”瓦斯科说着蹦起身，大步扫过房间。“你得去跟泰西斯谈。让她相信只有一种解药：往她女儿的子宫里灌满强健的种子，而且越快越好。梅登布里奇已经有个使节在城里，来求娶凯西——真是好运。要是你还没见过他，不妨去跟他谈谈。只是别，呃，别把这一切说出去。他蒙在鼓里对大家都好。”
    
    “那你打算做什么？”你问他。
    
    瓦斯科朝四周一挥手。“继续给她下药，直到泰西斯最终松口。等她一走，我就准备好插手，利用他们的软弱。我有一整套改革方案等着他们盖章，从农民的土地所有权，到给城里平民更公平的税赋。”
    
    好吧。去找泰西斯……

rows.original:
"You're not making a great case for yourself," you say, letting your hand drop to your [pc.weapon]. 
    
    Vasko sighs, rising to his feet. "I'm sorry to hear that, [pc.name]. You almost made a good choice, for once in your life. And now... now I can't exactly let you walk away."
    
    "Just give it up, Vasko." 
    
    The Magister narrows his eyes. You tense, ready for him to try and cast a spell — only for his tail to swipe the table, sending beakers and glass flying right at you!
    
    [var0
        |You duck down and draw your weapon as the glass shatters against the wall behind you. You're not falling for that old trick!
        |You barely manage to shield your eyes before the glass shatters against your arms and chest, slicing into you in a hail of agonizing blades. Fuck, there's blood all over your face! You can't see!
    ]
rows.translation:
“你这可没给自己辩出什么好名声，”你说着把手垂向你的[pc.weapon]。 
    
    瓦斯科叹着气站起身。“听到这话我很难过，[pc.name]。你这辈子总算差一点做了个正确的选择。而现在……现在我可没法就这么放你走了。”
    
    “放弃吧，瓦斯科。” 
    
    宫廷法师眯起眼睛。你绷紧身体，准备好他要施法——结果他的尾巴却扫过桌子，把烧杯和玻璃器皿朝你直直甩了过来！
    
    [var0
        |你低头闪避，拔出武器，玻璃在你身后的墙上砸得粉碎。这种老把戏可骗不到你！
        |你勉强护住双眼，玻璃就砸在你的手臂和胸口上碎裂，化作一阵剧痛的刀锋割进你的身体。操，你满脸都是血！你看不见了！
    ]

rows.original:
Vasko drops to a knee, breathing hard. "What... but how... my magic...?"
    
    You take a step forward and knock the magister's wooden rod from his hand. "Enough, Vasko. [pc.dcb
        |Your magic is nothing compared to me.
        |You've lost. Yield.
        |Stop being a meanie!
    ]"
    
    The magister's teeth clench, but he's got nothing left. No choice but to yield.
    
    "You fool," Vasko groans. "You're just perpetuating the status quo, for what? Another generation of weak-kneed rulers disconnected fr-"
    
    "Shut up!" you snap. "Nothing gives you the right to curse an innocent girl."
    
    Vasko winces. The aurora on the tip of his tail dims. "So, Champion... now what?"
rows.translation:
瓦斯科单膝跪地，喘着粗气。“什么……可是怎么……我的魔法……？”
    
    你上前一步，把宫廷法师手里的木杖打落。“够了，瓦斯科。[pc.dcb
        |你的魔法在我面前不值一提。
        |你输了。认输吧。
        |别再当坏蛋啦！
    ]”
    
    宫廷法师咬紧牙关，但他已经一无所有。除了认输别无选择。
    
    “你这蠢货，”瓦斯科呻吟道。“你只是在维持现状，图什么？又一代软脚虾统治者，跟民众脱fr-”
    
    “闭嘴！”你厉声道。“你没有任何权利去诅咒一个无辜的姑娘。”
    
    瓦斯科皱起脸。他尾尖上的极光黯淡下去。“那么，冠军……现在怎么办？”

rows.original: Bring Vasko to Lady Tethys and make him confess to what's he's done. He will face the law of the state for treason.
rows.translation: 把瓦斯科带到泰西斯夫人面前，逼他坦白自己的所作所为。他将以叛国罪面对国法制裁。
rows.raw: "Bring Vasko to Lady Tethys and make him confess to what's he's done. He will face the law of the state for treason."

rows.original: Bring the 'mander-mage to Eirina, of the Order Astrida. Vasko will be made Dreamless; his magic will be stripped away from him forever.
rows.translation: 把那个蝾螈法师交给阿斯特里达教团的艾瑞娜。瓦斯科会被变成无梦者；他的魔法将被永远剥夺。
rows.raw: "Bring the 'mander-mage to Eirina, of the Order Astrida. Vasko will be made Dreamless; his magic will be stripped away from him forever."

rows.original: Enact your own brand of justice, and ensure Vasko never even wants to hurt anyone again. Fill that mind of his with nothing but harmless horny.
rows.translation: 施行你自己那一套正义，确保瓦斯科连伤害别人的念头都不会再升起。把他那颗脑子塞满无害的发情念头，除此之外什么也不留。
rows.raw: "Enact your own brand of justice, and ensure Vasko never even wants to hurt anyone again. Fill that mind of his with nothing but harmless horny."

rows.original: You need two Bimbo Brews to fully blast a mind as dark as Vasko's.
rows.translation: 要把瓦斯科这样黑暗的脑子彻底轰烂，你需要两瓶笨蛋啤酒。
rows.raw: "You need two Bimbo Brews to fully blast a mind as dark as Vasko's."

rows.original: "You're going to see Tethys and explain to her what you've done to her daughter." Vasko snarls. "You might as well kill me yourself, coward. That brute will only have one thing on her mind." You just haul the traitorous 'mander to his feet and shove him towards the door. "Get moving." [kythie.isCursed |The nearer you draw to the tower, [kythie.highLibido |and the louder Kythie's horny screaming gets, ]the more hopeless Vasko looks. A few of the guards between his lab and the princess's cell give you questioning looks, but they don't stop you. | You march him straight to the lady-consort's sitting room, not far at all from his lab. The single guard between you and there gives you a questioning look, but otherwise doesn't hassle you. ] You find Tethys [kythie.isCursed |pacing in front of Kythie's door. She pauses in her fretting just long enough to frown at the both of you |reclining in her reading chair. She gets up with a frown ]. "What is the meaning of this, [pc.name]? Why are you manhandling my magister?" "Tell her," you say, shoving Vasko towards Tethys. "Go to hell." Tethys's eyes narrow. "Vasko, what have you done?" "He's your culprit," you say, since Vasko's still not owning up to it. "Vasko cursed Kythie." "Is this true, Vasko?" Tethys asks. Her lips draw into a thin line, and a vein pulses above her left eye. But her voice stays even, at least for now. "Are you responsible for my daughter's suffering?" You can practically feel the need to smart-talk her welling up inside the sorcerer; the visceral desire to overflow with sarcasm. But there's no point left. Not under the consort's withering gaze, standing within beating range. He just hangs his head and lets his shoulders go limp. "I am, Tethys. I did it. It was me." Tethys doesn't ask why. She doesn't question. She just strikes Vasko, a full-knuckle punch to the stomach that leaves him reeling against the wall. His tail bracing him is the only thing that keeps him upright. "You damn brute!" Tethys scowls, and whistles to her guard. "Take him. Gag him. Shackle his hands, down to the fingers. Evander will deliver justice in the morning." Vasko gives you a hateful look before strong arms clasp his shoulders, and he's hauled away.
rows.translation: “你要去见泰西斯，亲口告诉她你对她女儿做了什么。” 瓦斯科龇牙咆哮。“你还不如亲自动手杀了我，懦夫。那母夜叉脑子里只会想着一件事。” 你只是把那叛徒蝾螈拽起来，推着他往门口走。“走。” [kythie.isCursed |你越靠近那座塔，[kythie.highLibido |凯西发情的尖叫声就越响， ]瓦斯科看上去就越绝望。从他实验室到公主牢房之间的几个卫兵向你投来询问的目光，但都没有拦你。 | 你押着他径直走向亲王妃的起居室，离他的实验室一点也不远。你们之间那名唯一的卫兵向你投来询问的目光，除此之外并没有为难你。 ] 你找到泰西斯时，她[kythie.isCursed |正在凯西门前踱步。她焦躁不安地停下脚步，只够朝你们俩皱一下眉头 |正靠在自己的阅读椅上。她皱着眉站起身 ]。“这是什么意思，[pc.name]？你凭什么这样粗鲁地对待我的宫廷法师？” “告诉她，”你说着把瓦斯科推向泰西斯。 “去死吧。” 泰西斯眯起眼睛。“瓦斯科，你做了什么？” “他就是真凶，”你说，因为瓦斯科仍然不肯认账。“是瓦斯科诅咒了凯西。” “这是真的吗，瓦斯科？”泰西斯问。她的嘴唇抿成一条细线，左眼上方一根血管突突跳动。但她的声音至少此刻还保持着平稳。“我女儿的痛苦是你造成的？” 你几乎能感觉到那股想跟她耍嘴皮子的冲动在这位法师体内翻涌；那种忍不住要倾泻讽刺的本能渴望。但已经没有意义了。在亲王妃那令人窒息的注视下，站在挨打的范围内，毫无意义。他只是垂下头，肩膀松垮下去。“是我，泰西斯。是我干的。就是我。” 泰西斯没有问为什么。她什么也没问。她只是动手打了瓦斯科，一记握紧拳头的重拳砸在他肚子上，打得他踉跄着撞上墙壁。全靠尾巴撑着，他才没有倒下。“你这该死的畜生！” 泰西斯沉下脸，朝她的卫兵吹了声口哨。“把他带走。堵上他的嘴。把手锁起来，连手指都锁上。埃万德明天早上会来伸张正义。” 瓦斯科恨恨地看了你一眼，随即一只有力的手扣住他的肩膀，把他拖走了。

rows.original:
Tethy doesn't look any happier now that the criminal is in custody. Her hands rest on her hips, and her brow is furrowed deep enough to leave her looking like a bird of prey. 
    
    [kythie.isCursed
        |"Without anyone to poison her again, the Astrida should be able to fix Kythie now," you suggest, trying to snap Tethys out of it.
        
        Her eyes shift to you slowly. "About time." She sighs, long and hard. Her shoulder slump. "Thank you, Champion. I... thank you. Allow me some time to arrange things with Eirina. You will have your reward once my daughter is cured once and for all. And once the villain meets justice."
        
        You nod. "Tomorrow?"
        
        "Tomorrow, goddess willing."
        |"Are you alright, Tethys?" you ask. "The villain's been caught, you're daughter's cured..."
        
        "I wish I was," she says. She sighs, long and hard. Her shoulder slump. "Thank you, Champion. I... thank you. I will be alright, eventually. This has all been so... awful."
        
        She shakes her head. "You have done the realm a great service, finding the viper in our midst. I pray there was only the one."
        
        So far that you've found...
        
        "You've more than earned your commission, Champion. I will have our treasurer ensure you receive the rest by day's end. Now, I must tell Evander what's happened. You may excuse yourself."
    ]
rows.translation:
罪犯已经收押，泰西斯看上去却没有半点高兴。她双手叉腰，眉头皱得深到让她看起来像一只猛禽。 
    
    [kythie.isCursed
        |“既然没人能再给她下毒了，阿斯特里达现在应该能治好凯西，”你提议道，想把泰西斯从那股情绪里拉出来。
        
        她的目光缓缓移向你。“总算。”她长长地、重重地叹了口气。肩膀垮了下来。“谢谢你，冠军。我……谢谢你。给我些时间去跟艾瑞娜安排。等我女儿彻底痊愈、等那恶人受到审判，你就会拿到你的报酬。”
        
        你点点头。“明天？”

        |It takes a while, given that you're alone, but
        |[companion1.name] helps you, providing support while you waddle your way along until
        |Your companions are a boon, [companion1.name] and [companion2.name] working to help you until
    ] ultimately you stumble through the front door of the nursery.
    
    Gwyn doesn't waste a moment, having sprung into action the moment her keen ears picked up your wobbly steps. The matronly wolf guides you to a prepared area, where you're ready to finally greet your child.
    
    "Deep breaths, [pc.name]. Now, push!"
    "

rows.original:
The details of the birth itself are foggy, and you blink yourself awake groggily some time later.
    
    [vasko.name] is sitting next to you when you turn your head to look around, a small bundle swaddled in cloth held gently in [vasko.hisHer] arms.
    
    [vasko.anyKids
        |"[vasko.isBimbo
            |[var0
                |He
                |She
            ]'s so cute, [pc.name]!" Her voice is softer than her normal boisterous sound, likely so she doesn't wake the little one in her arms. "You did so amazing, sweetie." Vaska beams at you with so much love and affection that you almost feel blinded.
            |[var0
                |He
                |She
            ]'s beautiful, my dear. You did well to keep [var0
                |him
                |her
            ] safe all this time." He gives you a rare, genuine smile. 
        ]
        |"A girl." [vasko.HeShe] says, eyes locked on the bundle in [vasko.hisHer] arms.
        
        Huh?
        
        "We've got a wonderful baby girl[vasko.isBimbo
            |!
            |.
        ]" [vasko.HeShe] finally looks up to meet your gaze and you're [vasko.isBimbo
            |not all that surprised to see massive crocodile tears in her big eyes. "She's just, like, so awesome, y'know?" She sniffles.
            |surprised to see his eyes are watery with unshed emotion. "She's beautiful, my dear. Truly beautiful."
        ]
        
        [vasko.HeShe]'s silent for a moment longer before opening [vasko.hisHer] mouth again, almost hesitant. "[vasko.isBimbo
            |I know it's, like, more common for the birth-mommy to name the baby, but I've always wanted a baby girl to name Chryse. Is that... is that okay for her? She looks like a Chryse to me.
            |I know it's tradition for the one who actually gives birth to name the baby, but... I've always wanted my firstborn — if they were to be a girl — to be named Chryse. It would mean a lot to me if we could name her that.
        ]"
        
        Chryse... you like it. Welcome to the world, little Chryse.
        
        [vasko.name] gives you a watery, thankful smile.
    ]
    
    You scoot yourself up until you're propped against the headboard, holding your arms out so you can see your baby; [var0
        |he
        |she
    ]'s deposited carefully, the [vasko.isBimbo
        |sweet bimbo
        |magister
    ] holding the babe's head until it rests in the crook of your arms.
    
    How did [vasko.heShe] know? Surely you couldn't have been out for three entire days.
    
    [vasko.isBimbo
        |"I just had a feeling!" She says proudly, hands planted on her hips. "Must be some special mommy thing, y'know? I just knew I needed to be here for you two."
        
        She's gonna take [var0
            |him
            |her
        ] back to Tychris, then?
        
        "Yup yup! There they can learn to read and be warm and cuddled all the time! But, like, come by and see us? We'll miss you lots if you don't!"
        
        Of course you will[pc.isBimbo
            |!
            |.
        ]
        |"I was already on my way here. I estimated it was almost about time for our child to arrive, so I wanted to be here for their birth."
        
        He plans to take [var0|him|her] back to Tychris, then?
        
        "Yes. There I can assure they'll have a good and proper start to life."
        
        Can you come by and see them?
        
        "Of course, my dear. Come visit anytime."
    ]
    
    Several hours of quiet chatter back and forth between you and the [vasko.isBimbo
        |bimbo
        |court magister
    ] pass until, finally, [vasko.heShe] gathers up your [var0
        |son
        |daughter
    ] and leaves, headed for the City of Glass.
    
    Tugging your [pc.gear] back on, it's about time for you to head out, too.
rows.translation:
分娩本身的细节已经模糊不清；过了一段时间，你才昏昏沉沉地眨着眼醒来。
    
    你转头查看周围时，[vasko.name]正坐在你身旁，[vasko.hisHer]怀中轻柔地抱着一个裹在襁褓里的小小身影。
    
    [vasko.anyKids
        |“[vasko.isBimbo
            |[var0
                |他
                |她
            ]太可爱了，[pc.name]！”她的声音比平日那洪亮的嗓门轻柔许多，大概是不想吵醒怀中的小家伙。“亲爱的，你做得太棒了。”瓦斯卡满怀爱意地朝你灿烂一笑，几乎让你觉得睁不开眼。
            |[var0
                |他
                |她
            ]真漂亮，亲爱的。你一直把[var0
                |他
                |她
            ]保护得很好。”他难得地向你露出一个真诚的微笑。 
        ]
        |“是个女孩。”[vasko.HeShe]说道，目光牢牢锁在[vasko.hisHer]怀中的襁褓上。
        
        啊？
        
        “我们有了一个可爱的女宝宝[vasko.isBimbo
            |！
            |。
        ]”[vasko.HeShe]终于抬眼与你对视；你[vasko.isBimbo
            |并不怎么意外地发现，她那双大眼睛里滚落着豆大的泪珠。“她就是，呃，太棒了，你懂吧？”她抽了抽鼻子。
            |惊讶地发现，他眼中含着尚未落下的泪水。“她真美，亲爱的。真的很美。”
        ]
        
        [vasko.HeShe]又沉默了片刻，才近乎犹豫地张开[vasko.hisHer]嘴，再次说道。“[vasko.isBimbo
            |我知道，一般都是生下宝宝的妈妈给她取名，但我一直都想给女宝宝取名叫克丽丝。给她取这个名字……可以吗？我觉得她看起来就像个克丽丝。
            |我知道按传统应由真正分娩的人为孩子取名，但……我一直希望自己的长子——如果是女孩的话——能叫克丽丝。如果我们能这样为她命名，对我意义重大。
        ]”
        
        克丽丝……你喜欢这个名字。欢迎来到这个世界，小克丽丝。
        
        [vasko.name]含泪向你投来一个感激的微笑。
    ]
    
    你挪动身体，直到背靠床头坐稳，然后伸出双臂，好让自己看看宝宝；[var0
        |他
        |她
    ]被小心翼翼地交到你手中，那位[vasko.isBimbo
        |可爱的痴女
        |大法师
    ]托着宝宝的脑袋，直到它安稳地落进你的臂弯。
    
    [vasko.heShe]是怎么知道的？你总不可能整整昏睡了三天吧。
    
    [vasko.isBimbo
        |“我就是有种感觉！”她双手叉腰，骄傲地说道。“一定是某种特别的妈妈直觉，懂吧？我就是知道自己得来陪着你们俩。”
        
        那么，她要把[var0
            |他
            |她
        ]带回提克里斯吗？
        
        “嗯嗯！在那里，他们可以学会读书，还能一直被暖暖地抱着！不过，那个，要来看我们哦？你不来的话，我们会非常想你的！”
        
        你当然会去[pc.isBimbo
            |！
            |。
        ]
        |“我本来就在来这里的路上。我估算过，我们的孩子差不多该出生了，所以我想赶来见证其降生。”
        
        那么，他打算把[var0|他|她]带回提克里斯吗？
        
        “是的。在那里，我能确保孩子的人生拥有一个良好而妥善的开端。”
        
        你能去看他们吗？
        
        “当然可以，亲爱的。随时都可以来看望。”
    ]
    
    你和这位[vasko.isBimbo
        |痴女
        |宫廷大法师
    ]安静地聊了几个小时；最后，[vasko.heShe]抱起你们的[var0
        |儿子
        |女儿
    ]离开，前往玻璃之城。
    
    你重新穿好[pc.gear]，差不多也该出发了。

rows.original: Popping your head into the frostmander's lab, you're met with the peculiar sight of it being surprisingly empty. It's strange[vasko.isBimbo |; even though she's recently become much more friendly and social with the others in the castle, she still spends a lot of time in here | – especially for someone like Vasko, whom you hardly see anywhere else when he has his experiments and tests all in this room ]. A quick glance around shows that, no, [vasko.heShe] really isn't here — [vasko.heShe] isn't even taking a nap in the connecting bedroom. Though you do see a short, written note sitting on [vasko.hisHer] nightstand. Picking it up, it reads: [vasko.isBimbo |Hey Sweetie! I'm spending some time with our little bug here on the castle grounds. They've got caregivers to look after kids while the staff is working, so I drop by to visit Chryse there! Come join us!! Vaska ♡ |My dear [pc.name], Should you see this note, it means you've stopped by before I could return. I am visiting our daughter where she resides in the care of caretakers set up for working staff with children. If it pleases you, come join us. Vasko ] [pc.dcb |You guess you have the free time. |You have some free time, and you definitely want to see your little girl... why not? |Heck yes, you'd love to see your sweet baby!! ] The note doesn't actually mention any instructions for where, exactly, the nursery room is, so you sort of just wander a little bit until you finally reach it. It doesn't turn out to be that hard to figure out where it is, since you can hear the happy laughter and giggles of small children down the hall from where the room actually sits. The door itself is cracked open the slightest bit, granting you a small peek into the room before you open it fully. It's a very large room set up with a small kitchen in one corner and fully equipped for a wide range of ages. From small playpens and cribs, to a small but varied selection of books in a pseudo library, to a small area that looks set up to teach or tutor children of many ages. Several frostscales attend to the handful of children here, from a couple toddlers to the oldest, who looks to be roughly 12 years of age. One of them, a particularly curvaceous frostscale with untameably curly hair and a mole on her cheek, notices you and quickly comes to greet you at the doorway. "Hello," she says, voice soft yet laced with something protectively fierce. "My name is Myrine, and I'm the matron here. Can I help you with something...?" You quickly explain that you're looking for [vasko.name], and that a note said [vasko.heShe]'d be here. Immediately her body relaxes, giving you a smile instead. "Ahhh, I see! My apologies; one can never be too careful with an unfamiliar face. [vasko.HeShe]'s over there." [vasko.name] stands near the cribs, Chryse cradled in [vasko.hisHer] arms while [vasko.heShe] [vasko.isBimbo |coos at her with watery eyes |smiles at the way she gnaws at a scaled fingertip ]. [vasko.HeShe] gently bounces her; one hand alternates between rubs and soft pats against her back. The [vasko.isBimbo |bimbo |court mage ] looks back at you when you reach [vasko.hisHer] side and gives you a [vasko.isBimbo |beaming |soft ] smile. "[vasko.isBimbo |Hey, Sweetie. You got my note! |Hello, my dear. I see you got my note. ]" You were surprised to not see [vasko.himHer] in [vasko.hisHer] lab. Has [vasko.heShe] been here long? "I was about to head back to the lab, since she's about ready for a nap. I had some free time and I wanted to see her." [vasko.HeShe] wraps [vasko.hisHer] tail around one of your legs, the cool aurora at the tip tickling your [pc.skinFurScalesNounSimple]. [vasko.HisHer] eyes don't waver from the wiggling bundle of salamander baby in [vasko.hisHer] grasp. You get a good look at Chryse for the first time since she was born. The little frostscale is about as plump as a newborn can be, all chubby cheeks and pudgy belly. She's also got the same blue scales that [vasko.name] does, still soft with the newness of birth. Her tail tip has the barest flame started, already flickering in a beautiful aurora. But her eyes? Those are all yours. Even as they slip closed, she is indisputably yours and [vasko.name]'s. [vasko.isBimbo |"Babies weren't really anything I gave a whole lotta thought to, you know? Like, they happen, yeah, but I didn't think about ME having one. |"I wasn't really sure about having a child, at first. I didn't have the best experience myself when I was younger and I wasn't sure I'd really know what to do with a baby. ]" [vasko.name] leans against your side, [vasko.hisHer] skin cool. "But goddess, she's perfect." Reluctantly [vasko.heShe] transfers the sleeping babe from [vasko.hisHer] arms to the crib with all the care of a parent trying not to wake up a fussy child. Chryse settles peacefully without complaint, a sleepy snuffle her only response. The [vasko.isBimbo |bimbo |court mage ] uses [vasko.hisHer] tail to nudge you towards the entrance, nodding once to a matron that waves the two of you goodbye while you close the door of the nursery behind you. "I'm heading back to my lab now, [vasko.isBimbo |Sweetie |my dear ], but come find me whenever you want to visit our daughter, okay? We'll go together; spend some time as a family, if we get the chance." Reaching [vasko.hisHer] lab, the frostmander turns to you. "Now, what can I do for you, [vasko.isBimbo |hun |[pc.name] ]?"
rows.translation: 你把头探进冰霜火蜥蜴的实验室，却看到里面出奇地空无一人，不禁觉得有些古怪[vasko.isBimbo |；虽说她最近变得友善合群了许多，但还是常常待在这里 |——尤其是瓦斯科这种把实验和测试全放在这间屋里、平时几乎不会在别处露面的人 ]。 你迅速环顾四周，确认[vasko.heShe]确实不在——[vasko.heShe]甚至也没有在相连的卧室里打盹。不过，你倒是在[vasko.hisHer]床头柜上看见了一张简短的字条。 你拿起来一看，上面写着： [vasko.isBimbo |亲爱的！ 我正在城堡里陪我们的小可爱！这里有照顾员工孩子的看护员，所以我会来这里看克丽丝！ 快来和我们一起玩！！ 瓦斯卡 ♡ |亲爱的[pc.name]： 如果你看到这张字条，说明你在我回来之前来过了。我正在看望我们的女儿；工作人员工作期间，她会住在为有孩子的员工设置的托儿处。如果你愿意，请来和我们团聚。 瓦斯科 ] [pc.dcb |你想自己正好有空。 |你有些空闲，而且确实很想见见自己的小女儿……何乐而不为呢？ |当然要去，你太想见自己的可爱宝宝了！！ ] 字条其实没写育婴室究竟在哪里，于是你只能四处转悠了一会儿，最终才找到那里。不过想判断位置并不算难，因为还没走到门口，你便已经能听见走廊那头传来的孩童欢笑声。 房门微微敞着一条缝，你在彻底推开之前，得以先窥见里面的一角。这间屋子非常宽敞，角落里设有一间小厨房，各种设施足以照顾不同年龄的孩子：既有小型围栏和婴儿床，也有一处宛如小图书馆、种类丰富的藏书区，还有一片似乎专门用于教授或辅导各年龄段孩童的地方。 几名冰鳞火蜥蜴照料着屋里的几个孩子，年龄从蹒跚学步的幼儿到看起来大约十二岁的孩子不等。 其中一名身材格外丰腴、卷发怎么也理不顺、脸颊上还有颗美人痣的冰鳞火蜥蜴注意到你，很快便来到门口迎接。 “你好，”她柔声说道，嗓音中却带着一股保护幼崽般的强硬。“我叫米琳，是这里的女管事。请问有什么事吗……？” 你赶紧解释自己在找[vasko.name]，而字条上说[vasko.heShe]会在这里。 她立刻放松下来，转而向你露出微笑。“啊，我明白了！请原谅；面对陌生面孔，再小心也不为过。[vasko.HeShe]就在那边。” [vasko.name]站在婴儿床附近，将克丽丝抱在[vasko.hisHer]怀里；[vasko.heShe][vasko.isBimbo |眼含泪光地对她柔声细语 |微笑着看她啃咬自己覆着鳞片的指尖 ]。[vasko.HeShe]轻轻摇晃着她；一只手轮流在她背上抚摸、轻拍。 这位[vasko.isBimbo |痴女 |宫廷法师 ]在你来到[vasko.hisHer]身旁时回头看向你，露出一个[vasko.isBimbo |灿烂的 |温柔的 ]微笑。“[vasko.isBimbo |嗨，亲爱的。你看到我的字条了！ |你好，亲爱的。看来你看到我的字条了。 ]” 没看到[vasko.himHer]出现在[vasko.hisHer]实验室，你还挺惊讶的。[vasko.heShe]来这里很久了吗？ “她差不多该睡午觉了，我本来也准备回实验室。我正好有空，便想来看看她。”[vasko.HeShe]用[vasko.hisHer]尾巴缠住你的一条腿，尾尖冰凉的极光挠得你的[pc.skinFurScalesNounSimple]微微发痒。[vasko.HisHer]目光始终没有离开[vasko.hisHer]怀里扭动着的火蜥蜴宝宝。 自克丽丝出生以来，你第一次得以仔细端详她。 这个冰鳞火蜥蜴宝宝胖乎乎的，圆润的脸颊和肉嘟嘟的小肚子无不透着新生儿的可爱。她还长着与[vasko.name]相同的蓝色鳞片，只是初生的鳞片依旧柔软。她的尾尖刚刚燃起最微弱的火焰，已经开始闪烁出美丽的极光。 至于她的眼睛？ 那可全都随你。 即使她缓缓合上双眼，也毫无疑问是你和[vasko.name]的孩子。 [vasko.isBimbo |“我以前从没怎么认真想过宝宝的事，你懂吧？就是，当然会有人生宝宝，可我没想过自己会有一个。 |“一开始，我其实不确定自己是否想要孩子。我小时候的经历算不上好，也不知道自己是否真的懂得该怎么照顾宝宝。 ]”[vasko.name]靠在你身侧，[vasko.hisHer]肌肤一片冰凉。“不过，女神在上，她太完美了。” [vasko.heShe]依依不舍地将熟睡的宝宝从[vasko.hisHer]怀中放进婴儿床，动作无比小心，唯恐惊醒这个可能哭闹起来的小家伙。 克丽丝安静地睡着，没有半点不满，只发出一声睡梦中的轻哼。 这位[vasko.isBimbo |痴女 |宫廷法师 ]用[vasko.hisHer]尾巴轻推你走向出口，又朝一位女管事点了点头；你们轻轻关上育婴室的门时，对方挥手向你们道别。 “我现在要回实验室了，[vasko.isBimbo |亲爱的 |亲爱的 ]。不过，只要你想看女儿，就来找我，好吗？我们一起过来；有机会的话，就作为一家人共度一段时光。” 回到[vasko.hisHer]实验室后，冰霜火蜥蜴转向你。 “那么，有什么需要我效劳的吗，[vasko.isBimbo |亲爱的 |[pc.name] ]？”
rows.raw: " Popping your head into the frostmander's lab, you're met with the peculiar sight of it being surprisingly empty. It's strange[vasko.isBimbo |; even though she's recently become much more friendly and social with the others in the castle, she still spends a lot of time in here | – especially for someone like Vasko, whom you hardly see anywhere else when he has his experiments and tests all in this room ]. A quick glance around shows that, no, [vasko.heShe] really isn't here — [vasko.heShe] isn't even taking a nap in the connecting bedroom. Though you do see a short, written note sitting on [vasko.hisHer] nightstand. Picking it up, it reads: [vasko.isBimbo |Hey Sweetie! I'm spending some time with our little bug here on the castle grounds. They've got caregivers to look after kids while the staff is working, so I drop by to visit Chryse there! Come join us!! Vaska ♡ |My dear [pc.name], Should you see this note, it means you've stopped by before I could return. I am visiting our daughter where she resides in the care of caretakers set up for working staff with children. If it pleases you, come join us. Vasko ] [pc.dcb |You guess you have the free time. |You have some free time, and you definitely want to see your little girl... why not? |Heck yes, you'd love to see your sweet baby!! ] The note doesn't actually mention any instructions for where, exactly, the nursery room is, so you sort of just wander a little bit until you finally reach it. It doesn't turn out to be that hard to figure out where it is, since you can hear the happy laughter and giggles of small children down the hall from where the room actually sits. The door itself is cracked open the slightest bit, granting you a small peek into the room before you open it fully. It's a very large room set up with a small kitchen in one corner and fully equipped for a wide range of ages. From small playpens and cribs, to a small but varied selection of books in a pseudo library, to a small area that looks set up to teach or tutor children of many ages. Several frostscales attend to the handful of children here, from a couple toddlers to the oldest, who looks to be roughly 12 years of age. One of them, a particularly curvaceous frostscale with untameably curly hair and a mole on her cheek, notices you and quickly comes to greet you at the doorway. "Hello," she says, voice soft yet laced with something protectively fierce. "My name is Myrine, and I'm the matron here. Can I help you with something...?" You quickly explain that you're looking for [vasko.name], and that a note said [vasko.heShe]'d be here. Immediately her body relaxes, giving you a smile instead. "Ahhh, I see! My apologies; one can never be too careful with an unfamiliar face. [vasko.HeShe]'s over there." [vasko.name] stands near the cribs, Chryse cradled in [vasko.hisHer] arms while [vasko.heShe] [vasko.isBimbo |coos at her with watery eyes |smiles at the way she gnaws at a scaled fingertip ]. [vasko.HeShe] gently bounces her; one hand alternates between rubs and soft pats against her back. The [vasko.isBimbo |bimbo |court mage ] looks back at you when you reach [vasko.hisHer] side and gives you a [vasko.isBimbo |beaming |soft ] smile. "[vasko.isBimbo |Hey, Sweetie. You got my note! |Hello, my dear. I see you got my note. ]" You were surprised to not see [vasko.himHer] in [vasko.hisHer] lab. Has [vasko.heShe] been here long? "I was about to head back to the lab, since she's about ready for a nap. I had some free time and I wanted to see her." [vasko.HeShe] wraps [vasko.hisHer] tail around one of your legs, the cool aurora at the tip tickling your [pc.skinFurScalesNounSimple]. [vasko.HisHer] eyes don't waver from the wiggling bundle of salamander baby in [vasko.hisHer] grasp. You get a good look at Chryse for the first time since she was born. The little frostscale is about as plump as a newborn can be, all chubby cheeks and pudgy belly. She's also got the same blue scales that [vasko.name] does, still soft with the newness of birth. Her tail tip has the barest flame started, already flickering in a beautiful aurora. But her eyes? Those are all yours. Even as they slip closed, she is indisputably yours and [vasko.name]'s. [vasko.isBimbo |"Babies weren't really anything I gave a whole lotta thought to, you know? Like, they happen, yeah, but I didn't think about ME having one. |"I wasn't really sure about having a child, at first. I didn't have the best experience myself when I was younger and I wasn't sure I'd really know what to do with a baby. ]" [vasko.name] leans against your side, [vasko.hisHer] skin cool. "But goddess, she's perfect." Reluctantly [vasko.heShe] transfers the sleeping babe from [vasko.hisHer] arms to the crib with all the care of a parent trying not to wake up a fussy child. Chryse settles peacefully without complaint, a sleepy snuffle her only response. The [vasko.isBimbo |bimbo |court mage ] uses [vasko.hisHer] tail to nudge you towards the entrance, nodding once to a matron that waves the two of you goodbye while you close the door of the nursery behind you. "I'm heading back to my lab now, [vasko.isBimbo |Sweetie |my dear ], but come find me whenever you want to visit our daughter, okay? We'll go together; spend some time as a family, if we get the chance." Reaching [vasko.hisHer] lab, the frostmander turns to you. "Now, what can I do for you, [vasko.isBimbo |hun |[pc.name] ]?" "
